Episodes.Description: When Lisa spots a new best friend from the window of the bus, she gets a taste of what life could be like with a different, more cultured family.

Episodes.Title: I'm Dancing as Fat as I Can
Episodes.Description: Homer angers Marge by binging their favorite show without her, and has to pick up a new skill in order to make amends. Meanwhile, Bart prepares to compete in "Krusty's Holiday Trample".

Episodes.Title: The Clown Stays in the Picture
Episodes.Description: Krusty reveals the untold story of his past in his movie "The Sands of Space". While working as personal assistants on the movie, Bart and Lisa learn about the early years of their parents' relationship.

Episodes.Title: 101 Mitigations
Episodes.Description: Comic Book Guy sues Homer for joyriding in his car. Meanwhile, Guillermo del Toro saves Mr. Burns from his troubles with the law.

Episodes.Title: I Want You (She's So Heavy)
Episodes.Description: When a romantic night ends in injury, Marge recovers by taking up kite boarding while Homer bonds with his hallucinated hernia; Lisa attempts to fix her parents' strained relationship by seeking advice from an unlikely source.

Episodes.Title: E My Sports
Episodes.Description: As Bart begins to excel in video game competitions, Homer discovers a passion for coaching him; Lisa attempts to bring Homer back to reality, but the plan causes chaos.

Episodes.Title: Bart vs. Itchy & Scratchy
Episodes.Description: Krusty releases an all-female reboot of “Itchy and Scratchy,” so Bart and his crew of all-male friends decide to boycott the show. After Bart’s friends turn on him for laughing at the reboot, Bart joins a woke group of sixth-grade girls who commit crimes against patriarchy.

Episodes.Title: Girl's in the Band
Episodes.Description: Homer works extra shifts at the plant so Lisa can play in the Capitol City Philharmonic.

Episodes.Title: I'm Just a Girl Who Can't Say D'oh
Episodes.Description: Marge becomes director of Springfield's local theater, armed with Lisa's script resembling "Hamilton"; Homer joins a baby class with Maggie, and he takes a liking to supervisor Chloe.

Episodes.Title: D'oh Canada
Episodes.Description: Lisa is mistakenly given political asylum in Canada during a family trip to Niagara Falls.

Episodes.Title: Woo-Hoo Dunnit?
Episodes.Description: The documentary crime series "Dateline: Springfield" goes in-depth to solve the case of Lisa’s missing college fund.

Episodes.Title: Crystal Blue-Haired Persuasion
Episodes.Description: Marge starts a business selling healing crystals to the naive mothers of Springfield when Homer’s work cuts children’s health-care benefits, leading Marge to use the crystals as a cheaper solution for Bart’s ADD.

Episodes.Title: The Winter of Our Monetized Content
Episodes.Description: When a video of Bart and Homer fighting goes viral, they begin a journey as social media celebrities; Lisa battles the school's new industrialized detention system.

Episodes.Title: Go Big or Go Homer
Episodes.Description: Homer must supervise interns, among whom is a go-getter who asks Homer to be his mentor.

Episodes.Title: The Fat Blue Line
Episodes.Description: During the San Castellanta street festival, much of the town finds their wallets have been pickpocketed; after the state investigator puts the wrong man in jail, Chief Wiggum sets out to catch the real criminal and show he's still up for police work.

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror XXX
Episodes.Description: The 666th episode of the Simpsons parodies the Omen and Stranger Things, not to mention a little Crazy Rich Aliens.

Episodes.Title: Gorillas on the Mast
Episodes.Description: After a trip to Aquatraz Water Park, Lisa becomes determined to set free Springfield's most vicious animals in captivity. Meanwhile, Homer fulfills a lifelong dream of buying a boat, and quickly realizes boat ownership sucks.

Episodes.Title: Marge the Lumberjill
Episodes.Description: When Marge realizes that everyone views her as boring, she takes up competitive lumber-jacking as a hobby (and has a real gift for it). The circuit of competitive timbersports takes her on a month-long retreat to Portland with her trainer, Paula, whom Homer worries is going to steal her away forever

Episodes.Title: Livin La Pura Vida
Episodes.Description: The Simpsons join other Springfield families on the Van Houten's annual trip to Costa Rica, which they obviously can't afford. While there, Homer befriends Patty's new girlfriend, Evelyn, and Lisa tracks down the real reason the Van Houtens can go on this trip every year

Episodes.Title: Thanksgiving of Horror
Episodes.Description: The Simpsons face various Thanksgiving nightmares, including the first Thanksgiving, an A.I. mishap and a dangerous space mission complicated by a sentient cranberry sauce.

Episodes.Title: Todd, Todd, Why Hast Thou Forsaken Me?
Episodes.Description: Todd blames God for the death of his mother and rejects his faith, so Ned sends him to live with the Simpsons, hoping they can scare him into believing in God again.

Episodes.Title: Bobby: It's Cold Outside
Episodes.Description: Sideshow Bob gets contracted as this year’s mall Santa. Meanwhile, someone is stealing all the Christmas packages off people’s front porches.

Episodes.Title: Hail to the Teeth
Episodes.Description: Homer and Marge attend Artie Ziff’s wedding and become quite uncomfortable when they realize that his bride-to-be is a clone of Marge. Meanwhile, Lisa grapples with the misogynistic implications of the immediate popularity she receives after getting her new Invisalign braces.

Episodes.Title: The Miseducation of Lisa Simpson
Episodes.Description: Marge recruits Chrissy Teigen and John Legend for an education-based proposal.

Episodes.Title: Frinkcoin
Episodes.Description: Lisa decides to do an essay on Professor Frink just as the scientist invents a new cryptocurrency. When this makes him the richest man in Springfield, Mr. Burns sees red and he starts plotting against Frink in order to restore his former status, while Frink learns who his real friends are.

Episodes.Title: Bart the Bad Guy
Episodes.Description: Bart accidentally sees a new superhero movie one month before its intended release, and uses his knowledge to terrorize the other fans. Two executive producers of the film attempt to prevent Bart from leaking any more news to the public.

Episodes.Title: Screenless
Episodes.Description: When Marge implements a screen time limit for the family, she realizes that she is the one addicted.

Episodes.Title: Better Off Ned
Episodes.Description: Bart bonds with Ned Flanders, which leaves Homer jealous, so he retaliates by mentoring Nelson Muntz; a heroic act by Homer makes Bart look up to him again.

Episodes.Title: Highway to Well
Episodes.Description: When Maggie goes to preschool, Marge decides to get a job to pass the time and ends up working at an upscale weed dispensary; Homer decides to open his own dispensary that mimics a sketchy drug deal, putting their two businesses at odds.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Lightness of Being a Baby
Episodes.Description: Mr. Burns tasks Homer with swindling Cletus Spuckler out of his newfound helium fortune. Meanwhile, Maggie is reunited with Hudson from Playdate with Destiny again, only for Marge to tear them apart after his mother annoys her.

Episodes.Title: Warrin' Priests (1)
Episodes.Description: Helen Lovejoy's request for a youth pastor is answered by Bode Wright, a charismatic young preacher from Michigan. When Bode quickly has the Springfield congregation enamored by his easy-going and liberal approach to religion, an outcast and suspicious Reverend Lovejoy decides to look into the newcomer's past.

Episodes.Title: Warrin' Priests (2)
Episodes.Description: While Bode has won over most of Springfield, he finds one churchgoer he can't sway in Ned Flanders. Meanwhile in Michigan, Reverend Lovejoy finds the ammunition he needs to get rid of his replacement.

Episodes.Title: The Hateful Eight-Year-Olds
Episodes.Description: After severing her sibling ties with Bart, Lisa attends a sleepover at her new friend Addy's house, only to discover that Addy's clique are a group of cruel snobby rich girls that taunt her. Meanwhile, Homer takes Marge on a sunset cruise for the evening and finds himself at odds with the boat's cover band.

Episodes.Title: The Way of the Dog
Episodes.Description: Santa's Little Helper nips at Marge, causing the family to reflect on the difficult life that the dog led prior to being adopted by the family. They end up reuniting him with his mother to avoid having to euthanize him.

Episodes.Title: Undercover Burns
Episodes.Description: Mr. Burns goes undercover as "Fred" at the nuclear power plant and becomes friends with Homer and the gang. Burns implements all sorts of amenities to improve his employees' lives, but a jealous Smithers plots to bring the old, bitter Burns back and destroy Fred.

Episodes.Title: I, Carumbus
Episodes.Description: At a museum exhibit of Ancient Rome, Marge and Homer get into an argument about Homer's lack of ambition. They then imagine a Roman version of what would happen if Homer was more career-driven.

Episodes.Title: Now Museum, Now You Don't
Episodes.Description: Lisa stays home from school to explore the wonders of Western art. She appears as Lisanardo, while Bart takes the shape of a French impressionist, Homer and Marge as Diego Rivera and Frida Kahlo, and Maggie as a warrior Cupid.

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror XXXI
Episodes.Description: The 31st annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a frightening look at the 2020 election, parodies of Toy Story and Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and a 9th birthday Lisa just can't get over.

Episodes.Title: The 7 Beer Itch
Episodes.Description: Homer is tempted by a British femme fatale while Marge and the kids are on a seaside vacation.

Episodes.Title: Podcast News
Episodes.Description: Grampa Simpson is accused of a crime; Kent Brockman questions his career.

Episodes.Title: Three Dreams Denied
Episodes.Description: Bart becomes a voice-over actor; Comic Book Guy is humiliated at Comic-Con; Lisa is set up for a fall.

Episodes.Title: The Road to Cincinnati
Episodes.Description: Odd couple Skinner and Chalmers embark on an 800-mile car ride to Cincinnati to attend an administrator's convention - but can they reach their destination without killing each other first?

Episodes.Title: Sorry Not Sorry
Episodes.Description: Lisa calls her teacher, Ms. Hoover, a hack and refuses to apologize. Then, she learns Ms. Hoover's private pain.

Episodes.Title: A Springfield Summer Christmas for Christmas
Episodes.Description: A cable channel films a Christmas movie in Springfield and Skinner falls in love.

Episodes.Title: The Dad Feelings Limited
Episodes.Description: Comic Book Guy and his wife Kumiko debate about having a baby and we learn about his awesome origin story.

Episodes.Title: Diary Queen
Episodes.Description: Bart finds his old teacher's diary and learns a surprising secret. Then, Lisa discovers an even bigger surprise.

Episodes.Title: Wad Goals
Episodes.Description: Bart becomes a successful caddy, but Marge worries it is ruining his character.

Episodes.Title: Yokel Hero
Episodes.Description: Cletus becomes a singing sensation, while Homer becomes a new man. Then, Cletus turns on his fans, ruining everything.

Episodes.Title: Do Pizza Bots Dream of Electric Guitars
Episodes.Description: Homer tries to reunite a mechanical band from his youth, but film and TV creator J.J. Abrams gets ahold of them first.

Episodes.Title: Manger Things
Episodes.Description: A secret of Flanders' Past and a never-before-seen room of the Simpson house are shown off.

Episodes.Title: Uncut Femmes
Episodes.Description: It is discovered that Chief Wiggum's wife is more than she seems. Meanwhile, Marge takes part in a jewel heist.

Episodes.Title: Burger Kings
Episodes.Description: Mr. Burns gets into the plant-based burger business. Lisa refuses to believe he's up to no good.

Episodes.Title: Panic on the Streets of Springfield
Episodes.Description: Lisa gets a new imaginary friend - a depressed British singer from the 1980s. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a truck guy.

Episodes.Title: Mother and Child Reunion
Episodes.Description: Lisa makes a shocking college decision, wounding Marge. It leads to a very surprising place.

Episodes.Title: The Man from G.R.A.M.P.A.
Episodes.Description: A British secret agent comes to Springfield in search of a Russian spy.

Episodes.Title: The Last Barfighter
Episodes.Description: After Moe breaks their most sacred rule, a secret society of bartenders seeks ultimate vengeance on Homer and his friends.

Episodes.Title: The Star of the Backstage
Episodes.Description: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show - but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

Episodes.Title: Bart's in Jail
Episodes.Description: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror XXXII
Episodes.Description: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Wayz We Were
Episodes.Description: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

Episodes.Title: Lisa's Belly
Episodes.Description: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

Episodes.Title: A Serious Flanders (1)
Episodes.Description: When a ruthless debt collector come to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artificial world of prestige TV.

Episodes.Title: A Serious Flanders (2)
Episodes.Description: Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse in the stunning conclusion of this 'Simpflix' prestige crime thriller.

Episodes.Title: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
Episodes.Description: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but will his new relationship destroy Springfield?

Episodes.Title: Mothers and Other Strangers
Episodes.Description: In a flashback, Homer goes on a road trip with his father to find his mother.

Episodes.Title: A Made Maggie
Episodes.Description: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

Episodes.Title: The Longest Marge
Episodes.Description: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for the soul of a brash young football prodigy.

Episodes.Title: Pixelated and Afraid
Episodes.Description: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

Episodes.Title: Boyz N the Highlands
Episodes.Description: Bart, Martin and the bullies run for their lives when a weekend in the wilderness takes a dark turn.

Episodes.Title: You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About -- Act Three Will Shock You!
Episodes.Description: Homer becomes a pariah when footage of him allegedly leaving Santa's Little Helper in a hot car goes viral.

Episodes.Title: Bart the Cool Kid
Episodes.Description: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

Episodes.Title: Pretty Whittle Liar
Episodes.Description: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love ... of learning.

Episodes.Title: The Sound of Bleeding Gums
Episodes.Description: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy - and attempts to improve his life.

Episodes.Title: My Octopus and a Teacher
Episodes.Description: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

Episodes.Title: Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
Episodes.Description: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

Episodes.Title: Marge the Meanie
Episodes.Description: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

Episodes.Title: Meat Is Murder
Episodes.Description: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

Episodes.Title: Poorhouse Rock
Episodes.Description: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad - until a visit from a magical, singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.

Episodes.Title: Habeas Tortoise
Episodes.Description: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

Episodes.Title: One Angry Lisa
Episodes.Description: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

Episodes.Title: Lisa the Boy Scout
Episodes.Description: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

Episodes.Title: The King of Nice
Episodes.Description: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is!

Episodes.Title: Not It
Episodes.Description: Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
Episodes.Description: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

Episodes.Title: From Beer to Paternity
Episodes.Description: When Homer becomes Duffman's girl-dad hero, they go on a road trip with Lisa that threatens to expose Homer's terrible parenting.

Episodes.Title: Step Brother from the Same Planet
Episodes.Description: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather to his girlfriend's quirky young son. Lisa and Bart throw the ultimate slumber party.

Episodes.Title: When Nelson Met Lisa
Episodes.Description: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

Episodes.Title: Game Done Changed
Episodes.Description: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

Episodes.Title: Top Goon
Episodes.Description: Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery.

Episodes.Title: My Life as a Vlog
Episodes.Description: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

Episodes.Title: The Many Saints of Springfield
Episodes.Description: When Ned Flanders falls on hard times, Fat Tony makes him an offer he can't refuse.

Episodes.Title: Carl Carlson Rides Again
Episodes.Description: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

Episodes.Title: Bartless
Episodes.Description: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

Episodes.Title: Hostile Kirk Place
Episodes.Description: When Milhouse's Dad, Kirk, takes exception to a school history lesson that paints one of his ancestors in a bad light, Kirk goes on a crusade to censor and control the school curriculum -- a crusade that Homer co-opts for fun and profit.

Episodes.Title: Pin Gal
Episodes.Description: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

Episodes.Title: Fan-ily Feud
Episodes.Description: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

Episodes.Title: Write Off This Episode
Episodes.Description: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising.

Episodes.Title: The Very Hungry Caterpillars
Episodes.Description: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet… spending time in lockdown with each other.

Episodes.Title: Clown v. Board of Education
Episodes.Description: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

Episodes.Title: Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
Episodes.Description: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.

Episodes.Title: Homer's Crossing
Episodes.Description: Feeling worthless at work, Homer volunteers to be a school crossing guard. But when his safety squad receives too much funding, the crossing guards become a force to be feared.

Episodes.Title: A Mid-Childhood Night's Dream
Episodes.Description: Marge feels an overwhelming dread of the empty nest.

Episodes.Title: McMansion & Wife
Episodes.Description: When a new neighbor showers him with kindness, Homer thinks he's being tricked into buying a sports car at the dealership where the neighbor works - but the truth turns out to be even more sinister; Lisa neutralizes Nelson after he goes on a bullying spree.

Episodes.Title: Thirst Trap: A Corporate Love Story
Episodes.Description: In a parody documentary, a young college-dropout CEO embraces the Silicon Valley "fake it until you make it" philosophy and bewitches Mr. Burns into funding her highly dubious dream project.

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror XXXIV
Episodes.Description: After Bart is turned into an NFT, Marge fights though the blockchain to rescue her son. To track down a gruesome serial killer, Lisa turns to a murderer from her past. An outbreak transforms Springfielders into a plague of lazy, beer-loving oafs.

Episodes.Title: Iron Marge
Episodes.Description: When Marge's heart is broken by a bad birthday present, Bart and Lisa must dig into their mom's past to show that they really know her. Homer becomes a neighborhood fear-monger.

Episodes.Title: It's a Blunderful Life
Episodes.Description: Lisa recounts the story of how Homer was scapegoated for a power outage that plunged Springfield into darkness days before Thanksgiving.

Episodes.Title: AE Bonny Romance
Episodes.Description: When Groundskeeper Willie is kidnapped to Scotland, Bart and the Simpsons follow - only to discover that what awaits is Homer's worst nightmare.

Episodes.Title: Murder, She Boat
Episodes.Description: Lisa must solve a closed-boat mystery when Comic Book Guy's million-dollar action figure is "murdered" on a pop culture cruise.

Episodes.Title: Do the Wrong Thing
Episodes.Description: Homer and Bart become kings of the blue-collar sports circuit, but Marge suspects something dishonest at the core of their father-son bond.

Episodes.Title: Frinkenstein's Monster
Episodes.Description: Professor Frink secretly helps Homer, through a zoom interview, land a high-level position at a state-of-the-art nuclear plant in Shelbyville. But since Homer lacks the skills to actually perform the job, Frink must monitor Homer's work situation remotely and dictate his every word... causing Frink to fear he's created a monster.

Episodes.Title: Lisa Gets an F1
Episodes.Description: Lisa feels a need for speed as well a need for control of her anxiety when she becomes a pro kid go-cart racer.

Episodes.Title: Clan of the Cave Mom
Episodes.Description: A parenting disagreement between Marge and Luann Van Houten escalates into a life-or-death struggle for survival.

Episodes.Title: Night of the Living Wage
Episodes.Description: Marge gets a job in a high-pressure ghost kitchen, but when she tries to start a union, she gets more than she (collectively) bargained for.

Episodes.Title: Cremains of the Day
Episodes.Description: When someone in Homer's life passes away, he and guys from Moe's go on a road trip to scatter the ashes... but will their friendship die as well?

Episodes.Title: The Tell-Tale Pants
Episodes.Description: Marge comes upon a surprising windfall and, angry with Homer, spends it secretly on herself.

Episodes.Title: The Tipping Point
Episodes.Description: Homer loses his mind over tipping culture run amok.

Episodes.Title: Bart's Brain
Episodes.Description: Bart makes a new friend.

Episodes.Title: Bart's Birthday
Episodes.Description: Bart celebrates the most shocking birthday party of his entire life — one that might just change everyone in Springfield forever.

Episodes.Title: The Yellow Lotus
Episodes.Description: The Simpsons encounter death on vacation at a high-end resort.

Episodes.Title: Desperately Seeking Lisa
Episodes.Description: Lisa has a blazing misadventure in the dark world of Capital City's downtown art scene.

Episodes.Title: Shoddy Heat
Episodes.Description: An unearthed corpse opens up a cold case from Springfield in the 1980s… as well as a steamy relationship between young Grampa and Agnes Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror XXXV
Episodes.Description: Giant monsters created by political rage threaten to tear the town apart, a Victorian Mr. Burns is jump-scared on Thanksgiving by the ghosts of his abused workers, and Homer bonds with a pair of extra-terrestrial jeans in an unforgettable stop-motion adventure that can only be called… Denim.

Episodes.Title: Women in Shorts
Episodes.Description: Girls just want to have funny.

Episodes.Title: Treehouse of Horror Presents: Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes
Episodes.Description: A tattooed man at a mysterious night circus transports Lisa into three strange stories from the innocent 1950s, the chilling retro-present, and a brutalist future where prestige TV rules the world.

Episodes.Title: Convenience Airways
Episodes.Description: The Simpsons are trapped on a flight with the most unruly passengers in America.

Episodes.Title: Homer and Her Sisters
Episodes.Description: After a fight in an escape room, Krusty's truth-telling Aunt fixes Homer's relationship with Patty and Selma.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Flew Too Much
Episodes.Description: The new and improved Pin Pals travel to Capital City for their first ever state bowling championship.

Episodes.Title: Bottle Episode
Episodes.Description: Marge and Smithers team up to become wine-forging Robin Hoods.

Episodes.Title: The Flandshees of Innersimpson
Episodes.Description: Bart dips his toe into the world of celebrity DJ-ing, and Homer finally pushes Flanders too far.

Episodes.Title: The Last Man Expanding
Episodes.Description: Springfield becomes hooked on a miracle weight loss drug... all except Homer.

Episodes.Title: P.S. I Hate You
Episodes.Description: Marge's "nice-lady" reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.

Episodes.Title: Abe League of Their Moe
Episodes.Description: After Grampa and Moe recruit a Macedonian slugger to play in Springfield, it strains their friendship and the very integrity of baseball.

Episodes.Title: Stew Lies
Episodes.Description: Homer reinvigorates a celebrity chef's lost passion for food... with some help from the mob.

Episodes.Title: Full Heart, Empty Pool
Episodes.Description: Homer and Grampa team up to create a new sport that rivals pickleball, until Homer kicks Grampa off the team.

Episodes.Title: Estranger Things
Episodes.Description: When Bart & Lisa stop watching Itchy & Scratchy together, Marge fears that they'll start to drift apart... but she has no idea how bad things are about to get!

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Rick and Morty
Entries.Description: Rick is a mentally-unbalanced but scientifically gifted old man who has recently reconnected with his family. He spends most of his time involving his young grandson Morty in dangerous, outlandish adventures throughout space and alternate universes. Compounded with Morty's already unstable family life, these events cause Morty much distress at home and school.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Rick moves in with his daughter's family and establishes himself as a bad influence on his grandson, Morty.

Episodes.Title: Lawnmower Dog
Episodes.Description: Rick and Morty try to incept Morty's math teacher into giving Morty an 'A'.  Meanwhile, Rick gives Jerry a device to train their dog, Snuffles.

Episodes.Title: Anatomy Park
Episodes.Description: Christmas day, Rick's friend, Reuben, comes over for his annual medical checkup.  Meanwhile Jerry learns his parents have a new friend.

Episodes.Title: M. Night Shaym-Aliens!

Entries.Title: Dan Da Dan
Entries.Description: In a bet to prove whether ghosts or aliens exist, two high schoolers face terrifying paranormal threats, gain superpowers and maybe even fall in love?!

Episodes.Title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know!
Episodes.Description: Momo believes in ghosts. Okarun believes in aliens. To make each other believe what they deny, they head to a spot famous for UFO sightings and a spiritual hotspot.

Episodes.Title: That's a Space Alien, Ain't It?!
Episodes.Description: Momo awakens psychic powers, while Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny. They evacuate to Momo's house, but a giant alien appears before them.

Episodes.Title: It's a Granny vs. Granny Clash!
Episodes.Description: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

Episodes.Title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
Episodes.Description: Okarun and Momo arrive at the tunnel to confront Turbo Granny. Just when they think they've won, a giant crab spirit crashes through the wall.

Episodes.Title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
Episodes.Description: Momo and Okarun’s ordeal with Turbo Granny has brought them closer, but things remain awkward between them. Okarun realizes he still has a problem.

Episodes.Title: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
Episodes.Description: Turbo Granny reveals that Okarun's missing organs are contained within golden spheres. Aira, who has found one, now has the ability to see spirits.

Episodes.Title: To a Kinder World
Episodes.Description: Momo and Okarun manage to weaken Acrobatic Silky but make a shocking discovery regarding Aira. Acrobatic Silky suggests a surprising way to help.

Episodes.Title: I've Got This Funny Feeling
Episodes.Description: Aira begins to develop a crush on Okarun. As the three friends' emotions intertwine, they suddenly face another extraterrestrial emergency.

Episodes.Title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
Episodes.Description: Wielding Acrobatic Silky's power, Aira fights the Serpoians alongside Okarun and Momo. The frustrated Serpoians power up their crustacean-like minion.

Episodes.Title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
Episodes.Description: Okarun and the girls try to clean up some misunderstandings with their classmates. Later, the aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

Episodes.Title: First Love
Episodes.Description: Momo's childhood friend Jiji has come to stay with the Ayases. He explains that he needs Seiko’s help with some strange phenomena at his house.

Episodes.Title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
Episodes.Description: On the way to investigate the Enjoji house, Okarun feels uneasy about Jiji's closeness to Momo but finds himself drawn to his friendly nature.

Episodes.Title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
Episodes.Description: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. Just then, the doorbell rings.

Episodes.Title: The Evil Eye
Episodes.Description: In a bid to free Okarun and Momo from the Mongolian Death Worm’s psychic power, Jiji attempts to carry them to safety but runs into a powerful entity.

Episodes.Title: You Won't Get Away with This!
Episodes.Description: Unwilling to leave Jiji behind, Okarun helps Momo escape to the surface. Momo then begins forming a plan to expose the Death Worm to sunlight.

Episodes.Title: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
Episodes.Description: Momo tries to stop the magma, but the Kito family gets in her way. The tsuchinoko shrine priest joins the fray — but so does the possessed Jiji.

Episodes.Title: We Can All Stay There Together!
Episodes.Description: With everyone safely back at Seiko's house, Momo and the others discover that water has a surprising effect on how Evil Eye possesses Jiji's body.

Episodes.Title: We Became a Family
Episodes.Description: The hayashi musicians arrive and begin an energetic exorcism performance. But just when the ritual is about to succeed, Jiji makes a surprising plea.

Entries.Title: Kaiju No. 8
Entries.Description: In a world plagued by creatures known as Kaiju, Kafka Hibino aspired to enlist in The Defense Force. He makes a promise to enlist with his childhood friend, Mina Ashiro. Soon, life takes them in separate ways. While employed cleaning up after Kaiju battles, Kafka meets Reno Ichikawa. Reno's determination to join The Defense Force reawakens Kafka's promise to join Mina and protect humanity.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Became a Kaiju
Episodes.Description: Kafka Hibino has almost abandoned his dream of joining the anti-Kaiju "Defense Force." He now works in Kaiju clean-up, disposing of the bodies of slain Kaiju and thinking back with regret to the days he spent with his childhood friend Mina Ashiro, captain of Defense Force's Third Division.

Episodes.Title: The Kaiju Who Defeats Kaiju
Episodes.Description: After turning into a Kaiju, Kafka is forced to flee. His escape is interrupted, however, by the arrival of another Kaiju...

Episodes.Title: Revenge Match
Episodes.Description: Kafka arrives for one last shot at the Defense Force entry exam... but can he pass while keeping his Kaiju powers a secret?

Episodes.Title: Fortitude 9.8
Episodes.Description: An unexpected incident during the exam forces Kafka to use his powers at the risk of revealing his secret.

Episodes.Title: Joining Up!
Episodes.Description: Kafka is now a member of the Defense Force, if not a full-fledged one. But Hoshina tells him he has three months to prove himself before he's fired...

Episodes.Title: Sagamihara Neutralization Operation at Daybreak
Episodes.Description: It's time for Kafka's first mission, and he witnesses the true power of the Defense Force when a Kaiju strikes a nearby city.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju No. 9
Episodes.Description: Reno and Iharu encounter a powerful humanoid Kaiju that quickly overwhelms them. Can help arrive in time?

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Defense Force
Episodes.Description: After transforming into a Kaiju to rescue Reno and Iharu, Kafka is found by Hoshina, who immediately attacks him.

Episodes.Title: Raid on Tachikawa Base
Episodes.Description: Tachikawa base comes under attack from the air, as a powerful Kaiju has its sights set on the Defense Force.

Episodes.Title: Secret Revealed
Episodes.Description: When the Defense Force is in danger, Kafka is forced to choose between keeping his secret and saving his comrades.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju No. 8 Captured
Episodes.Description: Kaiju No. 8 is captured, and Kafka is at the mercy of the Defense Force's most important leaders.

Episodes.Title: Kafka Hibino
Episodes.Description: Kafka's final fate is determined as the monster within him tries to take control.

Episodes.Title: Kaiju Weapon
Episodes.Description: Kafka goes on a mission with his new squad and faces Kaiju No. 9 once again.

Episodes.Title: The Next Generation's Trial
Episodes.Description: A challenge begins for the next generation of the Defense Force.

Episodes.Title: The Strongest Division
Episodes.Description: Kaiju No. 9 appears for the third time, splitting in two and overwhelming the Defense Force.

Entries.Title: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures
Entries.Description: The animated shenanigans of the Rooster Teeth staff. Audio taken from the Rooster Teeth Podcast.

Episodes.Title: San Diego
Episodes.Description: Gus & Geoff encountering some rude passengers on their flight to San Diego.

Episodes.Title: Statue
Episodes.Description: Burnie and his fight to get a statue of him erected in Burnie, Tasmania.

Episodes.Title: Lightning
Episodes.Description: Geoff and his experience with lightning and a surly tow truck driver.

Episodes.Title: Headlight Fluid
Episodes.Description: Gavin and his work with a professional stunt driver who had an accident.

Episodes.Title: Expert Parent
Episodes.Description: Geoff and his advice on how to raise a child.

Episodes.Title: Omnibus #1
Episodes.Description: Watch as Burnie trolls frightened airplane passengers, Gavin experiences America in its purest form, a misplaced phone upsets Burnie and Gus' car gets egged.

Episodes.Title: Omnibus #2
Episodes.Description: Watch as young Geoff gets an adult in trouble, the podcast crew meets "the man", and young Burnie thinks he may have set a world record.

Episodes.Title: New Orleans (1)
Episodes.Description: The first part of the story of Geoff and Griffon in New Orleans.

Episodes.Title: New Orleans (2)
Episodes.Description: The conclusion of Geoff and Griffon's eventful trip to New Orleans.

Episodes.Title: Omnibus #3
Episodes.Description: Gus shows the "situation" to some people at PAX East, Burnie learns what "cribbing" is.

Episodes.Title: Double Derps
Episodes.Description: A story about two idiots and their questions about stromboli and soda machines.

Episodes.Title: Shakedowns & Breakdowns
Episodes.Description: Millie's learning how to use the threat of violence to get what she wants. Additionally, Gus and Geoff revisit their discussion about why the rules on a plane are important. Finally, Joel explains why he was right about everything.

Episodes.Title: Party of the Dead
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #13 shows the Rooster Teeth crew recreating a gaming industry party and tells the story of Burnie's older brother trolling him into thinking Dawn of the Dead was based on a true story.

Episodes.Title: Joel Hates Snakes
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Gus Anesthesia
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #15 shows Gus' true colors once he is under the effects of mind altering drugs.

Episodes.Title: Kara's Exciting Day
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #16 tells of the things Kara enjoys most about her job at Rooster Teeth. As a bonus in this episode, Joel talks about Geoff's fancy grill.

Episodes.Title: Fun With Earthquakes
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #17 shares the RT Crew's thoughts about earthquakes including Matt's first earthquake and Gus' earthquake fetish.

Episodes.Title: Gus vs Machete Man
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #18 is Gus' story about nearly getting hacked to death by a crazed machete wielding maniac in El Paso.

Episodes.Title: Burnie Fights Animals
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #19 is Burnie explaining why he isn't afraid of any animal and claims he can fight any of them.

Episodes.Title: Shamu Plane and Naked Joel
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #20 tells the story about Jack's excitement to ride the Shamu plane and Joel's confusion with hospital gowns.

Episodes.Title: Burnie and Joel's Bathroom Encounter
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #21 is Joel's story about Burnie invading his privacy in a hotel room shower. A steamy situation results.

Episodes.Title: Burnie Burns Horse Puncher
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #22 is the story of Burnie and his epic horse punching fight against a hungry horse.

Episodes.Title: Brandon and the Electric Fence
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Cookies & Hobos
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #24 tells how Girls Scouts use their guilt powers to force you to buy cookies. It also tells the story about the homeless guy who was always having his legs cut off.

Episodes.Title: Michael Meets a Drug Dealer
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #25 tells how Michael met a drug dealer in New York City with an offer that was difficult to refuse...

Episodes.Title: Award for Drink Ordering
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #26 is Burnie talking about presenting an award at the Inside Gaming Awards and Gus describing a typical night at a bar with Chris.

Episodes.Title: Robot Future Toys
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #27 contains a spirited discussion about the proper pronunciation of the name of the protagonist from the Portal series. You will also be treated to a discussion between Burnie and his wife where she tries to describe how the Covenant from Halo look.

Episodes.Title: Dishwashers and Bad Fliers
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #28 covers Burnie's quest to purchase a dishwasher for the office and the last will and testament of a travelling salesman.

Episodes.Title: Joel Meets a Panther
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #29 is Joel's experience meeting a panther while at work.

Episodes.Title: Left 4 Trek
Episodes.Description: Rooster Teeth Animated Adventures #30 is an explanation of Japanese story telling (according to Burnie), every great Star Trek story ever told and strategies for good teamwork while playing Left 4 Dead.

Entries.Title: King of the Hill
Entries.Description: Set in Texas, this animated series follows the life of propane salesman Hank Hill, who lives with his overly confident substitute Spanish teacher wife Peggy, wannabe comedian son Bobby, and naive niece Luanne. Hank has conservative views about God, family, and country, but his values and ethics are often challenged by the situations he, his family, and his beer-drinking neighbors/buddies find themselves in.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Middle-class Texan Hank Hill blows his top when an overzealous social worker accuses him of child abuse after rumors about his son's black eye get out of hand.

Episodes.Title: Square Peg
Episodes.Description: Hank is annoyed when Bobby asks to take a sex-education class--especially when he discovers that Peggy's the teacher.

Episodes.Title: The Order of the Straight Arrow
Episodes.Description: A camping trip with Bobby's scout troop leaves Hank griping after the boy clubs an endangered bird during a faux hunt. Meanwhile, Peggy embarks on a mysterious quest.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Got the Willies
Episodes.Description: Hank's determination to find a role model for Bobby leads to an unexpected encounter with Hank's own hero.

Episodes.Title: Luanne's Saga
Episodes.Description: When Luanne breaks up with Buckley, Hank takes it upon himself to pick up the pieces of his niece's broken heart, only to be left fuming when she makes a play for Boomhauer.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Unmentionable Problem
Episodes.Description: A concerned Peggy inadvertently spreads the word about Hank's bout with constipation, leaving her husband flushed with embarrassment.

Episodes.Title: Westie Side Story
Episodes.Description: The Hills' new Laotian neighbors cause Peggy and Hank confusion and consternation after a culture clash leads to suspicion over a missing dog.

Episodes.Title: Shins of the Father
Episodes.Description: Hank's caught in the middle when his overbearing father pays a visit--and incurs the wrath of a patience-exhausted Peggy.

Episodes.Title: Peggy the Boggle Champ
Episodes.Description: Peggy and Hank head to Dallas so Peggy can compete in a boggle tournament, but Hank decides to forego the tournament in order to attend a lawnmower expo.

Episodes.Title: Keeping Up with Our Joneses
Episodes.Description: Hank and Peggy's love of cigarettes is rekindled after Hank catches Bobby smoking, but Luanne is determined to nip their habit in the butt.

Episodes.Title: King of the Ant Hill
Episodes.Description: Hank's burning mad when he discovers fire ants on his lawn on the eve of the neighborhood block party.

Episodes.Title: Plastic White Female
Episodes.Description: Luanne and Bobby each face a crisis: she's fearful of failing her beauty exam, while he frets over his first boy-girl party.

Episodes.Title: How to Fire a Rifle Without Really Trying
Episodes.Description: When Bobby discovers the one sport he is good at, marksmanship, he and Hank decide to enter a father & son tournament. As it turns out Hank is a terrible marksman.

Episodes.Title: Texas City Twister
Episodes.Description: Luanne moves back into her home, a trailer, just as a twister is about to hit.

Episodes.Title: Arrow Head
Episodes.Description: After Hank finds an arrow head in his lawn, Peggy gives a archaeologist permission to have an archaeological dig their yard.

Episodes.Title: Hilloween
Episodes.Description: Hank is excited about Halloween until someone complains and has the holiday canceled.

Episodes.Title: Jumpin' Crack Bass (It's a Gas, Gas, Gas)
Episodes.Description: In an effort to catch more fish than his friends, Hank decides to buy special "bait" from a street vendor. He soon finds himself in trouble with the law.

Episodes.Title: Husky Bobby
Episodes.Description: Much to Hank's dismay, Bobby becomes a plus sized model.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Shot Cane Skretteburg
Episodes.Description: Hank and the guys seek vengeance after a group of teenagers beat them at paint-ball.

Episodes.Title: The Son That Got Away
Episodes.Description: Bobby and Connie get in trouble at school. They skirt their ensuing punishment and are joined by Joseph, as they head to "The Caves". Hank and Kahn quickly pursue them, knowing that the caves are Arlen's make-out point.

Episodes.Title: The Company Man
Episodes.Description: Hank struggles to portray himself and his life as that of a stereotypical Texan cowboy's for a Hollywood cowboy movie fan in order to secure a business deal for Strickland Propane.

Episodes.Title: Bobby Slam
Episodes.Description: Bobby joins the wrestling team and is caught in a dilemma when he has to fight Connie in order to make the team.

Episodes.Title: The Unbearable Blindness of Laying
Episodes.Description: Hank's mother bring home her new boyfriend, an affectionate Jewish man named Gary. After Hank sees the two of them having relations, he goes blind.

Episodes.Title: Meet the Manger Babies
Episodes.Description: After seeing that Luanne is depressed, Hank volunteers to buy her some hand puppets at a rummage sale. Luanne starts doing a Christian puppet show, The Manger Babies. Hank agrees to play God in the televised version of the puppet show. When it turns out that the show will be on at the same time as the Super Bowl, Hank has to choose between helping Luanne or watching the game.

Episodes.Title: Snow Job
Episodes.Description: When Hank's boss, Buck Strickland, has another heart attack, Hank expects to be put in charge of the company while Buck is recuperating. Instead Buck picks Lloyd Vickers, a business-school graduate, and puts Hank in charge of feeding his dogs. At Buck's house, Hank discovers that Buck's stove is electric, not propane. Realizing that Buck is just in propane for the money, Hank considers leaving the propane business and opening up a general store instead.

Episodes.Title: I Remember Mono
Episodes.Description: On Valentine's Day, Peggy finds out that Hank lied to her when they were dating: he told her he was at home one week with a football injury, when he actually got mono from kissing another girl. She sets out to uncover the whole truth, and finds herself face to face with the past.

Episodes.Title: Three Days of the Kahndo
Episodes.Description: Hank and his family go with Kahn and his family to spend a weekend in a duplex condo in Mexico. When Kahn discovers that only the bottom half of the condo has been rented, he breaks into the top half and lets Hank stay there. Dale shows up to stay with the Hills, and when Hank, Kahn and Dale are arrested for breaking into the upstairs condo, they have to sneak back across the border.

Episodes.Title: Traffic Jam
Episodes.Description: After Hank has a car accident, he has to go to traffic school. The teacher of the traffic school is a comedian, Booda Sack, who gets laughs by insulting the audience. Inspired by Booda Sack, Bobby tries developing a stand-up act of his own. Booda Sack tells Bobby that to be funny, he needs to get in touch with his roots as a white man. Looking for something about "white roots" on the internet, Bobby comes across all the material he needs on a site called the White Nationalist Brotherhood.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Dirty Laundry
Episodes.Description: When Hank tries to buy a new dryer, he is told that his credit is no good because he owes money to Arlen Video. The video store's computer says he rented and never returned a pornographic movie, Cuffs and Collars. Hank refuses to pay for a movie he never rented, and sets out to prove that the computer was wrong.

Episodes.Title: The Final Shinsult
Episodes.Description: When Cotton learns that the U.S. government is giving the artificial leg of General Santa Ana back to Mexico, he teams up with Dale to steal the leg from the Arlen Museum.

Episodes.Title: Leanne's Saga
Episodes.Description: When Luanne's mother, Leanne, is released from prison, she starts living in the Hills' garage, and becomes romantically involved with Bill. Bill is busy fighting a foot fungus, with every last dime.

Episodes.Title: Junkie Business
Episodes.Description: After Hank realizes that his new employee at Strickland Propane is a drug addict, he can't fire him, because drug addiction counts as a disability under the Americans With Disabilities Act.

Episodes.Title: Life in the Fast Lane, Bobby's Saga
Episodes.Description: To teach his son the value of a dollar, Hank makes Bobby get a job selling drinks at the racetrack, and tells Bobby to do everything his boss says. What Hank doesn't know is that Bobby's boss, Jimmy Witchard, is a complete moron who makes Bobby do humiliating and even dangerous tasks. Meanwhile, Boomhauer competes for the right to drive the pace car in the NASCAR race.

Episodes.Title: Peggy's Turtle Song
Episodes.Description: After Bobby eats too much sugar one morning, he is mistakenly diagnosed with attention deficit disorder. Feeling guilty about not spending enough time with her son, Peggy decides to give up teaching and be a stay-at-home mother, a decision Hank fully approves of. But Peggy is so bored at home that she starts taking guitar lessons, and composes a symbolic song about a turtle trapped in her shell. Meanwhile, Bobby takes pills for his ADD, and Luanne becomes convinced that she caught ADD from Bobby.

Episodes.Title: Propane Boom
Episodes.Description: When Mega Lo Mart starts selling propane, Strickland Propane can't compete with their prices, and Hank loses his job. He winds up working in the propane department at Mega Lo Mart, under the supervision of Luanne's boyfriend Buckley. Hank and other Mega Lo Mart employees decide to protest the way the company destroys small businesses, by disrupting a concert by the company spokesman, Chuck Mangione. Meanwhile, Luanne, who wanted Buckley to give her the job that he gave to Hank, tells Buckley she's breaking up with him. And Hank, Luanne and Buckley are the only people in the Mega Lo Mart when Hank notices a leak...

Episodes.Title: Death of a Propane Salesman
Episodes.Description: Hank and Luanne survive the Mega Lo Mart explosion, but Buckley is no more. Hank finds that he is scared of propane, and tries to figure out how to deal with his fear of dying. Meanwhile, Luanne, who lost all her hair in the explosion, decides to become an activist like Sinead O'Connor.

Episodes.Title: And They Call It Bobby Love
Episodes.Description: Bobby starts dating Marie, a girl who's two years older than him. Bobby takes the relationship more seriously than Marie does, and is heartbroken when she dances with other guys. Marie decides to "move on" leaving Bobby an emotional wreck. Meanwhile, Hank and the guys find an abandoned couch in the alley, and grow to depend on it.

Episodes.Title: Peggy's Headache
Episodes.Description: When Peggy starts writing "musings" for the local newspaper, the pressure gives her a headache, so she goes to John Redcorn for a therapeutic massage. When she finds out that Dale's wife Nancy is having an affair with John Redcorn, she is so horrified that she decides to tell Dale about it.

Episodes.Title: Pregnant Paws
Episodes.Description: Hank wants to breed Ladybird, but the veterinarian says that she has a narrow uterus and probably can't have children. Hank becomes obsessed with finding a way to get Ladybird pregnant, which annoys Peggy, because she's the one who really wants another baby. Meanwhile, Dale becomes a bounty hunter and is assigned to hunt down a man with several unpaid parking tickets. He decides that he needs a hound to accompany him on his first bounty, so he nabs Ladybird, to Hank's horror.

Episodes.Title: Next of Shin
Episodes.Description: Hank tries several different methods to improve his sperm count so he can get Peggy pregnant. The frustration of not being able to have another child becomes worse when Cotton shows up and announces that he got his wife pregnant. But Cotton becomes so nervous at the prospect of having a baby at his age that he flees to Las Vegas, and Hank, Bill and Dale go after him.

Episodes.Title: Peggy's Pageant Fever
Episodes.Description: A beauty pageant offers Peggy the chance to win a truck. If she can endure a series of rigorous makeovers to impress the judges.

Episodes.Title: Nine Pretty Darn Angry Men
Episodes.Description: Hank is outraged when he attends a lawn mower focus group and discovers that the new model of his favorite mower has been turned into an upgraded "yuppified" version.

Episodes.Title: Good Hill Hunting
Episodes.Description: All the kids in the neighborhood are going on their first hunt, but Hank is unable to get a hunting license for him and Bobby. Bobby is so upset about being denied the chance at a rite of passage that he starts to regress into acting like a little kid. Hank reluctantly decides to take Bobby hunting at the La Grunta Resort.

Episodes.Title: Pretty, Pretty Dresses
Episodes.Description: At Christmastime, Bill becomes even more depressed than usual, because it's the anniversary of when his wife Lenore left him. Bill tries to commit suicide, and when that doesn't work out, he dresses up in Lenore's old clothes and declares that he is Lenore.

Episodes.Title: A Firefighting We Will Go
Episodes.Description: Hank and his friends become volunteer firefighters. They manage to wreck a fire hydrant, ruin a funeral, and finally burn down the Arlen firehouse. When the Fire Captain comes to ask what happened, the trio turns the story around to match each of their scenarios.

Episodes.Title: To Spank, with Love
Episodes.Description: After being taunted and pantsed by one of her students, Peggy loses it and spanks him. She is immediately fired, but Cotton and his old buddies start a campaign to get "Paddlin' Peggy" reinstated. Once she is back teaching, Peggy uses her reputation for violence to scare her students, and takes things too far, in true Peggy fashion.

Episodes.Title: Three Coaches and a Bobby
Episodes.Description: Hank gets his tough old football coach to lead Bobby's football team. When the coach proves to be a tyrant, Bobby decides to quit football and join the soccer team, much to Hank's disappointment. Meanwhile, Peggy tries to fit in with the other soccer moms, and takes a crash course from Minh on Soccer-mom etiquette.

Episodes.Title: De-Kahnstructing Henry
Episodes.Description: Kahn gets a great new job and invites Hank over to the office, hoping to make him jealous. While bragging about his job, Kahn gives away government secrets, swearing Hank to secrecy. Hank talks to Bill about Kahn's job, and Kahn gets fired for it.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding of Bobby Hill
Episodes.Description: Angry that Luanne cost him his job house-sitting Boomhauer's house, Bobby replaces her birth control pills with candy.

Episodes.Title: Sleight of Hank
Episodes.Description: Hank and Peggy go to a magic show where Peggy gets to be the volunteer in the best trick. Hank tries to figure out how the trick was done, and Peggy won't tell him. Meanwhile, Bobby is looking for a way to liven up his Sunday School report on Jesus, and when he sees the magician, he incorporates some of the tricks and patter into the report, calling it "The Amazing Jesus."

Episodes.Title: Jon Vitti Presents: "Return to La Grunta"
Episodes.Description: Hank gets Luanne a job as a golf course drink girl at the La Grunta resort. In gratitude, Luanne gets Hank a chance to swim with a dolphin. Hank pets the dolphin, and the dolphin becomes aroused and tries to become sexually intimate with him. In return for his silence, the hotel pays him off, and Hank tells Luanne never to talk about what happened. Luanne gets sexually harassed by one of the golfers, she decides to follow Hank's example and not talk about it.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Party Island
Episodes.Description: Hank takes his mother and her friends to a museum of miniatures in Port Aransas, and they get stuck in the middle of MTV's Spring Break. Meanwhile, Bill tries to put the moves on Peggy while Hank is away.

Episodes.Title: Love Hurts... and So Does Art
Episodes.Description: Worried at the prospect of going to a school dance with Connie, Bobby starts overeating at the local deli, and develops gout. Meanwhile, Hank goes to an art gallery in Dallas and finds that they are displaying an X-ray of his constipated colon.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Cowboy Movie
Episodes.Description: After Hank and Bobby visit the Dallas Cowboys training camp in Wichita Falls, Hank decides to make a video that will convince the team to move their camp to Arlen.

Episodes.Title: Dog Dale Afternoon
Episodes.Description: When Dale brings home a new 'Super Mower' the neighbors are jealous, but his attitude leaves everyone with a bad taste in their mouths. To knock him down a few notches, the crew decides to hide his new mower, & make it look like a conspiracy, Peggy gets involved and it goes too far. Dale gets pushed over the edge & it is Hank that goes to help him back down.

Episodes.Title: Revenge of the Lutefisk
Episodes.Description: Arlen's new minister is a woman, which everyone except Cotton seems to accept. When Bobby eats all of a Midwestern fish dish prepared by the minister, it somehow leads to him accidentally burning down the church. Everyone assumes that Cotton did it, and he is arrested for a hate crime.

Episodes.Title: Death and Texas
Episodes.Description: Peggy gets a letter from a Death Row convict who says that he is a former student of hers, and that she had the most positive impact on his life. She starts visiting him in prison and bringing him what she thinks is timer sand for Boggle -- not realizing that it's actually cocaine. Meanwhile, Dale wants to become an executioner.

Episodes.Title: Wings of the Dope
Episodes.Description: While studying for her beauty school exam, Luanne sees someone bouncing on Buckley's old trampoline. It's Buckley, who has come back as an angel. Hank and Peggy think Luanne was hallucinating after using too many hair-dying chemicals, but Hank's friends come to believe in the existence of Buckley's Angel. But Luanne finds that Buckley isn't much more help to her as an angel than he was when he was alive.

Episodes.Title: Take Me Out of the Ball Game
Episodes.Description: When Thaterton stacks his Company softball team with Pro sports stars, Hank pulls Peggy off of her own Softball team to become the Ace pitcher for Strickland Propane. Unfortunately, Hank's over-managing causes her to lose her stuff, and cause her to lose the love for the sport.

Episodes.Title: As Old as the Hills...
Episodes.Description: Peggy and Hank's 20th-anniversary party leaves the missus missing their youth; and a bottle of tequila is the highlight of their private revelry.

Episodes.Title: Peggy Hill: The Decline and Fall
Episodes.Description: Peggy's fate and details surrounding Cotton and Didi's newborn are revealed.

Episodes.Title: Cotton's Plot
Episodes.Description: Freed from a six-week body cast, non-ambulatory Peggy takes physical therapy from Cotton, who drills her military style. Meanwhile, Hank's pals make use of her cast.

Episodes.Title: Bills Are Made to Be Broken
Episodes.Description: Bill is accepting, but Hank isn't, when opposing players lie down to let an injured high-school jock break Bill's touchdown record.

Episodes.Title: Little Horrors of Shop
Episodes.Description: Forced to take a vacation, Hank becomes a substitute shop teacher, and a popular one, rousing jealousy in Peggy.

Episodes.Title: Aisle 8A
Episodes.Description: Hank is the only one home when houseguest Connie has her first encounter with menstruation--and neither knows what to do. Meanwhile, someone has to explain PMS to Bobby.

Episodes.Title: A Beer Can Named Desire
Episodes.Description: Bill meets Cajun relatives and Hank competes for $1 million in a beer promotion at a football game in New Orleans.

Episodes.Title: Happy Hank's Giving
Episodes.Description: Hank's propane-smoked turkey is a casualty in "a war called 'Thanksgiving at the Airport'" as weather stalls the Hills' trip to Peggy's folks in Montana.

Episodes.Title: Not in My Back-hoe
Episodes.Description: Jealous of Hank's new acquaintance, Bill and Dale give Hank an ultimatum, and compound their mistake when they try to make amends.

Episodes.Title: To Kill a Ladybird
Episodes.Description: Bobby's affection for a raccoon brings problems when Hank's dog Ladybird and Dale get into fights with the ersatz pet that could be rabid.

Episodes.Title: Hillennium
Episodes.Description: A propane shortage gives Hank Y2K fears that alter his Christmas-gift plans; Dale's stash of hoarded goods is destroyed by a hamster that he was planning to use for food.

Episodes.Title: Old Glory
Episodes.Description: Bobby keeps mum that his mom wrote the A-plus essay that made him a school star.

Episodes.Title: Rodeo Days
Episodes.Description: Bobby's new calling is rodeo roping, but his first experience with livestock introduces him to an ambition even greater--at least to Bobby.

Episodes.Title: Hanky Panky
Episodes.Description: Hank and Peggy are caught in the middle after Strickland's wife catches him with his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: High Anxiety
Episodes.Description: Hank becomes the prime suspect in an investigation led by Sheriff Buford.

Episodes.Title: Naked Ambition
Episodes.Description: Bobby's accidental glimpse of a naked Luanne has Joseph yearning to get his own look. But Connie catches them trying to peep, and thinks she's the target.

Episodes.Title: Movin' On Up
Episodes.Description: Luanne moves out and into the house across the alley, where her roommates don't carry any of the load.

Episodes.Title: Bill of Sales
Episodes.Description: Bill becomes Peggy's star--and only--salesman in a health-food sales operation, and his profits net them a trip to a conference in San Antonio, where they must share a room.

Episodes.Title: Won't You Pimai Neighbor?
Episodes.Description: Buddhist monks think Bobby is a reincarnated Lama.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Bad Hair Day
Episodes.Description: After his lifelong barber loses it, Hank turns to Army haircutter Bill, who does a fine job on his first civilian head, but at a Government price, prompting Hank to declare war.

Episodes.Title: Meet the Propaniacs
Episodes.Description: Bobby's impromptu comedy at a propane sale prompts Strickland to send him on the road to entertain at other outlets, leading to a big trade show in front of the Texas propane president.

Episodes.Title: Nancy Boys
Episodes.Description: After joining the Hills for a free romantic dinner, the Gribbles sleep together, and guilt grabs Nancy for cheating on her lover, John Redcorn.

Episodes.Title: Flush with Power
Episodes.Description: Water restrictions prompt Hank to join the zoning board, while Bobby blackmails Kahn for bribing a water-meter reader.

Episodes.Title: Transnational Amusements Presents: Peggy's Magic Sex Feet
Episodes.Description: Peggy's embarrassment about her big feet ends when she meets a fetishist who directs her in a video Hank thinks is dirty, but Peggy approves of--wholefootedly.

Episodes.Title: Peggy's Fan Fair
Episodes.Description: At Nashville's Fan Fair, Peggy accuses Randy Travis of stealing her song, while Brooks & Dunn counsel Bobby about Connie.

Episodes.Title: The Perils of Polling
Episodes.Description: Bobby's act of heroism leads the Hills to a meeting with candidate George Dub-Ya, who turns Hank's vote from sure to tentative with the shake of a hand.

Episodes.Title: The Buck Stops Here
Episodes.Description: Bobby becomes Strickland's personal caddy and picks up some bad habits. Meanwhile, Peggy and Minh compete to donate the most blood.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to Wait...
Episodes.Description: As Hank builds coffins for his family, Bobby struggles with the fact that he's still treated as a child even as Joseph laments how awkward adulthood is for him.

Episodes.Title: Spin the Choice
Episodes.Description: Bobby rejects Thanksgiving after history lessons from John Redcorn, who longs to be a real father to his illegitimate son Joseph.

Episodes.Title: Peggy Makes the Big Leagues
Episodes.Description: The Booster Club sends a distraught Hank to talk to Peggy after she fails the football team's star fullback and gets him suspended from the team.

Episodes.Title: When Cotton Comes Marching Home
Episodes.Description: Cash-flow problems plague Hank's father, who's forced to work a menial job on Veterans Day instead of marching in the parade.

Episodes.Title: What Makes Bobby Run?
Episodes.Description: Bobby goes all-out to become school mascot, a high-profile post that suffers a low blow when he avoids a time-honored tradition.

Episodes.Title: 'Twas the Nut Before Christmas
Episodes.Description: Bill counters his holiday loneliness by becoming a generous Santa, attracting a nice single mother and a young slacker who takes advantage.

Episodes.Title: Chasing Bobby
Episodes.Description: Peggy thinks Hank's tears are indicative of a father-son void, but they're really about his truck, which looks headed for pickup-truck heaven.

Episodes.Title: Yankee Hankie
Episodes.Description: While a distraught Hank tries to deal with the fact that he wasn't born in Texas, Cotton and his buddies once again make plans to assassinate Fidel Castro.

Episodes.Title: Hank and the Great Glass Elevator
Episodes.Description: Bill and former Texas governor Ann Richards hit it off after a chance meeting resulting from Hank's reluctant prank in an Austin hotel.

Episodes.Title: Now Who's the Dummy?
Episodes.Description: Bobby's ventriloquist's dummy gets more of Hank's attention than Bobby, but it's Dale who harbors a grudge against the wooden being.

Episodes.Title: Ho Yeah!
Episodes.Description: Unaware that the new employee at Strickland Propane is a prostitute, Peggy becomes her best friend and even offers her a place to stay--Hank's den.

Episodes.Title: The Exterminator
Episodes.Description: Repeated exposure to poisons forces Dale out of extermination and into a desk job that leads him back into extermination--of careers.

Episodes.Title: Luanne Virgin 2.0
Episodes.Description: As Luanne's sponsor in a sexual-abstinence program, Peggy has to testify about her lifetime total of sexual partners--and it's more than one.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Choice
Episodes.Description: When Bobby develops an allergy to Ladybird, Hank builds a doghouse, an elaborate accommodation that's perfect--for Bobby.

Episodes.Title: It's Not Easy Being Green
Episodes.Description: Hank joins Bobby's environmental effort, but only to preserve a long-time cover-up concerning a mishap with Boomhauer's car in high school.

Episodes.Title: The Trouble with Gribbles
Episodes.Description: Dale plans to buy Nancy a face-lift by suing a tobacco company, which countersues--and carelessly bugs his home.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Back Story
Episodes.Description: Wearing a prosthetic rump relieves Hank's back pain, but makes him the butt of friends' jokes as they all prepare for a riding-mower race.

Episodes.Title: Kidney Boy and Hamster Girl: A Love Story
Episodes.Description: Bobby avoids a beating by high schoolers by pretending to be one of them.

Episodes.Title: Bobby Goes Nuts
Episodes.Description: Bobby goes from bullied to bully after learning a counterattack move in a self-defense class--for women.

Episodes.Title: Soldier of Misfortune
Episodes.Description: After an accident at his gun club destroys Dale's confidence, Peggy proposes sending him on a bogus mercenary mission, which he fouls up.

Episodes.Title: Lupe's Revenge
Episodes.Description: A female cop gets a hankerin' for Hank; Peggy accidentally brings back a native child after a school field trip to Mexico.

Episodes.Title: The Father, the Son, and J.C.
Episodes.Description: Hank's emotional outburst pushes him further from his father, so Bobby drafts Jimmy Carter to broker a Christmas peace.

Episodes.Title: Father of the Bribe
Episodes.Description: After Bobby feigns taking Connie's father's bribe to break up with her, Connie lets her grades slip to show how upset she is without him.

Episodes.Title: I'm with Cupid
Episodes.Description: Bobby adjusts to his breakup with Connie, until Bill's depressing experiences break his spirit. So Hank sends him to ladies' man Boomhauer.

Episodes.Title: Torch Song Hillogy
Episodes.Description: Peggy nominates Bobby to carry the Olympic torch through Arlen, but it's Hank who wins the honor--and bungles it.

Episodes.Title: Joust Like a Woman
Episodes.Description: Peggy leads a troupe of "wenches" to protest their unfair treatment at the Renaissance Faire, where Hank is trying to land a big-money propane account.

Episodes.Title: The Bluegrass Is Always Greener
Episodes.Description: Hank and the boys recruit Connie for a bluegrass fiddle contest, but Kahn insists that she focus on classical music.

Episodes.Title: The Substitute Spanish Prisoner
Episodes.Description: A con man offers "genius" Peggy an at-home doctorate course, which she finances with the Hills' retirement fund.

Episodes.Title: Unfortunate Son
Episodes.Description: Cotton's financially strapped VFW group moves into Hank's home, prompting Hank to recruit Vietnam vets, to whom Cotton doesn't exactly cotton.

Episodes.Title: Are You There God? It's Me, Margaret Hill
Episodes.Description: Unable to find a full-time teaching job, Peggy pretends to be a nun to land a position at a Catholic school, ending her budding career at Strickland Propane.

Episodes.Title: Tankin' It to the Streets
Episodes.Description: After learning the Army used him as a guinea pig for an experimental drug, Bill gets drunk and steals a tank. And it's up to his friends to try to return it.

Episodes.Title: Of Mice and Little Green Men
Episodes.Description: When Hank and Dale find more interest in the activities of the other's son, Dale concludes he's not Joseph's father--and that an alien is.

Episodes.Title: A Man Without a Country Club
Episodes.Description: Kahn covets membership in an all-Asian country club, but it's Hank who's asked to join--as a token white to secure a PGA tournament.

Episodes.Title: Beer and Loathing
Episodes.Description: Peggy gets a job at Alamo Beer, but a clause in her contract prevents her from telling Hank why Texas is completely devoid of the brew for the next 36 hours.

Episodes.Title: Fun with Jane and Jane
Episodes.Description: Oblivious to its cultlike ways, Luanne joins a sorority and gets Peggy in too; Hank and the boys rescue emus from death, but don't know what to do with them.

Episodes.Title: My Own Private Rodeo
Episodes.Description: Hank learns that the incident estranging Dale from his cowboy father was a cover to keep him in the dark about Dad being in the closet.

Episodes.Title: Sug Night
Episodes.Description: Hank is shaken after having a dream about grilling burgers...naked...with Nancy. And the situation is stirred when Peggy finds out.

Episodes.Title: Dang Ol' Love
Episodes.Description: Bill is heartbroken when the beautiful jogger he's pining for falls for Boomhauer, who is in turn heartbroken himself when the jogger dumps him.

Episodes.Title: Returning Japanese (1)
Episodes.Description: The Hills are off to Japan so Cotton can apologize to the widow of a soldier he killed in WWII, but something about Cotton's story doesn't quite add up.

Episodes.Title: Returning Japanese (2)
Episodes.Description: Cotton runs amuck in Tokyo when rejected by his newly found Japanese son.

Episodes.Title: Get Your Freak Off
Episodes.Description: Bobby meets a new girl, but Hank objects to her parents' liberal parenting style.

Episodes.Title: The Fat and the Furious
Episodes.Description: A competitive eating groupie encourages Bill to enter a hot dog eating contest.

Episodes.Title: Bad Girls, Bad Girls, Whatcha Gonna Do
Episodes.Description: Connie's delinquent cousin captivates Bobby, who's oblivious when she turns their science project into a drug lab.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye Normal Jeans
Episodes.Description: Hank is opposed to Bobby's taking Home Economics, until his domestic skills outshine those of Peggy, who tries to sabotage his Thanksgiving meal.

Episodes.Title: Dances with Dogs
Episodes.Description: A dog-dancing contest pits Hank and Ladybird against Bobby and Connie's dog, while Bill tries to partner with a rottweiler.

Episodes.Title: The Son Also Roses
Episodes.Description: Bobby's preference for gardening over gridiron irks Hank, until he enters Bobby in a rose-growing contest.

Episodes.Title: The Texas Skillsaw Massacre
Episodes.Description: Hank is ordered to take an anger-management class after accidentally cutting one of Dale's fingers off. Dale claims it was retaliation for his causing Hank's kitchen floor to collapse.

Episodes.Title: Full Metal Dust Jacket
Episodes.Description: Seeking an invitation to a book club, Peggy takes over the lease for a bookstore, where business is a bust--until she lets Dale sell guns there, too.

Episodes.Title: Pigmalion
Episodes.Description: A local pork producer is impressed by Luanne, who goes to his home for a job interview but comes away as his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Megalo Dale
Episodes.Description: Dale exterminates at the Mega Lo Mart, thanks to an endorsement from a reluctant Hank.

Episodes.Title: Boxing Luanne
Episodes.Description: Luanne becomes a boxer and, buoyed by success in fixed fights, challenges George Foreman's daughter.

Episodes.Title: Vision Quest
Episodes.Description: Worried about how Dale is raising Joseph, John Redcorn asks Hank to take the boy he fathered on a Native American rite of passage.

Episodes.Title: Queasy Rider
Episodes.Description: Hank and Peggy find marital salvation in a motorcycle--until their first long trip.

Episodes.Title: Board Games
Episodes.Description: Peggy, Minh and Nancy bond to save a school program, but split up when Minh decides she's the best candidate for a school-board seat.

Episodes.Title: An Officer and a Gentle Boy
Episodes.Description: To toughen up Bobby, Hank decides to send him to Cotton's old boot camp, unaware that lawsuits have altered the severe conditions.

Episodes.Title: The Miseducation of Bobby Hill
Episodes.Description: Despite a lack of seasoning that Hank deems mandatory, Bobby becomes a whiz at selling propane grills; Bill takes an inadvertent balloon ride.

Episodes.Title: The Good Buck
Episodes.Description: Kicked out by his wife, Hank's hard-living boss, Buck, turns to religion, assisted by his personal Bible coach: Luanne.

Episodes.Title: I Never Promised You an Organic Garden
Episodes.Description: Peggy takes over the organic garden at Bobby's school, but an insect infestation threatens her hope of making the post permanent.

Episodes.Title: Be True to Your Fool
Episodes.Description: After inadvertently spreading lice to his buddies, a shunned and depressed Bill winds up in jail, where his popularity soars.

Episodes.Title: Racist Dawg
Episodes.Description: A handyman sees racism in a bite from Ladybird, suspected of picking up subconscious cues from her master, Hank.

Episodes.Title: Night and Deity
Episodes.Description: A pest-control expert's chemistry with Dale worries Nancy; Hank is the designated driver as Luanne turns 21.

Episodes.Title: Maid in Arlen
Episodes.Description: To escape her daughter-in-law, Kahn's mother does maid work for the Hills, and for Bill, who finds the woman romantically made-to-order.

Episodes.Title: The Witches of East Arlen
Episodes.Description: Reading tarot cards introduces Bobby to a coven of compatriots who want to train him to become a wizard.

Episodes.Title: Patch Boomhauer
Episodes.Description: When Boomhauer's brother, Patch, announces he's getting married to Boomhauer's old girlfriend, Hank mistakenly comes to believe that Boomhauer is out to sabotage the wedding.

Episodes.Title: Reborn to Be Wild
Episodes.Description: Hank likes Bobby's new Christian youth group, but not their methods of worship, which include skateboarding and punk rock.

Episodes.Title: New Cowboy on the Block
Episodes.Description: The thrill of an ex-Dallas Cowboy moving onto the block is lost on Hank when the one-time hero breaks neighborhood rules.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Hank
Episodes.Description: Peggy overdoes it when she secretly slips Hank a testosterone supplement to combat his work-related stress. But he feels great, until he finds out.

Episodes.Title: Flirting with the Master
Episodes.Description: A Latin TV star hires Peggy to come to his home in Mexico to tutor his kids, but Peggy senses his interest is not entirely academic.

Episodes.Title: After the Mold Rush
Episodes.Description: The Hills' house tests positive for mold, found again and again just after Hank enters the home in a local showcase.

Episodes.Title: Livin' on Reds, Vitamin C and Propane
Episodes.Description: Hank and Bobby take an 18-wheeler to Arizona, with Dale, Bill and Boomhauer as stowaways.

Episodes.Title: Rich Hank, Poor Hank
Episodes.Description: Hank's thriftiness and reluctance to talk about money leads Bobby to believe he's wealthy, a rumor that spreads through the neighborhood.

Episodes.Title: Ceci N'Est Pas Une King of the Hill
Episodes.Description: Peggy's entry into the art world is rejected at first, then applauded by a dealer whose promotional method leaves her drawn.

Episodes.Title: That's What She Said
Episodes.Description: A new Strickland employee's constant double entendres delight all but Hank, who considers suing for sexual harassment.

Episodes.Title: My Hair Lady
Episodes.Description: Arlen's hottest new haircutting team is Luanne and Bill, who charms the ladies by pretending to be gay.

Episodes.Title: Phish and Wildlife
Episodes.Description: The boys' annual camping trip is disturbed by a gathering of hippies, who share their food with Bobby and expect sharing in return.

Episodes.Title: Cheer Factor
Episodes.Description: Peggy's aggressive approach as cheerleading coach brings football wins, and a hearing when one routine is deemed offensive.

Episodes.Title: Dale Be Not Proud
Episodes.Description: Dale donates a kidney to Funny Car racer John Force, and makes Hank his representative in all matters while laid up.

Episodes.Title: Après Hank, le Deluge
