Episodes.Description: During a flood, Hank's position as emergency-shelter team leader is usurped by Bill when Hank is drafted to watch over a fragile dam.

Episodes.Title: DaleTech
Episodes.Description: Hank's father becomes part of a civilian police patrol, usurping Dale's self-proclaimed title of neighborhood protector.

Episodes.Title: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Alamo
Episodes.Description: Ignorance of the Alamo in Bobby's Texas History class prompts Hank to help organize a reenactment, but the author's version is revisionist.

Episodes.Title: Girl, You'll Be a Giant Soon
Episodes.Description: Luanne helps Hank protest a grilling competition that bans propane; Peggy negotiates to see an infamous murder site.

Episodes.Title: Stressed for Success
Episodes.Description: Bobby joins his school academic team as the expert in pop culture, but the pressure gets to him.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Back
Episodes.Description: Hank starts taking yoga classes after injuring his back at work; Peggy bags groceries at a mom and pop store that's having a hard time competing against Megalomart.

Episodes.Title: The Redneck on Rainey Street
Episodes.Description: After Connie becomes a victim of reverse discrimination, Kahn gives up his hopes and dreams and embraces the life of a hillbilly.

Episodes.Title: Talking Shop
Episodes.Description: Bobby becomes a peer counselor, but gets personally involved with clients.

Episodes.Title: A Rover Runs Through It
Episodes.Description: Peggy's estranged mother summons her home to their Montana ranch, where Henry Winkler is an uncooperative neighbor.

Episodes.Title: Ms. Wakefield
Episodes.Description: An elderly woman who once lived in the Hills' house returns for the holidays--to die there. And that gives Dale a business idea.

Episodes.Title: Death Buys a Timeshare
Episodes.Description: Hank accompanies Cotton and his new friend Bill to Mexico to try to keep them from buying timeshare properties. But the salesmen are determined.

Episodes.Title: Yard, She Blows!
Episodes.Description: Hank's immaculately manicured front lawn is as good as gone when Peggy tries to horn in on the glory with her own contributions.

Episodes.Title: Dale to the Chief
Episodes.Description: Hank's fight to correct an error on his driver's license is a red flag to newly patriotic Dale, who reports Hank as a threat to national security.

Episodes.Title: The Petriot Act
Episodes.Description: Hank excitedly joins a new military program that allows civilians to adopt pets while G.I.s serve their tour of duty but the dog, Duke, turns out to be a mean-spirited cat.

Episodes.Title: Enrique-cilable Differences
Episodes.Description: Hank cringes when an employee with personal problems turns to him for solace.

Episodes.Title: Mutual of Omabwah
Episodes.Description: Hank's lapsed insurance policy puts him in an overprotective state, while Bill and Boomhauer carelessly experiment with deep-frying.

Episodes.Title: Care-Takin' Care of Business
Episodes.Description: Covert work by Hank and the boys turns a befuddled groundskeeper into a hero when his field is credited with hampering opponents.

Episodes.Title: Arlen City Bomber
Episodes.Description: Peggy follows Luanne onto a roller-derby team, where the tight-fisted owner prompts her to lead a revolt and form a team on borrowed money.

Episodes.Title: Redcorn Gambles with His Future
Episodes.Description: John Redcorn tries to open a Native American gambling casino to provide a venue for his band, Big Mountain Fudgecake.

Episodes.Title: Smoking and the Bandit
Episodes.Description: Dale dons a disguise to defy Arlen's smoking ban, and Peggy sets out to uncover his identity.

Episodes.Title: Gone with the Windstorm
Episodes.Description: Peggy helps weather-girl Nancy fight back when she's replaced by a qualified meteorologist. Also, a boy barking like a dog scares Bobby.

Episodes.Title: Bobby on Track
Episodes.Description: Hank talks Bobby into joining the track team, but the spot the boy lands isn't what Hank had in mind.

Episodes.Title: It Ain't Over 'til the Fat Neighbor Sings
Episodes.Description: Bill finds happiness in a men's chorus, where the required devotion jeopardizes his Army career.

Episodes.Title: Hank's on Board
Episodes.Description: Hank discovers that Dale and Boomhauer take yearly vacations together, and assumes that they are trying to avoid Bill.  He invites his family and Bill along for a weekend at the beach, but during the trip, Hank realizes that his friends are actually trying to avoid him because he’s uptight and bossy. Peggy advises Hank to throw caution to the wind and have some fun with his buddies, but the results leave Hank and the guys overboard.

Episodes.Title: Bystand Me
Episodes.Description: When the Arlen Bystander gets a new editor, Peggy gets a job writing a household hints column.  Except Peggy doesn't know any household hints, so she gets Minh to supply her with housekeeping tips in exchange for the answers to the New York Times crossword puzzles.  Meanwhile, Hank makes Bobby get a paper route.

Episodes.Title: Bill's House
Episodes.Description: After Bill nurses Hank, Peggy and Bobby through the flu, he starts to feel lonely when there is no one else to take care of.  Hank gets Bill to volunteer at a halfway house for alcoholics, and Bill invites the residents to stay with him. As more and more houseguests show up, Hank becomes determined to find them a permanent residence. Meanwhile, Peggy makes a promise to God that if she gets over the flu, she'll learn to ride a bike, and Bobby makes her keep her promise.

Episodes.Title: Harlottown
Episodes.Description: When Hank and Peggy try to clean up a historic Arlen landmark, they find out that the town was founded by harlots and was once a place of ill-repute. The new city manager uses the city's rediscovered history to turn the town into a tourist trap for the adult porn industry. Frustrated by the changes, Hank decides to move the family – that is, until he is aided by adult actress Candee.

Episodes.Title: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Clown
Episodes.Description: Hoping to get Bobby to stop cracking jokes in school, Hank enrolls Bobby in a clown class at the local community college.  The pretentious instructor teaches Bobby classical comedic theory and sucks all the fun out of him.

Episodes.Title: Orange You Sad I Did Say Banana?
Episodes.Description: Kahn is accused of having become so assimilated that he's a "banana" -- the Asian equivalent of an "Oreo."  To get back to his Laotian heritage, Kahn adopts a simple lifestyle and abandons the swimming pool his neighbors helped build.

Episodes.Title: You Gotta Believe (In Moderation)
Episodes.Description: In order to raise money to save the Tom Landry Middle School baseball program, Hank invites a Harlem Globetrotters-type softball team to compete against his community league Arlen Zephyrs.  But Hank ruins the show by deciding to take the game seriously.

Episodes.Title: Business Is Picking Up
Episodes.Description: When Bobby attends the school's job shadow program, he winds up interning for Peter Sterling, a man who runs a pooper-scooper business. Bobby is so impressed by Peter that he decides to pursue the same career.  Meanwhile, Hank is trying to train Joseph at Strickland Propane.

Episodes.Title: The Year of Washing Dangerously
Episodes.Description: Hank gets sucked into Kahn's get-rich-quick scheme when Kahn buys the car wash that hosts car cruising on Friday nights. But Kahn wrecks the business by trying to cut corners, and gets bought out by Buck Strickland. Meanwhile, Peggy tries to figure out if Nancy is deliberately refusing to take her calls.

Episodes.Title: Hank Fixes Everything
Episodes.Description: Buck Strickland embarks on a propane price war with Thatherton and two other rivals, and hires the guys from "American Chopper" to boost sales at the Propane Expo.  When the 'war' goes too far, and the companies are all losing profit, Hank takes matters into his own hands, and calls a meeting.  Unfortunately, the owners decide to 'price fix' and get caught.  Meanwhile, Lucky and Luanne wait for Brownsville Station tickets, in line 6 days before tickets go on sale.

Episodes.Title: Church Hopping
Episodes.Description: When Reverend Stroup gives the Hills' pew at the Arlen First Methodist Church to another family, Hank and his family decide to find another church. A slick pastor tries to bribe the Hills into worshipping at his Megachurch.

Episodes.Title: 24 Hour Propane People
Episodes.Description: When Buck gets banned from his favorite strip club, he refocuses on making Strickland Propane a "fun" place to work. He makes his employees dress in costumes, have sleepovers in the office and use hip catchphrases. It's up to Hank to get everyone focused on selling propane again.

Episodes.Title: The Texas Panhandler
Episodes.Description: Instead of getting a job, Bobby and Joseph discover that they can make more money, and look cooler, by hanging out on street corners and begging.

Episodes.Title: Hank's Bully
Episodes.Description: A young boy, Caleb, starts following Hank around, making fun of him and generally annoying him.  Hank isn't sure how to deal with such a young bully.

Episodes.Title: Edu-macating Lucky
Episodes.Description: Lucky asks Peggy to help him get his GED in the hopes of improving his chances of marrying Luanne.  Peggy intentionally teaches him the wrong information so he'll fail and give up the idea of marrying her niece, but then she starts to suspect that Luanne might be pregnant.

Episodes.Title: The Peggy Horror Picture Show
Episodes.Description: Feeling unfeminine after a clothing exchange party with the neighborhood girls, Hank offers Peggy a new pair of shoes. After finding that her usual place in Lubbock is out of business, she stumbles upon 'Clairissa's Closet', and a new best friend, Carolyn. They become the best of friends, until Peggy finds out that Carolyn is a he, and Carolyn finds that Peggy is a she.

Episodes.Title: SerPUNt
Episodes.Description: When Bobby's snakes gets into the toilet Hank decides to call Animal Control. But instead of taking care of the problem they make the city believe that the problem is worse than it is causing panic. Now it is up to Dale to save the city.

Episodes.Title: Blood and Sauce
Episodes.Description: The guys discuss what they want to pass on to their children, Bill becomes despondent because he doesn’t have any. In an effort to cheer him up, they help Bill put together a Dauterive family reunion, only to be thwarted by the realization that Bill only has one living relative. Bill winds up sharing an incredible barbeque with his neighbors and teaches Bobby the secret sauce recipe.

Episodes.Title: Luanne Gets Lucky
Episodes.Description: When Lucky ditches Luanne to go stumping with Hank and the gang, Luanne accepts an invitation to attend Arlen High School's Senior Prom. Lucky's friends Mud Dobber and Elvin take it upon themeselves bully Luanne's 15-year-old date.

Episodes.Title: Hank Gets Dusted
Episodes.Description: Hank is crestfallen when Cotton gives his beloved Cadillac to Cousin Dusty, however things get even worse when Dusty shows up at Hank's house with a reality TV show crew.

Episodes.Title: Glen Peggy Glen Ross
Episodes.Description: Peggy loses her job at The Arlen Bystander and begins a new career as a real estate agent. Meanwhile, after Dale buys a set of titanium golf clubs at a police auction, he gives the clubs to Hank.  However, Hank has trouble playing with a set of clubs that once belonged to a convicted murderer.

Episodes.Title: The Passion of Dauterive
Episodes.Description: After Bill survives a roof cave-in over his bed he has a religious experience which involves a romantic liaison with Reverend Stroup.

Episodes.Title: Grand Theft Arlen
Episodes.Description: Hank becomes obsessed with a video game about propane.  Meanwhile, Bobby trains for the Presidential Fitness Test.

Episodes.Title: Peggy’s Gone to Pots
Episodes.Description: Peggy tries to reach the pinnacle of real estate success by selling houses in the exclusive neighborhood of Arlen Heights, but she winds up selling pots door to door. Meanwhile the real Rusty Shackleford pays a visit to Dale.

Episodes.Title: Hair Today, Gone Today
Episodes.Description: Nancy turns to her mother for help when the stress of home life and unresolved feelings for Redcorn cause her hair to fall out.

Episodes.Title: Bill, Bulk and the Body Buddies
Episodes.Description: Bill has to shape up for an upcoming Army physical, but when he becomes friends with a group of body builders he becomes aggressive and develops a bad attitude.  Hank and the gang have to come to the rescue.

Episodes.Title: Lucky's Wedding Suit
Episodes.Description: When Lucky wants to give Luanne the expensive wedding that she desires, he sues Dale with a frivolous lawsuit after having an accident on the job.  After Lucky's lawyer finds out that Dale does not have insurance, he goes after Strickland Propane.

Episodes.Title: Suite Smells of Excess
Episodes.Description: When the guys take Bobby to a college football game, their hijinks land them in a VIP box suite and calling plays for the visiting team.

Episodes.Title: Bobby Rae
Episodes.Description: To impress a girl, Bobby protests against soda machines in the school.  However, since the teachers have been using the drink machine money to pay for their "retreat", they decide to fight back. Meanwhile, Dale decides to record his friends' witty quotes and put them all in a book.

Episodes.Title: The Powder Puff Boys
Episodes.Description: Hank encourages Bobby when he is asked to cheerleader for the girls in the school's annual Powder Puff game.  Bobby soon learns that there is a tradition and Hank, Bill, Dale and Principal Moss were once "Powder Puff Boys" themselves. However, the boys learn that Peggy and the PTA Are trying to put a stop to the tradition.

Episodes.Title: Four Wave Intersection
Episodes.Description: Arlen is hit by a heat wave and Hank and the gang take the kids to the water park. Unfortunately, when they have to tangle with a group of surfer bullies, Boomhauer, who is usually cool, winds up embarrassing himself. Meanwhile, Bill becomes known as the famous "Heat-Waver" when he begins to stand on the side of the highway and wave to motorists.

Episodes.Title: Death Picks Cotton
Episodes.Description: When the family goes out to a restaurant where the food is cooked at the table Cotton throws a tantrum and gets into a fight with the chef.  The fight leaves Cotton near death in the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Raise the Steaks
Episodes.Description: After Hank falls in love with organic food he starts his own mini co-op garden in his back yard.

Episodes.Title: Tears of an Inflatable Clown
Episodes.Description: Bobby gets mixed up with racial intolerance at Tom Landry Junior High.  Meanwhile, Lucky hurts himself by catching a frisbee made of barbed wire and the gang has to convince him to go to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: The Minh Who Knew Too Much
Episodes.Description: Mihn joins the Arlen Gun Club so that she can practise her skeet-shooting skills and become a member of the Nine Rivers Country Club team.  However, Minh loses track of the goal when she starts to identify with her "hillbilly" neighbors.

Episodes.Title: Dream Weaver
Episodes.Description: After they have financial troubles, Nancy convinces Dale to go on a "vocation vacation" to learn a new career.  Unfortunately, Dale picks basket-weaving, and he's not very good at it. Meanwhile, Peggy, Bill and Kahn try to create the next great Internet video.

Episodes.Title: Doggone Crazy
Episodes.Description: Ladybird is put on a list of vicious dogs after she gets a little crazy and bites Hank.  Afterwards, Hank is urged by a veterinarian to take Ladybird to a "dog spiritualist".

Episodes.Title: Trans-Fascism
Episodes.Description: Hank helps Buck Strickland battle the Arlen City Council and a rival restaurant after "Sugarfoots" loses its business due to a local ban on the sale of foods containing trans fats.

Episodes.Title: Untitled Blake McCormick Project
Episodes.Description: Bill falls in love after he has a blind date with Charlene, a hot single mother. However, Dale's intuition tells him  something is not quite right with the whole situation.

Episodes.Title: The Accidental Terrorist
Episodes.Description: Hank buys Peggy a new car, and like he has always done he pays sticker price for it.  However, after he realizes that he has been ripped off for years, he plots revenge against the car salesman.

Episodes.Title: Lady and Gentrification
Episodes.Description: Hank's agrees to speak at Enrique's daughter's quinceañera.  However, some of Peggy's real-estate clients fall in love with the quaint Mexican neighborhood and start to move in.

Episodes.Title: Behind Closed Doors
Episodes.Description: Peggy becomes over-protective after a child goes missing in Arlen.

Episodes.Title: Pour Some Sugar on Kahn
Episodes.Description: Kahn escapes to the bar and takes up Karaoke after Minh's father comes to visit. Meanwhile, Bobby and Peggy compete in an escalating game where they try to outdo each other.

Episodes.Title: Six Characters in Search of a House
Episodes.Description: Peggy has trouble selling a house when she realizes that the current residents are scaring away the buyers, so she hires actors to play their parts.

Episodes.Title: The Courtship of Joseph's Father
Episodes.Description: Dale's son becomes the star quarterback for Landry High School, but Dale pushes the boy to accept a private school's offer, which includes a cash contract.

Episodes.Title: Strangeness on a Train
Episodes.Description: Stressed that her birthday parties never live up to her expectations, Peggy plans herself a disco-themed party on a mystery train, but after Luanne ruins the surprise, Peggy worries her parties will always end badly. However, a new mystery arises after a couple sneaks away for some private time in the train bathroom, and the partygoers must figure out who did it.

Episodes.Title: Cops and Robert
Episodes.Description: Bobby has to work as a deputy for the school's police officer after he is framed for throwing a soda can.  Meanwhile, Hank accidentally takes the wallet of a man he thought stole his own wallet, however when he tries to return the wallet the man does not take it too well.

Episodes.Title: It Came from the Garage
Episodes.Description: Wanting to spend some quality time with his son, Hank distracts Dale, Bill and Boomhauer with a boat building competition. However, when bats attack the construction garage, Hank has to give up his idea of spending time with Bobby.

Episodes.Title: Life: A Loser's Manual
Episodes.Description: Luanne's long-lost father and Peggy's brother Hoyt, a two-strike felon, comes to Arlen. After Hoyt gets caught committing another crime, Lucky feels bad and takes the blame, leaving Hoyt free to continue his life of crime.

Episodes.Title: Dia-BILL-ic Shock
Episodes.Description: Bill's love of sugary snacks causes diabetes. After a doctor tells Bill that he will lose his legs he decides to start using a wheelchair. Once he is wheelchair bound he finds camaraderie with Thunder, a wheelchair sports enthusiast. Things turn around for Bill until Thunder finds out that Bill does not really need the wheelchair.

Episodes.Title: Earthy Girls Are Easy
Episodes.Description: When a local paper plans to run a story about Strickland Propane dumping old propane tanks into the river, Hank suggests that the company go green. Dale, in an attempt to impress the ladies, organizes an Earth benefit concert.

Episodes.Title: Square-Footed Monster
Episodes.Description: Hank and the guys do a good deed when they fix-up a neighborhood house, however after Ted Wassonasong buys the house he decides to knock down the house and build a mansion.

Episodes.Title: Lost in MySpace
Episodes.Description: Hank has bad feelings when Mr. Strickland decides to create a MySpace page for Strickland Propane. Hank's fears come true when Donna posts personal videos and information to the web site.

Episodes.Title: No Bobby Left Behind
Episodes.Description: In order to raise the school's average for standardized tests, Principal Moss classifies Bobby as a low achievement student. However, the plan backfires after Bobby is placed in a class where he no longer has to do homework and doesn't have to take the tests.

Episodes.Title: A Bill Full of Dollars
Episodes.Description: Peggy, Minh and Dale play the stock market together, however they lose money in their initial investment. To improve their odds they decide to study the consumer habits of an "average man" and Bill becomes the subject of their study. Meanwhile, after Peggy buys the family a new flat screen TV, Hank and Bobby have difficulty figuring out all the advanced features.

Episodes.Title: Straight as an Arrow
Episodes.Description: Hank tries to help Bobby become a member of the Order of the Straight Arrow, but he disagrees with the "Arrowmaster" who is a new member of Arlen. Meanwhile, Peggy gets involved in the disagreement as she is the local Welcome Wagon representative.

Episodes.Title: Lucky See, Monkey Do
Episodes.Description: Lucky's sister Myrna and her children attend a baby shower in which Peggy is throwing for Luanne. It doesn't take long before Myrna and Peggy clash over how the children will be raised by Luanne, with Peggy wanting the good, old fashioned skills where as Myrna likes the more modern way and by the book.

Episodes.Title: What Happens at the National Propane Gas Convention in Memphis Stays at the National Propane Gas Convention in Memphis
Episodes.Description: The Propane Hall of Fame is inducting Buck Strickland this year and he has asked Hank to come with him to make sure he stays out of trouble. This becomes a hard task after Buck meets his illegitimate son while at the event in Memphis.

Episodes.Title: Master of Puppets
Episodes.Description: Bobby is left waiting at the mall when Hank and Peggy's date goes long. Feeling his parents' guilt, Bobby uses the incident to pit each against one another to show him their affection. Soon, Peggy and Hank stop giving him anything Bobby wants and he demands they spend more time with him.

Episodes.Title: Bwah My Nose
Episodes.Description: Hank and the gang get a rematch for the high-school championship game they lost, when Bill accidentally breaks Hank's nose during a practice. He gets it fixed by a plastic surgeon and loves his new nose—maybe too much.

Episodes.Title: Uncool Customer
Episodes.Description: After Peggy finds out that she is not cool she befriends one of Arlen's most glamorous and cool moms in an effort to learn how to be cool. Bobby befriends her daughter, a girl named Michael Savage.

Episodes.Title: Nancy Does Dallas
Episodes.Description: After Nancy takes a glamorous new job in Dallas and temporarily leaving Dale behind he finds the freedom of the bachelor life too hard to handle.

Episodes.Title: Born Again on the Fourth of July
Episodes.Description: Bobby is offered an intervention at the church, after Hank becomes upset by his misbehavior. Meanwhile, Hank and his pals challenge a rival neighborhood to a Fourth of July fireworks showdown

Episodes.Title: Serves Me Right for Giving General George S. Patton the Bathroom Key
Episodes.Description: Hank discovers that his father's last requests are a collection of bizarre tasks including the wish to have his ashes flushed down a toilet that General George S. Patton once used. Meanwhile, Bill and Dale bicker over an empty beer can.

Episodes.Title: Bad News Bill
Episodes.Description: Hank is troubled when Bobby's Little League Coach is hassling Bobby about his lack of ability until Hank realizes that the Coach is only trying to make Bobby a better player.

Episodes.Title: Manger Baby Einstein
Episodes.Description: Luanne tries to become a breakout star in the children's entertainment industry.

Episodes.Title: Uh-Oh Canada
Episodes.Description: After Boomhauer trades houses with a Canadian family for the summer the Arlen gang tries to make some new neighbors at feel welcome. However it soon becomes apparent that Canadians and Arlenites do not see eye to eye.

Episodes.Title: The Boy Can't Help It
Episodes.Description: Bobby becomes quite the ladies' man when several girls in his class consider him a potential date for the Homecoming dance, but Hank is worried that Bobby is being used.

Episodes.Title: To Sirloin with Love
Episodes.Description: Thankful to finally have something in common with his son, Hank is proud when Bobby’s knowledge of beef earns him a spot on a college team bound for the State Championships.

Episodes.Title: Return of the King
Episodes.Description: Hank and Peggy move back to Arlen and struggle to readjust to their old life. Bobby runs into a childhood friend in Dallas.

Episodes.Title: The Beer Story
Episodes.Description: Hank and Bobby are competitors in a home beer brewing competition. Boomhauer bonds with Luke Jr. over non-alcoholic beer.

Episodes.Title: Bobby Gets Grilled
Episodes.Description: In his search for authentic robata charcoal, Bobby is accused of cultural appropriation. The Hills and Gribbles go to the Bush presidential library where Dale incites an incident.

Episodes.Title: Chore Money, Chore Problems
Episodes.Description: Hank joins an app for handymen and struggles to get a good rating. Bobby learns that Connie is dating a mutual friend.

Episodes.Title: New Ref in Town
Episodes.Description: Hank secretly becomes a soccer referee. Bobby goes to buy a car and leaves the dealership with more than he bargained for.

Episodes.Title: Peggy's Fadeout
Episodes.Description: Hank discovers that Bill's new coworkers think he's married, while Bobby discovers Connie's boyfriend may be cheating on her. Peggy struggles with her self-identity after getting rejected from a teaching opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Any Given Hill-Day
Episodes.Description: Bobby tries to bond with Hank at the Dallas Cowboys Fantasy Camp, but Willow interferes. Peggy starts a lending library in an effort to bring the neighborhood together.

Episodes.Title: Kahn-scious Uncoupling
Episodes.Description: The Souphanousinphones throw a lavish anniversary party to hide a secret that only Hank knows. Bobby is stressed out catering the party while trying to help Connie.

Episodes.Title: No Hank Left Behind
Episodes.Description: Hank takes Good Hank to a men's camp to instill good values, but the camp is not what Hank thought it would be. Peggy stays at Bobby's apartment after getting an MRI.

Episodes.Title: A Sounder Investment
Episodes.Description: Peggy and Hank's friends start a pig eradication business, but Hank is hesitant to join them. Bobby and Connie struggle to bond as adults.

Entries.Title: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
Entries.Description: Marinette and Adrien, two Parisian teenagers, are entrusted with powerful jewels in order to transform into superheroes Ladybug and Cat Noir. But neither hero knows the other's true identity — or that they're classmates!

Episodes.Title: Stormy Weather
Episodes.Description: The loser of a kids-channel contest gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Stormy Weather, she takes revenge on those who did not vote for her.  Dark skies await for our superheroes!

Episodes.Title: The Bubbler
Episodes.Description: Adrien's best friend, Nino, is akumatized into the Bubbler, a villain who traps adults in bubbles and sends them floating away into the atmosphere.

Episodes.Title: The Pharaoh
Episodes.Description: When a villain with the power of the ancient Egyptian gods wants to sacrifice Alya, Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight an army of mummies to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Lady Wifi
Episodes.Description: Mistakenly believing that Chloé is Ladybug, Alya gets expelled from school for her nosiness and becomes akumatized into the villain Lady Wifi.

Episodes.Title: Timebreaker
Episodes.Description: When anger over a broken watch turns Alix into a time-traveling villain, it's up to Ladybug to return to the past and thwart her plans.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Pigeon
Episodes.Description: The akuma fighters try to apprehend Mr. Pigeon, a bird lover who has kidnapped all the park keepers in Paris, but Cat Noir's allergies interfere.

Episodes.Title: The Evillustrator
Episodes.Description: A fellow student with a crush on Marinette is akumatized into the Evillustrator, a villain that Cat Noir must face without Ladybug.

Episodes.Title: Rogercop
Episodes.Description: When he's fired by the mayor, police officer Roger becomes Rogercop, a villain who thinks he's enforcing the law by ruling Paris as a dictator.

Episodes.Title: Copycat
Episodes.Description: A jealous sculptor in love with Ladybug akumatizes into Copycat, a duplicate of Cat Noir who tries to take his rival's place by Ladybug's side.

Episodes.Title: Dark Cupid
Episodes.Description: Marinette considers declaring her feelings to Adrien for Valentine's Day, but first they must stop Dark Cupid, a villain bent on eradicating love.

Episodes.Title: Horrificator
Episodes.Description: During the filming of a short horror movie for Marinette's class, scared star Mylène is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds on others' fears.

Episodes.Title: Darkblade
Episodes.Description: While Marinette tries to retrieve her diary from Chloé, Adrien's fencing teacher is akumatized into Darkblade, a villain who storms city hall.

Episodes.Title: The Mime
Episodes.Description: When Mylène's father loses a part in a play to his scheming understudy, he akumatizes into the Mime, a villain whose pantomimes become real.

Episodes.Title: Kung Food
Episodes.Description: When his dish at a competition is sabotaged, Marinette's great-uncle chef Wang Cheng becomes Kung Food, who recruits henchmen with his cooking.

Episodes.Title: Gamer
Episodes.Description: Marinette beats Adrien's video game tournament partner, Max, so she can replace him and spend time with her crush, but Max akumatizes into a villain.

Episodes.Title: Animan
Episodes.Description: A humiliated zookeeper is akumatized into a villainous shapeshifting animal on a day when Marinette, Adrien and friends are visiting the zoo in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Antibug
Episodes.Description: Crestfallen when her hero Ladybug refuses to heed her advice, Chloé akumatizes into Antibug, an evil twin of Ladybug with identical powers.

Episodes.Title: The Puppeteer
Episodes.Description: Marinette babysits little Manon, who becomes akumatized into the Puppeteer while playing with dolls of Ladybug, Cat Noir and some infamous villains.

Episodes.Title: Reflekta
Episodes.Description: Excluded from a class photo, dejected Juleka akumatizes into the villain Reflekta, who turns everyone, including Cat Noir, into copies of herself.

Episodes.Title: Guitar Villain
Episodes.Description: Rock star Jagged Stone is akumatized into a supervillain who tries to transform all Parisians into fans and undermine his musical rival, Mr. XY.

Episodes.Title: Pixelator
Episodes.Description: Rejected by a rock star, an angry fan becomes Pixelator, who traps Parisians in his camera's memory until Cat Noir and Ladybug halt his photo spree.

Episodes.Title: Princess Fragrance
Episodes.Description: Marinette can't transform into Ladybug when classmate Rose is akumatized into a villain whose perfume lets her control Cat Noir and a visiting prince.

Episodes.Title: Simon Says
Episodes.Description: A hypnotist akumatizes into Simon Says, a villain who can make anyone obey him with his deck of cards, and seeks revenge on Adrien's father.

Episodes.Title: Volpina
Episodes.Description: Humiliated in front of Adrien by Marinette, Lila -- a rival who pretends to be Ladybug's friend -- akumatizes into Volpina, a villain of illusions.

Episodes.Title: Ladybug & Cat Noir - Origins, Part 1
Episodes.Description: In a flashback, Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins are revealed, as Marinette befriends Alya and meets Adrien, a famous model with an overprotective dad.

Episodes.Title: Stoneheart - Origins, Part 2
Episodes.Description: In a continuing flashback to Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins, Marinette mistakes Adrien for a bully and hesitates to embrace her Ladybug persona.

Episodes.Title: The Collector
Episodes.Description: Master Fu and Marinette believe that the owner of the Miraculous book is Hawk Moth, but that suspicion leads to either Adrien or his father, Gabriel.

Episodes.Title: Despair Bear
Episodes.Description: Trying to learn how to be nice, Chloé throws a party but loses her temper and fires her butler, who becomes akumatized into the vengeful Despair Bear.

Episodes.Title: Prime Queen
Episodes.Description: During an exclusive interview, a reporter trying to trap Ladybug and Cat Noir into confessing feelings for each other is akumatized by Hawk Moth.

Episodes.Title: Befana
Episodes.Description: When Marinette elects to hang out with her friends on her birthday instead of her grandmother, grandma is akumatized into a candy-gun-wielding baddie.

Episodes.Title: Riposte
Episodes.Description: A fencing opponent who loses a duel against Adrien gets akumatized and goes after him for a rematch while only Ladybug is around to protect him.

Episodes.Title: Robostus
Episodes.Description: Hawk Moth akumatizes Max's best friend and pet robot, Markov, into Robostus, a raging techno-threat with the power to bring inanimate objects to life.

Episodes.Title: Gigantitan
Episodes.Description: Marinette's plans to ask Adrien out on a romantic walk are foiled when Hawk Moth akumatizes a frustrated child into a giant, lollipop-seeking baby.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Owl
Episodes.Description: After school principal Damocles is akumatized into Dark Owl, he traps Ladybug and Cat Noir in a warehouse and tries to uncover their true identities.

Episodes.Title: Glaciator
Episodes.Description: Marinette meets Alya and friends for a treat at André's, a legendary Parisian ice cream maker, but André is akumatized into the villain Glaciator.

Episodes.Title: Sapotis
Episodes.Description: During a sleepover with Marinette, Alya punishes her twin sisters, Etta and Ella, who get akumatized into monsters that multiply when they eat.

Episodes.Title: Gorizilla
Episodes.Description: Marinette must rescue Adrien from a group of overzealous fans and from his own bodyguard, who has been akumatized into the hulking Gorizilla.

Episodes.Title: Captain Hardrock
Episodes.Description: Hawk Moth akumatizes Juleka's mother into Captain Hardrock, a pirate whose indestructible ship blasts loud music to destroy a music festival.

Episodes.Title: Zombizou
Episodes.Description: The students give gifts to Miss Bustier on her birthday but the popular teacher is akumatized into Zombizou, a monster armed with evil black lipstick.

Episodes.Title: Syren
Episodes.Description: When her crush, Kim, goes on a movie date with someone else, talented swimmer Ondine gets akumatized into Syren, who tries to submerge Paris.

Episodes.Title: Frightningale
Episodes.Description: Marinette is cast to play Ladybug and Adrien as Cat Noir for a music video honoring the heroes, but the star gets akumatized into a musical monster.

Episodes.Title: Troublemaker
Episodes.Description: A rock star is scheduled to visit the bakery owned by Marinette's parents, but his overwhelmed personal assistant is akumatized by Hawk Moth.

Episodes.Title: Anansi
Episodes.Description: Alya's older sister Nora becomes akumatized by Hawk Moth into Anansi, an enormous spider-woman hybrid named after an African folktale.

Episodes.Title: Sandboy
Episodes.Description: The supervillain Sandboy uses his powers to turn the nightmares of Parisians into reality, forcing a Tikki-less Marinette to intervene.

Episodes.Title: Reverser
Episodes.Description: Angry over his perception that Marinette and Nathaniel humiliated him, fellow student Marc becomes Reverser, who is determined to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: Frozer
Episodes.Description: A figure skater gets akumatized by Hawk Moth into Frozer, a villain armed with powerful skates who tries to turn Paris into a frozen wasteland.

Episodes.Title: Style Queen: The Queen's Battle (1)
Episodes.Description: When she is humiliated by Gabriel, Chloe's mother becomes Style Queen, who possesses a magical scepter and aims to exact her revenge on Adrien.

Episodes.Title: Queen Wasp: The Queen's Battle (2)
Episodes.Description: In an attempt to impress her mother, Chloe tries to become the superhero Queen Bee but is instead transformed into the supervillain Queen Wasp.

Episodes.Title: Malediktator
Episodes.Description: When Chloe considers leaving Paris, her father, Mayor Bourgeois, turns into Malediktator, a powerful villain who wants her to stay at any cost.

Episodes.Title: Catalyst: Heroes' Day (1)
Episodes.Description: Marinette lies about preparing a good deed to perform for others on the Day of Heroes and quickly finds her untruth spinning out of control.

Episodes.Title: Mayura: Heroes' Day (2)
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face one of their most fearsome opponents when Hawk Moth sets a sinister plan into motion by akumatizing his assistant.

Episodes.Title: Backwarder
Episodes.Description: After Marinette mixes up some messages, an old love of Master Fu becomes Backwarder, who wields a magic wand that can steal time from others.

Episodes.Title: Weredad
Episodes.Description: Disappointed that Cat Noir doesn't return his daughter's love, Tom becomes Weredad, who locks Marinette in a magic prison to protect her from hurt.

Episodes.Title: Chameleon
Episodes.Description: Marinette and Adrien confront Lila with her lies, so she asks Hawk Moth to akumatize her into Chameleon, a new villain determined to destroy Ladybug.

Episodes.Title: Animaestro
Episodes.Description: Humiliated at the premiere of his new Ladybug and Cat Noir movie, the director becomes Animaestro, forcing the real superheroes to act fast.

Episodes.Title: Bakerix
Episodes.Description: Marinette meets her grumpy grandpa for the first time, leading him to akumatize into a villain who wants to destroy everything modern in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Silencer
Episodes.Description: Marinette and Kitty Section record a music video, but an unscrupulous producer, the father of XY, steals their ideas and inspires Luka to seek revenge.

Episodes.Title: Oblivio
Episodes.Description: When they enter the Montparnasse Tower, Ladybug and Cat Noir lose their memories and transform back into Marinette and Adrien in front of each other.

Episodes.Title: Stormy Weather 2
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight Aurore Boreale when she is akumatized again into Stormy Weather 2, who wants to plunge the world into endless winter.

Episodes.Title: Reflekdoll
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir each get the other's Miraculous when they must take on Juleka, who has become Reflekta again and now has a sentimonster.

Episodes.Title: Oni-Chan
Episodes.Description: Kagami becomes jealous when Lila manipulates her way into the Agreste mansion and turns into Oni-Chan, a masked villain who can teleport.

Episodes.Title: Miraculer
Episodes.Description: Sabrina, angry at Chloe for the attention she gives to Ladybug, becomes Miraculer, who can steal powers away from superheroes.

Episodes.Title: The Puppeteer 2
Episodes.Description: Marinette tries to arrange some alone time with Adrien at the wax museum, but she's supposed to be babysitting Manon, who becomes Puppeteer again.

Episodes.Title: Desperada
Episodes.Description: Jagged Stone seeks to replace the guitarist he fired, who akumatizes into Desperada, a villain with a magic guitar that turns people into stickers.

Episodes.Title: Startrain
Episodes.Description: Anxiously awaiting news about her astronaut application, Max's mom becomes Startrain, who wants to turn her train into a rocket ship.

Episodes.Title: Kwamibuster
Episodes.Description: Mrs. Mendeleiev discovers Plagg and Tikki and plans to reveal the existence of the kwamis on a TV show until she is akumatized into Kwami Buster.

Episodes.Title: Feast
Episodes.Description: A strange statue uncovered in Tibet turns out to be a sentimonster called Feast that was created accidentally by Master Fu when he was a child.

Episodes.Title: Ikari Gozen
Episodes.Description: Adrien is the prize in a Paris-wide Friendship Day treasure hunt, but Marinette is teamed up with Kagami, who has disobeyed her mother to participate.

Episodes.Title: Timetagger
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir are trapped between two time travelers from the future, one of whom has been sent by Hawk Moth to steal their Miraculous.

Episodes.Title: Party Crasher
Episodes.Description: After Adrien tells his friend Wayem he's not allowed to have friends over, Wayem discovers an impromptu party at the Agrestes that makes him jealous.

Episodes.Title: Gamer 2.0
Episodes.Description: When he can't find anyone to test his video game that pits formerly akumatized villains against one another, Max again becomes one himself: Gamer 2.0.

Episodes.Title: Cat Blanc
Episodes.Description: Marinette uses her powers to leave a gift for Adrien, causing him to realize her secret identity -- which has a devastating impact on the future.

Episodes.Title: Félix
Episodes.Description: Marinette reveals her feelings for Adrien on the anniversary of his mom's death, but his lookalike cousin pretends to be Adrien and responds cruelly.

Episodes.Title: Ladybug
Episodes.Description: Marinette's scheming nemesis Lila manipulates all of her friends into turning against her and even gets Marinette expelled from school.

Episodes.Title: Chris Master
Episodes.Description: Marinette babysits Nino's little brother, Chris, who akumatizes into Chris Master and wields a magic snow globe that can make giant toys.

Episodes.Title: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 1)
Episodes.Description: At a celebration for their twentieth anniversary, the Bourgeois couple is akumatized into Hearthunter, a two-headed Cerberus that devours love.

Episodes.Title: Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Hawk Moth changes Chloe into Miracle Queen and conquers Paris, forcing Miraculous wearers to reveal themselves -- but Ladybug and Cat Noir escape.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: A friend of Marinette's gets akumatized into Truth. Using his power to force people to tell the truth, he wants to know Marinette's secret.

Episodes.Title: Lies
Episodes.Description: A friend of Adrien's gets akumatized into Lies and becomes determined to rid the world of lies and those who tell them.

Episodes.Title: Gang of Secrets
Episodes.Description: Marinette's friends get akumatized into the Gang of Secrets, a team of supervillains determined to save her.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Pigeon 72
Episodes.Description: Mr. Ramier gets akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time, and now he can turn people into evil pigeons.

Episodes.Title: Furious Fu
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face someone they know well, and never imagined they would have to fight someday.

Episodes.Title: Sole Crusher
Episodes.Description: A newcomer to Marinette's circle of friends gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, a humongous supervillain who can absorb people.

Episodes.Title: Queen Banana
Episodes.Description: Chloe is akumatized into Queen Banana and Ladybug decides to entrust a Miraculous to help her stop a supervillain.

Episodes.Title: Guiltrip
Episodes.Description: When Reflekta becomes entangled in a bottomless abyss of guilt, Ladybug calls an ally for help with unshakable optimism.

Episodes.Title: Crocoduel
Episodes.Description: Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo.

Episodes.Title: Optigami
Episodes.Description: What would happen if Shadow Moth created a fearsome supervillain while Marinette and Adrien couldn't transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir?

Episodes.Title: Sentibubbler
Episodes.Description: Shadow Moth creates Sentibubbler, a fearsome sentimonster that will only stop if Rena Rouge betrays Ladybug and Cat Noir!

Episodes.Title: Rocketear
Episodes.Description: As Guardian of Miraculous, Ladybug must make difficult decisions which affect the people around her. But not everyone is ready to live in permanent hiding like her...

Episodes.Title: Mega Leech
Episodes.Description: When Malediktator comes back, now seconded by a Sentimonster, Ladybug entrusts a committed friend and ally with a Miraculous to help her save Paris.

Episodes.Title: Wishmaker
Episodes.Description: As Marinette thinks about her future, a supervillain shows up in Paris. Able to force people to live their childhood dreams, he turns into a nightmare for our heroes.

Episodes.Title: Hack-San
Episodes.Description: When Marinette needs to leave Paris for a day for her aunt's birthday in London, the fear of something happening in Ladybug's absence makes her super nervous. Shadow Moth manages to infect Max's robot with an evil virus to akumatize it again. What will happen?

Episodes.Title: Simpleman
Episodes.Description: Adrien asks Marinette a favor, who can't say no and ends up leaving her grandfather taking care of the 4 children she was taking care of to help Adrien. What she doesn't realize is that it ends up making her grandfather the Shadow Moth's next target.

Episodes.Title: Glaciator 2
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again. Glaciator annoys Ladybug by insisting that the superheroes are in love. Cat Noir encounters Marinette, who wrestles with secret romance.

Episodes.Title: Dearest Family
Episodes.Description: Galette Day is eventful for Marinette! Tikki is acting very strange and three supervillains show up! Will Ladybug still manage to establish herself as queen of the day?

Episodes.Title: Ephemeral
Episodes.Description: Ladybug decides whether she should reveal Cat Noir's identity so that she can remain the Guardian.

Episodes.Title: Gabriel Agreste
Episodes.Description: Marinette sneaks into the Agreste home during a private dinner, only to find that a supervillain is also crashing the party.

Episodes.Title: Psycomedian
Episodes.Description: A famous comedian gets akumatized into Psycomedian; able to impose any emotions on anyone, he wants to wipe the smiles off everyone's faces starting with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

Episodes.Title: Kuro Neko
Episodes.Description: Ladybug manages to assemble an amazing team of superheroes now that she is Guardian of the Miraculous, but Cat Noir is feeling left out and decides to give up his Miraculous. Ladybug now needs to deliver the Cat Miraculous to someone else.

Episodes.Title: Penalteam
Episodes.Description: When one of Shadow Moth's favorite victims is akumatized into Penalteam, a fearsome team of supervillains, Ladybug calls on her own superhero team in order to face her; may the best team win.

Episodes.Title: Qilin
Episodes.Description: Because one of Marinette's careless mistakes, one of her closet relatives is akumatized into Qilin, a fearsome supervillain.

Episodes.Title: Risk (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 1)
Episodes.Description: Without Ladybug and Cat Noir knowing, Shadow Moth patiently sets his final attack in motion...

Episodes.Title: Strikeback (Shadow Moth's Final Attack - Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Shadow Moth's trap closes in on Ladybug and Cat Noir, threatening to turn their fate upside down forever...

Episodes.Title: Evolution
Episodes.Description: After having access to almost all the Miraculouses, Hawk Moth turns into Monarch and uses the Rabbit Miraculous to return to a vulnerable moment in Ladybug and Cat Noir's past to capture their Miraculous.

Episodes.Title: Multiplication
Episodes.Description: As the days go by, not a single akumatized villain shows up to torment Paris. Could Monarch possibly have given up?

Episodes.Title: Destruction
Episodes.Description: What if Ladybug's worst nightmare came true? What if Monarch showed up at Marinette Dupain-Cheng's home... would she be able to escape him?

Episodes.Title: Jubilation
Episodes.Description: Monarch entrusts an akumatized villain with the power of Jubilation, which shows people their deepest desires. Will Ladybug and Cat Noir escape that dangerous power?

Episodes.Title: Determination
Episodes.Description: While Marinette and Adrien wonder about their feelings, Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain... and her 17 goons!

Episodes.Title: Passion
Episodes.Description: As everything turns upside down in their love lives, Ladybug and Cat Noir must exchange their Miraculous to escape a ruthless villain.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: While visiting the Louvre museum, Marinette discovers the secrets of the kwagatama that Tikki gave her on her birthday.

Episodes.Title: Illusion
Episodes.Description: A secret network at school is determined to find out how Monarch's new power works by deliberately triggering an akumatization. Would Ladybug and Cat Noir agree with such a plan?

Episodes.Title: Elation
Episodes.Description: As Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again, our heroes don’t know that they are about to make a chilling discovery!

Episodes.Title: Transmission (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 1)
Episodes.Description: Tikki and Plagg are sad to see their carriers so sad to be forced to give up their feelings. The Kwamis will then make a radical choice that will change many things in Paris.

Episodes.Title: Deflagration (The Kwamis' Choice - Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Monarch is faced with a unique opportunity that he refuses to miss. The world is about to be reconfigured, and no one seems able to prevent it, for the Kwamis have made a choice that completely freed Marinette and Adrien from their responsibilities. For better… and for worse.

Episodes.Title: Perfection
Episodes.Description: The whole class has decided to do everything to help Marinette finally get closer to Adrien, but what they don't know is that she also has come up with a unique plan to try and tell Adrien how she feels.

Episodes.Title: Migration
Episodes.Description: As the son of a celebrity, Luka piques special interest in Bob Roth, who would do anything to make money! But Luka himself would do anything to defend his values and his friends.

Episodes.Title: Derision
Episodes.Description: Marinette is about to have a normal date with Adrien, but she starts to suffer repeated panic attacks creating an emotional situation that can make her a target for Monarch.

Episodes.Title: Intuition
Episodes.Description: Monarch senses a unique occasion to get a real second chance. He is ready to do anything, even if it means that this could be his last chance to seize the Miraculous.

Episodes.Title: Protection
Episodes.Description: While the gang concocts yet another elaborate plan to reunite Marinette and Adrien, Lila uses her talents for manipulation to persuade Kagami that Marinette is a liar.

Episodes.Title: Adoration
Episodes.Description: Marinette learns that Zoé is secretly in love with someone in ninth grade at school. Zoé says that she cannot talk about it. To Marinette, this can only mean one thing: Zoé is in love with Adrien!

Episodes.Title: Emotion
Episodes.Description: Adrien must attend the Diamonds’ Dance organized by his father and Mrs. Tsurugi. When she finds out that Adrien did not dare to tell her about the dance, Marinette decides to go too.

Episodes.Title: Pretension
Episodes.Description: Marinette decides to have a frank talk with Gabriel Agreste about her love for Adrien, and her courage inspires her friend Kagami as she tries to open up to her mother.

Episodes.Title: Revelation
Episodes.Description: Marinette and Adrien’s closeness pushes the boy’s father to make Kagami the face of the brand, which infuriates Lila. She uses the class accident to call for a new election so that she can replace Marinette as class representative.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: The end of secondary school is approaching and Lila & Chloé have to defend their classmates futures in front of the class council. Marinette is worried. What will be the next evil plan of the 2 villains?

Episodes.Title: Collusion
Episodes.Description: The end of the school year is approaching and the rebellion is growing. Monarch decides to implement a dangerous plan for his secret identity, but also very precarious for Ladybug and Cat Noir.

Episodes.Title: Revolution
Episodes.Description: Chloé is more powerful than ever and, thanks to her, so is Monarch. Ladybug and Cat Noir wonder about their superpowers, unaware that they have just fallen into a machiavellian trap. As for Marinette and Adrien, their lives are about to change forever.

Episodes.Title: Representation
Episodes.Description: When Adrien disobeys his father to join Marinette, the latter is forced to find his son. At the same time, Marinette is convinced that Adrien is looking for her. Thinking she will find the boy she loves, she discovers a secret that nothing prepared her for.

Episodes.Title: Conformation (The Final Day - Part 1)
Episodes.Description: Monarch has just placed the final pieces of his machiavellian plan on his chessboard of evil. Are Ladybug and Chat Noir doomed?

Episodes.Title: Re-creation (The Final Day - Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Monarch's ultimate plan is now underway. Nothing seems to be able to stop him. Especially as, while the world is plunged into chaos, the super-villain has just trapped Ladybug himself.

Episodes.Title: The Illustrhater
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and her team face a villain full of imagination.

Episodes.Title: Sublimation
Episodes.Description: Adrien has made a new friend whom Marinette is determined to befriend too. But Marinette has no clue how to become friends with someone who doesn't need to be helped.

Episodes.Title: Werepapas
Episodes.Description: When Adrien gets nervous about meeting his grandparents, Marinette gatecrashes the lunch to support him... unaware that a family war is about to break out.

Episodes.Title: Daddycop
Episodes.Description: To celebrate her hundredth kiss with Adrien, Marinette has planned a romantic evening - forgetting that she'd already planned a movie night with her girlfriends at the same time!

Episodes.Title: Revelator
Episodes.Description: Marinette and Adrien are now the most famous couple in Paris. As such, they catch the attention of an unscrupulous influencer who will do anything to generate buzz...

Episodes.Title: Climatiqueen
Episodes.Description: Ladybug and Cat Noir face a villain determined to steal their thunder. Will the superheroes weather the storm?

Episodes.Title: El Toro de Piedra
Episodes.Description: While Ivan faces a difficult family situation, Marinette finds a letter addressed to Adrien...from his father.

Episodes.Title: The Ruler
Episodes.Description: While trying desperately to hide her seasonal cold from Adrien, Marinette tries to help Nathaniel assert himself so he can illustrate the comic Marc wrote for him.
