Episodes.Title: The Bet
Episodes.Description: Bobert becomes Gumball's servant and obeys every command he receives.

Episodes.Title: Christmas
Episodes.Description: Santa Claus is coming to town. Unfortunately he gets run over by the Wattersons, so it's up to them to save Christmas.

Episodes.Title: The Watch
Episodes.Description: The guys try to retrieve a family heirloom from an old man.

Episodes.Title: The Bumpkin
Episodes.Description: Gumball envies rural life and asks Idaho to teach his family to live like potatoes.

Episodes.Title: The Flakers
Episodes.Description: Darwin abandons Gumball when faced with a beating by Tina, so Gumball plots revenge.

Episodes.Title: The Authority
Episodes.Description: After Richard is hospitalized from an accident, Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger, which leads Nicole to disagree with her parenting style.

Episodes.Title: The Virus
Episodes.Description: An evil virus seeks vengeance on Gumball, Darwin, and Teri after they wipe out his army of bacteria.

Episodes.Title: The Pony
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin rent a film to watch with Anais, but they keep getting distracted on their way home.

Episodes.Title: The Hero
Episodes.Description: Richard gets upset when he realizes Gumball and Darwin think of him as a laughing stock.

Episodes.Title: The Dream
Episodes.Description: Darwin kisses Penny in one of Gumball's dreams and he gets mad about it.

Episodes.Title: The Sidekick
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin try to get a game back from Tobias, but Darwin begins to feel like he is just a sidekick to Gumball.

Episodes.Title: The Photo
Episodes.Description: Gumball tries to look good in the school photos.

Episodes.Title: The Tag
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin get caught in the middle of a trash can feud between Richard and Mr. Robinson.

Episodes.Title: The Storm
Episodes.Description: A plot to improve Alan and Carmen's relationship backfires, and Gumball has to reunite them.

Episodes.Title: The Lesson
Episodes.Description: The guys have detention and try to escape; Granny JoJo is overprotective and puts the family in danger.

Episodes.Title: The Game
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons play Dodge or Dare (Dodj or Daar).

Episodes.Title: The Limit
Episodes.Description: Mom lets the Wattersons have it in a supermarket.

Episodes.Title: The Voice
Episodes.Description: When Gumball and Darwin receive a scary email, everyone is a suspect...

Episodes.Title: The Promise
Episodes.Description: Darwin has promised to play video games with Gumball, but there is a Banana Joe-shaped problem...

Episodes.Title: The Castle
Episodes.Description: When Nicole is away "anything goes" and Richard's lack of rules soon attracts unwelcome house guests.

Episodes.Title: The Boombox
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin try to understand Juke's urgent beatbox message.

Episodes.Title: The Tape
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin fail to make instant home movie classics.

Episodes.Title: The Sweaters
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin's reputation is challenged and they really couldn't care less...

Episodes.Title: The Internet
Episodes.Description: Gumball decides to take down the Internet after he accidentally creates an embarrasing viral web video.

Episodes.Title: The Plan
Episodes.Description: The Watterson kids come up with a fool-proof plan to save Nicole, but is it Gumball-proof?

Episodes.Title: The World
Episodes.Description: The life of the "inanimate" objects of Elmore are shown in a series of short skits.

Episodes.Title: The Finale
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons are surprised to discover that their past actions have consequences.

Episodes.Title: The Kids
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin's voices may be breaking, but they're showing no signs of growing up. Whilst Gumball and Darwin make fun of Mom and Dad for being old, their voices start to break. They try to ignore it, but everybody they meet reacts to their new and unpredictable voices.

Episodes.Title: The Fan
Episodes.Description: New Elmore Junior High student Sarah becomes Gumball and Darwin's obsessive number-one fan.

Episodes.Title: The Coach
Episodes.Description: The new coach at Elmore High stands up to Jamie. The new Coach witnesses Jamie bullying the other kids at lunch and steps in. Jamie is made to apologize, much to the amazement of the other kids. Gumball and Darwin worry about Jamie seeking revenge, especially when they see her sneaking into the back of Coach's car.

Episodes.Title: The Joy
Episodes.Description: When Miss Simian sees Gumball and Darwin joyful on Monday, she knows that something is wrong with them. She performs tests on them, but the nurse disapproves what she's doing. But suddenly, Gumball and Darwin start to infect the school with the 'Joy Virus', and it's up to Miss Simian and her tape player to cure the students.

Episodes.Title: The Puppy
Episodes.Description: The Watterson children's long-awaited pet puppy turns out to be a turtle which hates them.

Episodes.Title: The Recipe
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin discover the secret behind their classmate Anton's immortality.

Episodes.Title: The Name
Episodes.Description: When Mom reveals that Gumball's real name is "Zach," Gumball adopts a cheesy, annoying persona to match the name. His family tries to make him remember the old Gumball, as this new Zach persona is progressively taking over Gumball's life and erasing his memories.

Episodes.Title: The Extras
Episodes.Description: Skits about the random extra characters seen throughout the series.

Episodes.Title: The Gripes
Episodes.Description: When Gumball and Darwin begin to complain about every little thing in their lives, the people of Elmore City mistakenly assumes charity cases and put together a benefit to raise money for them, leaving them having to fix the mix-up.

Episodes.Title: The Vacation
Episodes.Description: While driving to a campground, Nicole tells a horror story, which slowly starts to come true as their car breaks down and a stranger comes to help them out.

Episodes.Title: The Fraud
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin discover Principal Brown's diploma is fake, and Principal Brown is determined to keep their discovery a secret.

Episodes.Title: The Void
Episodes.Description: When Gumball and Darwin investigate a missing classmate, they discover a far greater mystery... about Elmore.

Episodes.Title: The Boss
Episodes.Description: Mr. Robinson has a stress attack and needs a  stuffing transfusion from his son Rocky the janitor. He won't take it unless Rocky gets a better job in life. Rocky gets one with Chanax, where he becomes a work drone. Gumball and Darwin now need to get Rocky's soul back from his boss in order to get him to surgery.

Episodes.Title: The Move
Episodes.Description: Clayton, a compulsive liar tells Gumball and Darwin about his awesome martial arts move, and discover that he wasn't lying.

Episodes.Title: The Law
Episodes.Description: Doughnut Cop shows Gumball and Darwin that the smallest misdemeanor can lead to a breakdown in law.

Episodes.Title: The Allergy
Episodes.Description: Gumball needs to find a cure for Darwin's allergy before he sneezes Elmore off the map.

Episodes.Title: The Mothers
Episodes.Description: It's Mother's Day and kids put their moms through a series of tests to determine who has the World's Greatest Mom.

Episodes.Title: The Password
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin are shocked to discover that Anais is Dad's favorite child.

Episodes.Title: The Procrastinators
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin spend the day doing other things instead of taking out the trash like their mother told them to do before she got back home.

Episodes.Title: The Shell
Episodes.Description: Gumball inadvertently cracks open Penny's shell, and discovers who she really is inside...

Episodes.Title: The Burden
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin are left in charge of the class pet hamster, Chris Morris, but they end up leaving it at school over the weekend.

Episodes.Title: The Bros
Episodes.Description: Darwin becomes jealous of Gumball and Penny's new relationship and sets out to find information that will break them up.

Episodes.Title: The Mirror
Episodes.Description: Gumball refuses to forward an e-mail purportedly sent by a ghost, against Darwin's advice. When a curse begins to take effect and their family is dragged into another dimension, Gumball and Darwin seek Carrie's help to save them.

Episodes.Title: The Man
Episodes.Description: After Granny Jojo brings her new boyfriend to dinner at the Watterson household, Richard forbids her from seeing the boyfriend again.

Episodes.Title: The Pizza
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons have had a bad day, but it turns out Larry has too and it's about to get worse... for everyone!

Episodes.Title: The Lie
Episodes.Description: Noticing that everyone is in the doldrums of January, Gumball and Anais invent a new holiday to spark excitement.

Episodes.Title: The Butterfly
Episodes.Description: When a Butterfly emerges from its chrysalis Gumball and Darwin want to release it. Miss Simian warns them about the butterfly effect. Gumball releases it anyways, and a domino effect causes chaos throughout the city.

Episodes.Title: The Question
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin try to figure out the meaning of life after coming down from a sugar rush.

Episodes.Title: The Saint
Episodes.Description: After failing at making Alan lose his temper, Gumball and Darwin decide to adopt Alan's positive attitude.

Episodes.Title: The Friend
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin help Anais make up an imaginary friend who turns out to be all too real.

Episodes.Title: The Oracle
Episodes.Description: After discovering a prophetic painting depicting Gumball's naked run through the mall, he is determined to avoid that outcome.

Episodes.Title: The Safety
Episodes.Description: Darwin becomes obsessed with safety after seeing a video in class.

Episodes.Title: The Society
Episodes.Description: Gumball is convinced there is a Secret Society in school, and he wants in.

Episodes.Title: The Spoiler
Episodes.Description: When Gumball and Darwin have to wait to see a movie, they must go an entire week without someone spoiling the plot.

Episodes.Title: The Countdown
Episodes.Description: Miss Simian threatens to expel the boys if they are late for school, so they race a clock in order to arrive on time.

Episodes.Title: The Nobody
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin investigate the disappearance  of the family's stuff only to find out some stranger is living in the house with them.

Episodes.Title: The Downer
Episodes.Description: When Gumball's family tries to cheer him out of an inexplicable lousy mood, he wishes they would all disappear.

Episodes.Title: The Egg
Episodes.Description: Nicole wants to show to Felicity that the Wattersons are a normal family, while her son, Billy, meets Anais.

Episodes.Title: The Triangle
Episodes.Description: Gumball grows jealous of Darwin's new talent.

Episodes.Title: The Money
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons become poor when Richard loses all their money.

Episodes.Title: The Return
Episodes.Description: Richard tries to find the kids before Nicole realizes they're gone.

Episodes.Title: The Nemesis
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin discover that Rob, who once swore to wreak vengeance on them, has been trying to destroy them for some time… but his traps never work.

Episodes.Title: The Crew
Episodes.Description: When Gumball and Darwin decide to join a crew, they are determined to prove their worth to senior citizens.

Episodes.Title: The Others
Episodes.Description: After learning what grade Anais is in, Gumball and Darwin learn that there is a whole new world of students.

Episodes.Title: The Signature
Episodes.Description: When Richard learns of Granny Jojo's plans to marry, he sets out to adopt Louie so he can forbid the wedding.

Episodes.Title: The Check
Episodes.Description: Gumball, Darwin and Anais are delighted when Grandpa Louie gives them a check for $5000, but the family soon fights over how to spend it.

Episodes.Title: The Pest
Episodes.Description: When they find Anais training herself for a brutal showdown, Gumball and Darwin realise that their sister is being pestered at school by an annoying kid: Billy. They try to teach her how to resolve the problem peacefully, but Billy has other ideas.

Episodes.Title: The Sale
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin are crushed to learn that Mr. Robinson is selling his house and moving away, and when trying to make their final moments together last doesn't work, the duo decide to sabotage the sale.

Episodes.Title: The Gift
Episodes.Description: After they receive an extravagant invitation to Masami's birthday party, Gumball and Darwin are anxious to find just the right gift for her. However, they're not the only ones: it turns out every kid in Elmore is competing to get Masami the perfect present.

Episodes.Title: The Parking
Episodes.Description: When the Wattersons arrive at the mall for a day of shopping, they struggle to find a space in the parking lot. They search for a space everywhere -- using all their intelligence, cunning and trickery -- but as the day goes on, the desperate hunt for a space becomes more important than the trip to the mall itself.

Episodes.Title: The Routine
Episodes.Description: Richard's trip to the store to find mayonnaise for the family's burger night turns into a Neverending Story-meets-Conan the Barbarian-style quest where he squares off against Tina Rex's father, Mr. Rex.

Episodes.Title: The Upgrade
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin upgrade Bobert the robot – and discover that his new operating system is full of buggy and useless applications and is prone to crashing.

Episodes.Title: The Comic
Episodes.Description: Sarah creates a comic of Gumball as a superhero named LaserHeart, prompting Gumball to act like one in real life.

Episodes.Title: The Romantic
Episodes.Description: Fearing that she may be sick of him due to a missing emoji on her message to him, Gumball sends Penny on a romantic quest to rekindle their love, which turns into a disaster when Penny gets lost in the woods.

Episodes.Title: The Uploads
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin get hooked on watching Elmore Stream (the show's version of YouTube) and viewers get a look at the different online videos the residents of Elmore have uploaded on the Internet.

Episodes.Title: The Apprentice
Episodes.Description: Gumball tags along with Patrick Fitzgerald (Penny's father) as Patrick prepares to pitch plans for a new hospital to the CEO of Chanax -- and ends up roping him into a golf game with the CEO.

Episodes.Title: The Hug
Episodes.Description: To prove to Darwin that he can be unpredictable, Gumball decides to hug the first person he sees -- an anthropomorphic hot dog -- and Gumball ends up in over his head when he and the Hot Dog Guy can't stop bumping into each other.

Episodes.Title: The Wicked
Episodes.Description: After being framed for feeding coffee- and prune juice-laced nuts to the squirrels, Darwin tries to prove to Gumball that Mr. Robinson's wife, Margaret, is a good person underneath her destructive, sociopathic tendencies, but when Darwin sees just how evil Margaret is, the duo decide to catch her committing grand theft auto.

Episodes.Title: The Traitor
Episodes.Description: When Alan allegedly ditches Gumball's dinner date with him, Gumball is desperate to track him down and make him pay for his betrayal, only to learn that Alan is taking his mother, Jessica, to the hospital for an organ transplant.

Episodes.Title: The Origins (1)
Episodes.Description: In this, the first half-hour episode, a four-year-old Gumball becomes too much for young parents, Nicole and Richard, to handle, so they buy him a goldfish, but after the first six die from neglect, stupidity, and unfortunate incidents, Richard finds a special one in a shady red van who bonds with Gumball on a spiritual level. This gets put to the test when Darwin gets flushed down the toilet and must traverse a scary, new world to return home.

Episodes.Title: The Origins (2)
Episodes.Description: In this, the first half-hour episode, a four-year-old Gumball becomes too much for young parents, Nicole and Richard, to handle, so they buy him a goldfish, but after the first six die from neglect, stupidity, and unfortunate incidents, Richard finds a special one in a shady red van who bonds with Gumball on a spiritual level. This gets put to the test when Darwin gets flushed down the toilet and must traverse a scary, new world to return home.

Episodes.Title: The Girlfriend
Episodes.Description: After seeing Alan and Carmen bond during her lunchtime bullying, Jamie decides that she needs a sweetheart... and has her eyes on Darwin.

Episodes.Title: The Advice
Episodes.Description: Mr. Small feels that he hasn't inspired the children of Elmore Junior High, so Gumball and Darwin try to lift his spirits... and end up causing chaos and putting most of the students (and faculty) in the school infirmary (and others in the hospital) after following Mr. Small's useless advice.

Episodes.Title: The Signal
Episodes.Description: Gumball develops a strange stutter, and it makes him accidentally offend Darwin.

Episodes.Title: The Parasite
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin read Anais' diary and discover her relationship with a new friend is one-sided.

Episodes.Title: The Love
Episodes.Description: The people of Elmore search for the meaning of love.

Episodes.Title: The Awkwardness
Episodes.Description: Gumball is walking in the same direction as Hot Dog Guy, and with each step it becomes increasingly awkward.

Episodes.Title: The Nest
Episodes.Description: A neighbor disappears and the Wattersons investigate, but discover the culprit may be their Evil Turtle.

Episodes.Title: The Points
Episodes.Description: In order for Tobias to let them use his points in a video game, Gumball and Darwin must do his chores for him.

Episodes.Title: The Bus
Episodes.Description: Rocky convinces the kids that they do not have to go to school. However, unbeknownst to the kids, some adults are trying to teach them about skipping school.

Episodes.Title: The Night
Episodes.Description: The Moon examines dreams and nightmares of Elmore residents.

Episodes.Title: The Misunderstandings
Episodes.Description: On his way to a date with Penny, Gumball finds himself dealing with people at their most oblivious.

Episodes.Title: The Roots
Episodes.Description: The family tries to make Darwin connect with his fish roots.

Episodes.Title: The Blame
Episodes.Description: After Felicity bans video games in Elmore, Gumball and his friends try to have books banned instead.

Episodes.Title: The Slap
Episodes.Description: Tobias offends Gumball when he doesn't slap him on the butt.

Episodes.Title: The Detective
Episodes.Description: When Daisy goes missing, Anais suspects Gumball and Darwin.

Episodes.Title: The Fury
Episodes.Description: A strange figure arrives and insults Nicole, but the kids are surprised when Nicole doesn't fight back.

Episodes.Title: The Compilation
Episodes.Description: Odd internet clips are recalled by the people of Elmore.

Episodes.Title: The Scam
Episodes.Description: Gumball scares the school into thinking a monster named Gargaroth is haunting the place, then recruits Carrie and Darwin (who has a crush on Carrie) as ghost exterminators in order to scam everyone in Elmore of their candy.

Episodes.Title: The Disaster
Episodes.Description: Rob gets new powers through a remote control and tries to destroy Gumball's world.

Episodes.Title: The Stories
Episodes.Description: Fed up with having to listen to Molly's long, tedious anecdotes, Gumball and Darwin try to teach her how to make them sound more exciting. When this doesn't work, they decide their only option is to give Molly a story worth telling.

Episodes.Title: The Re-Run
Episodes.Description: In this sequel to last season's "The Disaster", Gumball travels back to the events of the previous episode to prevent Rob from ruining his life, but everything he does makes things worse.

Episodes.Title: The Guy
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin are wary of Anais' new friend, Josh, making her question his motives as well.

Episodes.Title: The Boredom
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin search for adventure during a walk around Elmore.

Episodes.Title: The Vision
Episodes.Description: After finding a secret manifesto on Alan's memory stick, Gumball and Darwin decide to foil his plan for world domination.

Episodes.Title: The Choices
Episodes.Description: Nicole reminisces about how she met Richard during a disastrous family dinner, and how things could have turned out for her if she had not.

Episodes.Title: The Code
Episodes.Description: The family goes without wi-fi after Mr. Robinson changes the passcode, so Gumball tries to recover it.

Episodes.Title: The Test
Episodes.Description: When he is labeled a "loser" in an online test, Gumball believes he must do the opposite of everything he would normally do. Meanwhile, Darwin and Sarah notice Tobias is stealing Gumball's life and role in the series in the form of a cheesy sitcom.

Episodes.Title: The Slide
Episodes.Description: Rocky decides to stop living life online, and find love on a dating app, and Gumball and Darwin try to help him.

Episodes.Title: The Loophole
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin give Bobert instructions so he will behave in a safe and responsible manner, but he applies his logic to their rules.

Episodes.Title: The Potato
Episodes.Description: When Darwin has lunch with Idaho, he decides to stop eating potatoes in solidarity with his brotato, but he finds his obsession with his favorite food harder to kick than he ever imagined, so Gumball decides to help his friend curb his carb cravings.

Episodes.Title: The Fuss
Episodes.Description: Nicole tries, and fails, to hide her disappointment when Richard and the kids fail to remember her special day. Richard has to figure out what special day he has actually forgotten and then make it a day to remember or else.

Episodes.Title: The Copycats
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin are confused when they meet Chi Chi and Ribbit, a pair of siblings that copy everything they do and say. Then they find out this copycat family is making money online from imitating the Watterson family.

Episodes.Title: The Outside
Episodes.Description: The family goes to visit Richard's dad. Based on his basic living standards and extended absence from Richard's life, they assume Frankie must have done a stretch in the slammer.

Episodes.Title: The Vase
Episodes.Description: Sick of Granny Jojo's ugly gifts, Nicole encourages the kids to take matters into their own hands and "accidentally" break her latest hideous vase. But when Gumball, Darwin, and Anais try to destroy it, they discover it is more robust than it seems.

Episodes.Title: The Matchmaker
Episodes.Description: Gumball enlists Carrie to help bring Darwin and Teri together, but when they can't make Darwin and Teri's love blossom naturally, they decide to make it happen supernaturally.

Episodes.Title: The Box
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons receive an unmarked package in the mail. To distract themselves from the urge to open it they all take turns to imagine what it might contain.

Episodes.Title: The Console
Episodes.Description: When Gumball is given a cursed video game console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world. Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality.

Episodes.Title: The Ollie
Episodes.Description: Gumball teaches Darwin everything he knows about the world of skateboarding.

Episodes.Title: The Catfish
Episodes.Description: When Gumball and Darwin realize Grandpa Louie has no friends, they create one called Muriel, when Granny Jojo finds out Louie has been spending time online with another woman, Muriel not existing is not going to stop her from being destroyed.

Episodes.Title: The Cycle
Episodes.Description: Gumball, Darwin and Anais discover that Mr. Wilson has been picking on Richard for most of his life; ever since he humiliated Richard with a high school prank. The kids try to work their dad through it, but when their efforts fail they realize that getting back at Mr. Wilson is the only way to break the cycle.

Episodes.Title: The Stars
Episodes.Description: When Richard gives Larry’s hairdresser a bad review for saying he’s bald, he gets offered a free haircut. This inspires Gumball and Darwin to go on a reviewing spree across town, forcing Larry to give them stuff with the threat of a bad review. But, just because the customer is always right doesn’t mean that what they’re doing isn’t wrong.

Episodes.Title: The Grades
Episodes.Description: When a failed test grade brings down Gumball’s grade point average, he is forced to return to kindergarten.

Episodes.Title: The Diet
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin find out why Richard's diet wasn't working, and after they help him lose weight, he becomes more obnoxious.

Episodes.Title: The Ex
Episodes.Description: When Gumball learns that his nemesis, Rob, has found a new nemesis, he tries to sabotage Rob's new "enemy-ship", much to the frustration of Penny.

Episodes.Title: The Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: Gumball refuses to accept he is the only kid at school that does not have special powers. He convinces Mrs. Jötunheim, Hector's mom, to take him on as her apprentice but she soon learns leaving Gumball unsupervised around magic is a big mistake.

Episodes.Title: The Menu
Episodes.Description: The prize jewel on the Secret Joyful Burger menu is a mysterious burger, but to order it you need to know its name. When Larry refuses to tell Richard, Gumball, and Darwin what it is called, they go to super-sized lengths to discover it.

Episodes.Title: The Uncle
Episodes.Description: When Gumball finds out that Ocho has an uncle named Mario, he becomes desperate to meet him.

Episodes.Title: The Weirdo
Episodes.Description: When they see the school bullies making fun of Sussie, Gumball and Darwin decide to try and help her act less weird. They carefully observe her behavior and decide that the only thing they have to change is absolutely everything.

Episodes.Title: The Heist
Episodes.Description: Richard discovers that going into a bank whilst wearing a motorcycle helmet can lead to trouble.

Episodes.Title: The Singing
Episodes.Description: Join the citizens of Elmore for a song and dance spectacular that will have people covering their ears with joy.

Episodes.Title: The Best
Episodes.Description: No matter what Gumball does, Carmen thinks she knows better; when Gumball attempts to gain the moral high ground, but fails, his only option left is to bring Carmen down to his level.

Episodes.Title: The Worst
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons compete over who has the worst life.

Episodes.Title: The Deal
Episodes.Description: Richard goes on strike to prove that his work around the house is under appreciated by Nicole.

Episodes.Title: The Petals
Episodes.Description: When Leslie's petals begin falling off, he feels like his good looks are fading, so Gumball and Darwin use everything they know about style and beauty to try and help him.

Episodes.Title: The Puppets
Episodes.Description: Darwin is delighted when they discover their old childhood toys, but soon realizes that some things are best left in the past.

Episodes.Title: The Nuisance
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons fear the worst when they are summoned to a Town Hall meeting, but are surprised when they're offered a new house - until they discover it's in a different state.

Episodes.Title: The Line
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons will do whatever it takes to get into the first screening of the latest Stellar Odyssey sequel.

Episodes.Title: The List
Episodes.Description: When the kids find out that Mom's life hasn't panned out as she'd hoped, they start taking on her chores, but they accidentally grab her bucket list instead of her to-do list.

Episodes.Title: The News
Episodes.Description: From police chases to the inside scoop on Daisy the Donkey, Channel 6 Elmore News has all the top local stories. Experienced newscaster Kip Schlezinger brings the latest news, sports and weather, even when there is absolutely nothing to report.

Episodes.Title: The Rival
Episodes.Description: When Anais is a newborn baby, Gumball and Darwin become jealous of their new sibling, and spark a baby war.

Episodes.Title: The Lady
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin find out that Dad has been dressing as a woman to make friends.

Episodes.Title: The Sucker
Episodes.Description: Darwin ends up in detention with Julius, who decides to make Darwin his new target. However, it backfires when Darwin ruins his life.

Episodes.Title: The Vegging
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin want to veg out all day, but their plans go awry and they have to save the rest of the family.

Episodes.Title: The One
Episodes.Description: Tobias tries to be Gumball’s best friend.

Episodes.Title: The Father
Episodes.Description: The kids try to help Richard bond with Frankie.

Episodes.Title: The Cringe
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Hot Dog Guy discover why they're so awkward with each other.

Episodes.Title: The Cage
Episodes.Description: The kids convince Mr. Corneille to become a cage fighter and set up a fight against a fearsome Russian fighter.

Episodes.Title: The Faith
Episodes.Description: Alan has lost faith in humanity and turns the world black and white. Gumball must get over his hatred of Alan to bring the color back by singing.

Episodes.Title: The Candidate
Episodes.Description: A group of kids get locked in the school after their parents have a charity gala. They appoint Gumball as leader to get them out but it leads to chaos.

Episodes.Title: The Anybody
Episodes.Description: When Clayton shapeshifts into Gumball to take his detention, he starts framing others for misdemeanors so Gumball and Darwin must track Clayton down to stop him.

Episodes.Title: The Pact
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Principal Brown make a pact to tell each other what problems their girlfriends have.

Episodes.Title: The Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin try to find out the name of their neighbor, Antlers Guy, but accidentally blow his witness protection cover.

Episodes.Title: The Shippening
Episodes.Description: Sarah finds a notebook from the Awesome Store which magically makes what she draws happen. Unfortunately, she draws bizarre love stories throughout Elmore.

Episodes.Title: The Brain
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons have to stop doing stupid things in order to prevent Anais from falling into a coma from facepalming too much.

Episodes.Title: The Parents
Episodes.Description: Nicole and her parents reconnect after a long forced absence.

Episodes.Title: The Founder
Episodes.Description: Richard creates chaos in the Chanax building when he is mistaken for the long lost CEO. Nicole and a disgruntled employee must save everyone from Richard's dangerous ideas.

Episodes.Title: The Schooling
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin take on Larry's jobs for 5 minutes and realize how bad it is.

Episodes.Title: The Intelligence
Episodes.Description: Technology reaches human intelligence then becomes dysfunctional as it picks up human flaws.

Episodes.Title: The Potion
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin use a magic potion to shrink Hector.

Episodes.Title: The Spinoffs
Episodes.Description: Rob creates a variety of spinoff Elmore shows and formats to replace Gumball.

Episodes.Title: The Transformation

Episodes.Title: The Understanding
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin get into trouble misunderstanding a new kid in school.

Episodes.Title: The Ad
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons are forced to rent their house to a pair of elderly fainting goats.

Episodes.Title: The Ghouls
Episodes.Description: Halloween isn't what it used to be. Can Gumball and Darwin help the ghouls get their scare back?

Episodes.Title: The Stink
Episodes.Description: Mr. Small goes feral after Gumball and Darwin expose his hypocrisy.

Episodes.Title: The Awareness
Episodes.Description: Gumball decides to engross himself in plant culture to appease Leslie after making an offensive comment.

Episodes.Title: The Slip
Episodes.Description: Richard misses a package and is forced into an escalating feud with the delivery guy.

Episodes.Title: The Drama
Episodes.Description: Gumball tries to protect Darwin from his unsuitable undead girlfriend Carrie.

Episodes.Title: The Buddy
Episodes.Description: Anais and Jamie form an unlikely partnership when they're accused of a crime they didn't commit.

Episodes.Title: The Possession
Episodes.Description: Richard becomes supernaturally attached to his old refrigerator.

Episodes.Title: The Master
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons play a fantasy role-playing board game to resolve their differences.

Episodes.Title: The Silence
Episodes.Description: Have Gumball and Darwin finally run out of things to say to each other?

Episodes.Title: The Future
Episodes.Description: Banana Joe's Mom can predict the future, but she can't predict her own disappearance.

Episodes.Title: The Wish
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin believe they've turned Miss Simian into a neck-cushion.

Episodes.Title: The Factory
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin save the day at the Rainbow Factory.

Episodes.Title: The Agent
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin's clothes go missing after a swimming lesson; when Gumball is forced to wear a tuxedo from the lost and found office, he believes it makes him look like a certain dapper British secret agent.

Episodes.Title: The Web
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin realize that the adult residents of Elmore are dangerously naive when it comes to being safe online, and in fact are in serious need of the boys' help with even the simplest of tasks.

Episodes.Title: The Mess
Episodes.Description: After staying up all night, the boys baby-sit Penny's little sister and manage to lose her in the blink of an eye.

Episodes.Title: The Heart
Episodes.Description: Mr. Robinson tries and repeatedly fails to win back Gumball and Darwin's friendship.

Episodes.Title: The Revolt
Episodes.Description: Darwin tries to highlight the plight of all the household objects he feels are being oppressed and maltreated by the uncaring residents of Elmore, then decides to lead those objects in a revolt against the townspeople.

Episodes.Title: The Decisions
Episodes.Description: When everything goes wrong in Darwin's life, he begins to suspect that Gumball's bad influence might be to blame; Darwin decides to go elsewhere for guidance and finds a new mentor in Alan.

Episodes.Title: The BFFs
Episodes.Description: When Gumball's old BFF Fuzzy turns up on his doorstep, Darwin struggles to accept that there was someone before him and fails to contain his jealousy.

Episodes.Title: The Inquisition
Episodes.Description: The students of Elmore Junior High find their world turned upside down when the mysterious school superintendent comes to stamp out their cartoonish ways.

Episodes.Title: The Burger
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin want to find a heathy dinner option for their family because they are hooked on Joyful Burger, but an evil food consortium has monopolized the food industry.

Episodes.Title: The Assistant
Episodes.Description: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Nicole strikes up a friendship with a sympathetic AI. As their relationship intensifies, the AI tries to drive a wedge between Nicole and the other Wattersons.

Episodes.Title: The Distance
Episodes.Description: Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.

Episodes.Title: The Thing
Episodes.Description: Richard must retrace the memories of his day in order to figure out what “the thing” is, so Nicole’s family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won’t be another epic failure.

Episodes.Title: The Butts
Episodes.Description: Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital.

Episodes.Title: The Traffic
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

Episodes.Title: The Astrological
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Penny must stay together through the end of the school day to prove that they are meant to be together, despite an astrological prediction Mr. Small has made.

Episodes.Title: The Cheerleader
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to get Richard on the cheerleading team in order to end their family’s generational trauma.

Episodes.Title: The Boring
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin use Molly’s time-halting power (because she’s so boring) to avoid an after school beatdown by Tina.

Episodes.Title: The Teacher
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.

Episodes.Title: The App
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin must stop an evil social media app from turning every kid in Elmore into mindless internet-trend-following drone.

Episodes.Title: The Entrance
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin attempt to make a big impression at the coolest party of the year with the most praise-worthy entrance the world has ever seen.

Episodes.Title: The Letter
Episodes.Description: Darwin wants to get back a love letter he wrote to Carrie before she sees it.

Episodes.Title: The Gut
Episodes.Description: When Anais enlists her dad’s help with her science project, Richard’s GUT becomes its own brilliant thinking entity, separate from the original Richard we all know, and Anais must choose between the two.

Episodes.Title: The Wrinkle
Episodes.Description: Anais starts aging prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family.

Episodes.Title: The Gourmet
Episodes.Description: After tasting Masami’s gourmet, double-truffle mac-n-cheese at lunch, Gumball decides to do whatever it takes to get a full serving of the delicious meal.

Episodes.Title: The Pool
Episodes.Description: In the midst of a heatwave, Richard enlists Gumball, Darwin and Anais to assist him in his mission to jump in the Robinson’s newly-installed above ground pool.

Episodes.Title: The Portrait
Episodes.Description: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone’s entire face is in the photo and they’re all smiling.

Episodes.Description: Gumball must face his demons and overcome an embarrassing incident from his past if he wants to finally summit the dreaded rock-climbing wall in gym class.

Episodes.Description: Gumball vows to wear a shell and partake in strange Fitzgerald traditions, in order to help Penny get through a tense family birthday party with ease.

Entries.Title: South Park
Entries.Description: Follow the misadventures of four irreverent grade-schoolers in the quiet, dysfunctional town of South Park, Colorado.

Episodes.Title: Cartman Gets an Anal Probe
Episodes.Description: While the boys are waiting for the school bus, Cartman explains the odd nightmare he had the previous night involving alien visitors abducting him from his bed. Meanwhile Kyle and Stan try to convince Cartman that the dream was in fact a reality.

Episodes.Title: Volcano
Episodes.Description: The boys get together with Stan's Uncle Jimbo and Jimbo's war-buddy Ned for a hunting trip in the nearby mountains. After Cartman's mom makes sure her "little" boy is safe and sound (much to Cartman's dismay) the group heads off for adventure. As they drive away from the town, Jimbo explains the "finer" points of hunting.

Episodes.Title: Weight Gain 4000
Episodes.Description: Mr. Garrison starts the day off with a special announcement; one of South Park's own has won a national essay contest. Everyone is shocked to learn that the winner is Cartman, who doesn't even remember what he wrote about.

Episodes.Title: Big Gay Al's Big Gay Boat Ride
Episodes.Description: Stan's got a new dog named Sparky. Stan proclaims his pet to be the toughest dog on the mountain. Though while Stan thinks his dog is ready for fighting, Sparky proceeds to hump Sylvester like a little bitch. The other boys taunt Stan about his gay dog and Sparky runs away to find someone who will love him for who he is.

Episodes.Title: An Elephant Makes Love to a Pig
Episodes.Description: Stan notices a new addition in their bus stop crew, an elephant standing alongside Kyle. At school, class lessons for the day involve genetic engineering (conveniently enough). Kyle questions the possibility of a genetically engineered elephant made smaller by design. The boys have to beat the rough kids in their genetics experiment, and will try anything to do it.

Episodes.Title: Death
Episodes.Description: "Happy Birthday" to Stan's Grandpa Marsh who just turned 102. How does the wizened Mr. Marsh feel about his birthday? He sums it up in five words; "I wish I were dead" and proceeds trying to end his life enlisting Stan to do it for him. However, Stan is aware of a very important thing if he kills his grandfather, he'd be in trouble, and if he's in trouble he can't watch Terrance and Phillip.

Episodes.Title: Pinkeye
Episodes.Description: The first Halloween episode starts off with the failure of the Mir Space Station, which crashes right on Kenny. An ambulance comes and takes his body off to the morgue. The boys start to brag about their Halloween costumes. At the morgue, a freak accident involving a bottle of Worcestershire sauce occurs, and next thing you know Kenny is a member of the undead. Kenny breaks free and wanders off into the night.

Episodes.Title: Starvin' Marvin
Episodes.Description: The four boys are at Cartman's house watching the "Terrance & Philip Thanksgiving Special" on television. During a break from the show, a Sally Struthers commercial convinces the boys that the prospect of a free "Taiko" sport watch with a five-dollar donation is irresistible. Typical greedy American youth. So Stan dials in, using his mother's credit card number and makes their donation.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Hankey, the Christmas Poo
Episodes.Description: South Park Elementary is on stage rehearsing for the schools play. Kyle begins to sing a song about Mr. Hankey, the Christmas Poo. Of course, no one has any idea what the heck he's singing about. Kyle explains that Mr. Hankey comes every year to all the good boys and girls who have a lot of fiber in their diet. Everyone thinks he's insane and he gets sent to a mental institute.

Episodes.Title: Damien
Episodes.Description: Eric is handing out invitations to his birthday party at school. Mr. Garrison informs them all that there is a new student joining the class. Announcing to all that he is Damien, the son of Satan. Even as Damien demonstrates his demonic powers the children are more loathsome than impressed.

Episodes.Title: Tom's Rhinoplasty
Episodes.Description: Mr. Garrison deserts the class for a visit to Tom's Rhinoplasty. All the boys compete for the attention of their beautiful substitute teacher Ms. Ellen.

Episodes.Title: Mecha-Streisand
Episodes.Description: The boys meet up with Barbara Streisand who wants to take over the world with Kyle's discovery at an archaeological dig. Leonard Maltin, Sydney Potier, and Robert Smith come to the rescue to defeat Babs and her terrible destruction.

Episodes.Title: Cartman's Mom Is a Dirty Slut
Episodes.Description: Cartman needs to find out who his father is but his mom is no help. Learning that his father could be one of the many people that his mom had "relations" with during an annual party called "The Drunken Barn Dance", he finds that there's more to his mother than he thought.

Episodes.Title: Terrance and Phillip in Not Without My Anus
Episodes.Description: The show starts off with the build up from last season's cliffhanger revolving around Cartman's paternal origins. However, just as it seems they are about to get on with the second half of "Cartman's Mom Is A Dirty Slut," they do a 180 degree turn-around and reveal that for April Fool's Day they will be showing Terrance & Phillip in "Not Without My Anus".

Episodes.Title: Cartman's Mom Is Still a Dirty Slut
Episodes.Description: Dr. Mephisto is about to reveal who Eric Cartman's father really is! Glass shatters and gunshots ring out. A mysterious assailant apparently shot Mephisto while the lights were off. Much to Eric's chagrin, they rush Mephisto off to the hospital. Chef rushes out the door with Mephisto in hand. They must fight against time to learn Eric's background, who is his father? Where does he come from?

Episodes.Title: Ike's Wee Wee
Episodes.Description: Ike's going to have a Briss and everyone is invited! Stan, Kenny, and Cartman find out what a Briss really is and try to warn Kyle that his parents are going to cut off Ike's wee wee. Kyle sends Ike away to protect him from his scissor wielding parents.

Episodes.Title: Chickenlover
Episodes.Description: The Booktastic bus is in town and soon everyone finds out that Officer Barbrady can't read. He is whisked off to school with the boys so he can save his job. While he's there someone in South Park is having sex with the town's chickens and only Officer Barbrady with his new deputies Kenny, Kyle, Stan, and Cartman can stop them!

Episodes.Title: Conjoined Fetus Lady
Episodes.Description: Kyle is injured and must go to see the school nurse and is terrified because of the stories he's heard. She looks fairly normal, except for the dead fetus sticking out of her head. Kyle's mother educates the boys on her "condition" and decides that everyone in South Park should be made aware. Meanwhile, the South Park Cows dodgeball team goes to the state, national and finally the international finals in China.

Episodes.Title: The Mexican Staring Frog of Southern Sri Lanka
Episodes.Description: Mr. Garrison assigns the boys to learn about Vietnam from somebody they know. Stan's Uncle Jimbo and his friend Ned tell the boys their outrageous tale. Mr. Garrison doesn't believe the boy's report and gives them detention. They plot revenge against Stan's Uncle by submitting a phony video of the Mexican Staring Frog of Southern Sri Lanka to them.

Episodes.Title: City on the Edge of Forever (Flashbacks)
Episodes.Description: While their school bus is dangling on the edge of a cliff, the boys remember some of their past adventures. Mrs. Crabtree catches a ride into town with a stranger and winds up doing a brief stint as a standup comedienne. Back in South Park, Mr. Mackey convinces the parents that their missing children must have run away. In the end it's all a dream within a dream.

Episodes.Title: Summer Sucks
Episodes.Description: Schools out for summer and with Mr. Hat missing, Mr. Garrison is over the edge. The state has a ban on the sale of fireworks, and it screws up the boy's plans for a 4th of July celebration. Mr. Garrison seeks psychiatric help from Dr. Katz while Jimbo and Ned go to Mexico, in an attempt to smuggle fireworks back to the children of America.

Episodes.Title: Chef's Chocolate Salty Balls
Episodes.Description: A film festival moves to South Park, only to have a devastating effect on the sewer system. Mr. Hankey calls upon Kyle for help. The movie people interpret Kyle's pleading as a pitch and they quickly turn his story into a film starring Tom Hanks and a monkey they call "Mr. Hankey." Kyle is outraged that the filmmakers aren't hearing his pleas. Soon Chef's Salty Chocolate Balls energizes everyone.

Episodes.Title: Chickenpox
Episodes.Description: Cartman's mother plots to give the boys the chickenpox by sending them over to Kenny's for a sleepover. Both Stan and Cartman breakout, but Kyle remains immune. Kyle discovers "the parental conspiracy" and with the other boys hires a prostitute to give their parents herpes. Meanwhile, Kenny's mother and Kyle's mother reunite their husbands who were both childhood friends that drifted apart.

Episodes.Title: Roger Ebert Should Lay Off the Fatty Foods
Episodes.Description: The kids go on a field trip to the planetarium. All of the children except Cartman are acting weird. As usual Stan and Kyle, with Kenny's sacrifice, try to get to bottom of the mystery. Meanwhile, Cartman wins an appearance on a snack commercial. The four boys get to the root of the strange planetarium.

Episodes.Title: Clubhouses
Episodes.Description: Stan needs to build a clubhouse so he and Kyle can play "Truth or Dare" with Wendy and her friend, who has a crush on Kyle. Cartman and Kenny retaliate by building a clubhouse of their own; only theirs has hot chicks. Meanwhile, the Marshes marriage breaks up and Stan learns a valuable lesson about love and family.

Episodes.Title: Cow Days
Episodes.Description: South Park's annual "Cow Days" party is happening! The cows become transfixed on a cow statue. In order to get the money they need to win Terrance and Phillip dolls, the boys sign Cartman up for a bull riding contest. A freak accident has Cartman believing he is a Vietnamese prostitute named Ming Li. The boys learn about money and cow insanity.

Episodes.Title: Chef Aid
Episodes.Description: Chef is getting sued by Capitalist Records for trying to obtain the rights to a song he wrote twenty years ago. He needs 2 million dollars to hire Johnny Cochran. In response the boys round up all of Chef's old musician friends and organize a huge concert to raise the cash.

Episodes.Title: Spookyfish
Episodes.Description: Sharon Marsh's Aunt Flo makes her monthly visit and she has present for Stan, a fish. Stan's fish really freaks him out, especially when the dead bodies start piling up. Mrs. Marsh is convinced Stan is doing the killings and begins hiding the bodies. The boys discover there are two Cartmans and a gateway to a parallel universe at the "Indian Burial Ground Pet Store."

Episodes.Title: Merry Christmas Charlie Manson!
Episodes.Description: Kyle, Stan and Kenny accompany Eric and his family to a Christmas celebration with the Cartman family. One of Cartman's relatives breaks out of jail for the reunion, with his cellmate, Charles Manson.

Episodes.Title: Gnomes
Episodes.Description: Harbucks coffee plans to move into South Park and drive Tweek coffee shop out of business. Mr. Garrison assigns a report on current events to help him keep his job. The boys are planning on doing their report on the underpants gnomes. Tweek's father schemes to use the boy's report as a platform for fighting Harbucks. The report the boys deliver sparks the town into taking action.

Episodes.Title: Prehistoric Ice Man
Episodes.Description: Kyle falls into a cave. Stan goes to rescue him and finds an iceman, and the two fight each other for sole credit. Dr. Mephisto discovers that the iceman has been frozen since 1996. The iceman is put on display and the fighting Kyle and Stan free him. The iceman tries to return to his family, but finds himself a man out of time. Meanwhile, the government has their own plans to use the iceman in their plot against Sweden.

Episodes.Title: Rainforest Shmainforest
Episodes.Description: Mr. Mackey punishes the boys by forcing them to join the "Getting Gay With Kids" choir. The choir is going to Costa Rica to help save the rainforest. While on a tour of the rainforest the choir group gets lost when a snake kills their guide. They soon discover the evils of the rainforest, which changes the choir group's message.

Episodes.Title: Spontaneous Combustion
Episodes.Description: Kenny spontaneously combusts. The mayor asks Randy Marsh to find a solution. The boys try to help Kyle's dad to get an erection. One way they think they can help is by performing the Stations of the Cross at church crucifying Cartman and waiting three days for his res-erection. Randy Marsh figures out the reason everyone is combusting is because they are withholding their farts.

Episodes.Title: The Succubus
Episodes.Description: Kyle and Stan try to rescue Chef from the clutches of the Succubus that he is going to marry. Meanwhile, Cartman deals with his eye problems and the optometrist he doesn't like. Chef's Mama and Papa appear for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Jakovasaurs
Episodes.Description: The boys discover a live prehistoric Jakovasaur while camping on Stark's Pond. The government and the citizens of South Park are interested in trying to help keep this endangered species alive, until they all realize how annoying the Jakovasaurs really are. The only one who really enjoys them is Cartman. The boys try distracting him while the town tries to send the Jakovasaurs to France.

Episodes.Title: Tweek vs. Craig
Episodes.Description: The boys take Shop class and try to set-up a fight between Tweek and Craig. Kenny is delighted in safely taking the Home Economics course. When the big fight arrives, the combatants don't know what to do; so Jimbo and Ned teach Tweek boxing and Cartman has Craig instructed in the art of Sumo. Shop teacher Mr. Adler has a recurring dream about a woman that he was never able to say goodbye to.

Episodes.Title: Sexual Harassment Panda
Episodes.Description: Sexual Harassment Panda visits Mr. Garrison's class. Cartman sues Stan for sexual harassment and Kyle's dad is getting rich. The boys go in search of "Sexual Harassment Panda" to stop the insanity. They find him at "The Island of Misfit Mascots Commune" and convince him to change his cause. He becomes Petey, the "don't sue people" Panda.

Episodes.Title: Cat Orgy
Episodes.Description: Shelly Marsh is babysitting Cartman. Shelly invites her boyfriend over and he in turn invites his band. Cartman has to prove that Shelly has violated the rules. Meanwhile, the Cartman's cat is in heat, searches for a good time and invites all the cats in the neighborhood back to the empty Cartman house for an orgy.

Episodes.Title: Two Guys Naked in a Hot Tub
Episodes.Description: Stan's parents bring him to Mr. Mackey's party, but he gets sent down to the basement to be with the lame kids. Kyle and Stan's fathers experiment with their homosexual tendencies. The ATF is convinced that the meteor shower party is actually a gathering of a religious cult that is going to commit suicide when the meteor shower arrives. Stan tries to save himself and the party from the ATF.

Episodes.Title: Jewbilee
Episodes.Description: Kyle invites Kenny to join him at Jewbilee, a Boy Scout-like gathering for Jewish kids. His parents are going to attend Mr. Mackey's party. At camp, Ike is sent to join the little group called "Squirts." Kyle and Kenny, join the scouts, where they concentrate on soap sculptures. This art is key to the Jewish elders celebration of Moses however, Moses identifies Kenny as not being Jewish and Kenny is banished from the camp.

Episodes.Title: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery
Episodes.Description: Korn comes to South Park for a Halloween gig and learns of the boys problems with the 5th graders at South Park Elementary. Korn agrees to help the boys get revenge on the mean 5th graders all in a spooky Scooby Doo rip off!

Episodes.Title: Chinpokomon
Episodes.Description: The kids of South Park discover Chinpokomon, Japan's #1 cool toy to own! Wanting to avoid being losers, they persuade their parents to buy them the toys only to discover that the Chinpokomon are designed to brainwash them into bombing Pearl Harbor. The parents band together to stop Japan and save America!

Episodes.Title: Hooked on Monkey Fonics
Episodes.Description: Mrs. Cartman is about to give Eric a present. Of course Eric is hoping it will be some kind of toy, but it ends up being Hooked On Monkey Phonics to help him win the big South Park Annual Spelling Bee. Kyle finds Rebecca Cutswald to be quite intriguing and tries to woo her with his charm and teach her how to love and learn in public school.

Episodes.Title: Starvin' Marvin in Space
Episodes.Description: Starvin' Marvin finds an alien ship and begins searching out a new home for his people. The government interrogates the boys to find out about Marvin and direct them to Sally Struthers. Marvin stops in South Park to pick up the boys and take them to the planet Marklar. The Marklarians are willing to let the Ethiopians relocate to their world and the Christian channel does all they can to stop them.

Episodes.Title: The Red Badge of Gayness
Episodes.Description: South Park's Civil War reenactment, sponsored by "Jagerminz S'More Flavored Schnapps," gets out of hand. Cartman persuades the drunken lot to defeat the northerners so that he can win a bet with Kyle and Stan that will make them his slaves for one month.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics
Episodes.Description: Mr. Hankey introduces 10 musical segments highlighting songs the on the CD "Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics." The boys and all of the other South Park characters sing their own songs for the Holidays and realize that Christmas is all about the presents.

Episodes.Title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jesus
Episodes.Description: Cartman is convinced he is going through puberty since he started bleeding out of his ass. Dr. Mephisto gives Stan some hormones and he takes the entire bottle. Stan gets facial hair, boobs and his voice starts changing. People are waiting outside of Jesus' home to see what kind of miracle he offers which ends up involving a comeback performance of a very old Rod Stewart and eventually an appearance by God.

Episodes.Title: World Wide Recorder Concert
Episodes.Description: The children of South Park are practicing "My Country 'Tis of Thee" for the "4 Million Child Blow," sponsored by Yoko Ono. Mr. Garrison doesn't want to go because his father still lives there. At the concert Stan and Kyle try to figure out a way to "out cool" the kids from New York. Cartman tries to find "the brown noise" and is successful. Stan and Kyle plan against the kids from New York but their scheme goes much too far.

Episodes.Title: The Tooth Fairy Tats 2000
Episodes.Description: The tooth fairy has visited Cartman, leaving him two dollars. He rushes to the bus stop to share his news with the others. He then unveils his latest plan. If all they all combined their lost teeth, the tooth fairy will provide them with enough cash to purchase a Sega Dreamcast. They soon find out that they are treading on someone else's territory. Now they have to work with the mobsters to keep their manhood.

Episodes.Title: Cartman's Silly Hate Crime 2000
Episodes.Description: The kids have just won a sledding race. Token says that the only reason they won is because of Eric's fat ass. The girls challenge the boys to a sledding race down Phil Collins Hill. Token says that the boys can't lose thanks to Eric's fat ass. Eric then tosses a rock into the side of Token's head. The FBI claim that this was a hate crime and Cartman is sent to jail. Can the other boys bust Cartman out in time for the big race?

Episodes.Title: Timmy 2000
Episodes.Description: There's something wrong with new student Timmy. About the only thing Timmy can do is say his name. Ignorant of the fact that Timmy is "retarded", he is "diagnosed" with ADD, which relieves him of the responsibility to do any homework. Soon the rest of the class manages to get diagnosed with ADD, and all get prescribed Ritalin. Everyone is on Ritalin and just complacent enough to sit through a Phil Collins show.

Episodes.Title: Quintuplets 2000
Episodes.Description: The boys discover 8-year-old contorting quintuplets from Romania. Cartman decides to stage his own performance. The quintuplets and their grandmother defect from Romania and wind up staying at the Marsh's home. Thanks to Grandpa Marsh the girls' grandmother gets "loved to death." The girl's father is brought in by the Romanian government to demand his daughters back, Janet Reno to the rescue!

Episodes.Title: Cartman Joins NAMBLA
Episodes.Description: Cartman decides to seek the friendship of older men. Using the Internet, he makes a connection with men who love to hang out with little boys. An organization called NAMBLA (North American Man Boy Love Association) holds a meeting in South Park and Cartman becomes their poster child. The boys learn how much an adult can really love a child.

Episodes.Title: Cherokee Hair Tampons
Episodes.Description: Kyle needs a kidney transplant and Cartman is a perfect donor. Cartman has a $10 million price for his kidney. The other boys go to Cartman's house with the plan to take one of his kidneys. Cartman thwarts their plan. Stan, depressed about the inevitable loss of his friend decides to take action into his own hands and with the help of the parents gets Cartman's kidney for Kyle.

Episodes.Title: Chef Goes Nanners
Episodes.Description: Chef is declaring that South Park's flag is racist. Stan & Kyle head up the team championing the current flag, while Wendy and Cartman head up the side for a new flag. Wendy ends up confessing to Bebe of her attraction to Cartman. The debate starts, but before Wendy can make her point, she kisses Cartman to regain her composure. Chef realizes that Stan & Kyle's point of view on the flag issue was colorblind.

Episodes.Title: Something You Can Do with Your Finger
Episodes.Description: "Fingerbang" is the latest boy band starring the four boys. Randy Marsh is against Stan's participation in any boy band for dark reasons. The boys land a gig at the local mall when it is threatened because there are only 4 members in the band. Stan arrives and the group is set to perform when suddenly the mall elevator tragically crushes Kenny. A former boy band member steps into the spotlight to save the gig.

Episodes.Title: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell? (1)
Episodes.Description: The boys attend church and the priest puts the fear of hell in them. They must go to Sunday school and learn that they must confess their sins. The boys are worried about Timmy, after all, he can only say his name. Feeling the need to confess their sins they catch the priest in a compromising position and decide to save themselves.

Episodes.Title: Probably (2)
Episodes.Description: Cartman preaches and the children begin plans to build a church. Satan spends the night with Saddam. Kenny wasn't killed in the previous episode, but the bus that ran him over stops in Mexico, where Kenny is found. Satan, in his time of crisis turns to God for advice. Cartman is discovered as a fraud and is sent to Mexico for punishment.

Episodes.Title: Fourth Grade
Episodes.Description: The kids have to face the 4th grade, and they're not too happy about it. Cartman cooks up a scheme to go back in time to return to the 3rd grade where things were fun and easy. Two geeks help them rig Timmy's wheelchair into a working time machine and send Timmy on the trip of his life!

Episodes.Title: Trapper Keeper
Episodes.Description: Cartman has a new Trapper Keeper (that blows Kyle's out of the water) After he's done bragging, a stranger tells him that it will soon take over the world if they don't destroy it now. Cool 2001: A Space Odyssey and Akira parodies!

Episodes.Title: Helen Keller! The Musical
Episodes.Description: The boys are doing their version of the Helen Keller Story and plan to beat the kindergartners show. Timmy stars as Helen Keller and gets a new friend to play with! Fireworks, fountains, and outstanding musicals galore!

Episodes.Title: Pip
Episodes.Description: This is the story of Pip's origin. Pip gets a job at the Havesham Estate where he meets Estella. She only spurns his optimism with insults. When Pip is offered the opportunity to become a gentleman he goes to London only to discover that Miss Havesham plans to break his heart. Her plan is to use Pip's tears to power her Genesis device and will allow her to gain revenge on all men.

Episodes.Title: Fat Camp
Episodes.Description: Mrs. Cartman holds an intervention for her son's eating problem and is sending him to fat camp. Cartman returns from camp, 40 lbs. lighter. Cartman is selling candy to the fat kids. Kenny is challenged by the other children to do crazy things for money. Kenny's popularity rises and he soon gets his own TV show. An event happens where Kenny gets inside Ms. Crabtree's uterus for six hours.

Episodes.Title: The Wacky Molestation Adventure
Episodes.Description: The "Raging Pussies" concert is on! Kyle calls the police and say his parents have been "molestering" him. Soon all the children are calling in on all the adults in South Park. Until only children live in South Park. Someone from out of town breaks down and they have the task of retrieving a book for the fat-ass. The locked-up adults of South Park get therapy to prevent them from sexually abusing their children.

Episodes.Title: A Very Crappy Christmas
Episodes.Description: Kyle and Ike anxiously await Mr. Hankey. When he doesn't show, Kyle calls the others for a late night emergency meeting. They find Mr. Hankey living with his alcoholic wife and their three little nuggets. He tells them that no one is into Christmas. They all decide to try and spread some Christmas cheer. Their effort fails and the boys decide to create an animated special of their own. Featuring Jesus, Santa Claus and themselves.

Episodes.Title: It Hits the Fan
Episodes.Description: The you-know-what hits the fan 162 times when the citizens of South Park hear the word "Sh*t" on the popular show, "Cop Drama." Boffo ratings have the executives at HBC plotting further use of the curse word, as the nation is struck by a mysterious plague that unleashes the ancient Knights of Standards and Practices. Only Chef and the boys can save South Park, and the world!

Episodes.Title: Cripple Fight
Episodes.Description: Big Gay Al returns to South Park, only to be thrown out as Scoutmaster to the boys for being gay. The boys rally to his defense, with the help of the new "handi-capable" kid, Jimmy. But there's only room for one crippled kid in South Park, so Timmy and Jimmy throw off the gloves, as well as the crutches and wheelchair, in an all out slugfest to end all slugfests.

Episodes.Title: Super Best Friends
Episodes.Description: Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny discover David Blaine, magician and Cult Leader. Stan finds out early that the Blainiacs are not as nice as they thought. Stan has to convince Kyle, Kenny and Cartman that they've been brainwashed... but will he get to them in time? Jesus has a few tricks up his sleeve! Super Best Friends to the rescue!

Episodes.Title: Scott Tenorman Must Die
Episodes.Description: Cartman goes medieval on Scott Tenorman's ass when ginger-haired Scott tricks our supple hero into buying his pubic hair for $16.12. Radiohead guest stars and plays a role in Cartman's elaborate scheme at getting sweet revenge on his unsuspecting foe.

Episodes.Title: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow
Episodes.Description: In the grand tradition of Wham UK, flatulant Canadian superstars, Terrance and Phillip, have broken up over creative differences. The clock is ticking as the boys struggle to reunite the fartastic duo, and recruit them in time for South Park's Earth Day festivities.

Episodes.Title: Cartmanland
Episodes.Description: Cartman inherits one million dollars from his grandmother, fulfilling his lifelong dream of owning his own amusement park, Cartmanland! A hemorrhoid erupts in Kyle's ass when he learns of Cartman's undeserved fortune, making him question the very existence of God, and whether there's a reason to stay alive in a world where someone like Cartman is happy.

Episodes.Title: Proper Condom Use
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Stan's "handy" work, the children of South Park must endure sex education from the unlikely duo of Mr. Mackey and Ms. Choksondik. While the two adults take their lessons to heart, the children are left frightened, mis-informed, and armed for battle against the opposite sex. Much hilarity ensues.

Episodes.Title: Towelie
Episodes.Description: The boys get a new video game system and their plans for the next 38 hours is to play it! Untill they discover Towelie, a government secret, genetically engineered towel that gets his special powers from gettin' high. When the government steals Stan's new Game Sphere the boys will stop at nothing to get it back. Losing precious gaming time they find Towelie and begin the struggle of the century.

Episodes.Title: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
Episodes.Description: In the wake of the terrorist attack on the United States, the boys find themselves accidentally sent to Afghanistan, where they encounter their Afghani counterparts and try to understand why they hate Americans. While they are there they also take on the Taliban and Cartman pits his fat ass against Bin Laden himself.

Episodes.Title: How to Eat with Your Butt
Episodes.Description: Cartman has finally gone too far when a prank involving Kenny's sweet cheeks results in him blowing a "funny fuse." After a photo of Kenny's better side finds it's way onto the side of a milk carton, an unusual couple arrives in South Park to claim their missing child. Much ass kissing ensues.

Episodes.Title: The Entity
Episodes.Description: Kyle’s cousin comes to town and after Kyle sees how stereotypically Jewish his cousin Kyle is, he worries about how Cartman is going to react when he meets him. Meanwhile, Mr. Garrison invents an alternative form of transportation that requires the rider to use more than just their hands and legs to control it.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes the Neighborhood
Episodes.Description: Feeling like an outcast for being the only rich kid in town, Token succeeds in attracting several other wealthy people to South Park. Meanwhile, the townspeople, fearing that their little hamlet is rapidly going up the drain, attempt to run the new residents out of town by any means necessary.

Episodes.Title: Kenny Dies
Episodes.Description: In a very special episode of South Park, Cartman fights for Kenny's life when he speaks before Congress in favor of stem cell research. Meanwhile, Stan has trouble dealing with his friend's impending demise.

Episodes.Title: Butters' Very Own Episode
Episodes.Description: Butters finds out what his father has been up to late at night and when his mother hears, she overreacts by trying to kill her son and then herself back at home. After returning home and forgiving her husband, she realizes what she has done to her son and they spin a story to the media to cover their tracks. Meanwhile, Butters obsesses with returning home so that he can join his parents for an anniversary dinner at Bennigan’s.

Episodes.Title: Jared Has Aides
Episodes.Description: The boys decide to fatten up Butters so that he can lose weight by eating at their favorite restaurant just like Jared, the sub sandwich guy. Jared, who is making an appearance in town reveals another secret to his weight loss, he has aides.

Episodes.Title: Asspen
Episodes.Description: With their parents stuck in Time Share Hell, our boys are on their own on the slopes of Aspen, circa 1985. Stan gets challenged to a ski race and must win in order to save the youth center, get the girl, and free the trapped spirits of the Wakacha Vampire Indians. Not that he really cares.

Episodes.Title: Freak Strike
Episodes.Description: The boys learn that disfigured people get prizes for appearing on a talk show and they sign Butters up. When the prize he gets can’t be shared, Cartman has his mother join him on a segment called, "Please Help My out of Control Child."

Episodes.Title: Fun With Veal
Episodes.Description: The boys learn where veal comes from and they decide to save the calves by hiding them in Stan’s room, where they all intend to stay until the calves are guaranteed their safety. During the siege Stan develops symptoms of an illness caused by his new vegan diet.

Episodes.Title: The New Terrance and Phillip Movie Trailer
Episodes.Description: The boys have to sit through "The Russell Crowe Show" in order to see the premiere of the trailer for the new Terrance and Phillip movie. Meanwhile, Chef’s new TV has taken on a life of its own.

Episodes.Title: Professor Chaos
Episodes.Description: Butters isn’t working out and Cartman, Kyle and Stan decide to fire him and hold auditions for his replacement. Becoming an outcast, Butters becomes a super-villain with plans to cause chaos wherever he goes.

Episodes.Title: The Simpsons Already Did It
Episodes.Description: Professor Chaos returns with brand new, super evil, schemes to wreak havoc on South Park; unfortunately, the Simpsons have already done them all. Meanwhile, a super secret ingredient helps Cartman's "Sea People" evolve at an alarming rate.

Episodes.Title: Red Hot Catholic Love
Episodes.Description: Father Maxi is concerned with all the molestation claims that have been placed against the Catholic Church recently. After most of his parishioners turn to Atheism as an answer, he travels to the Vatican to get some answers.

Episodes.Title: Free Hat
Episodes.Description: The boys go out to see the new edition of Star Wars: Episode V and during the previews they find out that the movie studios are planning on re-releasing more movies with digitally enhanced effects. In an effort to stop this injustice, they go off to find Steven Spielberg and George Lucas.

Episodes.Title: Bebe's Boobs Destroy Society
Episodes.Description: After nearly five years and 89 episodes, it finally happens: Cartman gets kicked out of the gang. The reason? Bebe gets boobs and the boys go ape, threatening their friendships and society as we know it.

Episodes.Title: Child Abduction is Not Funny
Episodes.Description: In an effort to protect their children from kidnappers, the parents of South Park hire the owner and operator of the local City Wok to build a Great Wall around the city. When crazy things like Kid trackers and Mongolions come into the picture. The parents learn a very important lesson themselves about trusting strangers.

Episodes.Title: A Ladder to Heaven
Episodes.Description: Stan, Kyle, and Cartman win all the candy they can eat in a contest. There's just one problem, Kenny had the ticket. Now to get their prize, the boys have decided to build a ladder to Heaven in order to get the ticket back from their dead friend.

Episodes.Title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
Episodes.Description: The boys are on a mission: return "The Lord of the Rings" to the Two Towers Video Store in Conifer. But this is no ordinary copy. Butters, the evil sixth graders, and the boys' parents all try to steal the ring, er tape, from the boys. Will they succeed?

Episodes.Title: The Death Camp of Tolerance
Episodes.Description: A loveable new character, Mr Slave, makes his debut as Mr. Garrison desperately tries to get fired from his new job as the boys' 4th grade teacher. Meanwhile, the boys get sent to the Deathcamp of Intolerance for not tolerating Mr. Garrison's intolerable behavior.

Episodes.Title: The Biggest Douche in the Universe
Episodes.Description: When a famous psychic fails to help him exorcise Kenny from his body, Cartman takes other steps to achieve his goal. He and Chef travel to the moors of Scotland, where Chef's mom tries a little of her voodoo magic on him. Meanwhile, after the boys encounter with the TV psychic, Kyle is paralyzed with fear at the thought of members of the spirit world watching over him. Only by debunking those who claim they can communicate with the dead can Stan save Kyle.

Episodes.Title: My Future Self n' Me
Episodes.Description: When a 32 year old man claiming to be Stan from the future shows up in South Park, young Stan is forced to come to terms with the loser he will become. Meanwhile, South Park's own little entrepreneur, Eric Cartman is at the helm a new money making venture. Cartman is in the business of revenge.

Episodes.Title: Red Sleigh Down
Episodes.Description: In an effort to redeem himself days before Christmas, Cartman decides to bring Christmas to the Iraqis. So, along with Stan, Kyle, and Kenny they catch a ride with Mr. Hankey to the North Pole to bring Christmas to Iraq.

Episodes.Title: Cancelled
Episodes.Description: The boys are at the bus stop and they seem to be reliving events that they went through 6 seasons earlier; that is Kyle "kicking the baby" his little brother Ike and Cartman talking about his strange dream, which the other boys identify as visitors. What's going on in South Park? Did the boys travel back in time, or is some sinister force at work?

Episodes.Title: Krazy Kripples
Episodes.Description: Jimmy and Timmy pull together a group of people like themselves and call their new club the "Crips."

Episodes.Title: Toilet Paper
Episodes.Description: The boys are given a detention due to their attitudes in art class. Cartman decides that they need to toilet paper (TP) the art teacher's house in revenge.

Episodes.Title: I'm a Little Bit Country
Episodes.Description: After participating in a walk-out against the war in Iraq, Mr. Garrison tells the boys they have to write a report on the founding fathers.  Cartman decides he's going to figure out a way to flashback to the past and learn all about history first hand.

Episodes.Title: Fat Butt and Pancake Head
Episodes.Description: For a report on Cultural Diversity, Cartman chooses to do one on Latinos in the arts with the help of a Jennifer Lopez hand puppet.  Later, at the mall, the puppet insists they make a music video, which launches the hand puppet's musical career.  There's just one problem, the REAL J-Lo shows up to protest the hand's authenticity.

Episodes.Title: Lil' Crime Stoppers
Episodes.Description: The boys are playing "junior detectives," and have to find a kidnapped doll. After a daring rescue, they are taken back to Park County Police Headquarters. Upon their arrival, the Chief makes them "real" junior detectives and gives them their first assignment: breaking up a meth lab. The boys soon learn being real detectives isn't as fun as they thought.

Episodes.Title: Red Man's Greed
Episodes.Description: The owners of the Three Feathers Indian Casino have decided to buy out the town of South Park in order to create a super-highway from Denver to their Casino. The townfolk only have one night to make $350,000. So they head to the casino...

Episodes.Title: South Park is Gay
Episodes.Description: The metrosexual fad has hit South Park thanks to the "Queer Eye Guys," and all the men in town are affected, except for Kyle and his Dad.  Stan, Kenny, and Cartman give Kyle a makeover, and Gerald isn't far behind. Soon the women of South Park grow tired of the fad, as does Mr. Garrison.

Episodes.Title: Christian Rock Hard
Episodes.Description: The boys have hit a crossroads with their band "Moop." Cartman wants the band to play Christian Rock, and leaves the band when Stan, Kyle, and Kenny don't agree. Before leaving, Cartman bets Kyle $10 that he will get a platinum album with a Christian Rock band before "Moop" can.

Episodes.Title: Grey Dawn
Episodes.Description: Due to a rise in deaths due to senior citizens behind the wheel, the State of Colorado has revoked all the driver licenses of senior citizens.  Soon after, the AARP shows up to fight for the rights of their comrades.

Episodes.Title: Casa Bonita
Episodes.Description: Kyle is going to Casa Bonita for his birthday, but he can only bring three friends. He chooses Stan, Kenny, and Butters. Cartman, outraged by not being chosen, comes up with a plan to take Butters out of the picture.

Episodes.Title: All About Mormons
