Episodes.Title: Pups Save Chickaletta's Egg
Episodes.Description: Chickaletta has laid an egg, but it rolled away and is heading through town. The PAW Patrol has to catch it before it breaks!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Manatee
Episodes.Description: Farmer Al and Farmer Yumi need help from the PAW Patrol to a get a manatee to the swamp!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Breakfast
Episodes.Description: Mr. Porter and Alex are in a sticky situation - they’re up to their ears in maple syrup! It’s up to the PAW Patrol to save the Porter’s and Breakfast!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Land Pirates
Episodes.Description: Pirates Alex, Julia, Julius and Chick-ARR-letta, are sent sailing into the desert and get lost! It’s up to the PAW Patrol to save these Land pirates.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Birdwatching Turbots
Episodes.Description: Cap’n Turbot and Francois chirp need help when a bird-watching contest leaves them up in the air

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Bat Family
Episodes.Description: A rockslide traps a Bat Family inside their cave, so the PAW Patrol has to free them! The bats search for a new home leads to problems in town though!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Mud Monster
Episodes.Description: Snowboarders on Jake’s Mountain are stuck on a broken chair lift while a monster is on the loose!

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups and the Big Twin Trick
Episodes.Description: The Ladybird is up to her old tricks again, but this time the Mighty Twins have a super trick of their own!

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save the Mega Mayor
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger finally gets super powers, and it’s a total cat-astrophe! The Mighty Pups are summoned to save the Mega Mayor from himself.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Freaky Pup-Day
Episodes.Description: Chase and Chickaletta switch bodies and must learn to work together to return Cap'n Turbot's boat to the bay.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Runaway Mayor
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger creates robotic pants to cheat at the Most Amazing Athlete contest. They go haywire so the pups have to save a runaway mayor.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Bears
Episodes.Description: Bears are asleep all over town! The PAW Patrol must work quietly to save the Bears and return them to their cave.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Farmerless Farm
Episodes.Description: With the farmers out of town, Mayor Goodway calls the Paw Patrol to wrangle the animals and control the chaos on the farmerless farm.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Squirrels
Episodes.Description: The PAW Patrol is on a roll when squirrels stash acorns in Alex's treehouse, causing it to fall onto Daring Danny's skateboard!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Roo
Episodes.Description: A joey is separated from its mama, and now the pups must save a roo and the day!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Balloon Pups
Episodes.Description: Giant balloons have floated away from a parade and it’s up to the pups to save the pup balloons, the parade and Mayor Humdinger!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Spider Spies
Episodes.Description: The Turbot cousins try to spot a rare spider, but get stuck in its web. It’s up to the PAW Patrol save the spider spies!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a White Wolf
Episodes.Description: After a sudden snow storm, Everest cares for a white wolf cub as they work together to help the PAW Patrol find them.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Wrong Way Explorer
Episodes.Description: Famous wrong-way explorer, Travelling Travis, accidentally takes Chickaletta to the North Pole where they run into... crocodiles?

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Mighty Pups vs. the Copycat
Episodes.Description: The Mighty Pups get Charged Up to take on new super-baddie, The Copycat. It’ll take all new powers and gear to take down their most formidable foe to date.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Humsquatch
Episodes.Description: Travelling Travis yelps for help when he finds a mysterious creature in trouble. The PAW Patrol heads to Foggy Bottom to save a Humsquatch!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Far Flung Flying Disc
Episodes.Description: When a robo-toy causes mayhem, Ryder knows just who to call to save the far flung flying disc!

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Pups Stop a Big Bad Bot
Episodes.Description: When Harold Humdinger uses a GIANT ROBOT to take the buildings of Adventure Bay and make his OWN town, the Mighty Pups must save the day!

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Mighty Pups vs. the Dome
Episodes.Description: The COPYCAT is BACK and Adventure Bay needs a Mighty Rescue when he traps the entire town under a GIANT DOME!

Episodes.Title: Pups Rescue a Rescuer
Episodes.Description: Mayor Goodway tries to help the PAW Patrol rescue Danny, but the pups end up having to rescue the rescuer, too!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Phantom of the Frog Pond
Episodes.Description: A spooky sound forces frogs from their home. The pups must bring them home and solve the mystery of the frog pond phantom.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Tour Bus
Episodes.Description: The pups have to stop Mayor Humdinger's runaway tour bus after the kitty tastrophe crew hijacks the bus.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Midnight at the Museum
Episodes.Description: When Alex and the mini patrol get lost during a sleepover with Mayor Goodway and the twins at the Museum, the pups must come to the rescue.

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Pups Stop a Humdinger Horde
Episodes.Description: The Mighty Pups have to save the day when Harold makes a cloning machine and Mayor Humdinger clones five versions of himself, as they take Katie's Pet Parlor to Foggy Bottom, with Katie and Cali inside.

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups, Charged Up: Pups Save a Mighty Lighthouse
Episodes.Description: Harold uses his superpowers to turn Cap'n Turbot's lighthouse into a rocket ship to fly to the moon, but the pups make him go underwater instead.

Episodes.Title: Mighty Pups Charged Up: Pups vs. Three Super Baddies
Episodes.Description: Tired of Ryder and the PAW Patrol always winning up to the top, Harold Humdinger, Ladybird and the Copycat team up and uses Mayor Humdinger's idea to take the pups' meteor to get more powers, causing the Mighty Pups to lose their powers. With the help from Tuck and Ella, the Mighty Pups use a piece of the meteor to stop the three baddies and save the meteor.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save an Antarctic Martian
Episodes.Description: Travelling Travis thinks he is on Mars when he lands in Antarctica, due to his helmet cover being red.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Maze Explorers
Episodes.Description: While visiting Carlos and Tracker in the jungle with the pups, Mr. Porter and Alex get trapped inside a huge maze while going on a hike.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Waiter Bot
Episodes.Description: Mr. Porter gets a new robot that helps him around the café, but it soon malfunctions and cleans things all over town.

Episodes.Title: Pups Stop a Pie-Clone
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger tries to get pies faster by cooling them down, only to make them fly in a tornado.

Episodes.Title: Dino Rescue: Pups and the Lost Dino Eggs
Episodes.Description: The pups go into a tunnel in Jake's mountain to go into a world of dinosaurs, where they meet a dino expert pup named Rex and his owners, Dr. Turbot and her daughter, Taylor Turbot. However, Mayor Humdinger has followed the PAW Patrol into the world and decides to take dino eggs back to Foggy Bottom. It is up to the pups to get the baby dinosaurs back to their mothers on a Dino Rescue.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Big Bad Bird Crew
Episodes.Description: The pups must save Chickaletta after she gets lost along with Myrna the Mynha bird.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Soapbox Derby
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger poses as a kid to participate in a "kids only" soapbox derby.

Episodes.Title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Pterodactyl
Episodes.Description: Rex, Taylor Turbot, and the Baby Brachiosaurus, whose name was Benny, call for the PAW Patrol to help Maverick the daredevil pterodactyl after his wing gets injured by a rockslide. After being rescued, Dr. Turbot gives Maverick a brace to help him fly. But a fountain splashed on him and then he bumped into a tree, causing him to spin out of control.

Episodes.Title: Dino Rescue: Pups and the Big Rumble
Episodes.Description: The pups must get the dinosaurs away from an active volcano in the Dino Wilds before it erupts.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Skydivers
Episodes.Description: Mayor Goodway and Farmer Al end up getting stranded up a ledge of a canyon after skydiving from the air and are trapped by a mountain lion and it's cubs.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Cupcakes
Episodes.Description: Cap'n Turbot accidentally takes Alex's cupcakes for school instead of fish treats for Wally and Walinda.

Episodes.Title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-Dino
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger takes his kitties to the Dino Wilds for some dino acting lessons, but instead finds himself on top of a runaway Brachiosaurus bound for Adventure Bay! Now it's up to the pups to save the town before the Dino stomps all over it!

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Pupmobiles
Episodes.Description: Sid Swashbuckle and his pirate pup Arrby steal all of the pups' vehicles (except for Chase's) to steal the Key to the City, which opens every door in Adventure Bay. Since Chase's vehicle was not stolen by Sid and Arrby, the pups work together in an Ultimate police rescue mission to recover the stolen items.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Lost Gold Miner
Episodes.Description: Uncle Otis and Tracker accidentally get into a runaway mine cart in a mine in the jungle, and the pups must save them before they crash.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Uncle Otis from His Cabin
Episodes.Description: Mr. Wingnut puts in a "Smart Home 3000" in Uncle Otis' cabin, but they end up getting trapped inside after it malfunctions.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Rocket Roller Skater
Episodes.Description: A mix-up delivery leads to Ms. Marjorie and Danny speeding out of control in Adventure Bay. Now the pups must rescue them.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Ryder's Surprise
Episodes.Description: Ryder's present ends up in the jungle and Carlos is trapped in a Jungle Gym. It's up to the pups to save the present and Carlos.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Election Day
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger runs for mayor of Adventure Bay, his Mayor Mobile runs out of control, the PAW Patrol have to save the day!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Bubble Monkeys
Episodes.Description: Ryder and the pups visit Tracker and Carlos in the jungle, a group of monkeys find themselves in sticky bubble trouble!

Episodes.Title: Pups Saves the Chalk Art
Episodes.Description: The Mini Patrol and the Pups race to save a mural before it rains.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Hot Potato
Episodes.Description: Farmer Al and Yumi discover their garden is full of holes and their one-of-a-kind potato is missing.

Episodes.Title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Sore Dino
Episodes.Description: In the Dino Wilds, Marshall performs some Dino dentistry with the help of an ancient geyser and his fellow Dino Pup Pals.

Episodes.Title: Dino Rescue: Pups Save the Triceratops Tag-Alongs
Episodes.Description: Francois and Cap'n Turbot are in the Dino Wilds for an adventure. But a sightseeing expedition quickly turns into a wild dino ride!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Bah Humdinger
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger is being very naughty on Christmas Eve, and it's up to the PAW Patrol to help Santa and save Christmas.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Marooned Mayors
Episodes.Description: While out ice fishing in the North Country, Mayor Goodway, Humdinger, along with Chickaletta, get stuck in an ice crevasse.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Game Show
Episodes.Description: The Wingnuts' farm plays host to a rootin' tootin' game show hosted by Cowgirl Beryl!

Episodes.Title: Moto Pups: Pups vs. the Ruff-Ruff Pack
Episodes.Description: The Motorcycle Stunt Show comes to town - bringing famed stunt cyclist Wild Cat, and the trouble-making cyclists, the Ruff-Ruff Pack. Wild Cat joins the PAW Patrol to help stop the baddies from trashing the town!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Trash-Dinger
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger's trash-compacting truck is messing up the beach. It's up to Rocky's new Re-Use It Truck to help save a rescue!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Royal Armor
Episodes.Description: Gifts for the Princess have been scattered all over town. It's up to Rocky's Re-Use It Truck to put her gifts back together!

Episodes.Title: Moto Pups: Pups Save the Donuts
Episodes.Description: The Ruff-Ruff Pack steals Mr. Porter's Mini-Donut Maker, the Moto-pups set off to get the machine back in one piece.

Episodes.Title: Moto Pups: Pups Save the Kitties
Episodes.Description: The Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and run off with his kitties. Now the Moto Pups and Wild Cat must rescue Mayor Humdinger's precious felines.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Stop the Junk-Monster
Episodes.Description: When Wingnut's junk pile and Oscar go missing at the same time, Chase and team are called in to solve the mystery.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Whale Pod
Episodes.Description: When Francois accidentally crashes his diving bell, the PAW Patrol must rescue him, a Pupfish, and a pod of whales.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Queen Cluck-Cluck
Episodes.Description: Mayor Goodway dreams she's travelled to the mysterious Cluck Cluck Island-a very strange land where Chickaletta is royalty! Now it's up to the pups to save Chickaletta from her fowl new fans.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Desert Flounder
Episodes.Description: Traveling Travis's balloon gets caught on the Flounder, Travis and Cap'n Turbot wind up on a wayward airborne cruise all the way out into the desert.

Episodes.Title: Moto Pups: Pups Save a Moto Mayor
Episodes.Description: Mayor Goodway thinks she can change the Ruff-Ruff pack's naughty ways by pretending to be a "bad" biker and becoming part of their gang, but when Gasket puts the Mayor through a battery of tough tests, it's up to the Moto Pups to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Sweet Mayor
Episodes.Description: Encased in a huge chocolate bunny to steal a gold egg that the Princess of Barkingburg sent to Mayor Goodway for the Easter festival, Mayor Humdinger is carried away by hungry raccoons and ends up being saved by Ryder and the pups.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Magic Trick
Episodes.Description: When a magic trick goes awry from Wendini the magician, the Adventure Bay Easter Festival is overrun by wild bunnies.

Episodes.Title: Moto Pup: Pup Save a Sneezy Chase
Episodes.Description: The Moto Pups must rescue Chase from his cat allergies and the Ruff-Ruff Pack stranding him on a desert.

Episodes.Title: Moto Pups: Rescue at Twisty Top Mesa
Episodes.Description: The Moto Pups must rescue the Ruff-Ruff Pack on a bus off the Twisty Top Mesa.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Little Hairy
Episodes.Description: Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy. It's time for a Jungle Rescue!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Kooky Climber
Episodes.Description: Daring Danny X tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorensen. It's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue the extreme duo.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Thundermouth
Episodes.Description: A sound from the jungle scares a mother and baby elephant away, and the pups must figure out where the sound is coming from.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Class Pet
Episodes.Description: The PAW Patrol helps Mayor Goodway get a hamster back to the city hall before Julia and Julius realize Mayor Goodwhiskers is missing.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Runaway Rooster
Episodes.Description: Chickaletta and Roosterio run away from a chicken show and get stuck on top of a runaway drone.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Snowbound Cow
Episodes.Description: When Bettina wanders up Jake's mountain and gets caught in a snowstorm, it's up to the PAW Patrol to bring her safely down.

Episodes.Title: Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Water Walker
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest.

Episodes.Title: Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Windsurfer
Episodes.Description: A long lost letter inspires Ms. Marjorie to visit an old surfing buddy, The pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Rubble-Double
Episodes.Description: Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double. When the ship crashes on an alien planet, he needs help from Ryder and the rest of the pups.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Clown
Episodes.Description: The pups have to save Mayor Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Opening Ceremonies
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Adventure Bay Games
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Mustache
Episodes.Description: The Pups must find Mayor Humdinger's moustache after he accidentally shaves it off before it's about to be on the cover of a magazine.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Funhouse
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Pups vs. a Neon Humdinger
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger's giant neon sign of himself gets loose, the Paw Patrol must stop it from rolling through town.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Royal Painting
Episodes.Description: The Paw Patrol races to stop Mayor Humdinger's gigantic neon sign from rolling through town. The Paw Patrol goes to work to recover the Princess's royal portrait stolen by Sweetie.

Episodes.Title: Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his "barking" cats, the pups must save the town. Then, Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses and creates chaos in his path. It's up to the PAW Patrol to save him.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Glasses
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Pups Stop the Cheetah
Episodes.Description: When the Cheetah swipes the PAW Patroller to fulfill her nefarious plan to destroy the jungle and build the cheating-est racetrack ever, the PAW Patrol must get a brand new vehicle and stop her!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Show Jumper
Episodes.Description: When Winnie Winnington and her truck gets stuck in the swamp while Winnie looks for a frog to enter in a frog jumping contest, Ryder and the pups must rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Salmon
Episodes.Description: When Alex gets carried away on a beaver's house while on a wildwood walk with Julia, Julius and Cap'n Turbot, the PAW Patrol must rescue him and the salmon as well!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Hiding Elephants
Episodes.Description: The elephants become trapped in the Monkey Temple after a bee frightens them away from their watering hole. Can the PAW Patrol rescue the elephants?

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Yodeler
Episodes.Description: When Mr. Wingnut runs away from wolves that are attracted to his yodeling, he ends up trapped in a canyon. The PAW Patrol has to hurry to save him.

Episodes.Title: Pups vs. Ouchy Paws
Episodes.Description: Sid Swashbuckle and Arrby pretend to be a legendary ghost known as Ouchy Paws so that he can take Danny's new skateboard, and it's up to the PAW Patrol to stop them from taking it before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Glow-in-the-Dark Party
Episodes.Description: Ryder and the pups set off to save Cap’n Turbot, Mr. Porter, Alex, Katie, Cali, Little Hootie, and Mayor Humdinger from the alien boy's space bubbles so that they can attend Mayor Goodway's glow-in-the-dark party.

Episodes.Title: Pups Stop a Super Shaker
Episodes.Description: Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire and shakes up Adventure Bay, even threatening to rock the Lookout off its foundation.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Flying Farmhouse
Episodes.Description: Farmer Al has a wild dream that the PAW Patrol must rescue him and Farmer Yumi when his animals start acting like humans.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Dizzy Dust Express
Episodes.Description: When the Dizzy Dust Express appears with no one aboard, the PAW Patrol must stop the runaway train and find the missing passengers.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Treetop Trekkers
Episodes.Description: Mayor Goodway, Tilly Turbot and Ms. Marjorie's jungle zip-lining adventure becomes a tragedy, when they get stuck on the treetops, and it's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue them.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Treasure Cruise
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger tricks Mayor Goodway, her uncle Otis, Mr. Porter, and Alex to sail icy waters in search of an Antarctic treasure, but they need the PAW Patrol when they get stranded on shore.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Rocket Ryder
Episodes.Description: The pups need to rescue Ryder and Alex when they get out of control on a rocket-powered ATV.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Knights: Quest for Dragon's Tooth
Episodes.Description: When Ryder and the pups are knighted by the Princess of Barkingburg, they're put to the test when a disgruntled ex-Knight named Claw gains control of a dragon called Sparks and attacks the castle.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Knights: Pups Break the Ice
Episodes.Description: The Rescue Knights must warm up Barkingburg and rescue the Princess and the Earl from Big Benji after Claw and Sparks freezes it, they can use the help of the baby dragons to melt the ice.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save Excalibark
Episodes.Description: When Chase removes the fake Golden Bone of Excalibark from its stone, he becomes the Princess of Barkingburg's Royal Knight. Will his friends rescue him and fix the bridge?

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Chicken Tulip
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger and his mother Helga help Mayor Goodway look for a rare tulip, Humdinger's attempts to have his mom find the flower first gets them all in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Pups Stop an Xtreme Shark
Episodes.Description: When Daring Danny X takes off on an mechanical shark with Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Porter swallowed into it, Ryder, Chase, Rocky and Skye must rescue them.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Tournament
Episodes.Description: The Rescue Knights help a mystery knight, the Princess of Barkingburg in disguise, win a tournament when Claw and Sparks show up and sabotage the event.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save the Baby Dragons
Episodes.Description: The Rescue Knights must save some baby dragons from Claw and reunite them with their mother.

Episodes.Title: Liberty Makes a New Friend
Episodes.Description: When Liberty, the star of "PAW Patrol: The Movie" arrives at Adventure Bay, she bought a bear named Benny. Can she sort out the mess with the help from the PAW Patrol?

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Pup Pup Boogie Contest
Episodes.Description: Francois is floating on a hot air balloon, and it's up to Liberty, Ryder and the pups to rescue him, and fix the screen for the Pup Pup Boogie contest!

Episodes.Title: Rescue Knights: Pups Save a Dozing Dragon
Episodes.Description: When Claw and the Duke of Flappington use a magic cauldron to put the people of Barkingburg to sleep, their plan backfires when the enchanted fog works on Sparks, it's up to Rubble and the Rescue Knights to wake up the Dragon along with everyone else in town.

Episodes.Title: Dancing with Luke Stars
Episodes.Description: The pups must rescue Mayor Goodway, Mayor Humdinger, Julia, Julius, Farmer Yumi, Farmer Al, Luke Stars and of course, Rubble from a stranded dance floor!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Mischievous Octopus
Episodes.Description: Ryder and the PAW Patrol must investigate a mystery at the Turbots' exhibit at a museum and rescue the octopus.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Lonesome Walrus
Episodes.Description: While searching for Cap'n Turbot, Wally turns Adventure Bay upside down! Can the PAW Patrol find Wally before it's too late?

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Hummy Gummies
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger gets jealous, after everyone loves his mother's Hummy Gummies. Ryder and the pups must rescue him when he is inside a giant Hummy Gummy!

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger babysits his new friend's children, but trouble arises when they start feuding with his kitties. When Mayor Goodway and Mayor Humdinger accidentally get locked in a greenhouse, they need to be rescued.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Greenhouse
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Box Fort
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Pups Save Travelin' Travis from Really Big Bill!
Episodes.Description: Skye helps Traveling Travis search for Big Bill Island.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Floating Goodways
Episodes.Description: The Goodways drift out to sea on a swan-shaped float and need rescue from a flock of real swans aiming to protect the giant inflatable.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Portable Pet Wash
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Big Truck Pups: Pups Stop a Flood
Episodes.Description: With their new Big Truck vehicles and their new friend, Al, the PAW Patrol must save Adventure Bay from flooding.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Humdinger Doll
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger gets kidnapped as Big Hairy's doll, the PAW Patrol must save him.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Sand Sculpture Contest
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay sand sculpture contest, the PAW Patrol must stop his out-of-control machine!

Episodes.Title: Big Truck Pups: Pups Save the Swiped Speakers
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger hijacks Al's big rig carrying Luke Stars and his concert equipment, it's up to the Big Truck Pups to rescue him.

Episodes.Title: Big Truck Pups: Pups Save the Big Big Pipes
Episodes.Description: When Al's load of big pipes breaks loose, it's up to the Big Truck Pups to save their friend from the rolling hazards.

Episodes.Title: Pups Stop the Return of Humsquatch
Episodes.Description: When Eddie and Emmy get impatient at the carnival, they hide in Mayor Humdinger's Humsquatch costume to chase everyone out.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a Lonely Ghost
Episodes.Description: Rubble dreams that he meets a ghost and learns that it's not easy to help a ghost make new friends.

Episodes.Title: Big Truck Pups:  Pups Save a Sliding Chalet
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger's Mountain vacation literally goes downhill, it's up to the Pups to stop Jake's Chalet before it crashes.

Episodes.Title: Big Truck Pups: Pups Save a Really Big Dish
Episodes.Description: Mayor Humdinger messes with the satellite dish and downs a satellite and the town's communication systems.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save the Tooth Fairy
Episodes.Description: Julius loses his tooth and has a dream that the PAW Patrol saves a bumbling Tooth Fairy named Beamy.

Episodes.Title: Pups Solve the Mystery of the Missing Art
Episodes.Description: When all the paintings mysteriously disappear from the Art Museum festival, except for Eddie and Emmy's painting, the PAW Patrol must solve the Missing Art Mystery and return all the paintings.

Episodes.Title: Big Truck Pups: Pups Save the Bridge
Episodes.Description: The pups must save Adventure Bay's big bridge from collapsing.

Episodes.Title: Pups Meet the Cat Pack
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger transforms his robot cat into a tiger-sized metal-eating menace, the PAW Patrol calls in the Cat Pack for help in stopping the creature.

Episodes.Title: Cat Pack: Rocket Rescuers
Episodes.Description: When Chickaletta gets trapped in a rocket, it flies all over Adventure Bay very fast. Can the Cat Pack and the Mighty Pups stop the runaway rocket before it's too late?

Episodes.Title: Cat Pack: The Golden Lion Mask
Episodes.Description: The Ruff-Ruff Pack is back and this time they stole the Golden Lion Mask. Now the cats and the pups must stop the Ruff-Ruff Pack and rescue the mask and return it to the museum!

Episodes.Title: Cat Pack: The Cat That Roared
Episodes.Description: When a monkey is injured, it's up to the PAW Patrol, along with Cat Pack veterans Leo and Rory to save it and the jungle!

Episodes.Title: Cat Pack: Saving the Safe
Episodes.Description: When Mayor Humdinger and Meow-Meow break into Mayor Goodway's safe, the Cat Pack and the PAW Patrol must save it and stop Meow-Meow.

Episodes.Description: When an eel accidentally swallows a piece of the meteor and becomes gigantic, it's up to the Mighty Pups to save Adventure Bay.

Episodes.Description: After Sweetie decides to commandeer the Princess's royal carriage and horses, Sid the pirate sends Arrby to steal it.

Episodes.Title: Pups Save a T-Rex Tyke
Episodes.Description: When a baby T-Rex gets lost, Ryder and the pups go on a daring mission to the Dino Wilds to help find him.

Episodes.Title: Aqua Pups: Pups Save a Merdinger

While the Kitten Catastrophe Crew performs a diversion, Mayor Humdinger poses as a mer-pup named Merdinger in order to get close to the giant clam that makes the pearls so that he can get a purple pearl. Coral calls in the PAW Patrol when havoc occurs in Puplantis.

Episodes.Title: Aqua Pups: Pups Save the Whale Patroller

With the PAW Patrol's vehicles on the Whale Patroller, Coral summons some sea creatures to come to their aid and act as a mode of transportation for them with Robo-Dog being Ryder's mode of transportation.

Entries.Title: Pokémon
Entries.Description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

Episodes.Title: Pokémon - I Choose You!
Episodes.Description: Meet Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old boy full of imagination, confidence, and dreams that are almost too big for his village of Pallet Town—plus the desire to become a Pokémon Master!

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Emergency!
Episodes.Description: Ash rushes into Viridian City with his gravely wounded Pikachu. The city's on high alert for Pokémon thieves-thieves like Jessie, James, and Meowth of Team Rocket, a group of bad guys dedicated to stealing valuable Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Ash Catches a Pokémon
Episodes.Description: Ash discovers and catches a Caterpie—his first Pokémon capture! Though Ash is excited, Misty is grossed out by Bug-type Pokémon, so she is repulsed by its attempts to be friends with her. At night, as Ash and Misty sleep, Caterpie shares with Pikachu its dream of evolving into a Butterfree.

Episodes.Title: Challenge of the Samurai
Episodes.Description: Misty and Ash continue to wander the Viridian Forest when they spot a Weedle. As Ash battles it, he's distracted by a boy dressed as a samurai and calling himself (naturally) Samurai. Samurai challenges Ash to a battle, and Ash gets the advantage when his Metapod defends itself against Samurai's Pinsir. Samurai sends out his own Metapod—and a standoff begins.

Episodes.Title: Showdown in Pewter City
Episodes.Description: Jessie, James, and Meowth dig a trap for our heroes, but they end up falling into it themselves! Ash and Misty arrive at Pewter City and meet a curious fellow named Flint, who notices that Pikachu is tired and shows them the way to the Pokémon Center.

Episodes.Title: Clefairy and the Moon Stone
Episodes.Description: Will Team Rocket steal the Moon Stone? Are there other Clefairy lurking about, and do they carry Moon Stones, too? And is the legend of the Moon Stone true?

Episodes.Title: The Water Flowers of Cerulean City
Episodes.Description: Ash seeks the Cascade badge in Cerulean City—but for some reason, Misty doesn't want to join them. When Ash and Brock show up, the city is buzzing about a break-in that just took place—and are initially accused of the crime!

Episodes.Title: The Path to the Pokémon League
Episodes.Description: On the way to Vermillion City, Ash meets AJ, a Gym Leader at an unsanctioned Gym who has 98 wins and zero losses. They battle, and Ash is surprised that AJ's Ground-type Sandshrew can easily beat his Flying-type Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: The School of Hard Knocks
Episodes.Description: While searching for firewood in the foggy woods, Ash and Pikachu discover a bunch of prep-school kids bullying a classmate named Joe.

Episodes.Title: Bulbasaur and the Hidden Village
Episodes.Description: Ash and Misty, while arguing, discover an Oddish. As Misty's Starmie weakens the Oddish, a Bulbasaur appears and fights Starmie while the Oddish runs off into the woods.

Episodes.Title: Charmander - The Stray Pokémon
Episodes.Description: Our friends, lost, discover an injured Charmander. Pikachu talks to it and learns that it's been waiting a long time for its trainer to return.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes the Squirtle Squad
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends walk along a path and fall into a hole dug by a batch of mischievous Squirtle. Ash climbs out and tries to battle them, but they scatter when Officer Jenny arrives.

Episodes.Title: Mystery at the Lighthouse
Episodes.Description: A tremendously large shadow begins to take form in the sea mists, but this possible discovery could be hindered due to the infamous Team Rocket lurking in the background cooking up another one of their schemes.

Episodes.Title: Electric Shock Showdown
Episodes.Description: Our heroes finally reach Vermillion City, and they discover that the Pokémon Center is filled with Pokémon hurt during battles with Lt. Surge, the Vermillion City Gym Leader.

Episodes.Title: Battle Aboard the St. Anne
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends board a fancy cruise ship called the St. Anne, thanks to tickets provided by two friendly but familiar-looking people. We soon learn that they're actually Jessie and James in disguise!

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Shipwreck
Episodes.Description: The St. Anne has capsized and sunk with Ash, the gang, and Team Rocket trapped inside. Now, both sides must put aside their differences in order to escape.

Episodes.Title: Island of the Giant Pokémon
Episodes.Description: As our heroes and Team Rocket beat the odds by surviving the sinking ship, they are dragged into another potentially deadly situation when they are attacked by the ferocious Pokémon, Gyarados.

Episodes.Title: Beauty and the Beach
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends have finally arrived in Porta Vista, a beach-side tourist town. After destroying an old man's ship, they must help in the old man's business. To attempt to pay the man back faster, Misty enters a beauty contest, only to discover she is competing against Jessie and James.

Episodes.Title: Tentacool & Tentacruel
Episodes.Description: Our heroes arrive at Hutber Port, where a ferryboat line runs to the mainland.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost of Maiden's Peak
Episodes.Description: After leaving Acapulco in search of Saffron City, our heroes finally arrive at a small port town in the middle of celebrating a summer festival.

Episodes.Title: Bye Bye Butterfree
Episodes.Description: When the party sees a flock of Butterfree flying above the ocean, Brock, as a Pokémon breeder, explains that it is the Butterfree's egg-laying season.

Episodes.Title: Abra and the Psychic Showdown
Episodes.Description: The party finally arrives in Saffron City where a young girl manages a gym of Pokémon using her psychic powers. If Ash defeats this particular Gym Leader, Ash can earn a gold badge.

Episodes.Title: The Tower of Terror
Episodes.Description: In search of a ghost Pokémon, Ash heads immediately for a tower in Lavender Town where they are said to dwell.

Episodes.Title: Haunter Versus Kadabra
Episodes.Description: Unbenownst to Ash, one of the ghost Pokémon decides to join Ash and friends on their journey and more importantly help Ash battle the powerful Saffron City Gym Leader.

Episodes.Title: Primeape Goes Bananas
Episodes.Description: On their way to Celadon City, our heroes encounter Mankey, a wild Pokémon that if rubbed the wrong way can go into uncontrollable fits. Not realizing its unpredictability, the party accidentally upsets Mankey.

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Scent-sation!
Episodes.Description: The party arrives in Celadon City, a perfectly pleasant town full of large department stores, condominiums, and fancy arcades.

Episodes.Title: Hypno's Naptime
Episodes.Description: Our heroes come to a town in which a great deal of children have recently turned up missing.

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Fashion Flash
Episodes.Description: At Brock's persistent request, our heroes stop by Caesar Street, a town of breeders famous for its Pokémon beauty salons.

Episodes.Title: The Punchy Pokémon
Episodes.Description: In the outskirts of Fuchsia City, our heroes come across Hitmonchan, a fighter-Pokémon. With little thought, Ash attempts to capture it, but he and Pikachu are badly defeated.

Episodes.Title: Sparks Fly for Magnemite
Episodes.Description: As our heroes make their way through the industrial town of Gringy City, Pikachu, perhaps weary from travel, is in a strange state; the electric sacks on his cheeks are continually twitching as though overcharged.

Episodes.Title: Dig Those Diglett!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Brock, Misty and Pikachu are lost deep in the mountains. As they press forward on a rough road not even shown on their map, they suddenly hear a large explosion.

Episodes.Title: The Ninja-Poké Showdown
Episodes.Description: Fuchsia Gym, the authorized gym where Ash seeks his next badge, turns out to be a hidden ninja's lair. After finally discovering and entering the gym, he is held up by a complex system of traps.

Episodes.Title: The Flame Pokémon-athon!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes come to a prairie where the Laramies, a family of Pokémon Ranchers live. They learn from a daughter of the Laramie family that a race is held at the ranch once a year to measure the growth of everyone's Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: The Kangaskhan Kid
Episodes.Description: Our heroes accompany Officer Jenny into the forest, intent on pursuing the Pokémon poachers in the area.

Episodes.Title: The Legend of Dratini
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends get challenged by Team Rocket in seeing who can capture the most Pokémon within the Safari Zone, with Ash catching a whole herd of Tauros. As soon as Ash and his friends head out Pokémon hunting, Team Rocket manages to get the drop on the game warden (Mr. Kaiza) and forces him into giving up the location on where Dratini is (the Dragon Valley). In the end, Ash, his friends, Team Rocket, and Kaiza end up seeing the legendary Dratini and Dragonair, with the heroes saving the day.

Episodes.Title: The Bridge Bike Gang
Episodes.Description: Ash and the others happen upon a town that can only be reached by a long bike bridge, but they don't have enough money to rent bikes for the crossing.

Episodes.Title: Ditto's Mysterious Mansion
Episodes.Description: Our heroes take shelter in a cabin that turns out to be the Copycat House of a trainer who has a Pikachu that is a Ditto, the Transform Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Cyber Soldier Porygon
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends arrive at Pokémon Center where the PokéBall transfer machine has been causing problems, as the transferred Pokémon never end up at the other side. Ash and his friends decide to accompany Porygon, a computerized Pokémon, used by Professor Akihabara to investigate the problem, only to discover Team Rocket and another Porygon are to blame.

Episodes.Title: Pikachu's Goodbye
Episodes.Description: Ash and the others discover a group of wild Pikachu in a secluded area of the woods. How will Pikachu feel seeing others of its kind in the wild?

Episodes.Title: The Battling Eevee Brothers
Episodes.Description: Tracing a path through the woods, the party comes across a tree baited with a plate of food and water. An Eevee is bound to the trunk with string.

Episodes.Title: Wake Up, Snorlax!
Episodes.Description: On empty stomachs, our heroes' search for food brings them to a small village, but find there is no food at the bakery nor at the grocery store; even the town restaurant is out of food.

Episodes.Title: Showdown at Dark City
Episodes.Description: In the middle of a terrible desert, our heroes inadvertently wandered into Dark City. With no name but Dark, the city has fallen into ruin.

Episodes.Title: The March of the Exeggutor Squad
Episodes.Description: After discovering there's a traveling carnival nearby, Ash, Misty and Brock join in on the fun of the fair and stumble across a rather dull magic show.

Episodes.Title: The Problem with Paras
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket never let up with their constant interception, but today something seems strange. The coin on Meowth's forehead is blinking red, indicating overheating.

Episodes.Title: The Song of Jigglypuff
Episodes.Description: Our heroes trudge along, resigning themselves to the idea of camping out in the desert as the sun slowly sets. Suddenly they see bright lights in front of them: a glamorous city appears before them, covered in neon lights.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Prehistoric Pokémon
Episodes.Description: Our heroes approach Grampa Canyon, famous for the beautiful scenery of its valley. As they approach, however, they find wave upon wave of people also heading for Grampa Canyon.

Episodes.Title: A Chansey Operation
Episodes.Description: As our heroes sleep peacefully, Pikachu begins experiencing an unusual sensation. As though it were choking on something, Pikachu's expression grows steadily more and more pained.

Episodes.Title: Holy Matrimony!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes pass the entrance to a small village, they stop in front of a strange sign.

Episodes.Title: So Near, Yet So Farfetch'd
Episodes.Description: As Ash sits on a rock, staring at his Pokédex, it displays Farfetch'd, an odd-looking Pokémon holding a leek.

Episodes.Title: Who Gets to Keep Togepi?
Episodes.Description: When Ash and friends reach a certain Pokémon E. R., Joy informs Ash that a message has arrived for him, from Professor Oak.

Episodes.Title: Bulbasaur's Mysterious Garden
Episodes.Description: After Bulbasaur's bulb begins to emit an odd glow, a nurse runs some tests and discovers that Bulbasaur isn't sick: It's getting ready to evolve!

Episodes.Title: Princess vs. Princess
Episodes.Description: Misty and Jessie compete against one another for Queen of the Princess Festival, a day where women rule and the guys have to do whatever the girls tell them.

Episodes.Title: The Purr-fect Hero
Episodes.Description: It's Kids Day, and Ash and friends help the children at a nearby school celebrate the holiday.

Episodes.Title: The Case of the K-9 Caper!
Episodes.Description: Ash enrolls Pikachu in a training school for police Growlithe, but the course is tougher than he imagined, for himself and for Pikachu!

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Paparazzi
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends are being shadowed by Todd Snap, the world's greatest Pokémon photographer.

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Test
Episodes.Description: Ash signs up to take an exam to be admitted to the Pokémon League.

Episodes.Title: The Breeding Center Secret
Episodes.Description: Our heroes discover a terrible secret about the new breeding center in town.

Episodes.Title: Riddle Me This (1)
Episodes.Description: Ash, Brock and Misty travel to Cinnabar Island where Ash hopes to win his Volcano Badge.

Episodes.Title: Volcanic Panic (2)
Episodes.Description: Ash continues his quest to attain his Volcano Badge once he finally locates the gym that is suspended above a pool of molten lava!

Episodes.Title: Beach Blank-Out Blastoise
Episodes.Description: As Ash and the gang are rushing to catch the last ferry off of Cinnabar Island, they stumble over a rare Pokémon in trouble.

Episodes.Title: The Misty Mermaid
Episodes.Description: One of Misty's water Pokémon is in desperate need of exercise, so the gang decides to take her Horsea to a gym that's run by her sisters in Cerulean City.

Episodes.Title: Clefairy Tales
Episodes.Description: Ash, Brock and Misty get sidetracked on their way to Viridian City when all of their belongings mysteriously disappear.

Episodes.Title: The Battle of the Badge
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends finally make their way to Viridian City where Ash hopes to earn his Earth Badge.

Episodes.Title: It's Mr. Mime Time!
Episodes.Description: On their way back to Pallet Town, Ash, Brock and Misty encounter a runaway Mr. Mime.

Episodes.Title: Holiday Hi-Jynx
Episodes.Description: Ash, Misty, Brock, and their Pokémon must return a lost Jynx to Santa before Christmas, with the help of a Lapras. Meanwhile, Jessie attempts to take revenge on Santa for stealing her favorite doll when she was young.

Episodes.Title: Snow Way Out!
Episodes.Description: Pikachu is lost in a snowy mountain forest! Can Ash and the gang stay warm while tracking down their missing pal?

Episodes.Title: Showdown at the Po-ké Corral
Episodes.Description: Back in Pallet Town, Ash finds Gary, already there, waiting to partake in the Pokémon League. Always having a bitter rivalry with Gary, Professor Oak tells them both the meaning of Pokémon. Meanwhile, Team Rocket is trying to get inside the lab to steal the Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: The Evolution Solution
Episodes.Description: Ash goes to Seafoam Island to help Professor Oak to discover the mystery of how Slowpoke evolves into Slowbro. There, Professor Westwood V is also trying to solve the mystery. Jessie captures Shellder, and tries to rush a Slowpoke's evolution, forcing Psyduck to stall the evolution.

Episodes.Title: The Pi-Kahuna
Episodes.Description: Ash and the gang take some time off to go surfing. While surfing, however, Ash passes out, but is thankfully rescued by a surfer named Victor and his blue-eyed Pikachu, Puka. Victor then reveals his plans to surf a tsunami called Humungadunga and become a surfing legend.

Episodes.Title: Make Room for Gloom
Episodes.Description: Ash goes to a flower garden to get some fertilizer for his mother, but Bulbasaur sniffs the flowers and becomes paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Lights, Camera, Quack-tion
Episodes.Description: When the gang discovers there is a movie with an all Pokemon cast being made nearby, Ash and his friends put their Pokémon in for an audition. Misty's Psyduck gets the main role while the others get minor roles.

Episodes.Title: Go West Young Meowth
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends go to Hollywood (although only a small nearby town) to see the premiere of the movie their Pokémon were cast in. Team Rocket follows them to find out that Meowth has history in this town; It is here where he was a member of a gang of street Meowths led by the Persian. He learned to speak and walk upright to win the heart of a female Meowth who was abandoned by her owner. Upon returning, he challenges Persian who was once his mentor for the female Meowth he thought he lost years before.

Episodes.Title: To Master the Onixpected!
Episodes.Description: After watching Elite Four member Bruno on TV, Ash and his friends decide to do training in the mountains to be as strong as Bruno. However, they meet Bruno and he manipulates them to do some menial tasks for him. Meanwhile, a giant Onix is on a rampage.

Episodes.Title: The Ancient Puzzle of Pokémopolis
Episodes.Description: While training, Ash and his friends accidentally uncover the ruins of Pokémopolis, an ancient city. After a bit of research, they find a giant Gengar and a giant Alakazam starting to fight. Then, a giant Jigglypuff appears to put them to sleep.

Episodes.Title: Bad to the Bone
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends offer to help a trainer that is heading for the Pokémon League to retrieve his stolen gym badges from Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: All Fired Up!
Episodes.Description: Ash finally reaches the Indigo Plateau, home of the Pokémon League conference. Before the tournament begins, they plan on lighting a ceremonial cauldron with the flame of the legendary Pokémon, Moltres. Ash, as a participant, is free to carry the flame but when Team Rocket steals it, the tournament may be cancelled.

Episodes.Title: Round One - Begin!
Episodes.Description: Ash enters his first match of the tournament on the water field against Mandi the Astounding. During the battle against Mandi's Exeggutor, Ash's Krabby evolves into Kingler, who he then uses against Mandy's remaining Seadra and Golbat, winning the match and moving onto the next preliminary round.

Episodes.Title: Fire and Ice
Episodes.Description: For the second round Ash battles in the rock arena. Ash's last Pokémon, Squirtle, defeats his foe's last Pokémon, Nidorino, and he, victorious, moves on to Round 3. In the third round Ash faces a trainer named Pete in the ice arena. Both trainers are left with 2 Pokémon each. Pete uses Cloyster and Arcanine. In the end, Ash is victorious and he moves on to Round 4.

Episodes.Title: The Fourth Round Rumble
Episodes.Description: In the 4th round, Ash faces a trainer named Jeanette, who uses a Beedrill, a Scyther, and a Bellsprout. The match ends with Ash victorious, and he moves on to the 5th round, becoming one of the final sixteen members of the tournament.

Episodes.Title: A Friend in Deed
Episodes.Description: Ash meets a new trainer named Richie, who is eerily similar to Ash, including owning a Pikachu. However, Team Rocket makes another attempt to steal Ash's and Richie's Pokémon. Ash and Richie prevent Team Rocket from stealing their Pokémon. Ash discovers his next battle is against Richie. Will Ash manage to reach the quarterfinals?

Episodes.Title: Friend and Foe Alike
Episodes.Description: A twist of fate pits Ash and his new friend, Richie, against each other in the fifth round of the Pokémon League Competition. Both are determined to triumph, but who will emerge victorious? And, can their friendship survive the struggle?

Episodes.Title: Friends to the End
Episodes.Description: After losing to Richie in the fifth round, Ash is moping around, annoyed that he lost. He is convinced by Misty that he should support Richie who is now in the quarterfinals. However, when Richie loses, they both have to look inside themselves to see if they are good trainers.

Episodes.Title: Pallet Party Panic
Episodes.Description: After battling in the Pokémon League Tournament, Ash and his friends return to Pallet Town for a hero's welcome.

Episodes.Title: A Scare in the Air
Episodes.Description: Ash, Brock, and Misty prepare for their long journey to Valencia Island to bring back a mysterious Poké Ball for Professor Oak. After discovering that the trip will take a month to get there, Ash manages to win a free blimp ride so it will take only a day! Once on board, they realize the blimp is being powered by Team Rocket! And things only get worse from there!

Episodes.Title: Pokéball Peril
Episodes.Description: After making a crash landing onto Valencia Island, our heroes get directions to Professor Ivy's laboratory where the mysterious Pokéball is being held. Once at the laboratory, Brock realizes that Professor Ivy and her group of scientists are Pokémon breeders just like him! Suddenly Brock begins to feel at home and thinks about staying for awhile to continue his studies on Pokémon breeding.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Lapras
Episodes.Description: After picking up the GS Ball from Professor Ivy, Brock decided to stay on the island so Ash and Misty head back home by blimp. Unfortunately, our duo gets double-crossed by Team Rocket once again, and Jigglypuff puts the whole crew to sleep. After another crash landing in the middle of nowhere they meet a new friend named Tracey while trying to help a Lapras that washed up on the beach.

Episodes.Title: Fit To Be Tide
Episodes.Description: Ash, Misty and their new friend, Tracey, are on a new adventure exploring the Orange Islands as Ash sets out to qualify for the Orange League Tournament. After hearing that the Mikan Gym Leader is known as one of the toughest trainers in the Orange Crew, Ash can't wait for the challenge. He learns that Pokémon battles are run a little differently on the Orange Islands, but he can always rely on his Squirtle to pull them through!

Episodes.Title: Pikachu Re-Volts
Episodes.Description: Just as Ash, Misty, and Tracey set foot on Mandarin Island, Pikachu and Togepi turn against them and join a group of other angry Pokémon. When the misbehaving Pokémon disappear, Officer Jenny arrives and informs them that dozens of Pokémon have been reported missing, including Meowth! Everyone fears a Psychic attack is behind this mystery. Will Jessie and James actually join forces with our heroes? Could they possibly win a battle for the first time?

Episodes.Title: The Crystal Onix
Episodes.Description: While riding around the Orange Islands on his Lapras, Ash finds a mysterious message in a bottle, which leads the gang on a new adventure. Ash, Misty and Tracey travel to Sunburst Island, which is famous for its artists and glassblowers. They meet a struggling young shopkeeper who's seeking inspiration from a legendary crystal Onix. Having been unable to find this special Pokémon, the shopkeeper turns to our heroes. With Tracey and his observational Pokémon on board, they set out to fire up a new friend's creative drive!

Episodes.Title: In the Pink
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends are caught in a whirlpool and swept to an unexplored island where all the Pokémon are pink. It's Pinkan Island, a Pokémon refuge where the Pokémon's diet of Pinkan Berries causes their unique coloration. But the Pokémon aren't all as sweet as they look. Our heroes cross paths with an enraged Nidoking, and end up cornered under a cliff.

Episodes.Title: Shell Shock!
Episodes.Description: Aboard Lapras, the group follows a news crew to an uninhabited island, where a scientific expedition is underway after the discovery of a fossilized Kabuto. A series of natural disasters place our heroes in mortal danger, with only the power of their Pokémon to help them. What is the secret of the Kabuto, and who wants that secret to remain hidden?

Episodes.Title: Stage Fight!
Episodes.Description: Misty meets another female trainer who also is an expert on water Pokémon. The new trainer notices some signs that Misty's Psyduck may be ready to evolve. As the two prepare for a Pokémon battle, a Golduck springs from the water and battles for Misty. With her powerful new Pokémon, can Misty defeat both her newfound friend and Team Rocket?

Episodes.Title: Bye Bye Psyduck
Episodes.Description: After stopping on another island to rest, Misty notices her Psyduck's tail is glowing, a nearby trainer says it may mean it is time for it to evolve. So Misty challenges her to battle and when she finds she has a Golduck, she easily beats the trainer. However, Team Rocket has other plans. Later, Golduck turns out to be a wild Pokémon as Misty's Psyduck makes an appearance.

Episodes.Title: The Joy of Pokémon
Episodes.Description: While riding Ash's Lapras to the next island, Ash and the gang come across a tanned Nurse Joy who insists on healing Wild Water Pokémon on the island. Ash and Tracey decide to help out, but when Team Rocket arrives to stop them, a giant Magikarp arrives.

Episodes.Title: Navel Maneuvers
Episodes.Description: The group arrive on Navel Island where Ash finds himself up against the Gym Leader, Danny as Ash competes for his second Orange League badge. Misty tries to tempt Ash by showing more caring attitude to Danny. Ash once again gets jealous and sad.

Episodes.Title: Snack Attack
Episodes.Description: Arriving on the Grapefruit Islands, Ash discovers that there is a Snorlax going from island to island eating all the grapefruits. Ash is employed to help stop the Snorlax, but the Snorlax proves to be slippery. Later on, Ash captures the Snorlax.

Episodes.Title: A Shipful of Shivers
Episodes.Description: Arriving on Moro Island, Ash and his friends hear about a long lost Orange League Trophy being found on a sunken ship, but when Team Rocket steals it, Ash and the gang follow them to a ghost ship inhabited by a Gastly and Haunter.

Episodes.Title: Meowth Rules!
Episodes.Description: Meowth finds himself on an island where the inhabitants believe him to be a "Meowth God".

Episodes.Title: Tracey Gets Bugged
Episodes.Description: Arriving on Murcott Island, Ash and his friends discover a wounded Scyther. After capturing it, Tracey must take it to a Pokémon Center. While there, he discovers the Scyther got dethroned from being in charge of his group.

Episodes.Title: A Way Off Day Off
Episodes.Description: Deciding to take a break on a nearby island, Ash, his friends, and all their Pokémon just use the time to relax and get better acquainted. However, Team Rocket has other plans for the Pokémon and intend to steal them.

Episodes.Title: The Mandarin Island Miss Match
Episodes.Description: The group descend on Mandarin Island where Ash's arrogance emerges due to the fact that he's won every single battle he's had since arriving on the island but upon meeting Prima, a member of the Elite Four and challenging her to a battle, Ash starts to realize that he may have made a grave mistake.

Episodes.Title: Wherefore Art Thou, Pokémon
Episodes.Description: Still on Mandarin Island, Ash and his friends go through Victorian Town where they find two Nidoran who are in love with each other but any possible hint of a relationship is being derailed by the trainers who happen to be childhood rivals.

Episodes.Title: Get Along, Little Pokémon
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends discover a man who has troops of Magnemite and has to take them to a town on the island in order to give it power. However, he gets injured, so it is up to Ash to herd up the Magnemite and get to the town.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery Menace
Episodes.Description: Heading to the other end of Mandarin Island, Ash and his friends discover there's a monster in the sewer that is causing lots of problems in the town. When the Mayor wants to blow it up, Joy protests and asks Ash and company to help.

Episodes.Title: Misty Meets Her Match
Episodes.Description: Ash arrives on Trovita Island prepared to battle for his third Orange League Gym Badge. However, much to Ash's dismay, the Gym Leader, Rudy has more than just battling on his mind, Rudy develops a crush on Misty, and Ash gets jealous once again. Rudy moves in to court Misty after she helps rescue his younger sister, Mahri. While Ash battles for the Spike Shell Badge, Misty considers the tempting offer to stay on the island with Rudy and Mahri forever.

Episodes.Title: Bound for Trouble
Episodes.Description: After getting his 3rd Orange League Badge, Ash and his friends arrive on an island, where Pikachu is soon captured by Team Rocket and is chained to Meowth. But soon after Pikachu and Meowth are taken away by a giant Pidgeot, the trapped rivals eventually learn how to get along.

Episodes.Title: Charizard Chills
Episodes.Description: After hearing about Ash from the Trovita Island gym leader, another trainer seeks him out for a battle. When Pikachu is knocked out during the battle, Ash turns to his Charizard, but he struggles to make the unruly Pokémon listen to him.

Episodes.Title: The Pokémon Water War
Episodes.Description: On the next island, Ash and his friends see a team of firefighters consisting of Squirtles, Wartortles, and Blastoises. Eager to test its skills, Ash's Squirtle get to train with them. But when an actual fire turns up, training has to become reality.

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Food Fight!
Episodes.Description: While in a battle, Ash accidentally breaks Snorlax's Pokéball. With the Pokémon Center on the other side of the island, Ash and his friends have to get Snorlax there. And to make matters worse, Team Rocket arrive and are hoarding the island's food ransom until they get Pikachu.

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Double Trouble
Episodes.Description: On Kumquat Island, Ash discovers Luana, the final Orange Island Gym Leader, who mistakes him for her son. After defending the island from Team Rocket, they head to the Gym to have a Double Battle where Pikachu and Charizard battle against Marowak and Alakazam but Pikachu's and Charizard's unwillingness to work together might end up costing Ash his chance of qualifying for the Orange League.

Episodes.Title: The Wacky Watcher!
Episodes.Description: On Rind Island, Tracey meets Dr. Quackenpoker, a noted Pokémon Watcher who is doing a study on the Magikarp that climb up waterfalls and how they evolve into Gyarados. However, Team Rocket appears to steal the Magikarp and get them to evolve.

Episodes.Title: The Stun Spore Detour
Episodes.Description: On Tiny Island, Ash and Tracey get affected by Stun Spore leaving it up to Misty to get an antidote to heal them. Can Misty find it with the help of her new Poliwag?

Episodes.Title: Hello, Pummelo!
Episodes.Description: After winning his way to the final competition for the Orange League Winner's Trophy, victory seems a long shot for Ash as the Gym Leader deploys a powerful Gengar that topples one of Ash's Pokémon after another.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Dragonite
Episodes.Description: As if a gym battle with a Dragonite isn't challenge enough for one day, Team Rocket secretly surveys the weakened state of Ash's battling Pokémon and plots to turn the situation to their advantage.

Episodes.Title: Viva Las Lapras
Episodes.Description: It's piracy on the open seas and Ash and friends must rescue a local school of Lapras from would-be poachers, but how can they be of help when the Lapras, conditioned to fear humans, shun the young Trainers?

Episodes.Title: The Underground Round-Up
Episodes.Description: Having to travel by boat, Ash and his friends arrive on Hamlin Island, their final stop before returning to Kanto to discover that the town is being attacked by hundreds of Electrode. A man named Poncho is trying to stop them with his Diglett.

Episodes.Title: A Tent Situation
Episodes.Description: They’re back in Pallet Town. When they get home, they discover Brock is back and he won’t explain why he left Valencia Island. However, as usual, Team Rocket try to steal all of the Pokémon in Oak’s lab by vacuuming all the Pokéballs, including the GS Ball that Oak was working on. Can they get it back?

Episodes.Title: The Rivalry Revival
Episodes.Description: An errand of Professor Oak's sets Ash on the road once again, but first he must face his old hometown rival, Gary, in a Pokémon battle.

Episodes.Title: Don't Touch That 'dile
Episodes.Description: Ash begins his journey in Johto, a largely unexplored region said to be thickly populated with Pokémon entirely new to him and his friends.

Episodes.Title: The Double Trouble Header
Episodes.Description: In a Pokémon battle, Ash soundly defeats an ambitious young Trainer, who runs away dejectedly.

Episodes.Title: A Sappy Ending
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends discover a forest where invading Pinsir are causing heavy deforestation.

Episodes.Title: Roll On, Pokémon!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends stumble into a small valley where Donphan are used to harvest precious stones.

Episodes.Title: Illusion Confusion!
Episodes.Description: Who would be foolish enough to brave a thick forest in the dead of night without a Hoothoot guide? Certainly not Ash Ketchum...

Episodes.Title: Flower Power
Episodes.Description: Our heroes must help prepare an insecure Bellossom dance troupe for their upcoming exhibition.

Episodes.Title: Spinarak Attack
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends reach a new town and hear of three mysterious robbers apparently mimicking the crimes of a legendary master thief.

Episodes.Title: Snubbull Snobbery
Episodes.Description: With pet food prepared by a French chef, rooms of WalkMaster exercise equipment and closets stocked with the latest in Pokémon fashion, life couldn't be much better for a Palm Hills Snubbull.

Episodes.Title: The Little Big Horn
Episodes.Description: Brock saves a lost and frightened Stantler fawn and carefully nurses it back to health before releasing it.

Episodes.Title: The Chikorita Rescue
Episodes.Description: Ash encounters a wild Chikorita and engages it in battle, thinking to add it to his team.

Episodes.Title: Once in a Blue Moon
Episodes.Description: Professor Oak's errand—to deliver the mysterious GS Ball to a Poké Ball expert—is interrupted when a Quagsire with a penchant for spherical objects steals the GS ball for use in a nocturnal ritual.

Episodes.Title: The Whistle Stop
Episodes.Description: When Team Rocket attacks Ash and his friends, a brave young Trainer and her flock of Ledyba come to the rescue.

Episodes.Title: Ignorance Is Blissey
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket can't believe their luck when the Blissey employed in a Pokémon Center willingly gives them the cente's entire food supply.

Episodes.Title: A Bout With Sprout
Episodes.Description: Our heroes are recruited as guest instructors at a youth Pokémon Academy.

Episodes.Title: Fighting Flyer With Fire
Episodes.Description: With Pikachu's help, Ash is confident that winning the Zephyr badge will be a breeze.

Episodes.Title: For Crying Out Loud
Episodes.Description: Cute and cuddly is one thing, but a bawling Marill is too much even for Misty.

Episodes.Title: Tanks a Lot!
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket's most recent super vehicle, the Arbotank, is their ticket to world domination.

Episodes.Title: Charizard's Burning Ambitions
Episodes.Description: When Ash hears of the nearby Charicific Valley, he is sure a quick trip would be just the thing to reignite his Charizard's flagging spirits.

Episodes.Title: Grin to Win!
Episodes.Description: The annual Sunflora contest is only a day away and yet our hero's new friend and Sunflora Trainer is unable to convince her star Pokémon to compete.

Episodes.Title: Chikorita's Big Upset
Episodes.Description: A severe case of rivalry between Pikachu and Chikorita calls for therapy sessions with Nurse Joy.

Episodes.Title: Foul Weather Friends
Episodes.Description: Our heroes chance upon a Hoppip—the fluffy "Cottonweed" Pokémon that is able to drift for miles on a passing wind.

Episodes.Title: The Superhero Secret
Episodes.Description: When Ash and friends wander into town, they bring with them a challenge that threatens to be Gligarman's last—Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: Mild 'n Wooly
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket comes in sheep's clothing to relieve a kind Poké-shepherd of her Mareep flock.

Episodes.Title: Wired for Battle!
Episodes.Description: When the most promising trainee at a Pokémon dojo abandons battle altogether, it's up to Ash and friends to convince him that battling is more than just a matter of probability.

Episodes.Title: Good 'Quil Hunting
Episodes.Description: With Charizard gone and no fire Pokémon to call his own, Ash is overjoyed to come across a Cyndaquil in the wild.

Episodes.Title: A Shadow of a Drought
Episodes.Description: Ash carelessly makes enemies of the Slowpoke-worshipping residents of a town.

Episodes.Title: Going Apricorn!
Episodes.Description: Ash delivers the mysterious GS Ball to a renowned Pokémon expert, but Team Rocket wreaks trouble when they attempt to harvest the Apricorns essential to local Poké Ball production.

Episodes.Title: Gettin' the Bugs Out
Episodes.Description: When Ash reaches the Hive Gym, he has just the Pokémon to challenge the Gym Leader's Bug Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: A Farfetch'd Tale
Episodes.Description: An inexperienced young Trainer mistakenly scares off his own Farfetch'd.

Episodes.Title: Tricks of the Trade
Episodes.Description: At the Pokémon Swap Meet, our heroes befriend a young Pokémon trainer who's having difficulties finding a trading partner willing to accept his Wobbuffet. When Jessie inadvertently deposits her Poké Ball across from his in the exchanger, this young trainer gets more than he had bargained for.

Episodes.Title: The Fire-ing Squad!
Episodes.Description: Rocket attempts to steal all the water Pokémon from the annual Fire and Rescue Grand Prix.

Episodes.Title: No Big Woop!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends enthusiastically volunteer to watch over a troubled trainer's school of Wooper.

Episodes.Title: Tunnel Vision
Episodes.Description: While Ash and friends deliberate on how to pass through a tunnel replete with Onix, two wandering Pokémon arrive on the scene together.

Episodes.Title: Hour of the Houndour
Episodes.Description: Investigating a string of mysterious thefts, our heroes discover a pack of Houndour, struggling to survive in the wild.

Episodes.Title: The Totodile Duel
Episodes.Description: Ash and Misty's friendly rivalry is tested when they both try to capture a Totodile at the same time. Unable to determine whose Poké Ball had captured the wild Pokémon, the two must battle it out to determine the Totodile's new master.

Episodes.Title: Hot Matches!
Episodes.Description: When Ash and friends hear of a virtually undefeatable trainer operating nearby, they seek her out.

Episodes.Title: Love, Totodile Style
Episodes.Description: Ash's Totodile falls head over tail for a passing Azumarill, but is still unsuccessful in having its feelings requited when Team Rocket kidnap the Pokémon before Totodile's eyes.

Episodes.Title: Fowl Play!
Episodes.Description: Ash has his sights set on a rare and brightly-colored Noctowl.

Episodes.Title: Forest Grumps
Episodes.Description: When an Ursaring attack leaves Team Rocket and our heroes in compromising positions, compromise they do, members of each team being paired with members of the other.

Episodes.Title: The Psychic Sidekicks!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes come to a town whose residents all raise Psychic Pokémon to repel the Ghost Pokémon that lurk nearby

Episodes.Title: The Fortune Hunters
Episodes.Description: A Pokémon Fortune Telling boom turns out to be a Team Rocket plot to steal Pokémon from local trainers.

Episodes.Title: A Goldenrod Opportunity
Episodes.Description: Arriving in Goldenrod City, Ash is ready for his next Gym battle, but the Gym appears to be closed. Their plans delayed, our heroes decide to explore the vibrant city.

Episodes.Title: A Dairy Tale Ending
Episodes.Description: After losing to Whitney at the Goldenrod Gym, Ash is thinking of a rematch with her powerful Miltank. When Whitney suggests a trip to a Miltank dairy, it's just the chance he's is looking for!

Episodes.Title: Air Time!
Episodes.Description: With his new Gym badge in hand, Ash is asked to appear on a local radio station. But while he's acting out a radio drama with some "professional actors," the scripted danger becomes all too lifelike!

Episodes.Title: The Bug Stops Here
Episodes.Description: A Bug Pokémon Catching Contest turns into a hive of activity when Ash goes up against his rival Casey-and it isn't long before the Team Rocket villains swarm the scene, intent on catching a few things for themselves...

Episodes.Title: Type Casting
Episodes.Description: On the way to Ecruteak City, our heroes are trapped on the wrong side of a river. To get across, they first have to find a Sudowoodo...which, even for an expert, is no easy feat!

Episodes.Title: Fossil Fools
Episodes.Description: When an ex-student of Professor Oak's discovers some restored Omanyte and Omastar in the wild, our heroes are called into action to save these prehistoric Pokémon from harsh times with Team Rocket!

Episodes.Title: Carrying On!
Episodes.Description: The Pidgey Express courier service is in need of our heroes' helping hands, especially when Team Rocket wants to have the delivery Pidgey signed, sealed, and delivered to the Boss!

Episodes.Title: Hassle in the Castle
Episodes.Description: Caught in a sudden downpour, our heroes find a castle clinic that uses Pokémon healers to help patients. But when Brock and the doctor end up trapped in the castle's labyrinth, a helping hand is needed to get them out!

Episodes.Title: Two Hits and a Miss
Episodes.Description: After meeting the elderly owner of a Pokémon dojo, Ash is called upon to replace the man's granddaughter as the chosen heir! But when a vicious challenger approaches, can Ash help defend the dojo from destruction?

Episodes.Title: A Hot Water Battle
Episodes.Description: Chikorita, Cyndaquil, and Totodile find themselves separated from the group and stuck in a ravine! When Meowth finds himself stuck too, an unlikely partnership forms!

Episodes.Title: Hook, Line, and Stinker
Episodes.Description: Misty is reeled into a rivalry at a local Seaking fishing competition. Can she come out on top?

Episodes.Title: Beauty and the Breeder
Episodes.Description: A Pokémon breeding contest gives our heroes a chance to compete, greet an old friend, and defeat Team Rocket once again!

Episodes.Title: A Better Pill to Swallow
Episodes.Description: When Ash comes down with a serious stomach ache far from any hospital, a local healer and his Shuckle companions are on task to set him right!

Episodes.Title: Power Play!
Episodes.Description: A run-in with his longtime rival Gary leaves Ash in a bad mood. But when Team Rocket's latest weapon starts terrorizing the local Pokémon Center, Ash might have to turn to him for help!

Episodes.Title: Mountain Time
Episodes.Description: After our heroes meet a mountain patrol and their Ledian partners, they'll have to help protect the mountain from a destructive Team Rocket attack!

Episodes.Title: Wobbu-Palooza!
Episodes.Description: The peace and quiet of a Wobbuffet festival is interrupted by some hooligans picking a fight. Pokémon battles are banned during the festival, so how can our heroes defend the town?

Episodes.Title: Imitation Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Ash and the gang are happy to see Duplica again...but not as happy as the Team Rocket trio, when they discover her newest Ditto's tiny transformations!

Episodes.Title: The Trouble with Snubbull
Episodes.Description: A Snubbull falls into a Team Rocket trap, and the villains try to ransom it back to its wealthy Trainer. But when the Pokémon fights back, Jessie, James, and Meowth might be the ones in trouble!

Episodes.Title: Ariados, Amigos
Episodes.Description: On their way to Ecruteak City, our heroes must help a familiar Trainer and her Ariados defend a martial arts center from a rampaging Team Rocket!

Episodes.Title: Wings 'N' Things
Episodes.Description: When a young Trainer's Yanma accidentally destroys his father's precious glasswork, it inspires a Team Rocket scheme that will shatter the peace and quiet of the town!

Episodes.Title: The Grass Route
Episodes.Description: Hearing of a nearby Grass-type Pokémon tournament, Ash decides to enter...and a rivalry soon begins to bloom amid the heat of battle!

Episodes.Title: The Apple Corp!
Episodes.Description: Pikachu's in trouble when an orchard owner mistakes it for one of the hungry Pichu that have ransacked her harvests. Ash wants to help, but will the fruits of his labor satisfy both the orchard owner and the Pokémon?

Episodes.Title: Houndoom's Special Delivery
Episodes.Description: When the smoke clears after their latest run-in with Team Rocket, our heroes quickly realize that Togepi is missing! As they begin the search, Togepi has started making friends in another part of the forest.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost of a Chance
Episodes.Description: Finally reaching Ecruteak City, our heroes set out to find the Gym, but wind up inside a decaying tower instead. Suddenly, the tower bursts into flames with our heroes trapped inside! How can they escape?

Episodes.Title: From Ghost to Ghost
Episodes.Description: It is finally time for Ash's fourth Gym battle! After seeing Morty's powerful Gengar in action, Ash is under no illusions about how tough these Ghost-type Pokémon will be! Can he claim the Fog Badge?

Episodes.Title: Trouble's Brewing
Episodes.Description: When our heroes meet five beautiful sisters in a cultural garden, they are soon challenged to a series of testing battles involving Eevee and some of its evolved forms!

Episodes.Title: All That Glitters!
Episodes.Description: A mischievous flock of Murkrow cause trouble for Ash and Team Rocket by stealing some of their most prized possessions! Now, the race is on to get them back!

Episodes.Title: The Light Fantastic
Episodes.Description: In a harsh desert landscape, a strange light appears, and a city of ruins rises up before our heroes. But how did the city come to be this way? Could it have something to do with the beautiful light show?

Episodes.Title: UnBEARable
Episodes.Description: There's a food thief amongst our heroes...could it have anything to do with the cute and cuddly Teddiursa who has joined them on their journey?

Episodes.Title: Moving Pictures
Episodes.Description: When our heroes are reunited with Pokémon photographer Todd Snap, he starts them on an adventure to find the Legendary Pokémon Articuno!

Episodes.Title: Spring Fever
Episodes.Description: Still searching for Articuno, our heroes are found by a trio of keen-nosed, snuffling Swinub, and Team Rocket are keen on sniffing them out for profit!

Episodes.Title: Freeze Frame
Episodes.Description: Our heroes have finally found Articuno, but they've led Team Rocket right to the Legendary Pokémon as well!

Episodes.Title: The Stolen Stones!
Episodes.Description: Ash and the gang are rescued by a courier service of Arcanine and Growlithe, and in turn must rescue them and their cargo of Fire Stones from the burning ambition of Team Rocket!

Episodes.Title: The Dunsparce Deception
Episodes.Description: Our heroes find themselves in a village that adores Dunsparce and try to help one unlucky Trainer find one of his own!

Episodes.Title: The Wayward Wobbuffet
Episodes.Description: The race is on to find Team Rocket's Wobbuffet when it runs off with the key to an indestructible cage...a cage that holds Ash's Pikachu!

Episodes.Title: Sick Daze
Episodes.Description: When Brock falls ill, it's up to Ash and Misty to keep the group well and fed. But their inexperience, and the meddling of Team Rocket, makes their new jobs not-so-simple!

Episodes.Title: Ring Masters
Episodes.Description: Ash finds out about a local Pokémon Sumo competition and decides he wants to enter. He has just the Pokémon for the job: the mighty Snorlax!

Episodes.Title: The Poké Spokesman
Episodes.Description: A supposed Pokémon translator helps an exhausted Pikachu out on the road, but our heroes soon discover he is wanted by the police for fraud. Whose story do they believe?

Episodes.Title: Control Freak!
Episodes.Description: Hearing of ancient relics that allow the wearer to control any Pokémon, Jessie, James, and Meowth are preparing to crash an excavation to dig up the treasure of a lifetime!

Episodes.Title: The Art of Pokémon
Episodes.Description: An aging artist and his Smeargle assistants get in some hot water when they attempt to turn a town into their next great masterpiece!

Episodes.Title: The Heartbreak of Brock
Episodes.Description: Brock finally meets his match when another Trainer develops a mad crush on him...but with the tables turned, he's not entirely sure how to behave around her!

Episodes.Title: Current Events
Episodes.Description: After becoming accidentally locked inside an electrical generator, Ash and Chikorita will have to avoid the aggressive security Pokémon and Team Rocket to make it out safely!

Episodes.Title: Turning Over a New Bayleef
