Episodes.Description: Ash gets word that the gym leader has returned. Roark, the gym leader from Oreburg City has come to challenge his father, Byron the Canalave City gym leader. With Roark using Rampardos and Byron using Bastiodon, who will win the battle?

Episodes.Title: Dealing With Defensive Types!
Episodes.Description: With Oreburgh Gym Leader Roark as referee, Ash starts his 3-on-3 Gym battle against Byron, Canalave's fossil-loving Gym Leader. Byron's first Pokémon is the Steel-and-Psychic Bronzor, so Ash sends out Chimchar, a Fire-type Pokémon. But Bronzor's Ability, Heatproof, helps protect it against Chimchar's Fire attacks, and then it uses Rain Dance to rain on Chimchar's parade! Chimchar refuses to give up, and uses Flame Wheel in a head-on charge against Bronzor's Gyro Ball—the hit knocks out Bronzor, but Chimchar barely manages to stay on its feet!

Episodes.Title: Leading a Stray!
Episodes.Description: A Wailord blockage has trapped the boats in Canalave's harbor, and that means Dawn can't take a ferry to her next Contest. There's nothing to do but sit down for lunch, but a wild Luxio and its Pokémon accomplices steal the food! Pikachu and Piplup give chase, but run straight into Team Rocket. As always, Team Rocket tries to grab Pikachu, but Ash catches up with them and escapes into the sewer with his buddy. Piplup uses Whirlpool to toss Team Rocket, and now it's up to Ash to find his way back to his friends. As he wanders the sewers, he comes across the Luxio and its pals. They stole the food to feed a stranded Wailmer that somehow ended up in the sewer!

Episodes.Title: Steeling Peace of Mind!
Episodes.Description: On Iron Island, Ash's rival Barry is training with his Empoleon and Heracross when Empoleon suddenly turns on its Trainer. Barry calls Ash and Dawn, who are still in Canalave Town, to tell them what happened—other Pokémon on Iron Island are acting strangely, too! Ash and his friends catch the next ferry to Iron Island, with Team Rocket following them in secret, but Barry has already gone out to explore the island. Whatever is happening, only Steel-type Pokémon are affected, but why?

Episodes.Title: Saving the World from Ruins!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company continue their struggle to stop Team Galactic's latest scheme, which is somehow affecting steel type Pokemon. They learn this is just part of Team Galactic's overall plan.

Episodes.Title: Cheers on Castaways Isle!
Episodes.Description: Pikachu and Piplup get themselves stranded on an island where they discover a Corphish and several Mantykes taking care to a mysterious egg.

Episodes.Title: Hold the Phione!
Episodes.Description: As Dawn prepares for the next contest, the adventurers try to spot a rare Phione. One Phione becomes attracted to one of Dawn's Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: Another One Gabites the Dust!
Episodes.Description: Dawn enters the Chocovine town Pokemon contest and meets a tough trainer named Ursula. Will she win her 4th ribbon?

Episodes.Title: Stealing the Conversation!
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket steals Officer Jenny's Chatot.

Episodes.Title: The Drifting Snorunt!
Episodes.Description: A Froslass holds Meowth and Piplup captive and will only release them when her friend, a Snowrunt is returned.

Episodes.Title: Noodles! Roamin' Off!
Episodes.Description: Meowth decides to leave Team Rocket to become a Noodle Chef, which prompts the other members to pursue their own goals.

Episodes.Title: Pursuing a Lofty Goal!
Episodes.Description: Ash enters a Poke Ringer contest with Staravia. Paul also enters the competition.

Episodes.Title: Trials and Adulations!
Episodes.Description: Dawn encounters an Agron and become separated from Ash and Brock. When one of her Pokemon is injured fighting the Agron, she must use everything she's learned to heal her Pokemon

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Creatures, Pokémon!
Episodes.Description: The friends travel toward Snowpoint City.

Episodes.Title: The Lonely Snover!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company encounter a Snover who longs for companionship.

Episodes.Title: Stopped in the Name of Love!
Episodes.Description: Piplup seems to be worn out lately. They notice Piplup starts to glow. Everyone is excited by the prospect of Piplup evolving, except for Piplup.

Episodes.Title: Old Rivals, New Tricks!
Episodes.Description: Dawn enters the Sandlestraw contest.

Episodes.Title: To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Dawn enter a Pokemon Ping Pong Contest. After the contest, a trainer approaches Dawn and asks if he can train Ambipom for Ping Pong Contests.

Episodes.Title: Battling a Cute Drama!
Episodes.Description: The group encounters a Pokemon Trainer who doesn't appear to realize what Pokemon battles are about, and try to teach her what's really important.

Episodes.Title: Classroom Training!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company meet up with Zoey in Snowpoint City. The Gym Leader convinces Ash to teach a Pokemon class before their battle.

Episodes.Title: Sliding Into Seventh!
Episodes.Description: Ash finally arrives at Snowpoint Gym for his battle with Candice. This gym will be different from his previous gym challenges, with each trainer using 4 Pokémon each. Can Ash defeat Candice and win his seventh badge?

Episodes.Title: A Pyramiding Rage!
Episodes.Description: Following Ash's victory at the Snowpoint City Gym against the Gym Leader Candice, who should appear out of nowhere but Ash's rival Paul! Asking for a Battle with Candice as well, Paul is told he'll have to wait until the following day. But suddenly Paul's brother Reggie appears, and also - none other than the Kanto Frontier Brain from the Battle Pyramid, Brandon! Knowing that the only challenge Reggie ever made in his career as a Trainer that wasn't successful was when he challenged Brandon, Paul immediately challenges Brandon on the spot, vowing to beat him and ...

Episodes.Title: Pillars of Friendship!
Episodes.Description: Some Pokemon hunters attack a Temple and awaken a legendary Pokemon. The Pokemon goes on a rampage. Ash helps Brandon effort to calm the enraged Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: Frozen on Their Tracks!
Episodes.Description: The group takes a train to their next destination. The train takes an unexpected stop. Team Rocket tries to take advantage of the situation.

Episodes.Title: Pedal to the Mettle!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends arrive at Lake Acuity, the site where Ash and Paul will have their full 6-vs-6 battle. After healing his Pokémon, Ash meets up with Paul and the two begin their long awaited battle. Who will ultimately be victorious?

Episodes.Title: Evolving Strategies!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Paul continue their 6-on-6 battle. With both teams fighting extremely hard it could be anyone's match, so Paul calls out his newly evolved Magmortar, hoping it will secure him victory.

Episodes.Title: Uncrushing Defeat!
Episodes.Description: With all of his Pokémon weak and injured from the battle with Paul, Ash rushes to the Pokémon Center in order to get them healed. Nurse Joy does not, however, have the berry needed to properly heal Monferno. Brock decides to help and heads to Lake Acuity to find it. While at the lake, something strange happens.

Episodes.Title: Promoting Healthy Tangrowth!
Episodes.Description: Dawn decides to start training for the next Pokemon Contest with Mamoswine. However, despite overcoming its disobedience, Mamoswine still won't battle. Things turn bad when Mamoswine runs into a forest and Dawn chases after it.

Episodes.Title: Beating the Bustle and Hustle!
Episodes.Description: Dawn's favorite television program Pokémon Hustle was employing actors near the group's location, and, naturally, Dawn was eager for the chance to take part and therefore she, Ash and Brock decided to check the program out.

Episodes.Title: Gateway to Ruin!
Episodes.Description: While returning a wild Shellos to its herd, the adventurers encounter Team Galactic as they're trying to unearth some ruins.

Episodes.Title: Three Sides to Every Story
Episodes.Description: Piplup and a wild Elekid compete over the affections of a Maril.

Episodes.Title: Strategy Begins at Home!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers stay with Dawn's mother as Dawn prepares for the next Pokemon contest. Dawn challenges her mother to a battle.

Episodes.Title: A Faux Oak Finish!
Episodes.Description: Professor Oak arrives in Twin Leaf Town to give a lecture. But he gets distracted by some Pokemon, who need his assistance. Team Rocket attempts to take advantage of the situation.

Episodes.Title: Historical Mystery Tour
Episodes.Description: As the Twin Leaf festival draws to a close, Ash, Dawn and Barry encounter a Xatu and wind up miniaturized and trying to find a way to return to normal.

Episodes.Title: Challenging a Towering Figure
Episodes.Description: The Twin Leaf Town festival draws to a close. Only one person can challenge Palmer, Barry's father, and one of the Battle Frontier Brains from Sinou.

Episodes.Title: Where No Togepi Has Gone Before!
Episodes.Description: The young adventurers and Team Rocket encounter a mischievous Togepi.

Episodes.Title: An Egg Scramble!
Episodes.Description: While they are traveling, Ash and friends meet Lyra and Khoury, who are from the Johto region. Dawn and Lyra have a battle in which Dawn wins and gets an egg, which hatches into a Cyndaquil.

Episodes.Title: Gone With the Windworks!
Episodes.Description: Lyra and Khoury have joined Ash, Dawn and Brock on their journey across the Sinnoh region. However, while Dawn trains for the Lilypad Town Pokémon contest with her Cyndaquil battling Ash's Grotle (with Piplup stealing Cyndaquil's poffin and getting into a fight), Lyra loses her Marill, which seems to have gone to the Valley Windworks. The group make for the Windworks immediately, but Magnemite appears out of nowhere and attacks. Then, they find Marill in the basement storage room only to get locked in. After a few unsuccessful attempts to open the locked door, Ash and his friends are finally free after Pikachu cancels the lockdown by using Thunderbolt on Team Rocket and restoring power to the Windworks. Having found Lyra's Marill, Ash and his friends are confronted by Team Rocket and their giant Magcargo Cannon, but Pikachu saves the day by using Thunderbolt. (Piplup pushes Cyndaquil to the side an gets into another fight)

Episodes.Title: A Rivalry to Gible On!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Khoury compete for a wild Gible, who likes to play tricks on everyone, so Ash with his Buizel and Khoury with Totodile, try to compete to capture the wild Gible. At the end, Khoury catches the Gible as his first Sinnoh Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Dressed for Jess Success!
Episodes.Description: As the Lilypad Town Contest begins, Jessie gets sick and James takes her place in the contest. Dawn uses Piplup in the first round and James uses Meowth. Dawn and James both make it to the Semi-Final Round and compete for the Suiren Ribbon. Dawn uses Mamoswine for the battle round and James uses Carnivine. Dawn's Mamoswine uses a new strategy with Ice Shard as Grotle swallows energy ball a few episodes ago '(Episode 609)', but still she loses to James. In the final round, James wins the contest and gives the ribbon to Jessie.

Episodes.Title: Bagged Then Tagged!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Dawn have a tag battle against Lyra and Khoury. Ash sends out Monferno and Dawn sends out Cyndaquil. Lyra sends out Chikorita and Khoury sends out Totodile. During the battle, Totodile evolves into Croconaw. Ash's Monferno finishes up with Mach Punch and defeats Croconaw and Monferno teams up with Cyndaquil using Flamethrower and Flame Wheel. Ash and Dawn eventually win the battle, and Lyra and Khoury leave the group and go back to Johto, but not before Khoury's father gives Brock the Pokégear as a thanking present to them by showing Lyra and Khoury a little bit of Sinnoh.

Episodes.Title: Try for the Family Stone!
Episodes.Description: A young boy with a Murkrow and a young girl with a Misdreavus compete for a Dusk Stone to evolve their respective Pokémon into either Honchkrow or Mismagius.

Episodes.Title: Sticking with Who You Know!
Episodes.Description: A Pokémon scientist creates a love machine which will create a friendship between his water and electric Pokémon (Quagasire and Magnemite) but a flaw in it creates the friendship between the water and electric Pokémon all over that area. Unfortunately, Ash's Pikachu and Dawn's Piplup also comes under this area, thus becoming literally inseparable. The team somehow finds about this machine and helps the scientist to achieve his goal without the machine, thus helping their Pokémon to be free from their trance becoming normal again.

Episodes.Title: Unlocking the Red Chain of Events!
Episodes.Description: Team Galactic reappears to begin their Red Chain project to achieve Cyrus's goal in capturing the legendary Pokémon of Time and Space, Dialga and Palkia. Their plan was intervened by Looker of the International Police and Team Rocket, thus capturing them. But Meowth of Team Rocket blasts off alone and was saved by Ash, Dawn and Brock. Through Meowth, they came to know about Team Galactic's theme and rescues Looker, James and Jessie, but Team Galactic completes their final plan.

Episodes.Title: The Needs of the Three!
Episodes.Description: Team Galactic's plans at capturing the Lake Trio triumph with the help of Pokémon Hunter J and upon being transported to Team Galactic's HQ, Ash, Brock and Dawn find themselves in a tense stand-off with members of Team Galactic while learning that Cyrus, the businessman they met in the past is the leader and founder of Team Galactic. Meanwhile, Hunter J falls to her demise as her ship crashes in Lake Valor when she fails to realise that Future Sight was targeted on her.

Episodes.Title: The Battle Finale of Legend!
Episodes.Description: As Team Galactic's plan reaches its final stages, Ash, Brock and Dawn along with Cynthia, the Sinnoh Champion race against time to stop Cyrus from carrying out his plan of creating a new world. Will they succeed or will the Sinnoh region as well as the entire Pokémon world fall victim to Cyrus's mad plans?

Episodes.Title: The Treasure Is All Mine!
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends continue their way to Asatsuki Town for Dawn's next contest when Ash happens to find a treasure chest. However its contents prove surprising to James as he is forced to face his privileged past, his faithful childhood companion and his fiancée!

Episodes.Title: Mastering Current Events!
Episodes.Description: While on the way to Sunyshore City, Ash and his friends meet a gentleman who claims to be the master of air battles. Hoping to improve his Gliscor's flying, Ash decides to have a battle with him and his Scizor, and the results may be more than he expected... In the end, Gliscor learns Giga Impact, but Ash decides to leave it with the air battle master to train.

Episodes.Title: Double-Time Battle Training!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Dawn and Brock meet Zoey and Candice after Zoey's contest win and Dawn is trying to make new sequence and Zoey asks Dawn to battle her in a double battle and Zoey choose her newly captured Kirlia and Leafeon and Dawn chooses Cyndaquil and Mamoswine and makes her new move called 'Flame Ice'. On TV, Paul is revealed to have obtained the Mine Badge, also meaning he had obtained all the 8 badges necessary in order to compete in the Sinnoh League.

Episodes.Title: A Meteoric Rise to Excellence!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue toward Daybreak Town and Dawn's next Pokémon Contest, they lose their sense of direction in a large forest. Peering into the sky, all of a sudden they see what turns out to be a move called Draco Meteor. The move comes from an Altaria, a Pokémon under the tutelage of an elderly woman who calls herself Grandma Wilma. The team asks if they can watch Grandma Wilma's coaching session with Altaria. Then the whole group is approached by a feisty Gible, which Grandma Wilma says lives in the forest. Gible wants to be able to use Draco Meteor, too, but can't seem to pull it off!

Episodes.Title: Gotta Get a Gible!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends continue on their way to the next town when they notice that the Gible they helped has been following them. Ash decides to try and catch it, but Barry shows up and wants to catch it too.

Episodes.Title: Regaining the Home Advantage!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers come across two wild Pokemon, Magnezone and Metagross. The rampaging Pokemon wreak havoc on a nearby town.

Episodes.Title: Short and to the Punch!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company encounter a martial arts Pokemon trainer. He helps Ash and Weezil learn a new attack.

Episodes.Title: A Marathon Rivalry!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers encounter Daniel, a scientific Pokemon trainer. Daniel and Ash compete in a Pokemon Marathon.

Episodes.Title: Yes, in Dee Dee It's Dawn!
Episodes.Description: Dawn enters the Daybreak Town Pokemon contest. A rival's Pokemon reminds Dawn of a painful childhood experience.

Episodes.Title: Playing the Performance Encore!
Episodes.Description: Dawn competes in the finals at the Daybreak Town Contest for her fifth ribbon.

Episodes.Title: Fighting Ire with Fire!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company encounter Barry and Paul. Barry and Ash have a battle that's interrupted by Team Rocket with a new plan to take their Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: Piplup, Up and Away!
Episodes.Description: After getting hit by Drago Meteor one too many times by Ash's Gible, Piplup gets frustrated when the adventurers try to boost Gible's confidence, and decides to run away.

Episodes.Title: Flint Sparks the Fire!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company arrive at the Sunyshore Gym where they find Voltner, the Gym Leader, has given up on battling.

Episodes.Title: The Fleeing Tower of Sunyshore!
Episodes.Description: Ash's gym battle with Volkner is interrupted when Team Rocket steals Sunyshore Tower.

Episodes.Title: Teaching the Student Teacher!
Episodes.Description: Dawn's mother is supposed to teach a beginner's Pokemon Coordinator class, but gets called away to judge a nearby contest. The young adventurers teach her class.

Episodes.Title: Keeping in Top Forme!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes prepare for Dawn's entry into the Grand Festival and Ash's rematch with Gym Leader Volkner, they meet a mysterious girl with a sick Shaymin who needs help!

Episodes.Title: Pokémon Ranger: Heatran Rescue!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue their Sinnoh region journey, they come across a determined, upbeat Pokémon Ranger on a mission to capture a rare Heatran!

Episodes.Title: An Elite Coverup!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers meet Roland, a young trainer who falls victim to Team Rocket's latest ploy. They also meet Bertha, one of the Elite Four.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of a Royal Day!
Episodes.Description: A princess asks Dawn to trade places for a day, so that the princess may compete in a Pokemon contest.

Episodes.Title: With the Easiest of Grace!
Episodes.Description: Dawn begins training her new acquired Togekiss.

Episodes.Title: Dealing With a Fierce Double Ditto Drama!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers meet Narissa, a trainer who has a lot to learn about Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: Last Call, First Round!
Episodes.Description: Contestants arrive for the Grand Festival. Rivals and friends gather for the competition. One competitor makes an unexpected early exit.

Episodes.Title: Opposites Interact!
Episodes.Description: Day 2 of the Grand Festival. Dawn faces off against Ursala.

Episodes.Title: Coming Full Festival Circle!
Episodes.Description: Semi-final battles at the Grand Festival. With Nando vs Zoey. Then Dawn vs Jessilina.

Episodes.Title: A Grand Fight for Winning!
Episodes.Description: The Grand Festival finals. Dawn vs Zooey in the for title of Top Coordinator.

Episodes.Title: For the Love of Meowth!
Episodes.Description: Meowth meets and falls for a Glameowth. He's ready to quit Team Rocket to be with her.

Episodes.Title: The Eighth Wonder of the Sinnoh World!
Episodes.Description: Ash battles Voltner for his eighth and final badge.

Episodes.Title: Four Roads Diverged in a Pokémon Port!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers miss their ship and have to wait a day before continuing their journey. They meet up with old friends. Dawn receives an unexpected invitation, and all of them start to contemplate the next part of their journey.

Episodes.Title: Bucking the Treasure Trend!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers meet Buck, a treasure hunter, and help him on his latest venture.

Episodes.Title: An Old Family Blend!
Episodes.Description: Ash asks Professor Oak to send him some of his old Pokemon for the upcoming competition. Team Rocket intercepts the Pokemon, now Ash must find and recover his Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: League Unleashed!
Episodes.Description: Round one of the Sinnoh League Championship. Ash vs Nando.

Episodes.Title: Casting a Paul on Barry!
Episodes.Description: Paul vs Barry in round 3.

Episodes.Title: Working on a Right Move!
Episodes.Description: Ash vs Conway in Round 3.

Episodes.Title: Familiarity Breeds Strategy!
Episodes.Description: Quarter finals begin. Ash vs Paul, part 1.

Episodes.Title: A Real Rival Rouser!
Episodes.Description: After Ash's early lead, Paul begins his counter attack.

Episodes.Title: Battling a Thaw in Relations!
Episodes.Description: Ash vs Paul part 3. The battle of these arch-rivals concludes with the winner advancing to the semi-finals.

Episodes.Title: The Semi-Final Frontier!
Episodes.Description: Ash battles Tobias in the semi-finals. Tobia has only used his Darkrai in all his previous matches. Can Ash find a way to defeat Darkrai and what of the rest of Tobias's Pokemon?

Episodes.Title: The Brockster Is In!
Episodes.Description: On the way back to Twin Leaf Town, several Pokemon are injured. With no Pokemon Doctor on board, Brock does everything he can to help the Pokemon until support arrives.

Episodes.Title: Memories are Made of Bliss!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Brock spend the night at Dawn's house as they prepare for their return to their respective homes. It's a time of farewell. Brock makes a surprise announcement. The three friends part to pursue their own individual dreams.

Episodes.Title: In the Shadow of Zekrom!
Episodes.Description: Ash and his mother take a vacation with Professor Oak to the Unova region. A dark cloud reveals a mysterious Pokemon which affects Pikachu.

Episodes.Title: Enter Iris and Axew!
Episodes.Description: After being struck by lightning, Pikachu is having trouble using its Electric-type attacks...but a second strange thunderstorm heals the Pokémon just as quickly! Attributing the ordeal to the Legendary Pokémon Zekrom, Professors Oak and Juniper agree that further research is needed.

Episodes.Title: A Sandile Gusher of Change!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Iris try to help the owners of a Hot Sand Resort who are being plagued by Sandile.

Episodes.Title: The Battle Club and Tepig's Choice!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Iris stop at a Battle Club for some training. Ash's battle is interrupted by Team Rocket and a mysterious Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: Triple Leaders, Team Threats!
Episodes.Description: Ash arrives at the Striaton Gym for his first battle. The three gym leaders offer Ash a choice for the battle. Ash requests a battle with all three leaders.

Episodes.Title: Dreams by the Yard Full!
Episodes.Description: Ash's battle concludes. Cilan, impressed with Ash's victory, decides to journey with Ash to become a better connoisseur. Part of Team Rocket's plan is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Snivy Plays Hard to Catch!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company encounter a wild Snivy with some really powerful attacks. They suspect it left its previous trainer. Ash is determined to catch the Snivy.

Episodes.Title: Saving Darmanitan From the Bell!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company encounter a pair of Darumakas who steals food. They soon find they're bringing it to their friend who is psychically supporting a bell. Team Rocket's plans continue.

Episodes.Title: The Bloom Is on Axew!
Episodes.Description: Iris has a training battle with Cilan, and her past is explored.

Episodes.Title: A Rival Battle for Club Champ!
Episodes.Description: Ash challenges Trip to a full Pokemon battle.

Episodes.Title: A Home for Dwebble!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company encounter a Dweeble who has his shell stolen from him by other Dweeble. They aide him reclaiming his home.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes the Trubbish Squad!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends come across a group of kindergarten students who have befriended a Trubbish after rescuing it from a junkyard.

Episodes.Title: Minccino-Neat and Tidy!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company meet Bianca, Professor Juniper's helper. She gives Ash a badge case, which is promptly stolen by a Minccino. Now the group tries to catch the Pokemon

Episodes.Title: A Night in the Nacrene City Museum!
Episodes.Description: Arriving in Nacrene City, our Heroes discover the Gym has a most unusual location and situation!

Episodes.Title: The Battle According to Lenora!
Episodes.Description: The day for Ash's Nacrene City Gym Battle challenge is here, and Lenora isn't about to go easy on our Hero!

Episodes.Title: Rematch at the Nacrene Gym!
Episodes.Description: After some special training, Ash challenges Lenora to re-match.

Episodes.Title: Scraggy-Hatched to Be Wild!
Episodes.Description: Ash's Pokemon egg finally hatches revealing a Scraggy.

Episodes.Title: Sewaddle and Burgh in Pinwheel Forest!
Episodes.Description: Ash and company get lost in Pinwheel Forest and encounter a wild Swaddle and Burgh, the next gym leader Ash wants to challenge.

Episodes.Title: A Connoisseur's Revenge!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers encounter a Pokemon Connisuser who insists that Ash replace all his Pokémon. They soon discover she has a past with Cilan. And a Pokemon battle ensues.

Episodes.Title: Dancing With the Ducklett Trio!
Episodes.Description: A previously encountered Sandile wants to battle Ash's Pikachu. But their battle is interrupted by some wild Duckletts.

Episodes.Title: The Lost World of Gothitelle!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers cross a foggy bridge and seemingly into the past where they meet a young girl and her Gotitelle.

Episodes.Title: A Venipede Stampede!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers arrive in Castilla City and find that it's overrun with Venipede.

Episodes.Title: Battling for the Love of Bug-Types!
Episodes.Description: Ash battles Burgh for his third badge.

Episodes.Title: Emolga the Irresistible!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers try to help Bianca capture an Emolga.

Episodes.Title: Emolga and the New Volt Switch!
Episodes.Description: Iris attempts a training battle with her newly-acquired Emolga. But Emolga has other ideas.

Episodes.Title: Scare at the Litwick Mansion!
Episodes.Description: While taking cover from the rain, the adventurers encounter Team Rocket and some seemingly helpful Litwick.

Episodes.Title: The Dragon Master's Path!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers meet Emmy, a trainer who has yet to start her journey. Iris reveals her dream to be a Dragon Master.

Episodes.Title: Oshawott's Lost Scalchop!
Episodes.Description: During a battle with another trainer, Oshawott loses his scalchop, causing Oshawott to run off to search for it mid-battle.

Episodes.Title: Cottonee in Love!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers try to help a wild Cottonee who's having during its mating season.

Episodes.Title: A UFO for Elgyem!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers spot a UFO and encounter Professor Icarus, an expert on the subject.

Episodes.Title: Ash and Trip's Third Battle!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Trip have a 3-on-3 battle.

Episodes.Title: Facing Fear with Eyes Wide Open!
Episodes.Description: Having learned why Oshuwott is having difficulty with Aquajet, Ash helps Oshuwott through special training.

Episodes.Title: Iris and Excadrill Against the Dragon Buster!
Episodes.Description: Iris is challenged by Georgia - a Dragon Buster. Iris's past with Excadrill is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Gotta Catch A Roggenrola!
Episodes.Description: Ash attempts to capture a Roggenrola, but the battle is interrupted as they investigate Roggenrola's home and find Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: Where Did You Go, Audino?
Episodes.Description: The adventurers encounter an Audino wandering aimlessly through a patch of fog. They soon find out the local town has been losing their Audinos. They offer to help find the missing Pokemon

Episodes.Title: Archeops in the Modern World!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers meet up with Doctors Juniper and Fennel as they work to bring back an ancient Pokemon from a fossil.

Episodes.Title: A Fishing Connoisseur in a Fishy Competition!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers enter a fishing competition unaware that the competition is being run by Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: Movie Time! Zorua in "The Legend of the Pokémon Knight"!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers make a movie.

Episodes.Title: Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!
Episodes.Description: Day one at the Nimbasa Battle Tournament, a time to meet up with old friends and rivals.

Episodes.Title: Cilan Versus Trip, Ash Versus Georgia!
Episodes.Description: Day two of the battle tournament.

Episodes.Title: The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk!
Episodes.Description: Round 2 of the competition continues.

Episodes.Title: The Club Battle Finale: A Heroes Outcome!
Episodes.Description: The final round of the tournament: Ash vs Iris.

Episodes.Title: Meowth's Scrafty Tactics!
Episodes.Description: Axew is kidnapped by a wild Scrafty who demands the adventurers train him for a battle. The get some unexpected help from Meowth who has just been fired from Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: Purrloin: Sweet or Sneaky?
Episodes.Description: The adventurers encounter a Purrloin who claims it needs their help.

Episodes.Title: Beheeyem, Duosion, and the Dream Thief!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers meet Beheeyem, a Pokemon that can make dreams come true. They soon become trapped in a dream world and must find a way to escape.

Episodes.Title: The Beartic Mountain Feud!
Episodes.Description: The adventurers rescue a Cubchew that got separated from its pack. They soon get in the middle of a feud between two groups of Beartic.

Episodes.Title: Crisis from the Underground Up! (1)
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket executes their plan. They manage to steal several Pokemon, and use their "Ghost Train" to make their escape.

Episodes.Title: Battle For The Underground! (2)
Episodes.Description: The adventurers try to find Team Rocket's Ghost Train, and all the stolen Pokemon. Meanwhile Pikachu and Axchew try to free themselves and the other Pokemon.

Episodes.Title: Enter Elesa, Electrifying Gym Leader!
Episodes.Description: After meeting the Nimbasa City Gym Leader, Elesa, our heroes encounter an old friend with a surprise guest!

Episodes.Title: Dazzling the Nimbasa Gym!
Episodes.Description: The stakes are high for Ash winning his fourth Unova Gym Badge at the Nimbasa Gym, and our hero's taking no chances!

Episodes.Title: Lost at the Stamp Rally!
Episodes.Description: Spending the day in Nimbasa City after Ash's fourth Unova Gym Badge win, Cilan has a special challenge in mind, while our heroes discover a fellow Trainer in need!

Episodes.Title: Ash Versus the Champion!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes prepare to leave Nimbasa City, they bump into Ash's rival Trip, who introduces them to someone they had only dreamed of meeting!

Episodes.Title: A Maractus Musical!
Episodes.Description: On their way to Driftveil City, our heroes meet an enterprising young man with three dedicated friends and a dream!

Episodes.Title: The Four Seasons of Sawsbuck!
Episodes.Description: Stopping at a Pokémon Center on their way to Driftveil City, out heroes meet a young Pokémon photographer on the mission of a lifetime!

Episodes.Title: Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!
Episodes.Description: On their way to Driftveil City and Ash's next Gym Battle, our heroes meet a demanding Gothita with a crush on Scraggy!

Episodes.Title: The Lonely Deino!
Episodes.Description: On their way to Driftveil City and Ash's next Gym Battle, our heroes come across some very special Pokémon in a very special place!

Episodes.Title: The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue!
Episodes.Description: Arriving in Driftveil City, our heroes meet a fascinating hometown resident with a secret!

Episodes.Title: A Call for Brotherly Love!
Episodes.Description: While Ash prepares for his upcoming Gym Battle with Clay, a surprise visitor with a dilemma offers both Ash and Cilan the opportunity to help!

Episodes.Title: Stopping the Rage of Legends! (1)
Episodes.Description: What started as a trip to Milos Island to find Revival Herbs has turned into a cataclysmic battle of legendary proportions!

Episodes.Title: Stopping the Rage of Legends! (2)
Episodes.Description: In search of scarce Revival Herbs, our heroes are now faced with the potential destruction of Milos Island!

Episodes.Title: Battling the King of the Mines!
Episodes.Description: With a bag full of revival herbs, our heroes have returned to Driftveil City and Ash is raring to battle Gym Leader Clay!

Episodes.Title: Crisis at Chargestone Cave!
Episodes.Description: Continuing their journey to Mistralton City, our heroes encounter Chargestone Cave and a dilemma for its occupants!

Episodes.Title: Evolution Exchange Excitement!
Episodes.Description: After witnessing a dramatic Pokémon trade and evolution, Ash and his friends' excitement has just begun!

Episodes.Title: Explorers of the Hero's Ruin!
Episodes.Description: The elder Professor Juniper has invited our heroes to join him in what he promises will be an exciting adventure...and he keeps his promise!

Episodes.Title: Battling the Bully!
Episodes.Description: An encounter with Pikachu's rival from the past puts our heroes in the middle of a bullying confrontation!

Episodes.Title: Baffling the Bouffalant!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends continue their journey to Mistralton City as they head through a forest. They stop for a lunch break when suddenly they get attacked by a Bouffalant. After running away, the gang gets separated.

Episodes.Title: Cilan Takes Flight!
Episodes.Description: Ash is surprised to see a long line of Trainers waiting to challenge Skyla, the Mistralton City Gym Leader, and is even more surprised when he’s told he has to make an appointment for their battle!

Episodes.Title: An Amazing Aerial Battle!
Episodes.Description: After some convincing by a group of young challengers and Skyla’s grandfather, Skyla takes Ash up on his Gym Battle challenge.

Episodes.Title: Climbing the Tower of Success!
Episodes.Description: After winning his sixth badge, Ash and friends bump into Stephan. He is in town to compete in the Bell of Wishes Festival that is being held that day. Ash, Iris, and Cilan, after finding out that the winner gets to ring the bell atop Mistralton Tower and get a wish granted, decide to compete in the festival.

Episodes.Title: The Clubsplosion Begins!
Episodes.Description: At Ambiga Town, the local Don George holds a tournament called "Clubsplosion" to showcase Fighting-Type Pokémon, but all are welcome. Ash, Stephan, Bianca, Trip, and Georgia all enter the tournament, with Ash using his Scraggy. Ash and Scraggy's first opponent is Angus and his Simisage.

Episodes.Title: Search for the Clubultimate!
Episodes.Description: The Clubsplosion tournament continues. Iris and Excadrill face off against Burgundy and Dewott. Bianca and Emboar face off against Trip and Conkeldurr. And Dragon Buster Georgia and Bisharp face off against newcomer Gale and her Druddigon.

Episodes.Title: A Clubsplosion of Excitement!
Episodes.Description: The first round of the Clubsplosion tournament ends with Bianca's and Trip's battle. As the second round gets underway, the remaining contestants battle for the chance to enter the Top 4 in the Clubsplosion semi-finals.

Episodes.Title: Commanding the Clubsplosion Crown!
Episodes.Description: The Clubsplosion semifinals rage on. Bianca and Emboar battle Stephan and Sawk, while Ash and Scraggy battle Montgomery and his Throh. In the finals, Stephan and Sawk face Montgomery and Throh. Who will win the Clubsplosion Tournament?

Episodes.Title: Battling the Leaf Thieves!
Episodes.Description: During a practice match against Iris' Emolga, Ash's Swadloon evolves into Leavanny. Leavanny's leaf-sewing process causes it to make costumes for the other Pokémon, but this causes Axew to be accidentally kidnapped by a pair of Durant who are building a den. They stop to think about how they are going to enter the Durant's den, and to be able to rescue Axew.

Episodes.Title: A Restoration Confrontation! (1)
Episodes.Description: Ash, Cilan, and Iris make their way to Twist Mountain where they come across a fossil dig that has discovered a fossil Tirtouga. However, Team Rocket arrives and steals the fossil.

Episodes.Title: A Restoration Confrontation! (2)
Episodes.Description: The adventure with Mount Twist, Tirtouga, and Carracosta continues.

Episodes.Title: Evolution by Fire!
Episodes.Description: Stopping at Abtilbe Town's Battle Club, Ash meets his Tepig's former trainer Shamus who abandoned Tepig because he felt he was too weak. Angry, Ash challenges Shamus to a double battle with Snivy and Tepig going up against Shamus's Emboar and Heatmor.

Episodes.Title: Guarding the Guardian of the Mountain!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Iris, and Cilan finally arrive in Icirus City. But before Ash can challenge movie star Brycen and his Beartic for his next Gym Badge, they must help Brycen save Volcarona from the Pokémon Hunter Rizzo and his two Jellicent.

Episodes.Title: Caution: Icy Battle Conditions!
Episodes.Description: Ash challenges Brycen for the Icicle Badge, putting Scraggy, Krokorok, and Pignite up against Vanillish, Cryogonal, and Beartic.

Episodes.Title: Clash of the Connoisseurs!
Episodes.Description: With only one more badge left, the group heads to Opelucid City so Ash can challenge the Gym Leader. Unfortunately for Ash, the Gym in Opelucid City is closed. When the group stops in Stonesthrow Town, Cilan meets little Marigold who is picking out her first Pokémon today. Cilan offers his skills as a Pokémon Connoisseur, but another A-Class Connoisseur named Ricard Nouveau offers up his services instead of Cilan's, and they have a battle to determine who is the better Connoisseur. All while the S-Class Connoisseur Fauxgundy watches, but they believe they have seen her somewhere before.

Episodes.Title: Crisis at Ferroseed Research!
Episodes.Description: The group meets up with Dragon Buster Georgia who has a Vanilluxe now. They travel to the Ferroseed Institute to see the Moss Pokémon Ferroseed being studied, but when an accident forces an evacuation, Iris, her Axew, Ash's Oshawott, and Georgia's Vanilluxe are trapped inside. Iris has not yet overcome her crippling phobia of Ice-Types, and she must figure out a way out with Vanilluxe at her side.

Episodes.Title: An Epic Defense Force!
Episodes.Description: After Ash and the gang arrive in Virbank City and Cilan gives them a rundown of the area’s history, they run into their filmmaking friend Luke and his Zorua! Thanks to winning a film festival with the movie our heroes helped him make (The Legend of the Pokémon Knight), Luke is there to attend a preview event for Pokéstar Studios, a theme park opening soon within the film studio lots.

Episodes.Title: Rocking the Virbank Gym! (1)
Episodes.Description: Ash heads to Virbank City to face off against its Gym Leader, punk rocker Roxie from the band Koffing and the Toxics, in order to obtain his eighth Unova League Gym Badge.

Episodes.Title: Rocking the Virbank Gym! (2)
Episodes.Description: Ash's battle against Roxie for the Toxic Badge continues.

Episodes.Title: All for the Love of Meloetta!
Episodes.Description: After learning the Unova League conference will not be held for three more months, Ash, Iris, and Clian meet up with Cynthia, the Sinnoh Region Champion. She says she has come to Unova to participate in an exhibition match at the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, held in Lacunosa Town, and Ash learns that the prize of the tournament is a battle with Alder, Unova's reigning Champion. As the four head out of Virbank City for Undella Town, they come across the legendary Melody Pokémon, Meloetta who seems to have fallen ill.

Episodes.Title: Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!
Episodes.Description: Upon arriving in Undella Town, Cynthia leads the gang to her villa where Dawn and Piplup are waiting for them. Dawn has come to Unova to perfect her Coordinator skills, and Cilan decides to have a Tasting Battle to see exactly what she can do.

Episodes.Title: Expedition to Onix Island!
Episodes.Description: While Cynthia is preparing for the Junior Cup, Ash, Cilan, Iris, and Dawn take a trip to an uninhabited island for some relaxation. However, they soon discover the island is home to several Onix that begin to attack them.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery of the Missing Cubchoo!
Episodes.Description: While in Undella Town, Cilan helps a boy named Chris track down his missing Cubchoo. However, they instead find a roaming Beartic that might have once been Chris's Cubchoo.

Episodes.Title: Iris and the Rogue Dragonite!
Episodes.Description: When the power goes out in Undella Town, the gang tries to help out when they discover a rampaging Dragonite may be to blame. When Iris discovers the Dragonite, she believes it is truly not bad but she is soon trapped in the room with the Dragonite along with Ash's Oshawott and Dawn's Piplup.

Episodes.Title: Jostling for the Junior Cup!
Episodes.Description: The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup begins, with rivals such as Trip, Georgia, and Burgundy showing up to take part in the tournament. After an exhibition match between Sinnoh Champion Cynthia's Garchomp and Unova Elite Four member Caitlin's Gothitelle ends in a no official winner, the first round begins. Iris is up first against Georgia, with Iris's newly captured Dragonite being pitted up against Georgia's Beartic.

Episodes.Title: Battling Authority, Once Again!!
Episodes.Description: The quarter-final matches of the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup take place, and Iris must go up against Dawn, pitting Dragonite against Mammoswine. In another match, Cilan and Crustle take on Trip and Serperior.

Episodes.Title: Ash, Iris, and Trip: Then There Were Three!!
Episodes.Description: With the semi-finals of the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup underway, and with the grand prize of having a battle with Alder on the line, Ash, Iris, and Trip go all out.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!
Episodes.Description: After Trip's match against Alder, the Junior Cup draws to a close and the contestants bid each other farewell. Ash, Iris, and Cilan meet Cameron, a young naive trainer who wants to travel with them. Dawn bids farewell as well, but not before having a practice match against Ash.

Episodes.Title: The Road to Humilau
Episodes.Description: Ash, Iris, and Cilan help Cameron get to Humilau City where he wants to challenge Marlon for his own eighth Unova League Gym Badge. On the way, Ash and Cameron are separated from the group. Ash almost falls off a cliff, but then Cameron saves his life. Cameron has a "great idea" and he gets out what seems to be a "map", which was a table cloth. As they continue heading down a road, it starts to rain and then they take shelter in a nearby cave. Realizing that they didn't have any food, Ash, Cameron and their Pokémon are hungry as Meloetta leaves only to come back with an apple. Meloetta leads them to an apple tree where they harvest the apples to bring them back to the cave to munch on them. After they ate the apples (and Cameron's Riolu hiccups adorably), they decide to stay the night in the cave until the rain stops. Ash and Cameron exchange their goals in life. Ash wanting to a Pokémon Master while Cameron wanting to be the best Pokémon Champion in the world.

Episodes.Title: Unrest at the Nursery
Episodes.Description: While still staying at Cynthia's villa and training for the Unova League conference, Ash and the gang come across a fighting pair of Rufflet and Vullaby. It turns out they have both escaped the inexperienced Day Care Nurse, Layla. Whilst the manager is away, Ash, Iris and Cilan help Layla in the Nursery, but the ongoing conflict between the two Pokémon both craving Layla's attention continues.

Episodes.Title: Meloetta and the Undersea Temple
Episodes.Description: Ash continues to train at Cynthia's villa until Ridley (a member of an ancient civilisation dedicated to protecting Meloetta) and his Golurk hear Meloetta's song and come to take Meloetta back. At first, Ridley assumes Ash is associated with the thieves, but this turns out not to be the case. Before Ridley can take Meloetta home, Team Rocket assaults the group and capture Meloetta and summon up the ancient Abyssal Temple through its power and song. The heroes try to fend off Team Rocket, but with Giovanni himself present they are too strong.

Episodes.Title: Unova's Survival Crisis
Episodes.Description: With Meloetta in their possession, Team Rocket's Giovanni controls Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus in their more powerful Therian Formes though use of the reveal glass unlocked by Meloetta's presence and Meloetta's song. Ash, Cilan, Iris, Cynthia, and Ridley do their best to free Meloetta and save the world from Team Rocket. But forces stronger than Team Rocket are present, and Giovanni soon finds himself not able to control himself and sets Tornadus, Thundurus, and Landorus on a path to destroy Unova rather than take it over for Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: Beauties Battling for Pride and Prestige!
Episodes.Description: Learning that the Unova League will be held at Vertress City, Ash and his friends prepare for the tournament, but not before making a detour towards Iris' hometown, the Village of Dragons. But along the way, Iris drags the boys and their Pokémon into competing against a group of women who believe that their Pokémon are not only powerful but more beautiful than anyone else's.

Episodes.Title: A Surface to Air Tag Battle Team!
Episodes.Description: On the way to the Unova League, Ash and Cilan get challenged to a Tag Battle against the brothers Soren and Rocko who have trained their Braviary (Soldier of the skies) and Drilbur (Warrior of the land) to perform amazing combination attacks.

Episodes.Title: A Village Homecoming!
Episodes.Description: On the way to Vertress City, Ash, Cilan, and Iris find their way to Iris's hometown: the Village of Dragons. While there, Iris shows Axew to her elder and helps her childhood friend Shannon when one of her Zweilous suddenly evolves into Hydreigon and goes out of control.

Episodes.Title: Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!
Episodes.Description: The gang arrives in Opelucid City for Iris' scheduled rematch against the Dragon Master and Gym Leader Drayden, who handed her and Excadrill their first-ever defeat years ago. Upon arrival, Iris remembers her difficult time in going to school there and trying to adjust to urban life. She and the others then travel to the Opelucid Gym for her rematch with Drayden, where she puts her Excadrill and Dragonite to the test, respectively, against Drayden's Haxorus and Druddigon in order for him to evaluate her training and skills.

Episodes.Title: Team Eevee and the Pokémon Rescue Squad!
Episodes.Description: Near Vertress City, the gang meets the Pokémon Rescue Squad's Virgil - trainer of Team Eevee - and his brother Davey, whom they decide to assist in helping a group of troubled Cryoganal.

Episodes.Title: Curtain Up, Unova League!
Episodes.Description: The Unova League begins, and as the preliminary round matches get underway, Ash finds himself up against Trip.

Episodes.Title: Mission: Defeat Your Rival!
Episodes.Description: Ash's battle against Trip continues, with Pikachu facing Serperior. As the preliminaries end and the first round begins, Bianca pits her Escavalier and Emboar against Cameron's Samurott and Riolu.

Episodes.Title: Lost at the League!
Episodes.Description: During a break in the competition, Iris's Axew follows a balloon and gets lost in Vertress City. Pikachu manages to track him down, but they are cornered by a group of Trubbish and their Garbodor leader.

Episodes.Title: Strong Strategy Steals the Show!
Episodes.Description: The third round of battles at the Unova League begins and Ash finds himself up against Stephan, putting Krookodile, Palpitoad, and Leavanny up against Stephan's Liepard, Zebstrika, and Sawk.

Episodes.Title: Cameron's Secret Weapon!
Episodes.Description: In the fourth round of matches, Ash battles against Cameron - who begins the match by revealing his secret weapon, Hydreigon.

Episodes.Title: A Unova League Evolution!
Episodes.Description: Ash's Snivy and Pikachu must face off against Cameron and his newly evolved Lucario.

Episodes.Title: New Places... Familiar Faces!
Episodes.Description: With the Unova League tournament over, Ash and company return to Nuvema Town to meet up with Professor Juniper and to tell Professor Oak about his results. Along the way, they meet Nanette who is going to see Juniper for her first Pokémon, and eventually chooses Tepig and asks to have her first battle with Ash. However, during the battle, a robot appears and it is piloted by a very familiar trio. Later, Professor Juniper gets a call from her father, who invites Ash and friends to visit him at the White Ruins, located north of Icirrus City.

Episodes.Title: The Name's N!
Episodes.Description: On a boat heading to see ruins dedicated to Reshiram, Ash, Iris, and Cilan meet the mysterious boy calling himself N, who quickly befriends their Pokémon. However, when Team Rocket attacks the group once more and James's Amoonguss paralyzes Pikachu with Stun Spore, N's timely intervention helps turn the tide of the fight.

Episodes.Title: There's a New Gym Leader in Town!
Episodes.Description: The group's boat arrives in Aspertia City, and they arrange to meet Cheren, Professor Juniper's acquaintance and the city's new Gym Leader. A teacher at the local Pokémon School, Cheren is lacking in confidence regarding his worth for the title, something Cilan - as a former Gym Leader himself - connects with him over. After misadventures in the Pokémon House on the school grounds - including a series of mishaps between Cilan, Pansage, and a flock of Ducklett - Ash has an unofficial Gym match against Cheren, Oshawott facing off against Herdier.

Episodes.Title: Team Plasma's Pokémon Power Plot!
Episodes.Description: When Team Plasma scientist Colress uses his machine to draw out Pokémon strength, the controlled wild Pokémon attack the residents of nearby Floccesy Town. Ash, Iris, and Cilan get caught in the middle of the mayhem when Pikachu and Axew also fall under his control, but when they are saved by Looker, they agree to aid him in his investigation of Team Plasma and Colress's scheme.

Episodes.Title: The Light of Floccesy Ranch!
Episodes.Description: While stopped at Floccesy Ranch, Iris's Dragonite helps rancher Elly's Ampharos get into the fighting spirit.

Episodes.Title: Saving Braviary
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends once again run into N, who has freed a Braviary held captive by Team Plasma. They help him bring it to a Pokémon Center, but when Braviary is tracked by a pair of Team Plasma Grunts - Nero and Bianco, who respectively use a Seviper and Zangoose in battle - N puts his life on the line. Successfully freeing Braviary, N joins the group on their journey to the White Ruins.

Episodes.Title: The Pokémon Harbor Patrol!
Episodes.Description: Upon returning to Virbank City, Ash and friends meet Halsey who runs a rescue team consisting of his two Frillish, his Dewott, and his Watchog. Making his personal feelings on the idea of Pokémon putting themselves at risk for the sake of humans known, N's belief that Watchog (who seems ill-suited for the Team's risky endeavours) is being used as a tool causes an ideological clash between Halsey and N, but the two young men must put their enmities aside when a fire breaks out in Virbank City's Industrial Complex.

Episodes.Title: The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends come across the Kanto Fair, and seeing a Charmander perform on stage reminds him of his old friend Charizard. He tells Iris, Cilan and N about his and Charizard's history, with Misty and Brock making cameos during the tale. Professor Oak sends Charizard over, and after he meets Iris' Dragonite, the two trainers agree to have a friendly match. Ash's offer to let Charizard rejoin his team is met with approval from all parties involved.

Episodes.Title: Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!
Episodes.Description: Colress appears and tests his newly-advanced machine on Dragon-type Pokémon - first taking over a young trainer's Haxorus, and later Iris's Dragonite. As Ash and Charizard try to stop them, N puts himself in the crossfire, knowing the Pokémon should be friends and not fight.

Episodes.Title: Secrets From Out of the Fog!
Episodes.Description: After N is hurt by Colress's machine, two young women, Anthea and Concordia, come to save him. It is from these two girls that Ash and the others learn the truth about N's life, including his link to the evil Ghetsis.

Episodes.Title: Meowth, Colress and Team Rivalry!
Episodes.Description: Team Plasma's Colress convinces Team Rocket's Jessie and James to use his technology on Meowth to make him stronger, but it is all part of Colress's plans to test his Pokémon controlling device.

Episodes.Title: Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!
Episodes.Description: At the ruins dedicated to the Pokémon Reshiram, N steals the Light Stone from Cedric Juniper, and Ash's attempt to stop him ends with them separated from the others. Team Plasma move to attack the White Ruins while Team Rocket watch on in anticipation, and Iris, Cilan and Looker attempt to fight off the enemy forces.

Episodes.Title: Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!
Episodes.Description: Ash and N prepare to save Iris, Cilan, and Professor Juniper's father from the clutches of Team Plasma before Ghetsis can revive Reshiram, but their attempts to fight back are hampered by Colress's Pokémon controlling machine, forcing them all to call back their Pokémon. Pikachu gets hit by the machine's beam, which sways N into surrendering the Light Stone in exchange for its freedom just as Ghetsis arrives, ready to begin the ritual.

Episodes.Title: What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!
Episodes.Description: As the revived Reshiram quickly falls under Ghetsis' control, Ash and friends try to develop a strategy to stop Team Plasma. Looker convinces Team Rocket to help in the fight against the villains, while Ash and Pikachu aim to destroy the controlling machine, and N hopes to pacify the enraged Reshiram before it destroys the world in a righteous fury - akin to when it burned down Team Plasma's castle in the past.

Episodes.Title: Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!
Episodes.Description: With Team Plasma defeated once and for all, Ash decides it is time to go back to Kanto. Iris and Cilan decide to go with him to further their skills, and Professor Juniper charters all of them a cruise through the Decolore Islands on a boat with a mysterious crew. Once settled in their cabins, however, Ash finds that they are locked in and their Pokémon are not with them.

Episodes.Title: Danger, Sweet as Honey!
Episodes.Description: The cruise makes a stop on Honey Island, known for its colonies of the Honeycomb Pokémon Combee, Pupa Pokémon Kakuna, Stinger Pokémon Beedrill, and its honey-flavored cuisine.

Episodes.Title: Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!
Episodes.Description: As Ash and his friends prepare for the upcoming Marine Cup Tournament on board their new cruise ship, the group learns that Mrs. Ripple, a jewel collector, will display her collection after the tournament, but upon the tournament's conclusion she discovers that her rare Eye of Liepard has been stolen. She suspects Mr. Shaw - a businessman and jewel collector who has been asking to buy the Eye of Liepard from her - even though it was watched over by her Watchog all night. Cilan takes on his detective role once more to discover the thief of the Eye of Liepard.

Episodes.Title: Crowning the Scalchop King!
Episodes.Description: On Scalchop Island, Ash's Oshawott goes up against the Dewott named Caesar to see who will win the battle at the Scalchop King Competition.

Episodes.Title: The Island of Illusions!
Episodes.Description: On the way to Mahora Island, the gang's boat passes through fog and they believe they see a familiar shape in it. After avoiding a giant Heatmor when Pikachu's attacks do not work against it, Axew gets poisoned by a Foongus's Mushroom Spore attack, forcing the gang to take him to an old Pokémon Center which they soon discover is operating illegally.

Episodes.Title: To Catch a Rotom!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Iris, and Cilan catch up with Professor Oak who has come to one of the Decolore Islands to investigate the Plasma Pokémon Rotom and its Forme Change capabilities. However, the Rotom native to the island are more interested in Pikachu, Emolga, and Stunfisk.

Episodes.Title: The Pirates of Decolore!
Episodes.Description: When Team Rocket tries to ransack the group's cruise ship's food store, they are thwarted by a group of self-styled pirate Pokémon group made up of a Croconaw, an Octillery, an Azumarill, and a Ducklett, leaving Ash to try to get the food back.

Episodes.Title: Butterfree and Me!
Episodes.Description: On Wayfarer Island, Ash and his friends see the native Metapod and Butterfree, and when they find a Caterpie who has not yet evolved, Ash takes it upon himself to help the very lazy Pokémon join the rest of its friends, remembering the times he had raising his own Butterfree years ago.

Episodes.Title: The Path That Leads to Goodbye!
Episodes.Description: On Capacia Island, after a Dunsparce Ash fails to capture hurts Axew, Iris gets so mad at him that she says she will no longer be his friend and leaves.

Episodes.Title: Searching for a Wish!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Iris, and Cilan take a break on Capacia Island only to discover they have arrived on the one week once every 1000 years when Jirachi awakens and grants a wish. Gemma, a young girl who lives on the island, wants to ask Jirachi to bring prosperity back to the island, but Team Rocket has other plans.

Episodes.Title: Capacia Island UFO!
Episodes.Description: Ash must find a way to stop Beheeyem from taking over a town on Capacia Island after the townspeople, Iris, Cilan, and even Pikachu are placed under the strange Pokémons' control.

Episodes.Title: The Journalist from Another Region!
Episodes.Description: While on Harvest Island, Ash and his friends meet the Pokémon Reporter Alexa, who has come all the way from the Kalos Region with her Gogoat and Helioptile. She has come to investigate Harvest Island's fruit harvest festival, which the others realize has a Pokémon Sumo tournament. Ash, Iris, and Cilan enter Pignite, Pansage, and Dragonite in the tournament to win the grand prize Focus Band.

Episodes.Title: Mystery on a Deserted Island!
Episodes.Description: Alexa tells Ash, Iris, and Cilan about Yashi Island, a desert island where a pirate ship crashed years ago, and the ship's treasure has never been found. The group decides to investigate, and Team Rocket follows to get the treasure for themselves.

Episodes.Title: A Pokémon of a Different Color!
Episodes.Description: On Cave Island, Ash and his friends meet up with Clair, Gym Leader of Johto's Blackthorn City, who has come to the island to capture a different-colored Druddigon, but her Dragonite left without her. When they find her Dragonite, Iris's Dragonite takes an instant dislike to it and the two fight, hampering Clair's plans to find the different-colored Druddigon on the other side of the island from the port.

Episodes.Title: Celebrating the Hero's Comet!
Episodes.Description: The appearance of Woodate Comet approaches, so Ash, Iris, Cilan, and Alexa go stake out the ruins where the legendary hero it is named after first spotted it. However, they must deal with several Ghost Pokémon and Team Rocket who are once again trying to capture Pikachu.

Episodes.Title: Go, Go Gogoat!
Episodes.Description: On another island, Ash, Iris, Cilan, and Alexa meet a boy named Tony who touches Alexa's Gogoat's horns, causing it to temporarily bond with him. They all help Tony meet his father on the other side of the island.

Episodes.Title: Team Rocket's Shocking Recruit!
Episodes.Description: After being scolded by Iris, an ambush by Team Rocket starts to make Emolga wish she did not have to be with such strict trainers and fights on Team Rocket's side.

Episodes.Title: Survival of the Striaton Gym!
Episodes.Description: Chili and Cress meet up with Cilan on Paladin Island as they have both been beaten by a challenger at the Striaton Gym named Morana who exclusively uses Ice-type Pokémon such as Mamoswine and Glalie. It is up to Cilan and Pansage to face off against Morana and her Abomasnow for the honor of the Striaton City Gym.

Episodes.Title: Best Wishes! Until We Meet Again!
Episodes.Description: The group finally reaches the waters off of Kanto, just as Team Rocket once again tries to do their best to take Ash's Pikachu.

Episodes.Title: The Dream Continues!
Episodes.Description: With Iris and Cilan heading off on their own adventures in Johto, Ash is restless and still wishes to become a Pokémon Master. To that end, Alexa suggests that he travel with her back to her home in the Kalos region just as Team Rocket hatches another plan to steal Pikachu.

Episodes.Title: Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Pikachu have arrived in the Kalos region, and they waste no time building excitement and adventure to a fever pitch!

Episodes.Title: Lumiose City Pursuit!
Episodes.Description: After helping an ailing Pokémon, Ash puts everything he's got on the line, while an entire city bears witness!

Episodes.Title: A Battle of Aerial Mobility!
Episodes.Description: Ash is eager to catch some Kalos Pokemon, and he's definitely not alone!

Episodes.Title: A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue their Kalos region journey, exciting new Pokemon friendships are the order of the day!

Episodes.Title: A Blustery Santalune Gym Battle!
Episodes.Description: Ash is vying for his first Kalos Gym badge, but has our hero gotten more than he bargained for?

Episodes.Title: Battling on Thin Ice!
Episodes.Description: Never one to give up, Ash sets his sights on a rematch with Gym Leader Viola in order to win his first Kalos region Gym badge!

Episodes.Title: Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race!
Episodes.Description: There's an opportunity to be part of an exciting Rhyhorn race, and Ash can't wait to give it a try!

Episodes.Title: Grooming Furfrou!
Episodes.Description: Seeing a superstar Pokemon groomer in their tour guide, our heroes are later shocked to meet him and his assistant in person!

Episodes.Title: Clemont's Got a Secret!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes arrive back in Lumiose City, Clemont and Bonnie reveal a secret that has everyone else in shock!

Episodes.Title: Mega-Mega Meowth Madness!
Episodes.Description: During a visit with Professor Sycamore while in Lumiose City, our heroes encounter a surprising foe of mega-mega proportions!

Episodes.Title: The Bamboozling Forest!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes traverse a forest on their way to Cyllage City, some new Pokemon give them quite a challenge, and some old foes do, too!

Episodes.Title: To Catch a Pokémon Smuggler!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue their journey to Cyllage City and Ash's next Gym battle, they must confront a most unsavory character in a most unsavory line of work!

Episodes.Title: Kindergarten Chaos!
Episodes.Description: What starts out as a typical battle challenge between two Trainers in the middle of the forest leads to a life-changing experience for one young boy!

Episodes.Title: Seeking Shelter from the Storm!
Episodes.Description: A powerful rainstorm brings our heroes to a scary mansion seeking shelter, but with an unexpected outcome!

Episodes.Title: An Appetite for Battle!
Episodes.Description: A misunderstanding while camping out for the night turns out to be the perfect opportunity for some serious Pokemon-and-Trainer bonding!

Episodes.Title: A Jolting Switcheroo!
Episodes.Description: A visit to the local Pokemon Center results in a mix-up that has our heroes scrambling to undo it!

Episodes.Title: A Rush of Ninja Wisdom!
Episodes.Description: Continuing to Cyllage City, our heroes encounter a powerful young ninja and his equally powerful Frogadier, and both have much to share!

Episodes.Title: Awakening the Sleeping Giant!
Episodes.Description: Arriving in Camphrier Town, our heroes find themselves in the middle of a dilemma of epic proportions!

Episodes.Title: A Conspiracy to Conquer!
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket may still be after Pikachu, but for now, everyone's got another powerful Pokemon on their minds!

Episodes.Title: Breaking Titles at the Chateau!
Episodes.Description: A visit to an incredible Kalos region battling institution presents our heroes with lasting memories, and a surprising revelation!

Episodes.Title: A Pokévision of Things to Come!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes are exploring the world of Pokevision, and it's chock-full of epic productions and cinematic surprises!

Episodes.Title: Going for the Gold!
Episodes.Description: A visit by our heroes to an amazing aquarium turns out to reveal the stuff of legends!

Episodes.Title: Coming Back into the Cold!
Episodes.Description: After running into an old friend, our heroes are about to witness a major discovery they'll never forget!

Episodes.Title: Climbing the Walls!
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends make it to Cyllage City, where Ash plans on challenging the Gym Leader Grant. Having already seen his strategy with Onix at the Battle Chateau, Ash plans on having Froakie face the Rock Pokémon in battle, and later Pikachu against Tyrunt.

Episodes.Title: A Battle by Any Other Name!
Episodes.Description: While on the road, Serena makes some Poké Puffs for Pikachu and Fennekin, but her cooking skills are attacked by Miette, who has the Meringue Pokémon Slurpuff. The two decide to head to the next town and hold a Poké Puffs Contest to see who is the better pastry chef.

Episodes.Title: To Find a Fairy Flower!
Episodes.Description: A new hairstyle for Bonnie leads our heroes to new friends in need!

Episodes.Title: The Bonds of Evolution!
Episodes.Description: A chance encounter with the Champion gives our heroes a deeper look into the mysteries of Evolution!

Episodes.Title: Heroes - Friends and Faux Alike!
Episodes.Description: A case of mistaken identity is part of a sinister plot to catch Pikachu once and for all!

Episodes.Title: Mega Revelations!
Episodes.Description: A chance meeting with Korrina and her partner Lucario presents our heroes with more surprises then they could've imagined!

Episodes.Title: The Cave of Trials!
Episodes.Description: The search for Lucarionite is on, and Korrina faces challenges she never dreamed of!

Episodes.Title: The Aura Storm!
Episodes.Description: Korrina, Lucario, and our heroes discover there is much more to Mega Evolution than they ever imagined!

Episodes.Title: Calling from Beyond the Aura!
Episodes.Description: On their way to Pomace Mountain, Korrina, Lucario, and our heroes witness the next step in the Mega Evolution saga!

Episodes.Title: The Bonds of Mega Evolution!
Episodes.Description: Korrina and Lucario are on Pomace Mountain with our heroes, where they learn more about Mega Evolution in a most unexpected way!

Episodes.Title: The Forest Champion!
Episodes.Description: On their way to Shalour City, our heroes come across an amazing Pokémon with a powerful and unique way of battling!

Episodes.Title: Battles in the Sky!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue their journey to Shalour City, a different kind of battle piques their interest!

Episodes.Title: The Cave of Mirrors!
Episodes.Description: While exploring a well-known cave on their way to Shalour City, our heroes see themselves in unexpectedly different ways!

Episodes.Title: Forging Forest Friendships!
Episodes.Description: Some family squabbling gives rise to some fabulous teamwork!

Episodes.Title: Summer of Discovery!
Episodes.Description: It's day one of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon summer camp, and the excitement and adventures are just getting under way!

Episodes.Title: Day Three Blockbusters!
Episodes.Description: It's day three of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Summer Camp, and Pokévision is on everyone's minds!

Episodes.Title: Foggy Pokemon Orienteering!
Episodes.Description: On day five of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon summer camp, Pok?mon Orienteering leads our heroes to a mysterious discovery!

Episodes.Title: Battling Into the Hall of Fame!
Episodes.Description: It's the final day of Professor Sycamore's Pokémon summer camp, and entry into the hall of fame is right around the corner for the winning team!

Episodes.Title: Origins of Mega Evolution!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes have finally arrived in Shalour City, and Ash's Gym battle against Korrina is imminent!

Episodes.Title: Showdown at the Shalour Gym!
Episodes.Description: The long-awaited Gym battle between Ash and Korrina is getting under way, and it promises to be white-hot!

Episodes.Title: Splitting Heirs!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes make their way to Coumarine City and Ash's next Gym battle, they come across two brothers with a lesson to learn, and to share!

Episodes.Title: The Clumsy Crier Quiets the Chaos!
Episodes.Description: A visit to a nearby Pokemon Center introduces our heroes to a Wigglytuff with an unusual way of doing things!

Episodes.Title: Dreaming a Performer's Dream!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes meet up with Shauna, their friend from summer camp, who takes them to see their first Pokémon Showcase!

Episodes.Title: A Campus Reunion!
Episodes.Description: Clemont revisits his school days and meets up with a couple of old friends, both people and Pokemon!

Episodes.Title: Bonnie for the Defense!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue toward the Coumarine City Gym, Bonnie makes some new friends, and they're a force to be reckoned with!

Episodes.Title: Pathways to Performance Partnering!
Episodes.Description: After a squabble between friends, a chance meeting gives our heroes a chance for some unexpected teamwork!

Episodes.Title: An Undersea Place to Call Home!
Episodes.Description: Before Ash's Cyllage City Gym battle, a visit to the Muraille Coast set our heroes on an aquatic adventure filled with undersea Pokémon!

Episodes.Title: When Light and Dark Collide!
Episodes.Description: After Ash makes a mistake, his Hawlucha finds itself in the performance of a lifetime!

Episodes.Title: A Stealthy Challenge!
Episodes.Description: After running into a friend, our heroes embark upon an adventure filled with stealth and surprise!

Episodes.Title: A Race for Home!
Episodes.Description: A visit to a Skiddo ranch provides our heroes with some unexpected challenges!

Episodes.Title: Facing the Grand Design!
Episodes.Description: The entire world is in danger, and an unlikely group of long time foes must join forces to save it!

Episodes.Title: A Slippery Encounter!
Episodes.Description: A chance encounter with a Pokémon in need leads our heroes into an unexpected adventure!

Episodes.Title: One for the Goomy!
Episodes.Description: The newest member of our heroes' Pokémon family is in trouble, but their smallest member steps in to help!

Episodes.Title: Thawing an Icy Panic!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes have arrived in Coumarine City, and they are immediately confronted by a crisis with bone-chilling consequences!

Episodes.Title: The Green, Green Grass Types of Home!
Episodes.Description: The time for Ash's Coumarine City Gym battle is here, and with it the chance to learn and grow!

Episodes.Title: Under the Pledging Tree!
Episodes.Description: A Coumarine City tradition is in jeopardy, and our heroes are faced with averting a major crisis!

Episodes.Title: A Showcase Debut!
Episodes.Description: It's Serena's Pokémon Showcase debut, surrounded by friends and rivals, old and new!

Episodes.Title: An Oasis of Hope!
Episodes.Description: There's a bully in the Lumiose Badlands, and many helpless Pokémon are depending on our heroes for their freedom!

Episodes.Title: The Future Is Now, Thanks to Determination!
Episodes.Description: When the Kalos Power Plant is held under siege, the safety of Lumiose City and many Pokémon hangs in the balance!

Episodes.Title: A Fork in the Road! A Parting of the Ways!
Episodes.Description: A conflict of heartfelt emotions threatens the future of a longstanding partnership!

Episodes.Title: Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!
Episodes.Description: A chance meeting with a mystery Pokemon performer provides Serena and her Pokemon with some priceless advice and support!

Episodes.Title: Good Friends, Great Training!
Episodes.Description: A surprise reunion with an old friend give Ash the perfect opportunity for training - and even more surprises!

Episodes.Title: Confronting the Darkness!
Episodes.Description: Ash is finally in Lumiose City for his Gym battle with Clemont, but a major crisis threatens the proceedings!

Episodes.Title: The Moment of Lumiose Truth!
Episodes.Description: The long-awaited Gym battle between Ash and Gym Leader Clemont is off and running, and lots of intense training is being put to the test!

Episodes.Title: Garchomp's Mega Bond!
Episodes.Description: When our heroes visit Professor Sycamore on their way out of Lumiose City, they're in for a surprise of mega proportions!

Episodes.Title: Defending the Homeland!
Episodes.Description: With Goodra's beloved wetlands in imminent danger, our heroes are faced with a must-win situation for the sake of the many Pokémon who live there!

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Rainbow!
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket deceives Florges into an alliance and then double crosses it when they attempt to drain all of the Spring water of the wetlands.

Episodes.Title: So You're Having a Bad Day!
Episodes.Description: The daily fortune in Serena's guidebook predicts a bad day for our heroes, and that prediction turns out to be accurate!

Episodes.Title: Scary Hospitality!
Episodes.Description: A rainy night and an old mansion combine to give our heroes an evening to remember, or not!

Episodes.Title: A Fashionable Battle!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes have arrived in Laverre City, and the Gym Leader there has a wardrobe of surprises in store!

Episodes.Title: Fairy-Type Trickery!
Episodes.Description: It is time for Ash's battle with Valerie at the Laverre Gym, and it appears thinking on his feet could be our hero's key to victory!

Episodes.Title: Rivals: Today and Tomorrow!
Episodes.Description:
Season 18 - Episode 27

After Ash's fierce battle with Valerie at the Laverre Gym, young Sawyer has a lot of questions!

Episodes.Title: A Not-So-Flying-Start!
Episodes.Description: A chance discovery on their way to Anistar City gives our heroes a challenging teaching moment!

Episodes.Title: A Relay in the Sky!
Episodes.Description: An unexpected race provides our heroes with an opportunity to give their newest member a chance to spread its wings!

Episodes.Title: Lights! Camera! Pika!
Episodes.Description: A masterpiece is in the making, and our heroes can't wait to be involved!

Episodes.Title: A Frenzied Factory Fiasco!
Episodes.Description: A tour of the Poké Ball Factory provides our heroes with much more than just Poké Balls!

Episodes.Title: Performing with Fiery Charm!
Episodes.Description: Serena's next Pokémon Showcase appearance is taking place in Dendemille Town, and she's faced with some stiff competition!

Episodes.Title: Rotom's Wish!
Episodes.Description: A visit to a peculiar hotel gives our heroes the chance to right a wrong from long ago!

Episodes.Title: A Festival Trade! A Festival Farewell?
Episodes.Description: During a visit to a popular festival, our heroes fall victim to several cases of mistaken identity!

Episodes.Title: Over the Mountain of Snow!
Episodes.Description: A trip over a snow-covered mountain gives our heroes the chance to truly help those in need!

Episodes.Title: Adventures in Running Errands!
Episodes.Description: When the power goes out at a Pokémon Center, our heroes and their Pokémon come to the rescue!

Episodes.Title: Mending a Broken Spirit!
Episodes.Description: A crisis in confidence leads to renewed strength and determination!

Episodes.Title: A Legendary Photo Op!
Episodes.Description: A chance reunion with an old friend gives our heroes an experience of legendary proportions!

Episodes.Title: The Tiny Caretaker!
Episodes.Description: A Pokémon in need provides a heartfelt lesson in caring, and letting go.

Episodes.Title: A Trip Down Memory Train!
Episodes.Description: An emergency situation offers the perfect opportunity to recall a heartwarming story of times past!

Episodes.Title: A Frolicking Find in the Flowers!
Episodes.Description: A beautiful meadow provides our heroes with the perfect spot to take a break and witness a surprising performance!

Episodes.Title: Tag Team Battle Inspiration!
Episodes.Description: A friendly Tag Battle provides Eevee and Serena with some confidence and inspiration!

Episodes.Title: A Performance Pop Quiz!
Episodes.Description: It's time for the Anistar City Pokémon Showcase, and a second Princess Key hangs in the balance for Serena!

Episodes.Title: Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes look to Ash's next battle at the Anistar City Gym, they discover things about its Gym Leader they never could have imagined!

Episodes.Title: All Eyes on the Future!
Episodes.Description: The time for Ash's Anistar City Gym battle has arrived, but in this case, time has some unexpected meanings!

Episodes.Title: From A to Z!
Episodes.Description: Bonnie makes a new friend, Ash runs into an old friend, and a terrifying premonition begins to unfold!

Episodes.Title: Love Strikes! Eevee, Yikes!
Episodes.Description: While Eevee deals with some unwanted attention, Team Rocket turns its attention to Squishy!

Episodes.Title: A Giga Battle with Mega Results!
Episodes.Description: There's trouble at the local Pokémon Center, but our heroes and Professor Sycamore are there to help!

Episodes.Title: A Fiery Rite of Passage!
Episodes.Description: As our heroes continue their journey to Snowbelle City, they encounter a young Pokémon faced with the challenges of growing up!

Episodes.Title: Dream a Little Dream from Me!
Episodes.Description: A nighttime campout brings some interesting adventures for our heroes' Pokémon!

Episodes.Title: The Legend of the Ninja Hero!
Episodes.Description: Our heroes' friend Sanpei is showing them Ninja Village, his home, but its peace and tranquility is soon to be threatened!

Episodes.Title: A Festival of Decisions!
