The attacks fly furiously—just like the competitors themselves—until it appears that Rowlet is unable to battle. But Hala notices that Rowlet hasn’t lost yet…it’s actually just sleeping! The battle restarts, and after mastering a new move, Rowlet ends up victorious! Then, Kiawe and Charizard face off against Sophocles and Vikavolt, and the latter two successfully pull off a Z-Move—will Charizard be able to escape the devastating attack?

Episodes.Title: The Road to the Semifinals!
Episodes.Description:
As the Alola Pokémon League quarterfinals rage on, Kiawe and Charizard face off against Sophocles and Vikavolt in the third battle. Both sides show impressive offense and defense, making it clear they’ve trained hard. But Vikavolt’s Wild Charge attack isn’t enough to stop Charizard’s Supersonic Skystrike Z-Move, and Kiawe and Charizard end up on top!

In the fourth match, Lana and Primarina battle Guzma and Golisopod, but Guzma’s intense battling style takes Lana and Primarina by surprise. Despite a valiant effort, Primarina takes significant damage and loses the battle, but everyone agrees Guzma won fair and square.

Next up are the semifinals: Kiawe versus Gladion and Ash versus Guzma!

Episodes.Title: The Final Four!
Episodes.Description: We’ve reached the Alola Pokémon League semifinals! Ash is lined up to challenge Team Skull’s Guzma, but first, Kiawe will take on Gladion. Their battle allows each competitor to use two Pokémon, and given the skills possessed by both Trainers, this is going to be an exciting match. Gladion has chosen Lycanroc and Silvally to go up against Kiawe’s Alolan Marowak and Turtonator—four powerful Pokémon that have been trained to win. Lycanroc faces Marowak first, but there’s no way we’re going to spoil the outcome. We will say this, though: it’s an extremely heated battle with a cliffhanger that will leave you eagerly anticipating the next episode!

Episodes.Title: Getting Down to the Ire!
Episodes.Description: The Kaki/Gladio battle continues, with Bakugames now facing Glazio's Silvally, but will Kaki's Z-move be enough to win the battle? With Satoshi inspiring both of them, who knows? Then comes the match everyone's on the edge of their seats for ... another 2-on-2, and it's Satoshi vs. Guzma! But Guzma's supposedly never been defeated! First out for Guzma is Hassam, and Satoshi chooses Nyaheat. Just as the battle gets started, Guzma switches out and brings in Gusokumusha, but when Nyaheat begins to get the upper hand, Gusokumusha uses Crisis Prevention to forcibly switch-out with Hassam, who takes major damage, shocking everyone including Guzma! What's with Gusokumusha? And just how long can Rocket-Dan's robot-Yareyuutan keep Kiteruguma and Nuikoguma in that hot spring?

Episodes.Title: The Wisdom Not to Run!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Guzma’s battle continues in the second half of the Alola Pokémon League semifinals! After the surprising defeat of Guzma’s Scizor, his Golisopod is left to take on Ash’s Torracat. Unfortunately, the exhausted Torracat is quickly defeated, leaving it up to Pikachu to face the powerful Golisopod. During the fierce battle, new details come to light, revealing why Guzma is so determined to bring down Professor Kukui and the Alola Pokémon League. Can Ash and Pikachu overcome this determined adversary?

Episodes.Title: Final Rivals!
Episodes.Description: On the night before the Finals, Hanako, Barri-chan and Professor Okibo arrive at Manolo to cheer for Satoshi. The wild Meltan also arrive, and with their help, to everyone's surprise, Meltan evolves into Melmetal! The next day is the ultimate showdown between two strong rivals ... Satoshi vs. Gladio! This time, it's a 3-on-3 match. For their first Pokemon, Gladio chooses Silvally and for Satoshi Melmetal makes its battle debut! Unfortunately, Silvally is too strong and Melmetal is defeated. Satoshi sends in Pikachu, who defeats Silvally. Gladio sends in Lugarugan ... but there's something not quite right about Lugarugan.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Champion!
Episodes.Description:
As the Alola Pokémon League races toward the finish line, Gladion and Zoroark unleash the Z-Move Never-Ending Nightmare against Pikachu. But Pikachu stops in its tracks to meet the threat head-on with Breakneck Blitz: a strategy that’s pure Ash! The clash of Z-Moves leaves both Pokémon unable to battle, and Ash and Gladion both respond by sending out their Lycanroc for the final stretch of the match. The two Lycanroc battle to new levels of intensity, ending with a Counter-versus-Counter showdown—and a momentous, hard-earned win for Ash!

At long last, our hero is crowned the Champion of the first-ever Alola Pokémon League!

Episodes.Title: Z-Move Showdown!
Episodes.Description: Just as Ash is crowned Champion of the Alola Pokémon League, an Ultra Wormhole opens above the stadium, and an angry Guzzlord appears! Ash had battled it previously in a parallel world, so he tells Alola’s island kahunas about the Ultra Beast’s weak spot. But before they know it, two more Guzzlord appear! The kahunas and Pokémon School class leap into Z-Move action to defeat the first two, while Ash, Pikachu, and the Masked Royal reunite with Naganadel—formerly Poipole—and use Gigavolt Havoc to send the third one packing. The resulting explosion blows off the Masked Royal’s mask, revealing his true identity: Professor Kukui!

Episodes.Title: Exhibition Unmasked!
Episodes.Description: The Masked Royal is finally unmasked—he’s Professor Kukui! It’s time for the Alola Pokémon League’s exhibition match, and Ash is more excited than ever to battle his mentor in a six-versus-six Full Battle. First up are Torracat and Incineroar, and when Incineroar’s Blast Burn attack pelts Torracat with overwhelming flames, Torracat surprises everyone by absorbing the fire into its own body! But the heat becomes too much for Torracat, and it retreats from battle for the time being. Ash then sends out Lycanroc, who uses a shard from its Stone Edge attack to land a blow on Incineroar. Professor Kukui responds by sending out Braviary—what will happen next?

Episodes.Title: A Full Battle Bounty!
Episodes.Description: The Alola Pokémon League’s exhibition match continues with a dizzying array of Pokémon! Braviary manages to defeat Ash’s Lycanroc, and then Rowlet takes down Braviary with a powerful Brave Bird attack. Professor Kukui then calls on Venusaur, who traps Rowlet in its flower! Thanks to Feather Dance, Rowlet escapes unscathed—but then falls to Venusaur’s Sludge Bomb attack. Next up is Torracat’s fiery return to defeat Venusaur, followed by Pikachu versus Empoleon. After a dizzying Whirlpool, Ash switches in Melmetal, who takes down Empoleon but can’t withstand Incineroar’s flames. Each Trainer has three Pokémon still standing as Professor Kukui sends out Lucario, Ash responds with Naganadel, and the battle continues!

Episodes.Title: Fiery Surprises!
Episodes.Description:
With three Pokémon left on each side during the Alola Pokémon League’s exhibition match, Ash’s Naganadel is up against Professor Kukui’s Lucario. A strategic Dragon Pulse lands another win for Ash—and the first-ever battle victory for Naganadel!

Then, it’s Torracat’s rematch with Incineroar. The flames burn hotter than ever, and when the smoke clears, Torracat is on top! Triumphant, it suddenly evolves and becomes an Incineroar itself! But all the excitement leaves it too exhausted to continue.

Just as Professor Kukui is about to send out his final Pokémon, Tapu Koko appears—and decides that it wants to battle Ash instead! Just how will Ash approach this history-making matchup?

Episodes.Title: From Z to Shining Z!
Episodes.Description: As the Alola Pokémon League’s exhibition match nears its conclusion, Tapu Koko appears—it wants to team up with Professor Kukui and battle Ash! Our hero responds by sending out Naganadel, and the clash of Island Guardian and Ultra Beast powers is an amazing sight. But Tapu Koko manages to overpower Naganadel, so Ash turns to Pikachu, his last Pokémon standing! Tapu Koko raises the stakes as it and Professor Kukui unleash a legendary Z-Move reserved for Island Guardians, but Ash and Pikachu rise to the challenge with their own Z-Move: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt! Once the dust clears, Tapu Koko falls, and Ash and Pikachu are victorious!

Episodes.Title: Dreaming of the Sun and Moon!
Episodes.Description: With the Alola Pokémon League behind them, our heroes are deciding how to spend their upcoming vacation! Kiawe is determined to finally have an all-out battle against Ash, while Sophocles is going to take the first steps toward his dream of becoming an astronaut. Lana plans to help her dad with his ocean research, and Mallow wants to create a menu for Pokémon at the Family Restaurant. Meanwhile, Lillie continues her efforts to awaken Magearna…and succeeds! But what about Ash? After receiving some wise advice from Olivia, he decides to explore the world—first stop, Pallet Town!

Episodes.Title: Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!
Episodes.Description: As their vacation approaches, our heroes’ plans move closer to reality! Kiawe has decided to assist Olivia with her kahuna duties, while Lana, Mallow, and Sophocles continue to work toward their own goals. Now that Magearna is awake, Lillie and her family are setting out to find Mohn, and Ash is embarking on a new adventure of his own—he wants to see new places and meet new Pokémon! The Pokémon School class, Professor Kukui, and Professor Burnet are sad to see him leave Alola, but they wish him all the best for the future. And with Team Rocket also departing Alola, just what might that future hold?

Episodes.Title: Enter Pikachu!
Episodes.Description: Though he's excited to attend Professor Oak's Pokémon camp, Ash oversleeps when the day arrives. Newcomer Goh is just as excited — and on time.

Episodes.Title: Legend? Go! Friends? Go!
Episodes.Description: Professor Oak invites Ash to the opening ceremony for Professor Cerise's new lab in Vermilion City. Goh sets out to catch a legendary Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Ivysaur's Mysterious Tower!
Episodes.Description: Professor Cerise asks Ash and Goh to investigate the sudden appearance of Ivysaur in Vermilion City, but the two researchers disagree on their methods.

Episodes.Title: Settling the Scorebunny!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh head to the Galar region on assignment. During their stopover, some Pokémon steal Ash's backpack — with Ash and Goh's train tickets inside!

Episodes.Title: Mind-Boggling Dynamax!
Episodes.Description: Once they get off the train, Ash and Goh set out on the hunt for Dynamax Pokémon. Meanwhile, a Scorbunny is hot on their trail.

Episodes.Title: Working My Way Back to Mew!
Episodes.Description: After learning more about the Pokédex functions on their Rotom Phones from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh head out to catch some local Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Serving Up the Flute Cup!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh travel to the Hoenn region, where Ash has entered Goh into the Battle Frontier Flute Cup. Their first opponents are Hodge and his Hariyama.

Episodes.Title: The Sinnoh Iceberg Race!
Episodes.Description: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.

Episodes.Title: Finding a Legend!
Episodes.Description: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.

Episodes.Title: A Test in Paradise!
Episodes.Description: After a ship's captain reports being saved by a Dragonite, Goh and Ash set out in search of the Dragonite island that they believe exists ... somewhere.

Episodes.Title: Best Friend... Worst Nightmare!
Episodes.Description: While the laboratory staff deal with a mysterious power outage, Chloe contemplates her future and her relationship with Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Flash of the Titans!
Episodes.Description: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to the World Coronation Series finals in the Galar region, where the strongest trainers battle for glory!

Episodes.Title: The Climb to Be the Very Best!
Episodes.Description: When a Gigantamax Drednaw interrupts the World Coronation finals in pursuit of Team Rocket, Ash, Goh and their Pokémon spring into action!

Episodes.Title: Raid Battle in the Ruins!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh travel to the Unova region, where they head to the newly discovered Ruins of the Titan site at Desert Resort to search for Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: A Snow Day for Searching!
Episodes.Description: After snow in Vermilion City forces Professor Cerise to shut down the lab for system maintenance, Goh heads home for a few days to visit his family.

Episodes.Title: A Chilling Curse!
Episodes.Description: Gengar's hauntings at the lab resume. Ash and Goh vow to capture the poltergeist Pokémon, and Professor Cerise explains the lab's paranormal history.

Episodes.Title: Kicking It from Here Into Tomorrow!
Episodes.Description: After Darmanitan taunts Scorbunny in a practice battle, Scorbunny is determined to learn the Ember attack, but getting Goh's attention is a challenge.

Episodes.Title: Destination: Coronation!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh head to the Vermilion Gym, where Ash challenges the substitute Gym Leader as his first World Coronation Series opponent.

Episodes.Title: A Talent for Imitation!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash visit a film set, where the star, a Ditto, flees after a fight with the director. They search for her, but she's fallen in with Team Rocket!

Episodes.Title: Dreams Are Made of These!
Episodes.Description: Pokémon Orienteering day dawns bright and early, with Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise each leading a group of kids on a trek through Vermilion City.

Episodes.Title: Caring for a Mystery!
Episodes.Description: After learning about Pokémon Eggs, Goh wants to find one. Ash's latest World Coronation Series match ends with him feeling like someone is calling him.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Friend!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh head to the Hoenn region to witness the annual migration of Beautifly, but first they have to find them. Goh's Raboot starts acting out.

Episodes.Title: Panic in the Park!
Episodes.Description: Someone seems to be stealing the food that the researchers leave out for Pokémon in Cerise Park. To catch the culprit, Ash and Goh camp out.

Episodes.Title: A Little Rocket R & R!
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket are sent to the Sinnoh region for a vacation, but their break is interrupted by the arrival of Ash and Goh looking for a special Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: A Festival Reunion!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh head to the Kalos region, where Goh wants to catch Kalos Pokémon and Ash sets his sights on a World Coronation Series Battle Festival.

Episodes.Title: Splash, Dash, and Smash for the Crown! / Slowking's Crowning!
Episodes.Description: Goh enters his giant Magikarp in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Tournament. Then he and Ash head to Slowpoke Island, hoping to catch a Slowpoke.

Episodes.Title: Toughing It Out!
Episodes.Description: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to a World Coronation Series Master Class battle in Galar, with challenger Raihan battling champion Leon.

Episodes.Title: Sobbing Sobble!
Episodes.Description: A Sobble sneaks up on Ash and Goh while they're eating at the Wyndon Pokémon Center. To catch it, they have to follow a trail of crying people.

Episodes.Title: There's a New Kid in Town!
Episodes.Description: Yamper brings home an injured Pidove, so Professor Cerise and his family decide to nurse it back to health. Chloe has her hands full keeping the peace!

Episodes.Title: Betrayed, Bothered, and Beleaguered!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Riolu are on a roll after the latest World Coronation Series battle, and Pikachu is jealous! When Ash's mom visits, Pikachu follows her home.

Episodes.Title: The Cuteness Quotient!
Episodes.Description: Chloe asks Ash and Goh to step in at her younger brother Parker's school: His friend Nami is upset that other kids say her Feebas isn't cute.

Episodes.Title: Time After Time!
Episodes.Description: Goh joins his parents for a family vacation in the Johto region. Walking through the woods, he recalls meeting another trainer there three years ago.

Episodes.Title: Trade, Borrow, and Steal!
Episodes.Description: The local Pokémon Center is hosting a Pokémon trading event. When Ash and Goh head over to check it out, they meet a trainer who's a Bug-type enthusiast.

Episodes.Title: Solitary and Menacing!
Episodes.Description: Ash travels to Saffron City to battle his next opponent, but when he learns that the Karate Master has been defeated, he challenges the victor instead.

Episodes.Title: Gotta Catch a What?!
Episodes.Description: Goh decides to catch a Pikachu, and Professor Cerise informs him about a mass outbreak of Pikachu in the mountains. But Team Rocket is on the hunt too!

Episodes.Title: Making Battles in the Sand!
Episodes.Description: After Ash battles new opponents in the World Coronation Series, the Cerise Laboratory researchers head to the Hoenn region to investigate a sandstorm.

Episodes.Title: That New Old Gang of Mine!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh head to the Alola region and reunite with Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet and Ash's human and Pokémon friends at the Pokémon School.

Episodes.Title: Restore and Renew!
Episodes.Description: With Chloe in tow, Ash and Goh visit the Pewter Museum of Science. Goh heads to a public dig site to find a Fossil Pokémon, but Team Rocket is there!

Episodes.Title: Octo-Gridlock at the Gym!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash travel to the Cianwood Gym in the Johto region so Ash can take on Bea in a World Coronation Series rematch.

Episodes.Title: A Crackling Raid Battle!
Episodes.Description: When a hot day in Vermilion City turns thunderous, Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise suspect that the Legendary bird Pokémon Zapdos is somewhere nearby.

Episodes.Title: Pikachu Translation Check! / Up to Your Neck!
Episodes.Description: While Meowth battles a cold, Jessie and James review a video of Ash's Pikachu. On a forest walk, Ash and Goh try to help a wild Marshtomp.

Episodes.Title: Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh set out for the Galar region to investigate the Dynamax phenomenon. During a train delay, they meet strange Pokémon in a mysterious forest.

Episodes.Title: Sword and Shield: The Darkest Day!
Episodes.Description: While Goh and Sonia investigate the Darkest Day in Turffield, Team Rocket infiltrates the Galar Energy Plant, with Ash and Leon heading there too.

Episodes.Title: Sword and Shield: From Here to Eternatus!
Episodes.Description: Ash heads to Stow-on-Side to meet Sonia and Goh, who conclude that the Darkest Day is a Pokémon. At the Energy Plant, Leon encounters it directly.

Episodes.Title: Sword and Shield... The Legends Awaken!
Episodes.Description: At the stadium, Leon and Team Rocket are no match for Eternatus. Ash takes on Chairman Rose while Goh battles Oleana to break through and end the chaos.

Episodes.Title: Getting More Than You Battled For!
Episodes.Description: When Psychic energy is detected on Cero Island, Ash and Goh head out in hopes of finding Mew. When they get there, they meet an old foe: Mewtwo!

Episodes.Title: Crowning the Chow Crusher!
Episodes.Description: The Vermilion City Pokémon Eating Contest is on, and Ash, Goh and their Pokémon are competing for a trip to Unova. Team Rocket wants to win too.

Episodes.Title: A Close Call... Practically!
Episodes.Description: Setting out on Goh's prize trip, Ash and Goh arrive in Castelia City. Unbeknownst to them, Team Rocket is lying in wait to kidnap Pikachu!

Episodes.Title: To Train, or Not to Train!
Episodes.Description: A mysterious Eevee runs away from the Eevee Evolution Laboratory and meets Chloe. Meanwhile, Team Rocket makes a plan to steal some students' Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: A Pinch of This, A Pinch of That!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Goh and Chloe head to the Galar region to investigate some of its unusual fossils. The on-site researchers want to reconstruct the ancient Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Trials of a Budding Master!
Episodes.Description: Investigating an outbreak of Geodude in Rock Tunnel, Ash and Goh meet a trainer who accepts Ash's challenge to a World Coronation battle with Gurdurr!

Episodes.Title: How Are Ya Gonna Keep 'Em Off of the Farm?
Episodes.Description: When Professor Cerise's former student asks for help with some Diglett and Dugtrio wreaking havoc on his farm, Goh, Ash and Chloe go check it out.

Episodes.Title: Healing the Healer!
Episodes.Description: Hearing rumors that the legendary Suicune has been spotted at a lake, Ash and Goh travel to the Johto region, where they find a human polluting plot.

Episodes.Title: Sobble Spies a Stealthy Strategy!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash visit the set of a popular spy movie. When the film's Inteleon star cinematically foils a Team Rocket attack, Goh's Sobble is inspired.

Episodes.Title: The Tale of You and Glimwood Tangle!
Episodes.Description: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Glimwood Tangle to learn more about Galarian Ponyta and Rapidash. Separated in the forest, they have storybook adventures.

Episodes.Title: Searching for Chivalry!
Episodes.Description: After hearing about Wikstrom of the Kalos Elite Four, Ash and Goh travel to his castle to take his test alongside their Farfetch'd and Scyther.

Episodes.Title: Memories of a Warming Kindness
Episodes.Description: While Ash and Goh take advantage of a cold snap to search for Ice Pokémon, Chloe enjoys some girls' time with lab assistant Chrysa at her apartment.

Episodes.Title: A Rollicking Roll…Eyes on the Goal!
Episodes.Description: When Team Rocket's Pelipper dispenses too many Gulpin from the Prize Master, trouble rolls through Vermilion City. Then, the race is on with Chewtle!

Episodes.Title: When a House Is Not a Home!
Episodes.Description: Goh finds a Grookey in the lab and tries to capture it, only to learn it belongs to someone else. To locate its owner, he and Ash set out on a search.

Episodes.Title: Beyond Chivalry…Aiming to Be a Leek Master!
Episodes.Description: Ash runs into Rinto, who's also in the World Coronation Series, at the Pokémon Center. He and Farfetch'd challenge Rinto and Gallade to a rematch!

Episodes.Title: Searching for Service with a Smile!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash offer to help handyperson Multa after her partner is injured. Out on the job, they cross paths with Team Rocket and their latest plot.

Episodes.Title: Not Too Close for Comfort!
Episodes.Description: Goh's Sobble evolves into a Drizzile. But for some reason, it withdraws to a cave in Cerise Park, much to Goh's consternation.

Episodes.Title: On Land, in the Sea, and to the Future!
Episodes.Description: Chloe, Ash and Goh head to Hoenn to meet race champion trainer Kiley and his Vaporeon. At his suggestion, they enter the Kids Marine Athletic Race.

Episodes.Title: Absol Absolved
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash travel to Lavaridge Town to help their old friend Hodge, whose uncle's hot springs have gone dry — perhaps due to an Absol spotted nearby.

Episodes.Title: Thrash of the Titans!
Episodes.Description: Ash receives a letter from an old friend in Unova: Iris! He and Goh head to Opelucid City so Ash can face her in a World Coronation Series battle.

Episodes.Title: Under Color of Darkness!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash travel to Kalos to find a new flower for one of Goh's Flabébé. After a few days, they visit a plant researcher for some expert insights.

Episodes.Title: Sleuths for Truth!
Episodes.Description: Officer Jenny and an Inspector Decker visit the lab, searching for the culprit in a series of electricity thefts. Decker decides Pikachu is responsible!

Episodes.Title: Advice to Goh!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh travel to Pallet to visit Professor Oak, who offers Goh a job on the Project Mew research team. They also run into Ash's old frenemy, Gary.

Episodes.Title: Errand Endurance!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Chloe dispatch their Grookey and Eevee on an errand together but secretly follow them to supervise. Team Rocket do the same with Pelipper.

Episodes.Title: Take My Thief! Please!
Episodes.Description: After trying and failing to get rid of their Morpeko, Team Rocket hatch a plan to get Goh to capture it so they don't have to feed it anymore.

Episodes.Title: Leaping Toward the Dream!
Episodes.Description: Goh travels to the Sinnoh region for his first mission with Project Mew, accompanied by Ash. It turns out, becoming a full team member is quite a trial!

Episodes.Title: Everybody's Doing the Underground Shuffle!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to Driftveil City after hearing about a Klink. Surprised in a cave by Team Rocket, the two groups' members get mixed up!

Episodes.Title: Grabbing the Brass Ring!
Episodes.Description: After learning about Falinks from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh go to Galar to see one. Meanwhile, an Eiscue adrift on an ice floe washes up in Galar.

Episodes.Title: Nightfall? Nightmares!
Episodes.Description: Goh and Ash head to Sinnoh after reports of nightmares, suspecting the mythical Pokémon Darkrai is responsible. Chloe and Eevee travel to Sinnoh too.

Episodes.Title: A Midsummer Night's Light!
Episodes.Description: Dawn and Chloe find an injured Cresselia and are able to give it first aid. Ash and Goh are still on Darkrai's trail, and so is Team Rocket.

Episodes.Title: All Out, All of the Time!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh race through the mountains on a deserted island in the Alola region — where they meet the lively All-Out brothers, Phil and Mayshure.

Episodes.Title: Excitement from the Ultra-Shocking Start!
Episodes.Description: Ash has leveled up to the Ultra Class! Now, he must face gym leader Volkner in a blazing battle in solar-powered Sunyshore City.

Episodes.Title: Detective Drizzile!
Episodes.Description: Something has caused the Cerise Lab's data to suddenly vanish. Drizzile helps the team track down the mysterious culprit.

Episodes.Title: Night and Day, You Are the Ones!
Episodes.Description: Adam, Goh and Chloe arrive at Eclipse Castle to meet Espeon and Umbreon and see their special Pokémon powers firsthand.

Episodes.Title: Trial on a Golden Scale!
Episodes.Description: In search of Volcarona, the Sun Pokémon, Ash and Goh head to the Colossus Ruins in the Unova region for Goh's first trial mission from Project Mew.

Episodes.Title: Mad About Blue!
Episodes.Description: The crew spies the rare and spherical Voltorb and bumps into Gorman, a blue Pokémon fanatic. But Team Rocket plots to ruin the fun with this new friend.

Episodes.Title: The Sweet Taste of Battle!
Episodes.Description: The tasty Alcremie, a Pokémon made of cream, floats toward Goh and pals. Later, gym leader Opal arranges a special challenge with Leon.

Episodes.Title: Star Night, Star Flight!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh run into champion Cynthia while investigating strange phenomena in the Johto region, where daytime has plunged into total darkness.

Episodes.Title: An Adventure of Mega Proportions!
Episodes.Description: Ash receives a mega glove from cheerleader Korrina in Shalour City. Later, the gang searches for a mega stone to help Lucario mega evolve.

Episodes.Title: Battle Three with Bea!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Bea have already faced off twice. Will Ash have better luck during their third showdown at Stow-on-Side Stadium with Korrina in the stands?

Episodes.Title: A Battle of Mega Versus Max!
Episodes.Description: With a contentious back-and-forth battle with Bea, Ash brings out Sirfetch'd, Pikachu and Lucario to bolster his attacks and defensive strength.

Episodes.Title: Breaking the Ice!
Episodes.Description: Goh brings Ash along to school for a presentation. Later, transfer student Regina and her Glaceon Pokémon cause a freeze over the entire class.

Episodes.Title: Looking Out for Number Two!
Episodes.Description: Ash and Goh dive into the deep waters of the Hoenn region for Goh's trial mission. This time, he's off to catch a wild Kingdra, a Dragon Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: The Gates of Warp! (1)
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket shows up while Ash, Goh and Chloe travel to the Sinnoh region to investigate multiple missing Pokémon reports — including Dawn's Piplup.

Episodes.Title: Showdown at the Gates of Warp! (2)
Episodes.Description: Time's running out and flowing backwards as Ash, Goh and friends enter a strange world and battle alongside different versions of themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Spectral Express!
Episodes.Description: On their way to catch a ride to Stow-on-Side, Ash and Goh take a wild trip aboard a mysterious and eerie ghost train.

Episodes.Title: The Winding Path to Greatness!
Episodes.Description: Hoping to get his Pokémon Gengar to Gigantamax, Ash and Goh look for help from the Ghost-type gym leader, Allister.

Episodes.Title: It's All in the Name!
Episodes.Description: After unusual magnetic waves affect his Magnemite, Francois, Ren works together with Ash, Goh, Chrysa and Professor Cerise to solve the mystery.

Episodes.Title: Suffering the Flings and Arrows!
Episodes.Description: When Lilligant draws the romantic interest of its beloved Heracross, Pinsir is devastated. Could a Pokémon flower arrangement class save the day?

Episodes.Title: The Good, the Bad and the Lucky!
Episodes.Description: Tired of their missions always coming up short, Team Rocket decides to follow Pelipper to find out who's in charge of the Prize Master.

Episodes.Title: Lighting the Way Home!
Episodes.Description: The Space Center plans to use Ampharos' light to guide a satellite back home. But after Ampharos loses confidence, it's up to Sophocles to save the day.

Episodes.Title: An Evolution in Taste!
Episodes.Description: Hoping to add to his collection, Goh brings Ash along with him to Slowpoke Island. After meeting different Slowpokes, they try the local cuisine.

Episodes.Title: Out of Their Elements!
Episodes.Description: Ash, Goh and Chloe visit a Pokémon Circus, where the closing performers run into a problem after the evolutions of their Eevees don't go as planned.

Episodes.Title: Battling Turned Up to Eleven!
Episodes.Description: As the Pokémon World Coronation Series continues, Ash looks to challenge a rising star from the Galar region — but gets wrong directions from Team Yell.

Episodes.Title: Meeting Up with the Monarch!
Episodes.Description: While Goh goes to look for Pokémon in the Galar region, Ash ends up training with one of the world's greatest trainers, Leon.

Episodes.Title: A One-Stick Wonder!
Episodes.Description: Traveling out to the Wild Area, Ash and Goh encounter a Thwackey with a problem: It only seems to have one stick when it needs two.

Episodes.Title: Battling in the Freezing Raid!
Episodes.Description: As he takes on his latest Project Mew trial mission, Goh and a few allies challenge the legendary Pokémon Articuno to a raid battle.

Episodes.Title: The Future Is Now, Thanks to Strategy!
Episodes.Description: To master a new attack, Sirfetch'd gets unexpected help from Dracovish. But will the move be enough for Ash to survive his upcoming battles?

Episodes.Title: Taking Two for the Team!
Episodes.Description: In a battle against Drasna, Ash realizes a strong bond between Pokémon is the most important skill of all.

Episodes.Title: Reuniting for the First Time!
Episodes.Description: While on a visit to Lilycove City to meet a Sylveon, Chloe gets recognized by Lisia, who encourages her to compete in a Pokémon Contest.

Episodes.Title: Radio Lulled the Mischievous Stars!
Episodes.Description: To drum up more support for Team Rocket, Jessie and James take over a radio broadcast and win over some unexpected fans.

Episodes.Title: Big Brother to the Rescue!
Episodes.Description: When the Pokémon in Cerise Park get out of sorts, it's up to a helpful Yamper to set things right again.

Episodes.Title: Catching the Aura of Fate!
Episodes.Description: Hoping to help his Lucario grow stronger, Ash heads to the Kalos region to reconnect with Greninja, who teaches its protégé a thing or two.

Episodes.Title: Aim for the Eight!
Episodes.Description: Ash must survive an entrance battle with a popular trainer to earn a spot in the top eight. But in the arena, all eyes are on the underdog from Kanto.

Episodes.Title: Narrowing the Chaser Chase!
Episodes.Description: On his next trial mission for Project Mew, Goh must win a survival contest in Sea Mauville or he won't qualify as one of the chosen three Chasers.

Episodes.Title: The Homecoming Crown!
Episodes.Description: In a frozen land, Ash, Goh and Chloe search for a rare Pokémon while Lillie and her family hope to reunite with their missing father.

Episodes.Title: Helping the Hometown Hero!
Episodes.Description: Back in the Alola region, Ash joins a Battle Royal with three other trainers. But when any team can attack any Pokémon, who will survive?

Episodes.Title: Chasing to the Finish!
Episodes.Description: Goh competes in his final trial mission for Project Mew: capturing a Regieleki and Regidrago. Will he receive enough tokens to earn the title of Chaser?

Episodes.Title: Friends, Rivals, Lend Me Your Spirit!
Episodes.Description: To prepare for the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash reunites with his many Pokémon partners to battle an old rival and get as strong as possible.

Episodes.Title: Curtain Up! Fight the Fights!
Episodes.Description: The Pokémon World Coronation Series Masters Eight Tournament is underway! Ash arrives at Wyndon Stadium just in time for a battle between Leon and Alain.

Episodes.Title: Pride of a Champion!
Episodes.Description: At the Masters Eight Tournament, Ash, Goh and their new friend Hop watch as Lance goes head to head with Diantha on the stage of dreams.

Episodes.Title: The Fiery Road to Mastership!
Episodes.Description: Ash and his friends cheer on Cynthia and Iris in the third battle of the Masters Eight Tournament. With only one match left, will Ash's training pay off?

Episodes.Title: Battling as Hard as Stone!
Episodes.Description: Ash battles Steven Stone in the Masters Eight Tournament. But can the Alola region champion prove he belongs on the same stage as the toughest trainers?

Episodes.Title: Koharu and Eievui - The Miracle of Evolution
Episodes.Description: Barrierd has launched the so-called "Barri Channel" in order to shed light on the seven wonders of the Sakuragi Laboratories! What it's going to shed light on this time is Koharu's non-evolving Eievui?! Can it solve the mystery of this Eievui?! In addition, the radio show "You Are Swift Radio" is soliciting listeners to submit their problems?!

Episodes.Title: Infinite Possibilities!
Episodes.Description: On a camping trip with her family, Chloe encounters friends from her father's past who help guide her in her decision whether or not to evolve Eevee.

Episodes.Title: The Climax Begins! Satoshi's Masters Tournament Experience!!
Episodes.Description: The Pokémon World Championships semifinals are starting any minute now! But first, PWCS News will bring us an exclusive, thorough analysis of the Masters Tournament! They'll present all kinds of material ranging from analyses of the various competitors to confidential information on them! In addition, the radio show "A Dragon Dive Into Your Hearts" will present letters from its listeners!

Episodes.Title: It's... Champion Time! (1)
Episodes.Description: On the morning of Leon and Diantha's battle, Ash and Cynthia run into two young fans who are full of questions about selecting Pokémon partners.

Episodes.Title: Bewitch, Battle, and Bewilder! (2)
Episodes.Description: In the semifinals, the Sinnoh region champion Cynthia battles the very first Alola region champion Ash for the chance to take on the undefeated Leon.

Episodes.Title: Valor: A Strategic Part of Battling! (3)
Episodes.Description: As the epic battle continues, underdog Ash struggles to keep up with champion Cynthia's aggressive strategy — but he won't go down without a fight.

Episodes.Title: Whittle While You Work! (4)
Episodes.Description: The battle rages on, but Ash is down to his last Pokémon: Lucario. Can the power of their bond see them through to a victory over the Sinnoh champion?

Episodes.Title: GO FOR DREAM! Go's Road to Mew!!
Episodes.Description: A suspicious shadow is sneaking up on Go's Smartphone Rotom in the hotel room he and Satoshi are staying at in Shoot City in the Galar region... We'll be shedding light on the info on Go's Pokémon and the top secret data on Project Mew contained within?! In addition, the radio show "A Blaze Kick After School" will be doing a special on childhood friends!!

Episodes.Title: Just a Scone's Throw from Here!
Episodes.Description: On the eve of the finals, Ash and Goh enjoy a day off in town and run into a group of Nickit who've become popular for teaching other Pokémon to behave.

Episodes.Title: Climax! The Night Before the Decisive Battle! Satoshi VS Dande!!
Episodes.Description: It's time for the Masters Tournament Finals, which will determine who's the best in the world, and PWCS News is doing a special that will present the finals the world is eagerly awaiting in greater detail than anywhere else! The special will provide a thorough coverage of not only highlights of Satoshi and Dande's battles, but also of the various encounters between the two! In addition, the special has obtained some exclusive news it's going to break?!

Episodes.Title: A Flood of Torrential Gains! (1)
Episodes.Description: While Goh answers an emergency call from Project Mew, Ash heads into the finals of the Masters Eight Tournament, where Leon requests a full power battle.

Episodes.Title: Toying with Your Motions! (2)
Episodes.Description: With each competitor down to their final five Pokémon, the battle wages. Ash fights to get an advantage over Leon, who effortlessly sets the pace.

Episodes.Title: Paring Pokémon While Parrying! (3)
Episodes.Description: The fierce battle to determine who the strongest trainer is continues. Will Ash manage to see himself through to the ultimate victory?

Episodes.Title: Partners in Time! (4)
Episodes.Description: The mysterious appearance of a legendary Eternatus above Wyndon Stadium grants Ash and Leon a bonus round, where it comes down to partner versus partner.

Episodes.Title: The Mew from Here!
Episodes.Description: After picking up psychic energy signals, the Chasers set out to scale treacherous Table Mountain in search of Mew... but find surprises along the way.

Episodes.Title: In the Palms of Our Hands!
Episodes.Description: On Faraway Island, the Chasers make a startling discovery and find themselves transported to a mysterious realm, where Goh connects with an old friend.

Episodes.Title: Heroes Unite!
Episodes.Description: Goh has a new ambition to become a trainer worthy of partnering with Mew — but he's not sure how to broach the topic while camping with Ash and Chloe.

Episodes.Title: This Could Be the Start of Something Big!
Episodes.Description: An epic battle with a legendary Pokémon reignites the fire in both Ash and Goh's hearts. But before they set out on new journeys, they must say goodbye.

Episodes.Title: The Road Most Traveled!
Episodes.Description: While walking through the woods, Ash takes a random path that leads him to exciting encounters with many different types of Pokémon — and enemies.

Episodes.Title: A Fated Face-Off!
Episodes.Description: Misty believes she's connected to a wild Clauncher by fate. Ash thinks his Corphish called dibs on it first. The only solution? A fishing battle!

Episodes.Title: Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!
Episodes.Description: To cheer up a heartsick Brock, Ash and his friends take him to a nearby flower field, where he gets lost chasing after a tricky Psychic-type Pokémon.

Episodes.Title: Bearing Down Easy!
Episodes.Description: On a snowy mountaintop, Ash and the team try to help a gloomy Beartic by encouraging it to regain control of its ice powers.

Episodes.Title: A Squad's Worth of Passion!
Episodes.Description: Ash and friends decide to cheer on their old pal Squirtle at the Firefighting Squad Show, but the famous Pokémon's managers won't let the group say hi.

Episodes.Title: The Same Moon, Now and Forever!
Episodes.Description: When Team Rocket causes Pikachu to get separated from the rest of his group, Ash relies on their strong connection to track down his best friend.

Episodes.Title: Ride, Lapras, Ride!
Episodes.Description: A friendly Lapras takes Ash to a remote island, where a fellow Water-type needs the trainer's help. But Ash can't rescue the trapped Pokémon alone.

Episodes.Title: Getting to the Heart of It All!
Episodes.Description: When a supernatural entity starts stealing heart-shaped objects from houses in a small town, Ash, Brock and Misty team up to solve the mystery.

Episodes.Title: Rocket Revengers!
Episodes.Description: Team Rocket goes on a revenge mission to capture more Pokémon for their boss. The first step? Sending a Mime Jr. to gain Pikachu's trust.

Episodes.Title: Ash and Latios!
Episodes.Description: Latias takes Ash on a journey to figure out what happened to Latios. But rescuing the legendary Pokémon becomes a bigger battle than they bargained for.

Episodes.Title: The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!
Episodes.Description: As the group splits up, Ash and Pikachu return to Pallet Town, where they get some much-needed relaxation — before Team Rocket shows up.

Entries.Title: Solo Leveling
Entries.Description: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

Episodes.Title: I'm Used to It
Episodes.Description: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

Episodes.Title: If I Had One More Chance
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

Episodes.Title: It's Like a Game
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

Episodes.Title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
Episodes.Description: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

Episodes.Title: A Pretty Good Deal
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

Episodes.Title: The Real Hunt Begins
Episodes.Description: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

Episodes.Title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
Episodes.Description: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

Episodes.Title: This Is Frustrating
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

Episodes.Title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
Episodes.Description: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

Episodes.Title: What Is This, a Picnic?
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

Episodes.Title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
Episodes.Description: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

Episodes.Title: Arise
Episodes.Description: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

Episodes.Title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You
Episodes.Description: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

Episodes.Title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
Episodes.Description: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

Episodes.Title: Still a Long Way to Go
Episodes.Description: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

Episodes.Title: I Need to Stop Faking
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

Episodes.Title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
Episodes.Description: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

Episodes.Title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
Episodes.Description: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

Episodes.Title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
Episodes.Description: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: It Was All Worth It
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

Episodes.Title: We Need a Hero
Episodes.Description: Sparks fly as the S-rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

Episodes.Title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
Episodes.Description: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

Episodes.Title: Are You the King of Humans
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

Episodes.Title: On to the Next Target
Episodes.Description: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Once the greatest hitman of all, Taro Sakamoto retired in the name of love. But when his past catches up, he must fight to protect his beloved family.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

Episodes.Title: Just Desserts
Episodes.Description: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

Episodes.Title: Strong Assault
Episodes.Description: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

Episodes.Title: Round and Round the Tower
Episodes.Description: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.

Episodes.Title: Slice Slice Dance
Episodes.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
Entries.Description: Oggy, an anthropomorphic cat, would prefer to spend his days watching television and eating, but is continuously pestered by three roaches: Joey, Marky and Dee Dee. The cockroaches' slapstick mischief ranges from plundering Oggy's refrigerator to hijacking the train he just boarded. In many situations Oggy is also helped by Jack, who is more violent and short-tempered than him and is also annoyed by the cockroaches. Bob, a short-tempered bulldog, also appears in the show, and is Oggy's neighbor.

Episodes.Title: Bitter Chocolate
Episodes.Description: Oggy gets a box of cherry-chocolates delivered to his home and goes inside to enjoy them. However, the roaches - Joey, Marky and Dee Dee have decided to take it for themselves, and a chase begins throughout the house. Jack nurses Oggy and vows to get back the box of sweets, even if it involves blowing up the house.

Episodes.Title: It's All Under Control
Episodes.Description: During an afternoon, Jack is snoozing on his hammock while Oggy is tending the garden. The cockroaches jump into Jack's head so that they can control him to wreak havoc on Oggy.

Episodes.Title: The Lottery Ticket
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack won the lottery ticket number for a massive sum of money, but the cockroaches want the lottery ticket for the much-needed money as well.

Episodes.Title: The Time Machine
Episodes.Description: Poor Oggy, as usual, gets in an accident involving Jack against the cockroaches in retaliation of his cake being eaten, ending up being squashed into a disk. To make sure he'll never repeat that mistake twice, Jack builds a time machine to go back in time and prevent the accident. Unfortunately for him, turning forward - and back - the clock may yield unwanted results.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Babies
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack, after eradicating the cockroaches from their house, receive 3 baby kittens that look like Jack - little do they knew and suspect that these bundles of joy are actually the roaches in disguise, obviously in retaliation for being kicked out of the house.

Episodes.Title: So Lonely
Episodes.Description: Oggy finally manages to remove the cockroaches out of his home permanently, but gradually regrets doing so, as he starts to miss them, leading to a severe tantrum.

Episodes.Title: Baby Doll
Episodes.Description: Oggy is playing with his doll and its included playhouse. The cockroaches, however, have taken the playhouse for themselves and when Marky spots the doll, he falls in love with it. This results in Oggy making an all-out siege on the playhouse to take back what's rightfully his.

Episodes.Title: A Tip for the Road
Episodes.Description: Oggy, in order to get his driver's license, takes driving lessons with the driving instructor. The cockroaches, of course, try their best to shift the chaos into turbo.

Episodes.Title: A Dog Day Afternoon
Episodes.Description: Oggy arrives at home after shopping and trips over a small pup. He takes it inside and start pinching his own nose as a squeezing toy to play with the pup. When Jack arrives he, of course, begins to think that Oggy has gone crazy as Jack and the pup are not seen simultaneously.

Episodes.Title: It's a Long Way Down
Episodes.Description: While Jack takes up mountain climbing, Oggy intends on reading a good book from his library, only to end up getting stranded in some very high book shelves by the cockroaches, while Jack is having problems of his own at the mountain. Looks like it's going to be a real long way down for both of our feline friends...

Episodes.Title: Bugball
Episodes.Description: Oggy gets his hands on a new, super bouncing-ball. He decides to try it out and it soon bounces all over the house, wrecking everything in its path. And things don't get any better when Joey accidentally swallows it.

Episodes.Title: Emergency Room
Episodes.Description: Oggy was sent to the hospital when he tripped over down the stairs in pursuit while Jack watched over him. Unfortunately for him, the cockroaches decide to take a visit to the hospital - just to make an already bad situation worse for Oggy.

Episodes.Title: Occupied
Episodes.Description: Oggy desperately needs to use the bathroom, but the cockroaches have it occupied and do all what they can to keep him out.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Magic Broom
Episodes.Description: A wizard quietly sleeps over at Oggy's house for the duration of the day. Meanwhile, the cockroaches fight over the usage of his flying broom against Oggy.

Episodes.Title: The Dictator
Episodes.Description: While helping to catch the cockroaches, Jack starts acting like a ruthless, superior-minded Dictator to Oggy, reducing him to a downtrodden proletariat - an action he will live and come to regret, as that will evolve into a struggle between control and freedom...

Episodes.Title: Duck Soup
Episodes.Description: Jack and Oggy were making and preparing Duck Soup for their dinner, with the main ingredient being the duck itself – until a lot of its angry, protesting friends show up.

Episodes.Title: The Piggy Bank
Episodes.Description: Oggy puts a solid padlock on the fridge to stop the cockroaches pesky behaviour.

Episodes.Title: The Rise and the Fall
Episodes.Description: Jack is building a skyscraper in Oggy's back garden. However, when helping in the making of this building, Oggy experiences a complete acrophobia until Jack helps to get him to sleep. But the problems are just getting started. Oggy is sleepwalking, and to make matters worse, the cockroaches are around to sabotage the skyscraper at all costs.

Episodes.Title: Deep End
Episodes.Description: Taking a simple bath soon escalates into a desperate struggle for Oggy when the cockroaches sabotage it, especially when our blue feline can't swim and has a severe case of hydrophobia. Can Jack help him overcome this seaborne problem?

Episodes.Title: It's a Small World
Episodes.Description: Using a photocopier, Oggy shrinks himself down to the cockroaches' size in order to infiltrate their home and take back the key to his padlocked fridge.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Oggy invites his date over to his house for dinner. However, he starts to get jealous when cockroach Marky falls in love with her. And soon, this jealousy will escalate a brawl...

Episodes.Title: Go Slow With Your Dough
Episodes.Description: Jack has to pay a debt. He brings into Oggy's house a suitcase full of money, for Oggy to look after it. And Oggy becomes paranoid knowing that all that money is in his house.

Episodes.Title: Tooth Good to be True
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Oggy receive money from the tooth fairy, Joey plans on getting some himself. He is unwilling to give this up, even if this means losing all of his teeth in the process.

Episodes.Title: One Track Life
Episodes.Description: While Jack is hooked on video games, Oggy tries to pass the time by playing with a train set. However, when the cockroaches come aboard, he soon becomes a part of their roller coaster.

Episodes.Title: The Carnival's in Town
Episodes.Description: The carnival has come to town, and Oggy and Jack are more than happy to go into it. Unfortunately, the cockroaches also decide to go the carnival, just to have massive fun wreaking havoc all over the place...

Episodes.Title: Mouseagator
Episodes.Description: After seeing Oggy's new remote-controlled lawnmower, the cockroaches forge their own cat-destroyer machine that looks like a mouse, but acts like an alligator.

Episodes.Title: Nine Months and Counting
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches' latest prank on Oggy has them inflating his stomach, making him think that he's pregnant. However, he'll soon find out that only girls can have babies, and not boys...

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Magic Flute
Episodes.Description: After seeing a snake charmer on TV, Oggy decides to make his own flute, in which he steals a car part from his neighbour Bob. Upon adding holes to it, Oggy plays it and unwittingly hypnotises cockroach Marky into being a dog that would remain loyal to him, much to the dismay of cockroaches Dee Dee and Joey.

Episodes.Title: 3 Wishes and Your Out
Episodes.Description: A bedouin, who is lost and parched in as desert, finds a magic lamp. He uses his three wishes to get a palace, a pile of gold and lovely girls - but he forgets to wish for water. The genie flees after being attacked by the infuriated bedouin and of course, ends up in Oggy's house.

Episodes.Title: Virtual Voyage
Episodes.Description: It's all out Cyberspace War as Oggy, with his vacuum cleaner, and Joey takes the daring voyage in the internet in order to return to the real world - however, system errors, bugs, power flows and even Jack himself are hellbent on slowing Oggy and Joey down...

Episodes.Title: Granny's Day
Episodes.Description: Oggy's granny comes to visit. It's her birthday and what she wants is three dead cockroaches.

Episodes.Title: Beachcombers
Episodes.Description: Oggy is going to the beach for what he thinks will be a relaxing day off. What he doesn't notice, is that the cockroaches has decided to tag along. And when Oggy and the cockroaches are near each other, trouble is bound to happen.

Episodes.Title: Heatwave
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches fight Oggy over getting a sun tan. Their main scheme this time has them in a tire-made hot-air balloon under the guise of a rain cloud.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Clone
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches play a hit-and-run prank where they frame Oggy by dressing up as him and attacking Jack.

Episodes.Title: Race to the Finish
Episodes.Description: Jack bought Oggy a remote control car and they want to race with them, but then the cars are now annoyances and chasing - and chased by - the cockroaches to run them all over.

Episodes.Title: Mission Oggy
Episodes.Description: After getting himself trapped in a drink bottle, cockroach Dee Dee is kidnapped by Oggy and locked up in the fridge. Upon seeing this, Marky and Joey attempt to get past Oggy's newly installed defences and save their fellow roach by all means, at all costs.

Episodes.Title: Blue Sunday
Episodes.Description: Jack takes Oggy on a Sunday trip with the beach as the destination. The cockroaches decide to tag along. But trouble is always around the corner when the cockroaches are placed in a small space (Jack's car in this case) together with the two cats.

Episodes.Title: Metamorphosis
Episodes.Description: After consuming a piece of irradiated chocolate (obviously placed in the box by the cockroaches), Oggy transmutates into a cockroach himself! How will Jack react to this?

Episodes.Title: The Hiccup
Episodes.Description: What started out as a sip from a simple cup of coffee turns into intensely strong hiccups for Oggy. And while attempting to steal his fridge, the cockroaches get involved with his situation.

Episodes.Title: Globulopolis
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee is just swimming on Oggy's yogurt, when, unknown to him, Oggy drinks it up, and Dee Dee along with it. Dee Dee then travels around Oggy's insides and decides to give Oggy the mother of all indigestions.

Episodes.Title: House for Rent
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches rent Oggy's house to a redneck who kicks Oggy out. In trying to get his house back, Oggy finally rents it out to a wrestler who is even worse.

Episodes.Title: Fishing Frolic
Episodes.Description: Jack takes Oggy on a fishing trip, with neither of them knowing that cockroach Dee Dee has come along with them. While Jack keeps a large fish at bay, Oggy is learning how to fish whereas Dee Dee is eating all of the bait.

Episodes.Title: Space Roaches
Episodes.Description: Three alien cockroaches from another world (obviously genetically resembling Dee Dee, Marky and Joey) visit Oggy's household. They constantly shape-shift Oggy and Jack into different objects and share good moments with the regular cockroaches.

Episodes.Title: It's Been a Hard Days Noise
Episodes.Description: Oggy wants to listen to his music CD in peace, but the cockroaches decide to pump up the volume into and beyond acceptable limits.

Episodes.Title: Rock 'n Roll Altitude
Episodes.Description: Oggy has a fear of flying, and while taking him on a flight, Jack tries hypnosis to help him relax. However, while a relaxed Oggy has gone walkabout around the plane, the cockroaches have come aboard as well, in which they leave all of the pilots tied up and gagged in order for them to cause the usual sabotage.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Night Out
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack have a meal out at a fancy restaurant. Unfortunately, things take an unexpected and a real bad turn, as the cockroaches are stealing their orders and Jack can't wait any longer to tuck in.

Episodes.Title: TV Obsession
Episodes.Description: Oggy is hooked onto his favourite TV program. However, this doesn't stop the cockroaches from having fun, by locking his TV in a safe.

Episodes.Title: Abominable Snow Moth
Episodes.Description: Things go upside down in the winter when the abominable snow moth came into and eats any yarn in its path in Oggy's home. How would Oggy respond to this cotton-involving incident?

Episodes.Title: Docu-Mentally
Episodes.Description: Oggy gets a video camera in the mail and attempts to film the cockroaches' final demise. However, just as he could get to watching the end of it, the roaches decide to get their ultimate revenge by stealing his tape and recording him in the most humiliating way possible.

Episodes.Title: Bait Bites Back
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack were going fishing but Oggy try to catch the cockroaches as baits - and these baits sure can bite back!

Episodes.Title: Cat Kit
Episodes.Description: Jack arrives with a put-it-together-yourself roach-catching trap. When he tries to get some silence to work, the cockroaches try their best in causing as much noise as possible. This forces poor Oggy to try and keep them quiet, which is easier said than done.

Episodes.Title: A Bird of Ill Omen
Episodes.Description: Oggy is minding his own business, watering his flowers when a turkey comes running and hides behind his back. Shortly after, a visually impaired hunter appears from the hedge. The hunter has a problem, and so is for Oggy: because of his poor eyesight, turkeys looks like Oggy to him and Oggy looks vice-versa.

Episodes.Title: Memory Lane
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds some old love letters from a girl he used to go to school with. However, the cockroaches play a more rotten than usual prank, which involves faking a date and replacing Oggy's deodorant with insect repellent that stinks so badly.

Episodes.Title: A Truce for Christmas
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches are planning on ruining Oggy's Christmas but after they are thrown outside, Oggy makes a truce between them. Meanwhile, Jack must survive a huge snow storm to get to Oggy's house for Chrismtas.

Episodes.Title: The Patient
Episodes.Description: Jack ends up frozen in a block of ice while chasing the cockroaches so Oggy nurses him. Unfortunately the cockroaches have changed Jack's medicine for an evil concoction of their own.

Episodes.Title: The Neighbor's Cat
Episodes.Description: The fat neighbor woman treated Oggy as a pet cat when the real neighbor's cat made it happen - and the cockroaches want Oggy stay that way by all means.

Episodes.Title: Monster from the Mud Lagoon
Episodes.Description: Oggy watched a scary movie about a Monster from the Mud lagoon while Jack tripped over a mud and Oggy believed Jack is really the monster. The cockroaches try all what they have in their sleeves to intensify Oggy's fear of Jack.

Episodes.Title: The Wrong Side of the Bed
Episodes.Description: Superstitious Oggy finds out that today is Friday the 13th, and starts acting paranoid. And as always, the cockroaches are willing to take full advantage of his dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Honeymoon
Episodes.Description: While Oggy was eating honey or jam, it brings along an old bee woman which cockroach Joey is in love with, starting up a literal honeymoon - involving irritating Oggy.

Episodes.Title: French Fries
Episodes.Description: After making some french fries, Oggy intends on having a well-deserved snack... that is, if he can take them back from the cockroaches first.

Episodes.Title: Oggy vs. Super Roach
Episodes.Description: While repairing the roaches' TV in one stormy night, Dee Dee is struck by lightning, which gives him superhuman strength. However, Dee Dee lets this get to his head, causing him to be a bully toward Oggy and even to his fellow roaches, Marky and Joey.

Episodes.Title: Oggy Van Winkle
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches receive a zapping from Oggy's newly found Chronofreezer gun. They eventually wake up (thanks to a poodle marking its territory on them) in the future where they see Oggy and Jack at a very old age. The cockroaches decide to take advantage of this, which results in a chaotic fight the future has never seen before.

Episodes.Title: Beware Of Destruction
Episodes.Description: Jack is renovating Oggy's house and when the cockroaches steal his cement tray to use it as a swimming pool. Unfortunately, Jack ends up as a statue when the cockroaches put cement in his drink. Worse yet, they are about to take full advantage of his severe disadvantage.

Episodes.Title: Shake Oggy Shake
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack were washing clothes and dishes for chores but, for obvious reasons, the cockroaches crank Oggy's coffee up QUITE a notch as to make Oggy do everything very fast.

Episodes.Title: The Ghost Hunter
Episodes.Description: After Oggy finishes them off once and for all with a frying pan, the cockroaches come back as ghosts and constantly make nightmares a reality for poor old Oggy. Will Oggy be able to put down this paranormal paranoia he has created, and how will he do it - or is it all over for his sanity?

Episodes.Title: Caught in a Trap
Episodes.Description: Oggy wakes up and finds his house completely messed up. The cockroaches have yet again plundered his fridge and caused a mess which makes Oggy's eyes pop out of his head. He is now forced to protect the fridge as best as he can.

Episodes.Title: Winner Takes All
Episodes.Description: Conflict begins between Oggy and Jack after cockroach Joey sabotages a game of chess just by stealing one of the pieces.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Diet
Episodes.Description: Overweight Oggy decides to keep fit, much to the dismay of the cockroaches. What can those pests do to this situation? By performing the usual sabotages to make sure Oggy stays the way he is.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Horrors
Episodes.Description: Oggy was just minding his business, gardening the grass while the cockroaches made it worse by making them bigger.

Episodes.Title: Cloning Around
Episodes.Description: Jack is tired of the weak, useless Toxins in the Insecticide. He decides to enhance it by using his new Chemistry Set. The result is... a Gas that has the ability to clone the subject it used on.

Episodes.Title: A Night at the Opera
Episodes.Description: Jack is now a tenor and is making a performance at the opera. Dee Dee wishes to join in and tries to team up with him. Jack, however, tosses Dee Dee in a trashcan as his way of saying "no". But it will take more than that to break Dee Dee's dream, as he is trying to ruin the performance and take it all for himself.

Episodes.Title: Toys R Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy has found a lot of new toys for him to play with during Christmas Eve, but when an extended boxing glove punched Jack, his brain was knocked out of him and the cockroaches use it as a toy - and an initiative to make the holiday matters for Oggy worse.

Episodes.Title: Loony Balloons
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack share a ride in a remote-controlled hot-air balloon. However, it soon becomes a joyride when their remote ends up in the cockroaches' hands.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Giant Roaches
Episodes.Description: Oggy believes he's seeing things big, really big, after the cockroaches implant binocular lenses into his eyes.

Episodes.Title: Oggy goes Snailing
Episodes.Description: Oggy found a poor snail and kept it as a pet and bought a lot of snails he enjoy. However, he is about to be in for one slippery ride...

Episodes.Title: Happy Campers
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack go camping and, after a number of mishaps, starting with Dee Dee eating a plant that causes hallucinations to the user, upset a wild boar who follows them home.

Episodes.Title: The Outsider
Episodes.Description: A mouse makes his way into Oggy's household, taking whatever he wants, namely food and shelter. Unfortunately, Oggy has a fear of mice and the cockroaches aren't getting on well with this uninvited guest.

Episodes.Title: Happy Birthday
Episodes.Description: The good news: Oggy is having a birthday party, and Jack's invited (he stacks champagne glasses for the party). The weird news: the cockroaches are also invited, and up to no good again, as usual. Even worse, Oggy develops suicidal tendencies later on following an unintentional accident (which Jack triggered), forcing Jack to try and protect him for as long as he can, even if it means taking the lumps himself.

Episodes.Title: Missing in Action
Episodes.Description: A jog in the park with Jack goes wrong for Oggy when he trips over, causing him to try and catch up. However, as always, the cockroaches are around to make matters worse for the blue feline.

Episodes.Title: Ski Bugs
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are hoping to relax at a ski resort. However, the cockroaches once again follow them, and trick Oggy into sledding down a dangerous slope. Can Jack save him?

Episodes.Title: Fame & Glory
Episodes.Description: Oggy really want to go to the circus but had no money so Jack made a circus for himself, including the people and, unfortunately for the 2 felines, the cockroaches.

Episodes.Title: Hip Hip Hip Hypnoses
Episodes.Description: Marky learns to do hypnosis and want to hypnotize Oggy for anything.

Episodes.Title: All Out of Shape
Episodes.Description: While Oggy was playing and using his limitless imagination with clay, the cockroaches uses a clay Oggy as a voodoo doll to literally shape Oggy's life into a wreck in all the ways possible.

Episodes.Title: Roachy Redneck
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches have a redneck cockroach visitor (their father) and can make plants come to life which Oggy is enjoying... until he gets overconfident.

Episodes.Title: Love & Kisses
Episodes.Description: Oggy's sister, Monica comes over for a visit, whereas Jack is in love and tries to be a thrillseeker like her. However, love and kisses won't be for long, as the Cockroaches try their best to ruin it.

Episodes.Title: Milk Diet
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee wins a cow in a lottery.In prize he brings the cow to Oggy's house. Now for profits,the three got a bull.But it backfires on both of them.

Episodes.Title: The Techno-files
Episodes.Description: Jack decides to help Oggy by showing him his inventions, purely designed for cockroach removal - which is, in fact, overcomplex and technologically advanced versions of the flyswatter.

Episodes.Title: Wash Day
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches, in an attempt to give Dee Dee a bath, turn the entire suburban region into an ocean, and Oggy's just woken up to that. Can our blue feline make it back into the house, or will the cockroaches dampen any more of his plans?

Episodes.Title: Saturday Black Fever
Episodes.Description: Oggy strikes oil whislt doing a spot of gardening. Through this, he can earn a BIG profit, which brings attention to the cockroaches.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Shopping
Episodes.Description: Oggy arrives at the supermart, and the cockroaches have tagged along. Soon, their never-ending quabble results in Oggy knocking down a huge pile of detergent. Oggy is kicked out by the security guard and is forced to disguise himself in order to enter the shop and complete his errands.

Episodes.Title: Perpetual Motion
Episodes.Description: While repairing a broken remote Jack accidentally creates a device that can control time. Chaos breaks out while he tries out this new toy, and things does not get better when the cockroaches get ahold of the item.

Episodes.Title: Sleepless Night
Episodes.Description: Oggy returns home after a night out with Jack and only wants to go to sleep but the cockroaches have other ideas.

Episodes.Title: Saving Private Dee Dee
Episodes.Description: Oggy, being sick and tired of having his vegetable patch invaded by the cockroaches, decides to protect his vegetables with an electric barbed wire fence. However, cockroach Dee Dee is trapped in the patch, and is soon adopted as a child by a hedgehog. Can Dee Dee's fellow roaches help him break out?

Episodes.Title: Life's a Beach
Episodes.Description: Jack made the backyard a beach for everyone to do whatever they had in mind, but all Oggy gets is nothing but disaster from the customers, and needs all the urgent help he can get - even if it means from the cockroaches in person.

Episodes.Title: Laughing Gas
Episodes.Description: Jack's latest device at eliminating the cockroaches from the house ends up in the wrong hands when they manage to get Oggy to drink it. What's more, they're armed with some real wacky laughing gas as well.

Episodes.Title: Walls have Ears
Episodes.Description: On a rainy day, Oggy and Jack are watching TV when a thunderstorm damages the antenna. Oggy is sent to repair it, but a thunder hits him as well and he falls into muddy water full of snails, which makes him able to trespass walls.

Episodes.Title: Hit the Road Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy plans on going caravanning but the cockroaches continually ruin it for him. Don't miss the last few seconds of the cartoon.

Episodes.Title: Face Off
Episodes.Description: When Oggy gets himself - and his original face - anviled by another prank the cockroaches made, Jack decides to take him to the plastic surgery to fix the problem. Unfortunately, misunderstanding and cockroach intervention will lead to severe and literral defacing - and it will be pretty ugly, too.

Episodes.Title: Penguin Pandemonium
Episodes.Description: Oggy and cockroach Dee Dee wake up to find their fridge-freezer occupied by a penguin and its egg. It's (quite) obvious what this hostile occupation by a polar bird leads to...

Episodes.Title: Penalty Shot
Episodes.Description: After watching a game of soccer on TV, cockroach Joey introduces it to Dee Dee and Marky, and decide to have their own game. However, they soon learn that finding the perfect pitch is no walk in the park.

Episodes.Title: That's the Last Straw!
Episodes.Description: When all else fails for Oggy to eliminate the cockroaches once and for all, then there is always one last resort... this time, the cockroaches attempt to fool Oggy into thinking there's a meteor coming.

Episodes.Title: Going Up
Episodes.Description: The stairs at Oggy's house are too long, and is difficult for him to climb them up when chasing the cockroaches. So, he buys an elevator for making it easier to go to the second floor. But soon, cockroaches make everything go out of control.

Episodes.Title: Copy Cat
Episodes.Description: When the cockroaches break the ear of one of Oggy's most precious figurines, he gets so frustrated and heart-broken that he simply sits still in the sofa, holding the rest of the broken ear in his hand. The cockroaches decide to build a robot to take Oggy's place in chasing them - a decision they will come and live to regret.

Episodes.Title: High Flyers
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee and Joey have decided they want to fly and Marky is the test subject in a number of very unsuccessful attempts.

Episodes.Title: The Wonder Whistle
Episodes.Description: Oggy receives a time-freezing whistle in the mail (along with some ear muffs). But when the cockroaches take notice of this, they trick him into thinking that he has frozen them in time. And upon doing so, they steal the whistle while Oggy's asleep and cause mayhem in the city.

Episodes.Title: The Hungry Ostrich Empire
