Episodes.Description: Oggy is left to look after an ostrich for Jack. While it starts eating anything around the house, the cockroaches get involved with the ostrich chase. Dee Dee and Marky want to eat it, whereas Joey wants to ride it.

Episodes.Title: Lost in Space
Episodes.Description: Oggy is on the duty of looking after a space station. However, the cockroaches have come aboard to cause the usual mischief, this time in the deep, dark, inky depths of the final frontier.

Episodes.Title: Working Cat
Episodes.Description: With electricity bills and economic shortage (lack of food and money), Oggy decides to take up a job test in order to look for work. One of the few episodes where the cockroaches support him.

Episodes.Title: Beware of the Bodyguard
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches are causing the usual trouble, again. Oggy is sick and tired of them bullying him all the time (at least more than he usually is), so he decides to get... a bodyguard.

Episodes.Title: Go for it, Jack
Episodes.Description: Oggy wanted to play table tennis but Jack got busy trying to impress Oggy’s sister. The three cockroaches Joey, Marky and Dee Dee tried their best to ruin Jack’s attempts but Jack ended up conquering his love. Very romantic indeed.

Episodes.Title: Soldier for a Day
Episodes.Description: Oggy is drafted into the Army, given the fact that he is fit for service, and the cockroaches decide to come along and cause havoc in the Boot Camp.

Episodes.Title: Do Not Lean out of the Window
Episodes.Description: Oggy's taking a train home, apparently - until the cockroaches decide to give him their own brand of handling the railways.

Episodes.Title: The Joker Joked
Episodes.Description: Oggy prepares to meet up with his date, and her parents. However, a mix-up in the mail results in Oggy wearing the wrong attire: a magician's suit.

Episodes.Title: 7 Minutes & Counting
Episodes.Description: After Oggy is bitten by a poisonous snake, Jack has to take care of him. However, the cockroaches try to prevent him from doing so, as well as allowing the poison inside of Oggy to kick in.

Episodes.Title: Un-Bear-able Bears
Episodes.Description: Carneval time! Oggy and Jack decide to dress up in different costumes. But the costumes soon causes a serious misunderstanding not only between the cats, but between two bears as well.

Episodes.Title: Warning! Boa on the Run
Episodes.Description: Upon returning from a picnic to the zoo with Jack, Oggy finds a Boa Constrictor in his picnic basket. In the process, it consumes almost everything in the house, namely Jack and the Cockroaches. Can this large reptile be taken back to the zoo before it gets indigestion?

Episodes.Title: Hide and Sick
Episodes.Description: Oggy is having a sick day recently - and the Cockroaches are out to take advantage of his current situation all the while Jack is trying to cure Oggy from his illness, resulting in a hide-and-seek game of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Mayday Mayday!
Episodes.Description: Oggy's cruise trip is rudely interrupted by cockroach Dee Dee while Jack, Marky and Joey are feeling... seasick.

Episodes.Title: Green Peace
Episodes.Description: Oggy attempts to get a pine tree ready in time for Christmas, despite a dispute involving his inner-angel and inner-demon. To add insult to injury (or was it the other way around?), his inner-demon joins forces with the cockroaches and attempt to destroy all of the trees Oggy prepares for Christmas Time.

Episodes.Title: My Beautiful Prison
Episodes.Description: Oggy is given a treasure map by the cockroaches. However, in order to get this 'treasure,' Oggy must break INTO a maximum security prison. The result... an all-out Prison siege.

Episodes.Title: Mission To Earth
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Joey unwittingly catapult themselves to another planet. They later see a spaceship leading toward the invasion of Earth from aliens disguised as garden gnomes. The directive is clear and the imperative is obvious now: terminate the gnome aliens' invasion permanently and get back to Earth at once.

Episodes.Title: Jack-In-A-Box
Episodes.Description: Jack shows Oggy a machine that can transform objects into other things (i.e. transforming a cow into dairy products). But when the cockroaches throw Jack into the machine, Oggy makes his attempt to save him - even if it costs him his sane physical form.

Episodes.Title: The Blob
Episodes.Description: After Oggy receives a lava lamp-like object from the post, the cockroaches release the blob from inside of it, which then starts growing and eating anything in its path.

Episodes.Title: Barbecue
Episodes.Description: Oggy is enjoying a barbecue in his garden and Jack is unsuccessfully trying to fly a kite. When he (Jack) gets wrapped in the line the cockroaches are using for their tennis ball, he starts a mayhem. The mayhem soon escalates and involves them all, including Bob and the Hawk living in Oggy's tree.

Episodes.Title: Off Limits
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches move into Bob's home, taking Oggy's TV, fridge and money with them. After reasoning fails him, Oggy tries to win back his key possessions by force.

Episodes.Title: Golf Curse
Episodes.Description: Jack believes he is a good golfer but his caddy, Oggy, knows he isn't. Both suffer from attacks from the targets of Jack's wild swings.

Episodes.Title: Up To No Good
Episodes.Description: While having a roast chicken cooked, Oggy finds a switch in his garden, which unveils a mountain from underneath his house. Unfortunately, the cockroaches have already made it into the house, awaiting his meal. Can Oggy make it back in, even with an encounter from a disco-dancing yeti?

Episodes.Title: Don't Rock the Cradle
Episodes.Description: Oggy is left to look after the baby of Jack and Monica while they were far away, which is, however, easier said than done, as the cockroaches are all hellbent on making this babysitting job a challenge.

Episodes.Title: The Pied Bagpiper
Episodes.Description: Oggy encounters the Loch Ness Monster in his swimming pool. Whilst he tries all his best to look after it, the cockroaches want to get rid of it by all means, at all costs - even if it means their physical health.

Episodes.Title: Magic Carpet Ride
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a new carpet, which turns out to be a magic carpet, able to fly. When the cockroaches tie explosives to it, it goes out of control and Jack must save Oggy, who can't control the carpet.

Episodes.Title: Safari so good
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are on safari on Africa. Dee Dee is there too, and is trying to ruin the trip. After monkeys steal their safari truck, Oggy and Jack must devise several ways to try to escape from the African wilderness.

Episodes.Title: Strike!
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches' game of pick-up sticks is interrupted by Oggy, who is bowling. However, when Jack comes over, a chase begins, leading both cats to a real bowling alley.

Episodes.Title: A Tooth for a Tooth
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches are pulling yet another prank on poor Oggy. This time, they put massive, fake teeth in his mouth. Oggy is forced to call his old friend Jack in order to get rid of his new, oversized teeth.

Episodes.Title: What A Dump
Episodes.Description: Oggy's latest attempt at removing the cockroaches results in them (including our blue feline) taking a one way ticket to the rubbish tip. Can Oggy break out of the junkyard in one piece, especially with the cockroaches?

Episodes.Title: Baby Boum
Episodes.Description: The stork is coming and, of course, he also brings babies. Oggy decides to dump a baby in Bob's garden. As the storks continue to bring babies, this results in an all-out infant battle between Oggy and Bob where both are trying different methods of dumping the babies in the opponent's garden.

Episodes.Title: Black and White
Episodes.Description: Oggy is trying a new, super-strong detergent. The cockroaches decide to fill the washing machine to the brim with it as Oggy exits the laundry room. This causes the washing machine to over-flow and cover Oggy's house with pink foam. When a rain cloud washed it off, the house (and the garden) has lost all its colour. This has quite a depressive effect on both Oggy and the cockroaches.

Episodes.Title: Sky Diving
Episodes.Description: Just as Jack was about to propose marriage to her, a thrill-seeking Monica decides to take up skydiving, taking both Jack and Oggy with her. However, Dee Dee has come along too, just to make the stunt harder for an already scared Jack.

Episodes.Title: Brainchild
Episodes.Description: Oggy trips over a small, fat kid sitting on the street and typing with a laptop. The kid then decides to follow Oggy home. Oggy tries (but to no avail) to call Jack for advice. But while he does, the unusually intelligent kid starts performing strange experiments on the cockroaches. Soon, Oggy must call the FBAÏ (Federal Bureau of Analgesics Ïo) for help.

Episodes.Title: Welcome To Paris
Episodes.Description: Oggy's trip in Paris goes horribly awry when the cockroaches, somehow, hitch a ride. The chase starts at the Eiffel Tower and goes all the way to Notre Dame de Paris.

Episodes.Title: Boxing Fever
Episodes.Description: After the cockroaches pranks result in another encounter between Oggy and Bob, this time Oggy challenges Bob to a duel with Bob forcing on Oggy a boxing duel. Oggy calls Jack in order to get some help in training for the upcoming match - will Oggy get out of this fisticuff, or is it TKO for him?

Episodes.Title: Chatter Box
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a new type of crackers that causes anyone who eats one to speak non-stop in gibberish. Dee Dee tries one out and gains the ability to speak. However, the other cockroaches are not very impressed by Dee Dee's new verbal skills (and no one else by the way), until Jack also eats one of the crackers.

Episodes.Title: Sitcom
Episodes.Description: After seeing Oggy watch a TV sitcom, the cockroaches play a clever prank on him, which involves a tape recording of laughter. And if that's not enough, the recording ends up in Oggy's mouth while Jack and Monica are near to breaking up.

Episodes.Title: Paper Chase
Episodes.Description: Another series of cockroach pranks results in Oggy falling into a photocopier, and trapped inside a piece of paper. Can Oggy find a way out of this situation?

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Puzzled
Episodes.Description: Oggy's attempt at finishing a jigsaw puzzle starts to go to pieces when cockroach Joey steals the final piece.

Episodes.Title: Control Freak
Episodes.Description: Jack and Oggy are having a racing contest in order to decide who should be allowed to use the TV's remote-control – something that only results in more mayhem.

Episodes.Title: Flower Power
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a book on flower power and decides to become a peaceful hippy. The cockroaches try to provoke him into losing his temper.

Episodes.Title: Sea Risks
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are left stranded in the middle of the ocean on a lifeboat following a shipwreck. Jack tries to find a way out while Oggy can only think about one thing, and one only: food

Episodes.Title: Upside Down
Episodes.Description: A terribly windy day leads to Oggy nailing all appliances and furniture to the floor. However, the house itself gets blown away, landing upside down on top of a tree. Oggy tries to cope with a world gone upside down, but the cockroaches, again, make things hard.

Episodes.Title: Oggy Has Kittens
Episodes.Description: Oggy adopts a kitten after it faces torment from the cockroaches. What's more, he's willing to teach this infant the proper cat etiquette, much to the confusion of Jack.

Episodes.Title: Keep Cool
Episodes.Description: Once again, the cockroaches have raided Oggy's fridge in the middle of the night, but this time, they leave the fridge door open, causing the whole world to go into a second ice age. How can Oggy and Jack cope?

Episodes.Title: Pharonuf
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack's trip in Egypt takes the usual twist when the cockroaches show up to cause mayhem. However, the chase takes themselves and Oggy into a time vortex (inside a pyramid), leading to the Ancient Egyptian Empire time period, where our blue feline is suddenly taken into slave labour, whereas the roaches are all treated like Emperors. What's more, an ancient mummy awaits those who dare disturb its rest.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Bag
Episodes.Description: Oggy chases the cockroaches into his dirty laundry bag. However, they soon find out that this bag's a world of its own, and the clothes come to life.

Episodes.Title: Homebreaker
Episodes.Description: After his home gets reduced all the way down to ruins, Bob moves into Oggy's house for a stay while his house is being rebuilt. Just how would they react with this situation, only time will tell

Episodes.Title: Joey and The Magic Bean
Episodes.Description: One night a green giant comes to Oggy's neighborhood and Joey meets with him. He gives Joey a can of magic beans, which make Joey grow taller when he eats them. Joey spends all night trying to grow up enough to scare Oggy. But no matter how huge he grows, whenever he confronts Oggy, he is still shorter.

Episodes.Title: The Pumpkin that Pretended to be a Ferrari
Episodes.Description: In this fairytale-like story, Oggy accidentally runs over a frog whilst returning home from his shopping. He then tries to kiss it better, only to learn that this frog is actually a fairy, who decides to make a van out of his shopping bag. When Jack learns of Oggy's situation, he decides to find another frog/fairy in order to have a big night out.

Episodes.Title: Take Cover
Episodes.Description: Jack's love for playing toy soldiers turns into a nightmare when the cockroaches fool him into believing that there's a real war going on in the back yard.

Episodes.Title: Octopus
Episodes.Description: Oggy befriends an octopus which the cockroaches want to eat. Little does Oggy know this octopus makes a habit of plotting robberies - for example, when Oggy was at his most unaware when he sleeps and gets relaxed, the Octopus sniggers and pulls Oggy's stuff into his head.

Episodes.Title: Sheepcat
Episodes.Description: Oggy has a new job shaving sheep. For him, even here, the cockroaches are there, ready to get Oggy in trouble - for the shear love of it.

Episodes.Title: Night Watchmen
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are assigned to keep watch over a toxic waste plant, briefed to make sure no monkey business will make this plant go nuclear. But while Jack is sleeping on the job, Oggy has to take damage from the cockroaches, trying his best to avoid sending the entire waste plant sky-high.

Episodes.Title: Abandoned Cockroaches
Episodes.Description: When Oggy and Jack go on vacation yet again, the cockroaches tag along, then the cruel cats plan on leaving them behind at a convenience store which only destroys their car.

Episodes.Title: V.I.P. Party
Episodes.Description: Our favorite feline is invited to a extravagant V.I.P. party. As always (if you're familiar with Oggy), the cockroaches come along and turn this party up one notch too high as Oggy suffers torture by Marky and Dee Dee, while Joey has eyes for Cinderella and her only.

Episodes.Title: Scuba Diving
Episodes.Description: When our not so deliberate duo, Oggy and Jack, take up scuba diving in Hawaii during their vacation, not even water can stop the cockroaches from tagging along and taking the plunge to cause their usual mischief - this time under the great blue.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Magic Shoes
Episodes.Description: While walking home, Oggy finds a pair of magic shoes that can dance on their own whenever spit-shined. Oggy soon becomes famous with the toe tappers. All goes well until the cockroaches ruin everything.

Episodes.Title: Casino
Episodes.Description: Oggy receives his 1 million Euro payment. Jack spends it all on a casino joint. And of course, the cockroaches come along for the ride.

Episodes.Title: Santa Oggy
Episodes.Description: Right in the middle of this Christmas night, Santa Claus, while doing his routine gift delivery services, experiences - and gets disabled by - cockroach-related technical difficulties, so Oggy volunteers to do his job for him. Too bad the cockroaches are trying to take the "merry" out of Oggy's merry Christmas tonight - festive anything-goes style.

Episodes.Title: Invincible
Episodes.Description: After being run over by a car, Oggy discovers he has superpowers, and Jack becomes his sidekick in order to protect the world from villainy. However, both cats always get into trouble.

Episodes.Title: First Flight
Episodes.Description: Jack is preparing an airplane flight, while Oggy gets on the wrong flight and the cockroaches are the pilots.

Episodes.Title: Living Carrots
Episodes.Description: One day, Oggy discovers that all of the vegetables in his house are alive! So naturally, the vegetables are saved. But when Oggy gets hungry, they may have to resort to change Oggy into a predator.

Episodes.Title: Just Married!
Episodes.Description: The big day has arrived when Oggy gets invited to the marriage of his best friend, Jack, and a French poodle, promising to be cockroach-free, but Dee Dee, Marky and Joey come along for the wedding too, uninvited, just to raise a little heck... well, so much for that "No Cockroaches Allowed" policy of the invitation.

Episodes.Title: Transamazon-ians
Episodes.Description:
Jack is preparing an airplane flight, while Oggy gets on the wrong flight and the cockroaches are the pilots.

Oggy and Jack are on a wild safari. They run into friendly insectivore natives who accidentally make Jack unconscious which the cockroaches take advantage of.

Episodes.Title: Castaway Cats
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack fall overboard on their cruise ship and fall on an island. While Oggy is enjoying himself, Jack is trying to leave. Meanwhile, the cockroaches are being kidnapped by a roach eater.

Episodes.Title: Inside Out
Episodes.Description: A witch drops a strange invention - an enchanted telescope, namely - in Oggy's house. When the cockroaches use it, they grow to gigantic size - and of course manage to shrink Oggy, Bob and Jack.

Episodes.Title: Golden Eggs
Episodes.Description: While doing laundry, Oggy discovers of a chicken that can lay eggs... but not just any egg - golden ones. When the cockroaches learn of this, they try to get one of her eggs too for profits.

Episodes.Title: The Fugitive
Episodes.Description: After catching him in the fridge, Oggy manages to kill cockroach Dee Dee, but he did not realize that Dee Dee was just playing dead. Also, Joey and Marky calls the police and a crime inspector to make this even worse for Oggy.

Episodes.Title: Priceless Roaches
Episodes.Description: Oggy is in China and the cockroaches are there also causing mischief. With that, Oggy sells them to a Chinese merchant but then starts to think he made the wrong decision.

Episodes.Title: The World Underneath
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches' latest prank on Oggy is trapping him under the house, Jack hears of it and makes the cockroaches go down to save him. However, Jack must first sign the contract that if the cockroaches save Oggy, they will humiliate Jack by recording him dancing like a ballerina.

Episodes.Title: Termite-ator
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches hire a termite to help them get in the cupboards. However, this termite causes problems with Oggy and Jack.

Episodes.Title: Oggywood
Episodes.Description: Oggy is exploring scenic Hollywood, and the cockroaches try to bug him. The chase leads them to several movie scene parodies.

Episodes.Title: The Mini-Golf War
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are playing mini golf in Oggy's yard. The cockroaches show up to cause trouble for Jack, while Oggy keeps getting a pefect score.

Episodes.Title: The Ancestor
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a past form of a cockroach frozen in his garden. The kind cockroaches unfreeze him, later finding out the really, really hard way that what cockroach they've thawed is a wild cat eater - which equals Oggy is bound to end up becoming the main item in a prehistoric cave-bug's menu.

Episodes.Title: Horse Ride
Episodes.Description: Jack brings Oggy a horse for a horse show. Oggy plans on getting famous for riding it but becomes only a show the cockroaches can enjoy.

Episodes.Title: Surf's On
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are out surfing but Oggy is stuck with the big board. Plus, after he manages to control it, the cockroaches make things worse for him and Jack.

Episodes.Title: Hold Up
Episodes.Description: Oggy must protect the banks' money, but the cockroaches steal his forklift, and Oggy has to get it back once and for all!

Episodes.Title: Fancy-a-Pizza
Episodes.Description: Jack opens up a pizza delivering business and Oggy is the deliverer. But Oggy's job becomes difficult once the cockroaches steal Oggy's every order.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Crab
Episodes.Description: Oggy adopts a crab knowing that it keeps the cockroaches away, However, the crab soon gets a bit... clingy to Oggy much to his dismay.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's grandma
Episodes.Description: Oggy's grandmother returns which means bad news to the cockroaches. Considering, Oggy's grandmother drinks a power coffee, making her super strong against them.

Episodes.Title: Locked Outside
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches lock poor Oggy out of his house. Now Oggy must find a way back in before his house is trashed.

Episodes.Title: Moving Out
Episodes.Description: Oggy is up to his breaking point with the cockroaches so he moves to the city. Feeling sad and lonely, the cockroaches try to look for him - but when they show up in his new apartment room, something tells the city there's not enough room for the both of them.

Episodes.Title: Cartoon Lesson
Episodes.Description: While watching a bunch of old cartoons, Oggy and the cockroaches are transported in the projector. Oggy then finds the characters who want to teach him a little something about cartoons.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Double
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds another cat that is a near-perfect replica of himself (save for a white spot on his tail). When Jack learns of this, he decides to play a cruel joke on the cockroaches making them think that Oggy is everywhere, resulting in double the trouble, double the laughs.(There's a deleted scene in this episode. When Joey finds out that Oggy follows him in space, there's a part that his head exploded. But since it was deleted due to censorship, the result is the scene when he cries.)

Episodes.Title: Ugly, Dirty and Good
Episodes.Description: Cockroach Joey is hit on the head and treats Oggy like a role model. Now Marky and Dee Dee must try to change him back.

Episodes.Title: The Cicada and the Cockroach
Episodes.Description: Kindhearted Oggy takes in a cicada hoping to use her sound for relaxation, not realizing it gives Joey a headache.

Episodes.Title: Deep Trouble
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack climb aboard on a submarine, but the cockroaches come along and take over the entire ship.

Episodes.Title: To Serve and Protect
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack attend Bob's police training camp, and the cockroaches sabotage Jack's every task and then somehow made Oggy win.

Episodes.Title: Formula 1
Episodes.Description: Jack invites Oggy to see him participate as an F1 racer in the big Formula 1 tournament being hosted at the circuit arena. But when the cockroaches come with the cats to get their race on, havoc-wreaking bug style, things are about to go way too turbo for Oggy and Jack to stomach.

Episodes.Title: Olivia
Episodes.Description: When a new girl cat named Olivia moves into Oggy's neighborhood, he instantly falls in love with her. But, not only are Bob and Jack (who are working together) also pining for Olivia, when the cockroaches see the whole thing, they pull out all the tricks they can to throw a wrench into this relationship.

Episodes.Title: The Lighthouse Keeper
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack become lighthouse keepers for the day. While Jack gets a fear of heights, Oggy once again chases Marky and Joey, who have the book, while Dee Dee is directing boats all over the place.

Episodes.Title: Dump the Roaches!
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack find a new job − Oggy and a sleep deprived Jack become garbage men. But the worst has just come as the cockroaches mess up the controls and things go crazy.

Episodes.Title: Dee Dee's Diet
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee thinks he is too fat so he decides to go on a diet.

Episodes.Title: A Jealous Guy
Episodes.Description: During a lovely day in the yard, Joey photoshops some pics and makes Oggy believe that he has had a fling with Olivia, the lovely neighbor. Oggy turns jealous and begins to act very strangely. No one can understand why.

Episodes.Title: Let's Party, Guys!
Episodes.Description: It's Joey's birthday. And Marky and Dee Dee decide to throw a surprise party. The two post an invitation on the internet and hundreds of roaches show up the next day.

Episodes.Title: Airship House
Episodes.Description: After Oggy gets everything ready for Jack's birthday party, things go airborne as the roaches blow up all the hot air balloons with helium and release them in the attic, eventually making the house fly into the city.

Episodes.Title: Panic Room
Episodes.Description: Exasperated at being once again, victim to the roaches' practical jokes, Oggy orders a mysterious kit. When the kit arrives, it turns out to be an airtight, hermetically sealed CCTV room where he can close himself up and then, with help from a console, activate various traps he has set all over the house.

Episodes.Title: Into the Wild
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack go hiking on the GR 20 trail across the island of Corsica... so do the roaches. They sabotage Jack's compass and the two cats get lost in the wild, which turns out to be pretty frightening.

Episodes.Title: Washing Day
Episodes.Description: Oggy has just washed his clothes, and is about to dry them, when the cockroaches come up and steal the clothes, starting a battle between them on the clotheslines.

Episodes.Title: Lightning Visit
Episodes.Description: Oggy's relatives arrive at Oggy's house for a visit. As such, Oggy is determined protect his visitors from the roaches' plots, or else the visit will turn into a historical disaster.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Shadow
Episodes.Description: The roaches have trapped Oggy with lights and nailed his shadow as they are about to, as usual, raid the fridge. When Oggy breaks free, his shadow is still trapped and then becomes stray. Will Oggy be able to get his shadow back?

Episodes.Title: Buddy Parrot
Episodes.Description: One day, Oggy finds a parrot which repeats anything he says and does, and decides to take it home. As the parrot is at Oggy's house, Dee Dee becomes very obsessed with the parrot, and wants to get its feathers only for... food?

Episodes.Title: The Magic Pen
Episodes.Description: A pencil with a magical drawing ability has just fallen onto Oggy's house yard, and the cockroaches plan to use it against Oggy.

Episodes.Title: The Cube
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a weird cube on his yard, and decides to take it to his living room, not knowing the cube soon causes trouble for his friends as it grows bigger until it entrances him.

Episodes.Title: A Charming Guy
Episodes.Description: Oggy has problems expressing his feelings for Olivia. To make matters worse, the roaches come along to ruin Oggy's every attempt to impress Olivia.

Episodes.Title: Fly for Fun
Episodes.Description: When a helicopter lands on Oggy's yard, Oggy deicdes to take control of it for a while. Suddenly, Joey falls in love with the helicopter, thinking it's a giant female dragonfly and leaving the other roaches in confusion... and harder for Oggy to control it.

Episodes.Title: Olivia's Pimple
Episodes.Description: Olivia notices a pimple on her face and refuses to leave her home. What will Oggy do to help Olivia get rid of the pimple?

Episodes.Title: The Ice Rink
Episodes.Description: It's an icy day, and when Bob crashes into a fire hydrant, Oggy's yard turns into a large ice rink. Oggy and Olivia decide to have some fun on the rink by going skating.

Episodes.Title: For Real
Episodes.Description: After being electrocuted, Oggy and Joey turn into a realistic cat and a realistic roach. Nobody recognizes them, not even Jack nor Marky nor Dee Dee.

Episodes.Title: Fly to the Sun
Episodes.Description: Following an explosion provoked by the roaches, the house and everyone inside find themselves in outer space and heading straight for the sun!

Episodes.Title: Run, Olivia, Run
Episodes.Description: Olivia is taking part of a marathon, and Oggy comes with a bag with a bottle of water inside. However, the roaches, as usual, also come with him and are up to no good, stealing the bag, resulting in a big chase while the race is on.

Episodes.Title: Mind the Giant
Episodes.Description: Marky eats some tree seeds which make him grow really, really big, turning him into a giant roach who wants more and more food.

Episodes.Title: A Soft World
Episodes.Description: Oggy gets a package containing a spray bottle, which he hopes to be able to kill the roaches. However, as the roaches have it in their hands, they have made everything droopy and soft.

Episodes.Title: Sport Fans
Episodes.Description: After the cockroaches destroy Oggy's TV, Oggy and Jack make the cockroaches do Olympic events themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Kitchen Boy
Episodes.Description: Oggy gets a new job as an apprentice cook in a chic, modern restaurant. Bob is his boss. All is good until the cockroaches come along and try to sabotage Oggy's work.

Episodes.Title: Mister Cat
Episodes.Description: Oggy is taking part of a Mister Cat contest, but then Bob also enters with his new pet cat. When it comes to the first round, Bob decides to ask help from the cockroaches to fix the contest to make sure his pet cat wins.

Episodes.Title: The Easter Egg
Episodes.Description: An Easter Bell accidentally drops an Easter egg in Oggy's yard. Oggy finds it and decides to use it to impress Olivia. The cockroaches want it too, and they want to eat it.

Episodes.Title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
Episodes.Description: After the cockroaches steal Oggy's nose, Joey and Oggy fall to the center of the earth. Meanwhile, Dee Dee and Marky tell Olivia of this, and they go down to save their friends.

Episodes.Title: Butterfly Race
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a butterfly and teaches it tricks. Jealous, Bob dresses Marky up as a butterfly and the two compete in a race. Olivia makes a butterfly race, the winner will get a trophy and honey. Who will win?

Episodes.Title: Oggy Goes Green
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a solar panel, and sees its effects. Then, Oggy goes crazy and uses everything from solar energy. Soon the cockroaches decide to use them as a weapon to chase Oggy with burning heat.

Episodes.Title: Now You See Me, Now You Don't
Episodes.Description: Oggy is fixing himself up a veggie drink, so what could be more healthy than that? But when his back is turned, the roaches put some junk into the blender. When Oggy drinks it, the taste is as gross as dirt! And while he is cleaning dishes, he suddenly becomes invisible - an unintended but intriguing side effect.

Episodes.Title: What a Lousy Day
Episodes.Description: Oggy starts scratching his head and lends his comb to Jack who lends it to Bob and the three of them start scratching their heads. Olivia sees this and tries to clean their hair. When all else fails, call in the cockroaches...

Episodes.Title: Jack's Nephew
Episodes.Description: Jack brings his nephew to Oggy's house, wanting Oggy to look after him. But Jack's nephew is lazy, and only wants to eat cereal flakes for breakfast. Even worse, he also makes friends with Joey, and they both start to trash the place.

Episodes.Title: Roommate Wanted
Episodes.Description: Oggy is getting mighty bored living all alone. As he vacuums the spare room, he suddenly has an idea: get a roommate!

Episodes.Title: The Bathtub Race
Episodes.Description: When everyone around the neighborhood is bored, Olivia decides to have a bathtub race. Oggy, Jack, and Bob sign up with their customized bathtubs while the cockroaches join in using Oggy's toilet bowl.

Episodes.Title: Inspector Dee Dee
Episodes.Description: Oggy has returned to his house and shocked to find every thing gone in his house which makes him upset. With the police useless (literally), Dee Dee decides to find the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Hep Taxi
Episodes.Description: Oggy becomes a taxi driver, and the roaches try to sabotage the business.

Episodes.Title: (Un)happy Camper!
Episodes.Description: Olivia and Oggy head off in their camping car for a beach vacation. The roaches come along for the ride and decide to ruin Oggy's vacation of course. Also, Bob comes along caravanning near Oggy and Olivia's the next day, making Oggy (and Olivia) very disturbed by Bob's furniture. Can Oggy save his camping trip?

Episodes.Title: A Streetcar on the Loose
Episodes.Description: Jack has become the driver of a new streetcar that runs through the neighborhood. Olivia also brings some kids to ride the streetcar. The cockroaches slip into the machine and raise heck. Even worse, this makes Bob crushed by Jack's streetcar several times. Can Oggy stabilize the high-speed situation while Jack is asleep?

Episodes.Title: Grease-Monkey Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack opened up a garage with gas tanks and lets Oggy worked as a mechanic while he relaxes.Oggy has to fix Bob's car while the cockroaches make havoc.

Episodes.Title: Farmer for a Day
Episodes.Description: Olivia takes Oggy to an old farm.Oggy starts having an unusual experience with the animals, but with the cockroaches it's only the beginning.

Episodes.Title: Oggy Splits Hairs
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack open up a salon. But the cockroaches are here to mess up the work.

Episodes.Title: Little Tom Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy exits shopping and confused to see which way to go. He tries to leave a trail but Dee Dee eats it and both of them became lost. Can they get home to their friends?

Episodes.Title: Artsy Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy is painting a portrait of his tree in his yard. Suddenly, the cockroaches snatch his painting and doodled all over it. After Oggy gets it back from Joey, he calls an art critic and gives Oggy a briefcase full of money. Surprised, Oggy paints more portraits but when the critic arrives again, he refuses to accept Oggy's painting. Later Oggy forces the roaches to doodle all over his portraits and when the critic arrives once more, he gives Oggy bars of gold. The roaches confess what really happened. Feeling angry, Oggy grabs the roaches and hangs them in frames.

Episodes.Title: Don't Barge In!
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Olivia are on a boat ride and the cockroaches are there too except Oggy kicked them out. Bob is the bridge operator signaling Oggy to stop except Oggy is confused with Bob's signals and ended up bumping into him. The cockroaches raced back to the boat while Bob always ended up getting bumped by Oggy's ride. The cockroaches managed to go to the controls and slams into dam bridges and ended in Oggy's house. Bob goes to kill Oggy with a shotgun but Oggy pushed the button and Bob got crushed by the gate.

Episodes.Title: A five-legged sheep
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a five-legged sheep in front of his yard, little does he know that it is astray. Oggy decides to keep it for a while and also the roaches have come along for the ride. The mayhem ruins Bob's yard. Later, the sheep's owner finally finds it and brings it home back to where it belongs. Meanwhile, Bob confronts Oggy and drags him to the garage and beating him up.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Magic Smile
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a magic smile from the magic shop. Everytime he wears it, he turns into a muscular tough guy. Will he use it to impress Olivia or plot revenge against the roaches? Both of these don't happen until cockroach Joey gets a hold of the magic smile. How will Oggy get it back?

Episodes.Title: Water Sports
Episodes.Description: Oggy, Jack and Olivia go to Aqualand for the day. The roaches wreak havoc by fiddling around with the wave-making machine and cranking it to max.

Episodes.Title: Caviar on the House!
Episodes.Description: Oggy decides to buy some caviar to impress Olivia. Unfortunately, he only has enough money to buy one little fish egg!

Episodes.Title: Party Pooper
Episodes.Description: Oggy decides to throw a private party just for Olivia so as to try and seduce her. But the roaches hack into Oggy's printer and print up three more invitations to the party. So Jack and Bob join in the fun.

Episodes.Title: Scaredy-Cat
Episodes.Description: It's Halloween! While Oggy is busy sculpting a pumpkin to put in the window, Jack is trying on his most horrible costumes. What's worse, a swamp monster came in Oggy's house by mistake and got lost

Episodes.Title: Dream On!
Episodes.Description: Oggy is having a nightmare, can he solve this little sleeping problem? In the end, Oggy is angrily ruin his dream by cockroaches and he chase around his house with chainsaw to rupture the roaches. Meanwhile, Olivia, Bob and Jack are do nothing to stop his sleeping problem.

Episodes.Title: Skate Fever
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a skateboard in the street. After a disastrous start, he begins to get the hang of it and really enjoy it. He even builds a skate park at home.

Episodes.Title: North Pole Panic
Episodes.Description: This year's Christmas would have been the best one in the lifetime if it hadn't been ruined by the cockroaches.

Episodes.Title: Shoplifting
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches are trying to get some food by stealing.

Episodes.Title: Lady K
Episodes.Description: Oggy goes over to Olivia’s for tea. The roaches manage to invite themselves and start to make a mess of Olivia’s house. While the roaches are walking through the air vents, they meet a magnificent roach babe: Lady K…

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Dodo Bird
Episodes.Description: Oggy adopts a bird and Dee Dee decides to eat it.

Episodes.Title: Steamed Out
Episodes.Description: Oggy, Jack and Bob built a den. However, the cockroaches puts on steams in the house.

Episodes.Title: Picnic Panic
Episodes.Description: Oggy, Jack and Olivia are going for a picnic and the roaches came along too. However, the ants flock the roaches out by attacking them after the lovely picnic.

Episodes.Title: Lights Out
Episodes.Description: Oggy, Jack, Bob and Olivia are playing a game of cards when suddenly Joey accidentally turn off the lights and starts to raid the fridge.

Episodes.Title: Wrestling Time
Episodes.Description: Jack coerces Oggy into being a wrestler.

Episodes.Title: Teleportation
Episodes.Description: Oggy ordered a teleport machine which he uses it to go to any place faster by teleporting to that location. While Oggy is asleep, the cockroaches uses that to rob the fridge but Dee Dee and Marky are trapped while Joey's asleep. Jack and Bob wanted to try that machine but unfortunately after a few teleportations, they became stuck together so Oggy has to get them free.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Flour Man
Episodes.Description: Oggy is about to make a pastry delight until Dee Dee steals his flour and Oggy chases after it. After that, the flour becomes a flour man and Oggy befriends it, while Dee Dee and his pals are trying to get the flour from the flour man, but it won't be easy because they can easily get through it instead of touching it, and easily blown away.

Episodes.Title: High Rise Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Bob has built a modern skyscraper and moves in the penthouse. Bob now thinks he can do what ever he wants. He throws his garbage out the window and Oggy's garden quickly becomes a garbage dump! Oggy declares war against Bob…

Episodes.Title: Very Special Deliveries
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack take up jobs as delivery cats with Bob as their boss and the cockroaches as their saboteurs.

Episodes.Title: The Cucaracha
Episodes.Description: A mexican cockroach came for a visit with the cockroaches until Joey became jealous when Lady K fell in love with the cucaracha.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Mermaid
Episodes.Description: Oggy went scuba diving and saw a mermaid, the cockroaches kidnapped it, leaving Oggy to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: The Abominable Snow Roach
Episodes.Description: A heavy snowstorm covers the whole area and the whole place is soon under a heavy pile of snow. The cockroaches are making a snow roach and they want to eat food but Dee Dee has already eaten all the food in the fridge. So when they spot Oggy carrying food, they decide to disguise themselves as a snow roach and let Oggy give them food.

Episodes.Title: Wake up, my Lovely
Episodes.Description: Lady K wanted to rule the house of Olivia, she had a evil plan, making the apple to a forever sleeping potion, Olivia ate it. Oggy had to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: Bicycle Crazy!
Episodes.Description: A big bicycle race will be passing through the neighborhood. Jack plans to get money from the spectators by making a barbecue stand, only to get distracted by what Bob is planning to do. Meanwhile, Marky wants to meet Eddy, a bicycle racer, and get a photo of him.

Episodes.Title: Back To The Past!
Episodes.Description: A witch is flying through the sky on her broomstick when her hat blows off and disappears in the clouds. She turns back and goes after it. The hat lands in Oggy’s yard…

Episodes.Title: Oggy is getting Married!
Episodes.Description: Oggy is in Venice with Olivia, the perfect setting for a marriage proposal. Jack is there too… and the roaches, of course…

Episodes.Title: From Mumbai with Love
Episodes.Description: Jack got three tickets to the Mumbai Chricket World Cup 2012, however, Joey only went there to steal the princess' precious diamond. The cockroaches stole the three tickets and going on their way on their plans.

Episodes.Title: The Great Pyramid Mystery
Episodes.Description: Oggy chases the cockroaches across the great pyramid construction site, trying to get his sandwich back. In the wink of an eye, the blue cat and his scurrilous companions get lost inside the immense pyramid... Will they ever find their way out?

Episodes.Title: Gladiator Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Olivia go to the Coliseum to watch a gladiator combat. The roaches filch Oggy's popcorn. He goes after them but ends up being enlisted as a gladiator! The roaches, propelled into the arena themselves, bitterly regret nicking Oggy's popcorn...

Episodes.Title: The Levee of the King
Episodes.Description: Oggy helps Jack, the King's page because the sovereign must be prepared in all his finery before the Royal Portrait painter turns up. It's a nightmare with the roaches around...

Episodes.Title: Sheriff Oggy
Episodes.Description: Sheriff Jack is about to take a nap and designates Oggy as sheriff. Oggy accepts, to impress Olivia, but things get out of hand. Can he protect the bank when the roaches hold it up again and again?

Episodes.Title: Marky's Tournament
Episodes.Description: Jack competes in a medieval tournament, with Oggy as his groom. Marky falls in love with Bob's daughter and decides to compete. All's fair in love and war – that's what cockroaches say.

Episodes.Title: Fragile Goods!
Episodes.Description: Oggy is entrusted with an honorable task – restoring the Emperor's precious Ming vase. But the cockroaches are obsessed with the idea that the vase would be filled with rice. Can Oggy find a way to protect the vase?

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Special Spa
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a great job working in the Roman Baths. Today, a celebrity is expected: Julius Caesar! Unfortunately, the cockroaches want to use the luxury spa too. Oggy freaks out: if Caesar sees those roaches, he can say goodbye to his new job!

Episodes.Title: The Octopus Masters
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a magic medallion in a shipwreck graveyard and gives it to Olivia. When she puts it on, an Octopus appears, to obey her every wish. Now the cockroaches want it too.

Episodes.Title: RodeOggy
Episodes.Description: Jack wants to participate in a rodeo contest organized by Buffalo Bill. Joey also wants the first prize. He is also registering. Jack then leaves the contest and asks Oggy to replace him. Who will win? Joey or Oggy?

Episodes.Title: Wanted
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches stick Oggy's photo over a poster: 'WANTED - BOB'. A bounty hunter turns up in search of Oggy.

Episodes.Title: The Green Thumb
Episodes.Description: Bob, head gardener in the Versailles Palace, gives Oggy a list of jobs to make the gardens beautiful! Everything goes well, until Oggy inadvertently flattens the cockroaches, who decide to get even...

Episodes.Title: Oggy, the King's Coachman
Episodes.Description: Oggy, employed as the King's coachman, must prepare the royal carriage and drive it to Versailles for the King's outing. On the way, Oggy comes across highwaymen... it's the roaches of course!

Episodes.Title: The Roaches Seize the Castle
Episodes.Description: Lord Bob goes hunting, leaving Oggy and Jack in charge of the castle. The cockroaches boot them out. Will Oggy and Jack succeed in getting back inside, before the roaches wreak utter havoc?

Episodes.Title: The Hunchback from the Cathedral
Episodes.Description: Due to a bizarre meteorological phenomenon, the sun shines on Oggy's house but everywhere else, it's raining cats and dogs. Jack decides to take advantage of the situation and turn the house into a Club.

Episodes.Title: Cockroaches Play Cricket
Episodes.Description: The Maharajah is bored and asks Jack to find an activity to entertain him. Thanks to a chaotic intervention by Oggy and the cockroaches, he invents a new game which amuses the sovereign: cricket.

Episodes.Title: Oggy the Fakir
Episodes.Description: Oggy yearns to meet Olivia, the Maharajah's daughter, but he's denied entrance to the palace. So he tries to climb a rope mid-air, by playing the flute.

Episodes.Title: The Tiger Hunt
Episodes.Description: Oggy, mahout of maharajah Chadabad-Abad leads his master and his servant Jack to the tiger hunt. But the roaches covet the diamond adorning the turban of the maharajah. While the tiger prowls, they do everything to seize the jewel.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Treasure
Episodes.Description: Oggy is cabin boy on Jack the Pirate's ship. While searching for treasure, they meet (and sink) Bob's ship. and kidnap Olivia. A mad chase ensues over Treasure Island as roaches and cats race to find gold.

Episodes.Title: Oggy on the Nile!
Episodes.Description: Oggy invites Olivia for a dream cruise on the Nile. The cockroaches, furious at being denied access on board, decide to ruin the outing. Plagued with sea-sickness, Oggy does his best to stay afloat!

Episodes.Title: Shift that Chariot Oggy!
Episodes.Description: When Oggy sees Olivia set off to Rome on Bob's chariot, he's miserable. How can he compete? He doesn't know how to drive those things! Jack gives him chariot driving lessons, which become a nightmare when the roaches get involved.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Grasshopper Cloud
Episodes.Description: Joey fools around with Oggy's bird-caller whistle, and attracts a cloud of grasshoppers, who invade the pyramid. The Grasshopper Leader does a deal with Joey, and ousts Pharaoh Bob. Dee Dee and Marky feel left out, and join forces with Oggy to get rid of the invaders.

Episodes.Title: The Precious Panda
Episodes.Description: The little Emperor of China is a nightmare. But the Little Emperor adores Oggy – who is appointed to take care of him. Oggy tries to sneak off, but the cockroaches stop him.

Episodes.Title: In the Glare of the Sun
Episodes.Description: In Machu Picchu, Joey uses a machine that creates artificial darkness and apparently controls the sun god. He becomes the leader of the village – a true tyrant. Can Oggy trick the cockroaches and push Joey off the throne?

Episodes.Title: Gold Fever
Episodes.Description: In Machu Pichu, Oggy is appointed to watch over the temple offerings. The cockroaches team up with a crazy conquistador who helps them to get rid of Oggy and steal the offerings. He gets the temple’s golden statue in exchange.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Dragon
Episodes.Description: Oggy collects and hides a baby dragon that Bob wanted to capture. Oggy attaches himself to his dragon and tries to teach him how to fly. Roaches set their sights on it because they dream of a good fire lit in express by the dragon.

Episodes.Title: A Touch of Genius
Episodes.Description: Oggy works in Jack's carpet store and the cockroaches are looking for a flying carpet. While looking around, Oggy and the roaches find a genie instead.

Episodes.Title: Sacrificial Special
Episodes.Description: Bob, an Incan priest, is looking for a ritual sacrifice. Oggy distracts Bob from choosing his beloved llama and lets him have the roaches instead, who are attracted to the priest's necklace.

Episodes.Title: Baby Sitting for the Emperor
Episodes.Description: The little Emperor of China is a nightmare. His tutor, Bob, is at his wits' end. But the Little Emperor adores Oggy – who is appointed to take care of him. Oggy tries to sneak off, but the cockroaches – overjoyed to be in the Imperial Palace – block his way.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's 1001 Nights
Episodes.Description: Oggy is a carpet cleaner in Baghdad. Olivia comes to choose a carpet in the shop and is kidnapped by Bob, the vizier. With the help of Aladdin, his flying carpet, and a certain genius, Oggy flies to the rescue of Olivia, this beautiful stranger.

Episodes.Title: Moonshot Movie
Episodes.Description: During 1900 in Paris, Oggy and Jack hunt the cockroaches hiding in the revolutionary film studio of Georges Méliès. In a film set, they all board aboard a cardboard rocket. The problem – the rocket actually takes off and brings them to the moon, while Jack is filming the adventure.

Episodes.Title: Lead Wings
Episodes.Description: Charles Lindbergh starts his nonstop flight from New York crossing the Atlantic Ocean. But he has a couple of stowaways on board: Oggy and the cockroaches. Jack tries to rescue his cousin using a rowboat to chase the plane. A chaotic journey begins.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Invention
Episodes.Description: It's 1700 and the cockroaches steal the pressure cooker Jack just purchased. During the ensuing chase, the cooker lands on a cart and inspires Oggy with an idea for the first steam powered vehicle.

Episodes.Title: Dee Dee Capone
Episodes.Description: During prohibition, Dee Dee is designated by Joey and Marky to get hold of canned food. But Oggy exposes Dee Dee and stops his business which has people starving all over the city.

Episodes.Title: Oggy, The Lord of Lightning
Episodes.Description: When the Viking Chief launches an expedition to search for a milder climate, Oggy volunteers. Now the cockroaches are determined to get there before Oggy and steal his long ship.

Episodes.Title: A Gorilla in Town
Episodes.Description: An American adventurer brings a gorilla to the city but Joey wants to steal the ape and make his own fortune. Infuriated by the roaches, the gorilla breaks loose – and kidnaps Olivia.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Tramp
Episodes.Description: It's New York 1930, and Olivia is selling flowers on the street. Joey steals them for Lady K, and has Oggy arrested instead of him. But Oggy meets Chaplin in prison and they escape, with a plan.

Episodes.Title: Beware the Longship
Episodes.Description: When the Viking leader decides to mount an expedition to find a more climate-friendly land, Oggy volunteers: the explorer will be appointed governor of the colony. But the roaches expect to arrive before Oggy and fly on his beautiful longship.

Episodes.Title: On the High-Yurt-Way
Episodes.Description: Jack and Oggy are holding an auto-youth area. Olivia is holding the cafeteria. Bob, a camel-trucker, points to Oggy's demands as he watches his cargo and flirts with Olivia. Oggy is jealous but cockroaches are interested in Bob's convoy.

Episodes.Title: Xanadu Milk
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Olivia run a rest area in Mongolia, where the roaches create a shortage in goat's milk. So Oggy and Olivia follow Marco Polo all the way to Xanadu to find a yak.

Episodes.Title: Crackdown on the Fridge
Episodes.Description: Coming back from the market, Oggy finds his house ransacked by the cockroaches: it's a total dump. He decides to protect his fridge against the cockroach attacks and clamps on a solid lock. A remastering of "Mission Oggy".

Episodes.Title: Laughter Forbidden
Episodes.Description: The roaches force Oggy to swallow an explosive concoction that Jack invented to get rid of the roaches. Jack tries everything in the books to stop Oggy, the walking time bomb, from going off. A remastering of "Laughing Gas".

Episodes.Title: Cockroach vs. Mouse
Episodes.Description: A mouse makes his way into Oggy's household, taking whatever he wants, namely food and shelter. Oggy has a fear of mice and even the cockroaches aren't getting on well with this uninvited guest. A remastering of "The Outsider".

Episodes.Title: Strong Coffee
Episodes.Description: Oggy wakes up, depressed and yawning. The house looks like it's been blitzed. After a cup of coffee he decides to get this place in order. The roaches are more than willing to lend a hand. A remastering of "Shake Oggy Shake".

Episodes.Title: Jack's Kit
Episodes.Description: Jack arrives with a put-it-together-yourself roach-catching trap. When he tries to get some silence to work, the cockroaches try their best in causing as much noise as possible. This forces poor Oggy to try and keep them quiet, which is easier said than done. A remastering of "Cat Kit".

Episodes.Title: Cute Little Puppy
Episodes.Description: Oggy comes across an adorable dog who’s lost his way. Moved by the young pup’s moist eyes, he immediately takes him in. Everything would be fine if Jack didn’t surprise Oggy barking and immediately called for psychiatric help. A remastering of "A Dog Day Afternoon".

Episodes.Title: The Great Invasion
Episodes.Description: Jack is tired of the weak, useless toxins in the insecticide, so he decides to enhance it by using his new chemistry set. The result is a gas that has the ability to clone the subject it was used on. A remastering of "Cloning Around".

Episodes.Title: Tooth Exchange
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Oggy receive money from the Little Mouse, Joey is determined to get some coins too, even if it means losing all of his teeth. A remastering of "Tooth Good to be True".

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Costume
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches play a hit-and-run prank where they frame Oggy by dressing up as him and attacking Jack. A remastering of "Oggy's Clone".

Episodes.Title: Mamma Oggy
Episodes.Description: The Cockroaches prank Oggy by inflating his stomach, making him think that he's pregnant. A remastering of "Nine Months and Counting".

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Kittens
Episodes.Description: Jack chases for the cockroaches but Oggy supports them once and for all, so the cockroaches are thrown out. Just a few seconds after that they receive three young kittens. Jack yet has a doubt, can he solve the mystery? Or is there none at all? A remastering of "Oggy and the Babies".

Episodes.Title: A Rebel Bait
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are going fishing. Oggy has gathered all the necessary material, including an enormous worm who escapes from the jar and threatens Oggy with a revolver. "Rambo-worm" blows up Jack’s trailer, steals his car and… goes fishing. A remastering of "The Bait Bites Back".

Episodes.Title: The Winning Ticket
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack win the lottery ticket number for a massive sum of money, that is, until Dee Dee gets a hold of it. A remastering of "The Lottery Ticket".

Episodes.Title: Super Dee Dee
Episodes.Description: While repairing the roaches' TV in one stormy night, Dee Dee is struck by lightning, which gives him super strength. However, Dee Dee lets this get to his head, causing him to be a villain toward Oggy and even his fellow roaches, Marky and Joey. A remastering of "Oggy vs. Super Roach".

Episodes.Title: Alone at Last
Episodes.Description: Oggy finally manages to remove the cockroaches out of his home permanently, but gradually regrets doing so, as he starts to miss them, leading to a severe tantrum. A remastering of "So Lonely".

Episodes.Title: Snack Time
Episodes.Description: Poor Oggy, as usual, gets in an accident involving Jack against the cockroaches in retaliation of his cake being eaten, ending up being squashed into a disk. To make sure he'll never repeat that mistake twice, Jack builds a time machine to go back in time and prevent the accident. For him, turning forward – and back – the clock may yield unwanted results. A remastering of "The Time Machine".

Episodes.Title: Doll Idol
Episodes.Description: Having completely regressed, Oggy enthusiastically plays with his doll. He puts it in a pretty little doll house, without suspecting for a second that the cockroaches have already squatted the place. A remastering of "Baby Doll".

Episodes.Title: Ups and Downs
Episodes.Description: Oggy's house is ripped off the ground by a violent gust of wind. It lands on the top of a tree, but upside down. Oggy has to nail down all the furniture so it doesn't come crashing down on his head. A remastering of "Upside Down".

Episodes.Title: Bless You Oggy!
Episodes.Description: Oggy is having a sick day recently – and the cockroaches are out to take advantage of his current situation all the while Jack is trying to cure Oggy from his illness, but everytime he tries to cure Oggy with a pair of syringes they keep on striking on Bob when Oggy sneezes. A remastering of "Hide and Sick".

Episodes.Title: The Loot
Episodes.Description: With a conspiring wink, Jack slips his cousin a mysterious attach case bursting with greenbacks. Oggy is scared about holding such a sum of money and tries to find the ideal hiding place for it. A remastering of "Go Slow With Your Dough".

Episodes.Title: Roach Charmer
Episodes.Description: After seeing a snake charmer on TV, Oggy decides to make his own flute, in which he steals a car part from his neighbour Bob. Upon adding holes to it, Oggy plays it and unwittingly hypnotises Marky into being a dog that would remain loyal to him, much to the dismay of Dee Dee and Joey. A remastering of "Oggy and the Magic Flute".

Episodes.Title: A Crazy Carpet
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a new carpet, which turns out to be a magic carpet, able to fly. When the cockroaches tie explosives to it, it goes out of control and Jack must save Oggy, who can't control the carpet. A remastering of "Magic Carpet Ride".

Episodes.Title: Wake-Up Oggy!
Episodes.Description: Oggy heads home as the sun is rising. He has one thing in mind: Sleep. But the roaches are in tip top shape and they have just one thing in their dirty little minds: keep Oggy from sleeping. A remastering of "Sleepless Night".

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Sister
Episodes.Description: One fine morning a blue tornado storms into the house: it's Oggy's sister! Jack immediately falls into a catatonic love stupor. When love digs in its claws, it's hard to let go and no sacrifice is too big in Jack's pursuit of the young cat-babe... A remastering of "Love and Kisses".

Episodes.Title: Bowling Champions
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches' game of pick-up sticks is interrupted by Oggy, who is bowling. However, when Jack comes over, a chase begins, leading both cats to a real bowling alley. A remastering of "Strike!".

Episodes.Title: A Fit Body For Oggy
Episodes.Description: Overweight Oggy decides to keep fit, much to the dismay of the cockroaches. What can they do in this situation? Perform the usual sabotages to make sure Oggy stays the way he is. A remastering of "Oggy's Diet".

Episodes.Title: Wild Flight
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack share a ride in a remote-controlled hot-air balloon. However, it soon becomes a joyride when their remote ends up in the cockroaches' hands. A remastering of "Loony Balloons".

Episodes.Title: Bouncing Ball
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a ball that starts bouncing off all the walls, smashing everything and ends in an open-mouthed Joey who swallows it. Now the chase is really on. A remastering of "Bugball".

Episodes.Title: Cockroach Oggy
Episodes.Description: Having swallowed a dubious pill concocted by the roaches, Oggy transforms into a giant cockroach. Wild-eyed and completely distraught at first, little by little Oggy gets used to his new appearance. A remastering of "Metamorphosis".

Episodes.Title: An Intrusive Neighbor
Episodes.Description: After his home gets blown up all the way down to ruins, Bob moves into Oggy's house for a stay while his house is being rebuilt. Just how would Oggy and the cockroaches react with this situation? Only time will tell. A remastering of "Homebreaker".

Episodes.Title: Serenade for a Monster
Episodes.Description: Oggy does a beautiful swan dive into his pool and hits his head on a sea monster. His panic quickly dissipates when he realizes that it's just old Nessie, the Lock [sic] Ness monster. Oggy will charm the big guy with a bagpipe and leads him back home. A remastering of "The Pied Bagpiper".

Episodes.Title: A Shockproof Denture
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches are pulling yet another prank on poor Oggy. This time, they superglue massive, fake teeth in his mouth. Oggy is forced to first try to call his neighbor Bob, but he instead puts the big teeth out to beat up Oggy and then he puts them back in, which causes Oggy to call his old friend Jack in order to get rid of his new, oversized teeth. A remastering of "A Tooth for a Tooth".

Episodes.Title: A Wild Train Ride
Episodes.Description: Jack is completely immersed in his video game. To get his cousin’s attention, Oggy takes out his old electric train, but Jack doesn’t even lift an eyelash! The cockroaches take advantage of their good luck to hijack the train and steal all the food! A remastering of "One Track Life".

Episodes.Title: Bad Luck Day
Episodes.Description: It's Friday the 13th and Oggy has broken his mirror. A guaranteed seven years of bad luck. Catastrophes are drawn to Oggy, orchestrated from the shadows by our three little beasts. A remastering of "Wrong Side of the Bed".

Episodes.Title: Oggy Cat Trainer
Episodes.Description: Oggy rescues a kitten who was being tormented by the cockroaches then teaches him proper cat lessons but that only makes Jack a bit confused. A remastering of "Oggy Has Kittens".

Episodes.Title: The Tenants
Episodes.Description: Oggy flattens the cockroaches with a well-deserved swat of the flyswatter. The three insects are thrown out without further ado. Humiliated, they can think of only one thing : get their revenge! They decide to put Oggy’s house up “for rent”! A remastering of "House for Rent".

Episodes.Title: Chocolate Wars
Episodes.Description: Oggy orders a box of chocolates but that turns into a battle when the cockroaches try to steal it from his hands. A remastering of "Bitter Chocolate".

Episodes.Title: Nature's Call
Episodes.Description: Oggy rushes over to the little boy's room but the door is locked from the inside. The cockroaches are basking in a refreshing bath. It's out of the question that someone's going to bother them. A remastering of "Occupied".

Episodes.Title: Flying Lesson
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee and Joey have decided they want to fly and Marky is the test subject in a number of very unsuccessful attempts. A remastering of "High Flyers".

Episodes.Title: Crazy Driving!
Episodes.Description: Oggy takes his driving test and the least one can say is that he’s not really gifted! The cockroaches, of course, are along for the ride, and take it upon themselves to transform the driving test into a real stock-car race… A remastering of "A Tip for the Road".

Episodes.Title: Puzzle Mania
Episodes.Description: Oggy is putting the last piece of his complicated jigsaw puzzle into place when the roaches steal it from him. With Jack and Oggy on their tail, the roaches wreak havoc as they run through the house. A remastering of "Oggy's Puzzled".

Episodes.Title: Special Deliveries
Episodes.Description: A stork keeps delivering babies into Oggy's garden. Oggy discreetly drops them off at Bob's who in turn discreetly gives them back to Oggy. A remastering of "Baby Boum".

Episodes.Title: Under the Sun
Episodes.Description: It’s a beautiful summer day. Oggy savors this moment of pure joy. But suddenly a small cloud projects a shadow directly onto Oggy. A remastering of "Heatwave".

Episodes.Title: Abracadabra
Episodes.Description: In this remastering version, Oggy bought a ring for Olivia and goes to her place hoping to win her love and her parents acceptance. Unfortunately for him, due to a mix up with the mail packages, he ends up with a magician suit and things didn't go too well for Oggy. A remastering of "The Joker Joked".

Episodes.Title: Soccer Fever
Episodes.Description: Jack is glued to a soccer game on TV. Drawn by the screaming soccer fans, Joey takes an interest in the game and with his two partners and a few buddies he forms two teams and organizes a match. But they need a soccer field. A remastering of "Penalty Shot".

Episodes.Title: Lost at Sea
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are shipwrecked, floating in the middle of the ocean on a little raft. Dee-Dee gobbles up their last cookie reserve. The two cats are ready to go at each other’s throats when a ship appears on the horizon. A remastering of "Sea Risks".

Episodes.Title: Deep into the Wild
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are on a safari photo-shoot in Africa. A remastering of "Safari So Good".

Episodes.Title: Wacky Garden Party
Episodes.Description: Oggy has set up his barbecue under an oak tree where a mommy eagle is tending to her eggs. A remastering of "Barbecue".

Episodes.Title: Bath Time!
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee stinks to high heaven, so much so that even Joey and Marky can't stand the smell. His buddies decide to force him to take a bath. A remastering of "Wash Day".

Episodes.Title: A Voracious Pet
Episodes.Description: Jack brings a female Ostrich to Oggy's place but things didn't go to well when the ostrich begins devouring Oggy's furniture. The cockroaches get involved in this predicament, Dee Dee and Marky are planning to eat the ostrich but their leader Joey wants to ride her instead. A remastering of "The Hungry Ostrich Empire".

Episodes.Title: TV Addict
Episodes.Description: Oggy is hypnotised by his favourite TV programs. The roaches take advantage of this to start up the practical jokes. But nothing and nobody are going to get in the way of Oggy's TV. A remastering of "TV Obsession".

Episodes.Title: Sweet Teddy-Bear
Episodes.Description: While his parents are hibernating, a little bear cub leaves the family den. His curiosity leads him to Oggy's house where the latter is getting ready for a costume party. Jack is dressed up as a bear and Oggy as a baby whose teddy bear looks too real. A remastering of "Un-Bear-able Bears".

Episodes.Title: Oggy Robot
Episodes.Description: During a chaotic chase, the roaches shatter one of Oggy's crystal, animal sculptures. Oggy is so depressed that he doesn't even respond to the roaches' nasty attacks. A remastering of "Copy Cat".

Episodes.Title: A Crazy Week-End
Episodes.Description: Jack decides to take Oggy to the seaside for the weekend. Oggy is ecstatic and jumps into the car with his ducky life preserver. But hiding in the shadows of the car are three pesky little stowaways. Yes you guessed right, the three roaches. A remastering of "Blue Sunday".

Episodes.Title: The Challenge
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are having a disagreement to see which show they watch until Jack gets an idea: A 10-Lap Motorcycle Race around Oggy's house and the one who wins gets the remote. The cockroaches on the other hand get involved with the race betting to see which of the 2 cats win but Joey puts most of the bets on Jack while Dee Dee and Marky bet on Oggy. A remastering of "Control Freak".

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Brand-New Face
Episodes.Description: Oggy needs to have plastic surgery after his face gets badly injured during a chase against the Cockroaches. A remastering of "Face Off".

Episodes.Title: Thunder Oggy
Episodes.Description: As Oggy climbs up on the roof to repair his TV antennae, he is struck by lightning. Oggy pounds on the door to get in, then stops, stunned. His fist has gone right through the door without even touching it... He can now walk through walls! A remastering of "Walls Have Ears".

Episodes.Title: Destruction Work In Progress
Episodes.Description: Jack has decided to redo the facade of Oggy's house. While he breaks for a quick snack, the cockroaches steal his tools and his trough in order to build themselves a makeshift pool. A remastering of "Beware Of Destruction".

Episodes.Title: A Greedy Friend
Episodes.Description: After Oggy receives a lava lamp from the post, the cockroaches release the blob from inside of it, which then starts growing and eating anything in its path. A remastering of "The Blob".

Episodes.Title: Christmas Spirit
Episodes.Description: There's a snow storm raging on Christmas eve. Oggy throws the roaches out into the bitter cold so that he can continue decorating the Christmas tree in peace. A remastering of "A Truce for Christmas".

Episodes.Title: What's on the Menu
Episodes.Description: Dressed to the nines, Jack and Oggy go to dinner in the city. Of course, the three beasties tag along but when the cockroaches go crazy, someone is going to get their desserts! A remastering of "Oggy's Night Out".

Episodes.Title: Beach Havoc
Episodes.Description: Oggy arrives at the seaside on his scooter, ready for a nice day of laziness. But the cockroaches, who discover the joys of the Big Blue, its crafty shellfish, its short-lived sandcastles, soon transform this dream-like beach into a battle zone. A remastering of "Beachcombers".

Episodes.Title: Good Night,Don't Sleep Tight
Episodes.Description: Oggy is trembling with fear but completely riveted to a horror film on TV. Of course the roaches take advantage of the situation in order to frighten him even more by pretending to be blood-thirsty monsters... A remastering of "Monster From The Mud Lagoon".

Episodes.Title: Itsy Bitsy Oggy
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches take off with the key to Oggy’s fridge and dash down to the center of the Earth. To flush them out of their hideout, Oggy jumps into the Xerox machine and makes himself the size of the roaches. A remastering of "It's A Small World".

Episodes.Title: Magic Laundry Bag
Episodes.Description: Oggy and the cockroaches enter a world where laundry is alive. A remastering of "Oggy's Bag".

Episodes.Title: Bodyguard Oggy
Episodes.Description: In order to keep the roaches at bay for good, Oggy hires a bodyguard. The gorilla is ready to engage in mortal combat with the roaches each time they get out of hand. A remastering of "Beware Of The Bodyguard".

Episodes.Title: Playing Dough
Episodes.Description: Oggy has a new hobby: modeling clay. With the dexterity of a Rodin, Oggy sculpts a miniature version of the entire house, including himself. A remastering of "All Out Of Shape".

Episodes.Title: Remote Controlled
Episodes.Description: The remote for the TV becomes able to affect reality. A remastering of "Perpetual Motion".

Episodes.Title: Locked Out
Episodes.Description: Oggy has decided to put an end to the roaches' pesky behavior once and for all. He puts a solid padlock on the fridge and hides the key in his piggy-bank. A remastering of "The Piggy Bank".

Episodes.Title: Brain Control
Episodes.Description: By chance one day, the roaches find themselves scrambling through the labyrinth of Jack's (minuscule) brain. A remastering of "It's All Under Control".

Episodes.Title: An Unwanted Customer
Episodes.Description: Oggy is off to the supermarket to shop. But the roaches have tagged along and they sit in the shopping cart stuffing their faces with chicken at Oggy's expense. As he chases the them through the aisles, Oggy turns the supermarket upside down... A remastering of "Crazy Shopping".

Episodes.Title: Green Trouble
Episodes.Description: While picking mushrooms with Jack, Oggy gets bit by a snake. It's countdown time as a disquieting purple spot starts spreading all over poor old Oggy's fur! Despite the traps set by the roaches on Oggy's rush back home, Jack manages to save him... A remastering of "7 Minutes And Counting".

Episodes.Title: Cyber-Oggy
Episodes.Description: After a short circuit, Oggy and Joey have been sucked into the electrical system. Navigating from wire to wire and surfing on the Net, they discover the fascinating world of communication. A remastering of "Vitrual Voyage".

Episodes.Title: Whistle Power
Episodes.Description: Mailman has brought Oggy a stun-whistle in order to neutralize the roaches. But the insects aren't stupid and once they've stolen the whistle they head downtown, paralyzing everything that moves. A remastering of "The Wonder Whistle".

Episodes.Title: The Delights Of Camping
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack go camping and, after a number of mishaps, starting with Dee Dee eating a plant that causes hallucinations to the user, they upset a wild boar who follows them home. A remastering of "Happy Campers".

Episodes.Title: Bad Sport
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are playing an interminable game of chess. Oggy moves one of his pawns forward and wins. A remastering of "Winner Takes All".

Episodes.Title: Showtime!
Episodes.Description: The circus is in town. But Oggy and Jack are flat broke and can't go. Oggy's down in the dumps. To cheer Oggy up, Jack transforms the living room into a three-ring circus. Jack's roach taming number is a big hit! The roaches' revenge is imminent... A remastering of "Fame & Glory".

Episodes.Title: Hiccup Treatment
Episodes.Description: Oggy makes himself a cup of coffee, but just when he’s about to drink he’s lifted up by a monstrous hiccup that throws the coffee right in his face. The cockroaches, dumbfounded by Oggy’s clumsiness, are convinced that he has gone completely crazy! A remastering of "The Hiccup".

Episodes.Title: Rock Bottom
Episodes.Description: Oggy joins Cousteau's expedition on the Calypso, but he drops a ring in the water – the one he'd planned on giving Olivia. So the cockroaches plunge overboard to fish it up.

Episodes.Title: Emperor for a Day
Episodes.Description: During the Napoleonic Wars, Oggy is a cleaner in the French army. Napoleon asks Oggy to replace him, so that he can honour a lover's tryst and the cockroaches do everything they can to unmask Oggy.

Episodes.Title: My Kingdom for a Teddy
Episodes.Description: Oggy solves the mystery of Napoleon's famous pose: the Emperor is hiding his precious cuddly toy. Napoleon is rather ashamed, and orders Oggy to keep quiet and watch over his toy during battle.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Hieroglyphs
Episodes.Description: During the Egyptian campaign, Oggy, Napoleon's aide-de-camp, meets Champollion who enlists him for his archaeological excavations. At the corner of a chase with the roaches, Oggy discovers the Rosetta Stone. But Joey wants to grab it.

Episodes.Title: The Yak Festival
Episodes.Description: It is Yak Festival at the auto-youth area. Assisted by Oggy, Olivia participates as the best trainer, with the small yak of his cafeteria. Bob, winner last year, puts his title in play, while the cockroaches also plan to participate.

Episodes.Title: Housework in Orbit
Episodes.Description: Oggy, a hygiene technician, does his best to keep everything spotless.However his boss, Bob, detects that cleanliness is only 99.97% complete.

Episodes.Title: The Cockroaches' Awakening
Episodes.Description: Oggy has the mission of terra-forming a frozen planet, assigned to him by Bob. Aboard his ship, Oggy thaws the cockroaches, who were trapped in ice. The cockroaches decide to mess with Oggy's mission.

Episodes.Title: The First Samurai
Episodes.Description: When Jack the samurai's hand is disabled, he forces Oggy to be the substitute but Oggy failed and Olivia despite being skilled in battle was rejected due to being female and can only take the role of a geisha. Olivia decides to switch places with Oggy to make things easier.

Episodes.Title: Oggy-Sumo
Episodes.Description: When Oggy is in conflict with Bob, Olivia suggests that the duo should settle with a sumo match to which Oggy has a disadvantage against the big dog.

Episodes.Title: Oggy Manga Star
Episodes.Description: Bored with his life, Oggy compensates by drawing manga, but is forced to hide them from the emperor to which the cockroaches uses that to cause trouble for Oggy.

Episodes.Title: Color Conflict
Episodes.Description: During the Stone Age, Oggy and Jack uses cave paintings as part of a plan to capture a Mammoth for dinner. However, the cockroaches are gonna mess the plans up.

Episodes.Title: Wheeling and Dealing
Episodes.Description: Oggy Maggon has made friends with the Stone Age’s first invention, the Wheel.

Episodes.Title: Mission Apolloggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy gets lost in a car near Cape Canaveral, Joey bites his road map and leads him into the space rocket, then Marky and Dedede, standing in the checkpoint, inadvertently takes off the rocket. Who of the four will walk first on the moon?.

Episodes.Title: The Race to the North Pole
Episodes.Description: April 1909. Jack aims to be the first one to reach the North Pole. Oggy is on his team, of course. But they have rivals: Joey wants to be first to walk on the arctic ice-fields. A crazy race ensues.

Episodes.Title: Jackoromeo and Bobette
Episodes.Description: In Venice, Gondolier Jack falls in love with Bobette, the Doge's daughter. But dog and cat couples aren't tolerated in the Renaissance. Everyone wants to end to their romantic idyll, except Oggy.

Episodes.Title: Masquerade
Episodes.Description: Oggy is a master in the art of making confetti in Venice. The doge orders him to release the confetti for his costume party. By emptying his supply of confetti, Oggy destroys the paradise of cockroaches, who intend to make him pay.

Episodes.Title: Marky Da Vinci
Episodes.Description: Venice 1500 – Oggy is a failed painter unlike Marky who is a true genius at everything, artist as well as an inventor. Marky is going to invent revolutionary machines to allow Joey and Dee Dee to steal Oggy's spaghetti.

Episodes.Title: The Intruder from Space
Episodes.Description: Bob sends Oggy and Olivia to investigate a planet and a spaceship. Dee Dee steals an egg, and takes it home, intending to eat it. However, the egg hatches into an alien, who steals Dee Dee's eyes.

Episodes.Title: The Big Move
Episodes.Description: Prehistoric Oggy and Jack are trying to find a new home after a mistap burned down their old one.

Episodes.Title: Below My Tree
Episodes.Description: After a blow from Oggy’s swatter, the cockroaches want to get even by cutting down the one and only baobab in the village thus crushing Oggy.

Episodes.Title: Head in the Clouds
Episodes.Description: Oggy has a wondrous power: whenever he sings in his village, he causes rain, providing villagers with water. But Joey ties his vocal cords in a knot
