Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Short-Sighted Cyclops
Episodes.Description: Oggyseus disturbs Poseidon who wakes up in a fury and triggers a storm. Oggy's ship ends up on the Cyclops' Island, and the crew is in a terrible state. Will Oggyseus and friends manage to escape?

Episodes.Title: Super Temor
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches are driving Oggy crazy. He goes to a witch-doctor for help, a curse specialist, who bestows him with a genie called “Super Temor”. This creature deals with the cockroaches in a flash, but lingers on with Oggy, behaving in an over-zealous way.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Minotaur
Episodes.Description: Due to a mishap, an angry Zeus sends Olivia and Cockroach Dee Dee into the maze, leaving Oggy, Joey, and Marky on a mission to rescue them before the Minotaur gets them.

Episodes.Title: Mythologgy
Episodes.Description: While chasing each other, Oggy and the cockroaches find themselves in the Olympian Gods Palace.

Episodes.Title: Oggy’s 12 Labors
Episodes.Description: In the Gods Palace, Athena insists that Zeus and Hades do their share of housework. But Zeus is wily and hands his tasks to Oggy and the cockroaches. Now cat and cockroaches have to collaborate.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Misty Mermaids
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches sabotage the compass. The result? Oggyseus’ ship goes off course, and sails straight into the Mermaids’ waters. Joey does a deal with the mermaids to get rid of Oggyseus and his crew. However, when the little mermaid sings her enchanted song, it hypnotizes Jack, Olivia, and Cockroach Marky, so Oggyseus, Joey, and Dee Dee must rescue the trio before the mermaids plan to eat them.

Episodes.Title: The Pig Curse
Episodes.Description: Circe is in love with Oggyseus, and makes a love potion to keep him on her island. Whoever tries to stop her from succeeding will be changed into a pig.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Four
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee makes a false move with the microwave and Oggy, Jack, Olivia and Bob find themselves endowed with super powers. Can the cockroaches compete with adversaries like this?

Episodes.Title: Morgan the Fairy
Episodes.Description: Merlin and the Knights of the Round Table get a visit from Arthur's sister, Morgan, who is not best of friends with Merlin. Can Oggy cope with his new responsibilities as Assistant Wizard?

Episodes.Title: The Jungle Child
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a lost boy in the street. He leaves Jack to babysit while he goes in search of the parents. Jack takes the child for a walk but the cockroaches have plans.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Legend of Excalibur
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a sword stuck in a rock but he can't remove it. Merlin appears and makes an announcement: he who can remove it will be King. Merlin appoints the cat to oversee operations.

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the Search for the Grail
Episodes.Description: The Knights have gathered in the castle with Arthur when Merlin appears. He tells them he has had a vision.

Episodes.Title: Z Men to the Rescue
Episodes.Description: The three diabolical cockroaches escape from jail. The Z-men – Olivia, Jack and Oggy – move into action. Their boss Bob sends them out to neutralise the nasties. But the roaches relish their new-found freedom. No way are they going back behind bars.

Episodes.Title: The Statues’ Awakening
Episodes.Description: The cockroaches have taken over Oggy’s house, occupying his bed, shower, and kitchen.

Episodes.Title: Bananas of Wrath
Episodes.Description: 1150, Khmer Kingdom. King Surya Aman II orders Jack and Oggy to build him a temple (the future Angkor Wat). But Oggy is Jack’s one and only worker.

Episodes.Title: Metalman
Episodes.Description: Oggy buys a special suit so he can FLY when chasing those cockroaches. Soon he ends up flying everywhere, in service to the town. Oggy’s super hero status annoys the three pests and encourages jealousy.

Episodes.Title: Library Hysteria
Episodes.Description: Jack tries to take his cousin with him to practice a manly and healthy sport: rock climbing. As for Oggy, he much rather prefers climbing the ladder in his library. A remastering of "It's a Long Way Down".

Episodes.Title: Well Guarded Gold
Episodes.Description: Oggy discovers a map that indicates that a treasure is hidden right next to his house. But here's the hitch: a prison has suddenly sprung up right on the spot. A remastering of "My Beautiful Prison".

Episodes.Title: The Black Gold Rush
Episodes.Description: In digging its toes, Oggy is oil. In the House, also, it is oil. Once he opens a tap, it's also the oil flowing in. In fact, he has the 'black hand'. His house is quickly invaded of pipelines and rigs of all kinds. It stinks and it's dripping from all but the money comes flowing in. Cockroaches also want their piece of pie, but Joey shows up a little too high roller with the pocketed 1 ticket. A remastering of "Black Saturday Fever".

Episodes.Title: Oggy the Babysitter
Episodes.Description: Oggy is given custody of a baby by his sister and Jack. With his twisted mind, Joey immediately sees the opportunity to make a maximum of money. He decided with his accomplices to kidnap the kid for ransom to Oggy. But with the children, you have to expect everything. Far from being scared, the baby enjoys adventure and the cockroaches are the ones to suffer. A remastering of "Don't Rock the Cradle".

Episodes.Title: Ghost Hunting
Episodes.Description: After Oggy finally manages to kill the cockroaches with a frying pan, the cockroaches' spirits come back and constantly make nightmares a reality for poor Oggy. Oggy has to do a ritual to survive the terror of the three ghosts. A remastering of "The Ghost-Hunter".

Episodes.Title: The Whiz Kid
Episodes.Description: Oggy trips over a small, fat kid sitting on the street and typing with a laptop. The kid then decides to follow Oggy home. But there, the kid starts performing strange experiments on the cockroaches. A remastering of "Brainchild".

Episodes.Title: Drone Out of Control!
Episodes.Description: Jack has ordered a drone and he's barely had time to try it out when the cockroaches figure out what they're going to do with it. Steal it and wreak havoc all over the neighborhood...

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Exoskeleton
Episodes.Description: Armed with his good old fly swatter, Oggy is once again chasing the roaches. Fed up with this medieval weapon, Jack suggests that he tries out his latest invention: a roach exterminator outfit. A remastering of "The Techno-Files".

Episodes.Title: General Jack
Episodes.Description: Once again, the cockroaches have made Oggy look ridiculous. In nothing flat, the cockroaches find themselves locked up in a cage by Jack. A Remastering of "The Dictator"

Episodes.Title: Back To School
Episodes.Description: After getting hit on the head, Oggy dreams he's back in school, with Bob playing all the adult roles. The cockroaches make Oggy the dunce of the class and it looks like he's in for a rough day.

Episodes.Title: The Sacred Roaches
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack went to Egypt to go to the top of “The Great Pyramid of Giza” but when Joey discovers the hole on top of the pyramid, Oggy and the cockroaches fell to the hole and went to the past (when the pyramid is just building). A remastering of "Pharonuf".

Episodes.Title: Bleached!
Episodes.Description: The roaches are doing a wash and the washing machine overflows, spreading suds throughout the house. A rain storm washes it all away and the house and its inhabitants reappear. But in black and white. A remastering of "Black & White".

Episodes.Title: Wild Rides at the Fair
Episodes.Description: The carnival has come to town, and Oggy and Jack are more than happy to go to it. The cockroaches also decide to go to the carnival, just to have massive fun wreaking havoc all over the place. A remastering of "The Carnival's in Town".

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Jungle
Episodes.Description: Oggy has recently bought a super fertilizer that he uses to make his plants super big. But the roaches put a firecracker in the bag, resulting in the bag exploding, showering the house with fertilizer. Now, Oggy’s house has become a jungle, and the animals all have gotten bigger as well... A remastering of "The Garden of Horrors".

Episodes.Title: Xmas Tree Quest
Episodes.Description: Oggy’s artificial Christmas tree is in shreds. Despite a nagging conscience, Oggy decides to cut down a real Christmas tree from the forest. A remastering of "Green Peace".

Episodes.Title: Panic In the Air
Episodes.Description: Oggy has aviophobia (fear of flying), and while taking him on a flight, Jack tries hypnosis to help him relax. However, while a relaxed Oggy has gone walkabout around the plane, the cockroaches have come aboard as well, in which they leave all of the pilots tied up and gagged in order for them to cause the usual problems. A remastering of "Rock 'n Roll Altitude".

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Beach Club
Episodes.Description: Due to a bizarre meteorological phenomenon, the sun shines on Oggy's house but everywhere else, it's raining cats and dogs. Jack decides to take advantage of the situation and turn the house into a Club. A remastering of "Life's a Beach".

Episodes.Title: Oggy and the not So Smart Bracelet
Episodes.Description: Olivia buys a “smart bracelet” which as far as Oggy is concerned, is becoming a little too much part of her life. Oggy looks for a way to get rid of it while Marky goes bug-eyed with wonder over the thing. Jack then introduces Oggy to a app which you can hack the bracelet to do what you want.

Episodes.Title: Zen Oggy
Episodes.Description: Oggy finds a book on flower power and decides to become a peaceful hippy. The cockroaches try to provoke him into losing his temper, but to little avail. A remastering of "Flower-Power".

Episodes.Title: Life's a Zoo
Episodes.Description: When Olivia goes on vacation she asks Oggy to keep her parrot. Oggy also gets Jack's turtle, and some circus animals, all under one roof. How will Oggy survive, especially with the roaches around?

Episodes.Title: Oggy Snail Farmer
Episodes.Description: Oggy found a poor snail and kept it as a pet and bought a lot of snails he enjoy. However, he is about to be in for one slippery ride... A remastering of "Oggy Goes Snailing".

Episodes.Title: Extreme Indoor Sports
Episodes.Description: It's raining like crazy and Monica is bored silly. Then she has an idea: why don't she and Jack try out some indoor sports?

Episodes.Title: Mouse Attack
Episodes.Description: As the roaches watch on with interest, Oggy constructs a remote control for his lawn mower. Right then and there the roaches decide to out-do him. A remastering of "Mouseagator".

Episodes.Title: The Power of Love
Episodes.Description: While Oggy is getting his butt whipped by Jack in a game of Ping-Pong, his sister shows up unannounced. A remastering of "Go For It Jack!".

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Teddy Bear
Episodes.Description: The roaches steal Oggy’s Teddy Bear and hold it hostage for food. But Oggy won’t give in. It turns out though, that his fetish teddy is a collector’s item that Bob wants desperately.

Episodes.Title: Guess Who in the Fridge
Episodes.Description: A female penguin sets up home in Oggy's fridge and doesn't budge an inch. Jack convinces Oggy to disguise himself as a penguin in order to draw the intruder out of the fridge. A remastering of "Penguin Pandenomium".

Episodes.Title: The Roaches Move
Episodes.Description: Tired of being chased by Oggy, the roaches decide to change the tune. A remastering of "Off Limits".

Episodes.Title: Freefall Jump
Episodes.Description: Oggy's sister drags her brother and Jack along for a bit of parachuting. Dee-Dee who's got nothing better to do, follows them. As they get ready to jump, our two fraidy cats show their true colors. A remastering of "Sky Diving".

Episodes.Title: Oggy at Top Speed
Episodes.Description: Jack and Oggy are racing their remote controlled cars through the house. As the race cars zoom through the house they flatten everything in their way, including the roaches. A remastering of "Race to the Finish".

Episodes.Title: Inside Oggy
Episodes.Description: During one of the cockroaches’ many pig-out sessions, Dee Dee falls to the bottom of a strawberry yogurt without noticing that Oggy. A remastering of "Globulopolis".

Episodes.Title: Roach Vision
Episodes.Description: Tired of hunting down the roaches, Oggy orders special glasses that can tell exactly where they are and predict all their moves. With these he can sabotage all their plans. The roaches get so depressed that they want to move out, but Joey always has Plan B...

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Mars
Episodes.Description: In order to flatten out the roaches once and for all, Oggy buys an enormous catapult-fly swatter. Always curious, Joey tries it out and suddenly finds himself projected all the way to Mars. A Remastering Of "Mission To Earth"

Episodes.Title: Roach Express
Episodes.Description: As Oggy gets on the train and waves farewell to Jack, the roaches take over the conductor's controls. Their antics get out of hand and they lose control of the train, which is going faster and faster. A Remastering Of "Do Not Lean Out Of The Window"

Episodes.Title: The Food Dispenser
Episodes.Description: To stop the roaches from eating him dry, Oggy orders a food dispenser and stores all his edibles in it. But when Oggy realises that the roaches have managed to sneak into the machine, war is declared!

Episodes.Title: Oggymon Go
Episodes.Description: Jack and Olivia introduce Oggy to their new obsession: hunting down virtual veggies on their smartphones and winning lots of points. The roaches build a machine to turn Oggy into a huntable character, then hack into the game site to triple the number of points you can get if you catch Oggy, obviously as a incentive for the cats to suck Oggy into their smartphones.

Episodes.Title: Broom Driving
Episodes.Description: A witch lands at Oggy’s then disappears in order to take a snooze, her magical broom stored neatly in the kitchen. A remastering of "Oggy and the Magic Broom".

Episodes.Title: Oggy Learns Swim or Not
Episodes.Description: After being chased about, the cockroaches sniff a horrible odor. All eyes turn to Oggy, who must face the facts that he stinks. But taking a bath is hard for Oggy, who is hydrophobic. Jack tries to cure Oggy of his hydrophobia, while trying to hide the fact that he’s hydrophobic as well. A remastering of "Deep End".

Episodes.Title: Lead Me A Hand Oggy!
Episodes.Description: Oggy orders a remote controlled hand, which scratches wherever you want it to. But our smart cat also uses it to attack the cockroaches. But when Oggy is asleep, the roaches attach the hand to his arm.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Vacations
Episodes.Description: Oggy is joyfully closing the shutters and double locking the front door. Wearing sunglasses and a straw hat, Oggy hops in his camping trailer, destination: vacation. A remastering of "Hit The Road Oggy!".

Episodes.Title: Dumpster Driving
Episodes.Description: Oggy stuffs the roaches into a garbage bag and throws it in the dump truck. He gives them a sarcastic little wave good-bye but isn't paying attention to the back of the truck which snaps shut on him. A Remastering of "What a Dump!"

Episodes.Title: Blah Blah Blah
Episodes.Description: Unbeknownst to him, Oggy has just bought a box of special biscuits. Whoever eats them becomes a real gossip. A Remastering of "Chatter Box"

Episodes.Title: Alpine Antics
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are getting a taste of alpine antics. While Jack is being a real show-off on his skis, Oggy is sledding with caution. A Remastering of "Ski Bugs"

Episodes.Title: Oggy at the Opera
Episodes.Description: An exceptional gala evening at the Opera is under way with the famous tenor Jack. But Dee Dee is a bit of a music buff himself and tonight he'd like to share the stage and the glory with Jack. A Remastering Of "A Night at the Opera".

Episodes.Title: Oggy Copy Cat
Episodes.Description: Oggy accidentally falls into the Xerox machine. He disappears and his double, flat as a photocopy, pops out of the machine and comes to life. A Remastering Of "Paper Chase"

Episodes.Title: A Roachneck Cousin
Episodes.Description: The roaches country cousin shows up for a visit. The little bumpkin has a real green thumb and immediately tends to all the damage his cousins have inflicted on Oggy's garden. A Remastering Of "Roachy Redneck"

Episodes.Title: Sharing Oggy
Episodes.Description: Monica, Oggy's sister pays a family visit. She quickly understands she's got to share her brother with his girlfriend, Olivia. The two girls are polar opposites.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Elevator
Episodes.Description: Oggy builds an elevator in order to catch the nasty little bugs more easily. But the roaches immediately build one of their own. Oggy ups the ante and builds another one, then another, then another. A Remastering Of "Going Up"

Episodes.Title: Very Special Treatment
Episodes.Description: After a cockroach chase that has finished badly, Oggy finds himself at the hospital. A Remastering Of "Emergency Room"

Episodes.Title: Oggy Cranes His Neck
Episodes.Description: Oggy decides to renovate his house by building it higher. So he buys a used crane on-line. Except he has a heck of a time mastering the cranky, old machine.

Episodes.Title: And the Winner Is... Dee Dee
Episodes.Description: Dee Dee steals money from Oggy's piggy bank and plays the lottery. He wins and heads off to pick up the big prize only to learn he's won a milking cow. A Remastering of "Milk Diet"

Episodes.Title: Oggy Goes to Paris
Episodes.Description: Like any tourist in Paris, Oggy buys a ticket for the Folies Bergère from a sidewalk ticket-salesman and then decides to kill time until the show by going to see the Eiffel Tower. Dee Dee takes advantage of his inattention and snags his ticket...  Remastering of "Welcome To Paris"

Episodes.Title: Vertigo!
Episodes.Description: Jack has invited Oggy to visit the construction site of his future home sweet home. But in his megalomania, Jack has found nothing better to build than a skyscraper. A Remastering of "The Rise Of The Fall

Episodes.Title: High Security Fridge
Episodes.Description: Once again the roaches have raided the fridge. But Oggy has more than one trick up his sleeve and this time the little critters are going to be caught in a trap they can't get out of. A Remastering Of "Caught In A Trap"

Episodes.Title: The Golf Pro
Episodes.Description: Jack takes Oggy out to play golf. Despite his complete lack of talent, he manages to sink holes-in-one right and left. Jack is beside himself with rage. The roaches who are bored decide to move the holes around in order to spice up the game... A Remastering Of "GA Remastering Of "Golf Curse"olf Curse"

Episodes.Title: A Carriage For Jack
Episodes.Description: On his way home from shopping, Oggy unintentionally steps on a frog. He picks it up and kisses it to ask forgiveness. A Remastering of "The Pumpkin That Pretended To Be A Ferrari"

Episodes.Title: Alien Roaches
Episodes.Description: During a raid on the kitchen, the cockroaches are surprised by extraterrestrial cockroaches. An abominable racket finally wakes up Oggy. A Remastering of "Space Roaches"

Episodes.Title: The Laugh Box
Episodes.Description: Oggy has lately been watching old sitcoms. Joey records some of the laughter, then tags behind the cat, hitting play when our favourite feline does the slightest move. Joey then makes Oggy swallow the tape recorder, and makes it look like Oggy is laughing by a remote connected to the tape. The whole neighborhood now thinks Oggy is rude, because he laughs when he’s not supposed to. A Remastering of "Sitcom"

Episodes.Title: Hide and Go Whiskers!
Episodes.Description: The roaches cut off Jack's whiskers so they can use them like pogo sticks. But with no whiskers, Jacks panics. Oggy tries a miracle "whisker growing lotion" but the result is going to be very weird!

Episodes.Title: Where's the Exit?
Episodes.Description: Jack drags Oggy along for some jogging. A Remastering Of "Missing In Action"

Episodes.Title: Brainy Roaches
Episodes.Description: Through one of the cockroaches’ latest pranks, Jack’s brain, hardly bigger than a chickpea, finds itself unceremoniously ejected from his skull. A Remastering of "Toy's R Oggy"

Episodes.Title: Nursing the Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Bob finds himself in a full body cast after an accident caused by Oggy. To make up for it, the cat decides to look after Bob, becoming his full-time nurse.

Episodes.Title: Space Journey
Episodes.Description: Oggy is piloting the space craft replacement for the space station that is orbiting around the earth! Once he's rid himself of his space suit. A Remastering of "Lost In Space"

Episodes.Title: Boxing Match
Episodes.Description: In order to regain his pride (thank-you roaches!) Bob challenges Oggy to a duel. A Remastering of "Boxing Fever"

Episodes.Title: Freezing Cold
Episodes.Description: After pillaging the fridge, the roaches forget to close the door. And the ice age returns! The ground, the walls, the garden all freeze over...and pretty soon it's the entire earth! Jack and Oggy are now living in the North Pole... Brrrrrrrrrrr! A Remastering of "Keep Cool!"

Episodes.Title: A Dreamy Cruise
Episodes.Description: Oggy and Jack are on a magnificent cruise ship. While Jack, Joey and Marky are seasick to their stomachs. A Remastering of "Mayday! Mayday!"

Episodes.Title: Hypnotic Oggy
Episodes.Description: Marky is learning hypnosis and it seems to work like crazy on Oggy! Under the spell of our evil roach, Oggy starts doing the most outrageous things all over the neighborhood. A Remastering of "Hip Hip Hip Hypnoses"

Episodes.Title: Fishing Lesson
Episodes.Description: Jack takes Oggy out to teach him how to fish. Ah nature, fresh air, the soft chirping of birds in the shade. A Remastering of "Fishing Frolic"

Episodes.Title: Snake and Snacks
Episodes.Description: On their way back from a picnic at the zoo, Oggy and Jack discover a boa stowaway in their basket. More slippery than soap, they can't get a grip on the snake. After the roaches, it's Jack's turn to get gobbled up by the boa... A Remastering of "Warning! Boa On The Run!"

Episodes.Title: The Big Bad Wolf
Episodes.Description: A wolf escapes from the penitentiary and is hanging out in Oggy’s neighborhood, looking for food. When he ends up swallowing Oggy and Joey, Marky and Dee Dee try to rescue them, with a little help from Olivia playing the role of little red riding hood…

Episodes.Title: Poor Sports
Episodes.Description: When the roaches sabotage a virtual game in which Oggy and Jack get to smash cockroaches, the cats decide to face off with each other in a more traditional game.

Episodes.Title: The Giant Roaches
Episodes.Description: Oggy sets up a pair of binoculars, but the roaches take advantage of his drowsiness to put a binocular lens underneath each eyelid. When Oggy wakes up, he bumps into giant cockroaches! A Remastering of "Oggy and the Giant Roaches"

Episodes.Title: Up, Up and Up!
Episodes.Description: After having put the chicken in the stove to cook, Oggy heads off to do a bit of gardening. A Remastering of "Up To... No Good!"

Episodes.Title: Fake News
Episodes.Description: When cockroaches post fake videos on the internet and pass themselves off as victims abused by Oggy, the reputation of the cat takes a shot... Jack and Oggy trick and trap cockroaches in turn to restore the truth on the web.

Episodes.Title: The Machine
Episodes.Description: Jack has built an imposing machine that is capable of modifying, recycling or transforming just about anything. A Remastering of "Jack-In-A-Box"

Episodes.Title: Whose Turn to Do the Dishes?
Episodes.Description: Jack has left the house in a total mess and Oggy makes him clean up. The roaches, who are living in the dirty dishes, make sure that Jack would rather play around than clean the house.

Episodes.Title: Oggy's Got Talent!
Episodes.Description: Oggy accidentally becomes an ace guitarist and the roaches sign him up for "You've got Talent!", hoping to milk his popularity. But teen-idol Oggy has a huge ego and all the whims of a pop star.

Episodes.Title: The Witch Hunt
Episodes.Description: A irritable witch turned Oggy into mice and cockroaches into cats. The roles reverse: Oggy becomes a fugitive and discovers his house under a new dimension.... The Cockroaches! And the cockroaches are taking advantage of the situation...

Episodes.Title: Run for Shelter
Episodes.Description: Jack is playing with his toy soldiers. Fed up with his cousin's stupid childish games, Oggy tells him he should go play outside. A Remastering of "Take Cover"

Entries.Title: Gachiakuta
Entries.Description: In a floating city where the rich discard their waste—and people—Rudo is framed for murder and thrown into the Pit, where a hellscape of mutated garbage beasts dwell. To survive, he must wield a new power and join the rogue Cleaners. Rudo doesn’t just aim to battle monsters, but the corrupt who cast him into Hell.

Episodes.Title: The Sphere
Episodes.Description: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

Episodes.Title: The Inhabited
Episodes.Description: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

Episodes.Title: The Ground
Episodes.Description: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

Episodes.Title: Cleaner HQ
Episodes.Description: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

Entries.Title: The Producers
Entries.Description: A rookie producer joins the Korean Broadcasting System to be near his secret crush and enters the madcap world of network TV, where ratings rule.

Episodes.Title: The Variety Department, Unintentionally
Episodes.Description: On his first day of work, Seung-chan is interviewed by “Documentary 3 Days” for a feature on working at KBS and gets a taste of his complex new job.

Episodes.Title: News of Quitting, Unintentionally
Episodes.Description: Jun-mo has to orchestrate bad news, Cindy stops by her ruthless agent’s office and Seung-chan struggles to get toner cartridge for the team printer.

Episodes.Title: Pheasant Instead of Chicken, Unintentionally
Episodes.Description: Seung-chan feels hated at work, Ye-jin frets about paying for car repairs and the “Two Days and One Night” team tries a new concept.

Episodes.Title: Acting That Way, Unintentionally
Episodes.Description: Seung-chan’s team tests new games for the show relaunch, Ye-jin gets a notice from the communications commission and Cindy takes a calculated risk.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Editing
Episodes.Description: Cindy gets a hard lesson about herself, Jun-mo takes a stand and Ye-jin has too much to drink. Seung-chan learns the ins and outs of food delivery.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Broadcast Accidents
Episodes.Description: Seung-chan confronts Jun-mo, Ye-jin confides in Seung-chan and Cindy wants to try a new sweet public persona after running into saintly Lee Seung-gi.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Media Play
Episodes.Description: Ye-jin and Jun-mo get an unexpected visitor, Seung-chan works on his poker face and rumors start flying when Cindy goes missing.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Love Lines
Episodes.Description: Seung-chan’s reaction confuses Cindy, the entertainment department takes part in the annual sports meet and Go A-ra visits the show.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Preemptions
Episodes.Description: Seung-chan helps Ye-jin move into her new place, “Two Days and One Night” gets bumped, Jun-mo resolves not to lose his spot and Cindy has doubts.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Previews
Episodes.Description: Jun-mo is unsure if he wants to let go, Seung-chan tries editing, Cindy shows her hand and Ye-jin thinks she’s good at reading situations.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Ratings
Episodes.Description: Seung-chan doesn’t want to lose hope, Jun-mo wonders if producers get to decide, Ye-jin seeks relationship advice and Cindy deals with bad press.

Episodes.Title: Understanding Long Running Programs
Episodes.Description: The team questions Jun-mo’s decision, Seung-chan wants a reshoot, Cindy’s conflict with Byun comes to a head and the show’s future is unclear.

Entries.Title: Six Flying Dragons
Entries.Description: The ambitious success stories of 6 people surrounding Prince Lee Bang Won, and the ideological and political conflict between Prince Lee Bang Won and Jung Do Jeon, the man instrumental in helping King Taejo establish the fledgling Joseon nation.

Entries.Title: She Was Pretty
Entries.Description: After a complete reversal of fortune and looks, childhood sweethearts reunite for the first time in 15 years as employees at a fashion magazine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin’s old friend Sung-joon wants to meet up with her. When he shows up looking unexpectedly handsome, Hye-jin asks Ha-ri to pretend to be her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin sees Sung-joon again when he joins her team as an editor at The Most magazine. Sung-joon scolds her harshly for her clumsiness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Shin-hyuk notices there’s something going on between Hye-jin and Sung-joon. Tired of being looked down on, Hye-jin starts learning all about fashion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin calls Sung-joon after drinking to deal with his treatment of her. Ha-ri starts falling for Sung-joon as she continues meeting him as Hye-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: On her day off, Hye-jin overhears Sung-joon talking on the phone about how The Most could cease publication unless performances improve.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin worries about Sung-joon’s health. As he gets to know Ha-ri better, Sung-joon starts to notice that she is different from the Hye-jin he knew.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sung-joon forgets his wallet when he gets lunch with Hye-jin while on assignment. They are put to work to earn back what they owe the restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Shin-hyuk tries to convince Ha-ri to stop pretending to be Hye-jin. Sung-joon struggles to deal with the feelings he has for both Hye-jin and Ha-ri.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin’s colleagues marvel at her transformation when she returns to work. Shin-hyuk continues to tease Hye-jin as she and Sung-joon get closer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Sung-joon rushes to Hye-jin’s side after her car breaks down. As he holds her tightly, he realizes just how much he cares about her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin and Sung-joon meet and catch up on all the things that have happened between them. Ha-ri’s mother comes to see her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Sung-joon convinces Shin-hyuk to stay at The Most. Shin-hyuk returns back to work, but his feelings for Hye-jin remain unchanged.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Hye-jin starts seeing Sung-joon but his completely different attitude at work makes her worry that their colleagues will figure out what is happening.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: The Most’s big interview gets canceled at the last minute, but Poong-ho makes a brilliant suggestion of interviewing the famous writer Ten.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Sung-joon is shocked to learn Ten’s true identity. As Hye-jin prepares to move to America, a children’s book author invites her to work with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Sung-joon talks to Hye-jin every day since moving to America, while she starts writing children’s books. One day, Sung-joon stops answering his phone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description:
Day 1 (Jirisan)

The members played Boom Boom game as the character selection game. Whoever gets it wrong will be out and last one standing will get to choose the character first.

For a chance to have a pancake for lunch (Na PD as the chef), the members played Complete the Phrase game.

The members get to drink espresso among the herbal tea, sophora root tea (a healthy but bitter taste tea).

The members are split up into group of 3 playing SNS Challenge.

Hodong, Soogeun & Mino (Team Hengbu)

Jiwon, Kyuhyun & P.O. (Team Nolbu)

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Hodong was given a task by Na PD to give the morning mission briefing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description:
3

Winners of "Music Scholarship Quiz" are Mino (1st, 210 points), Soogeun (2nd, 170 points), P.O and Hodong (joint 3rd, 150 points), Kyuhyun (5th, 110 points) and Jiwon (last, zero points).

After their dinner, Na PD started the morning mission.

Morning Mission

The theme of the morning mission is "What are You Doing Now". Each member will pick a card that will indicate their task to perform till 9 am the next day.

If the member is able to perform the task as stated in the card, the first three members will have a breakfast from the food truck.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description:
After the dinner, they played the "Guess Who Quiz".

For every wrong answer, the production team will remove a Jirisan speciality product from the list of 10 items from the table.

They did not win any speciality products.

Na PD suggested they form Team Old Boys (Hodong, Soogeun & Jiwon) and Team Young Boys (Kyuhyun, Mino & P.O) and play "Bonus Round over Pears".

Team Young Boys eventually win the quiz and a box of apples.

Na PD started the Nana Late Night Snack Bar.

This is an indivdual game challenge. If they are able to answer the questions, they will be rewarded with the choice of food. If failed, they will be penalised.

Morning Mission

The theme of the morning mission is "Keep Your Item". They will have to hide and preserve the item they received till the 9am next day.

The first three winners will get a hearty breakfast with a beautiful view.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description:
A few days later,

Mino and P.O were tasked to design on a t-shirt and hoody jacket for each member and was present on their team building at the studio.

Na PD announced the new theme is Retreat for Team Building as a company.

Na PD presented 6 makeup designs for the members to decide and played Boom Boom game to select. They end up with the panda makeup.

Lunch choice

Prior to lunch, Jiwon was asked to make a voiceover of the Swallow (his character in this season) in the car.

The remaining were given a task to guess Jiwon's choice of first dish from a selection of 12.

If they are successful, they will earn one Dragon Ball but they failed.

Korean Language Game

Na PD joined the memebers in the car to play "Korean Language Game", but they failed. They have to do a live streaming.

They were given a re-match but they failed.

At the restaurant, they played "Strawberry Game" to get lunch.

After arriving at Yeongwol, they start the team building game.

Episodes.Description: Ki Joon proposes to Chae Yeon, but she's angered by his manner. Ri Jin agreed to be Do Hyun's secret doctor.

Episodes.Title: Turning the fate into destiny... that’s my third mistake.
Episodes.Description: My third mistake was my destiny. Ri Jin meets all of Do Hyun's personalities in one night.

Episodes.Title: The memory that only you can remember... am I there inside it?
Episodes.Description: Se Gi declares total war on Do Hyun and Jeon Myun while Ri Jin remains at the mercy of Se Gi.

Episodes.Title: Show me and persuade me with your charms.
Episodes.Description: Tae Im is shocked by seeing the video footage from Joon Pyo's hospital room and subsequently faints.

Episodes.Title: If you did it, then I will do it too. Because you’ll become me soon!
Episodes.Description: Do Hyun learns later what Se Gi has done and falls into despair. Chae Yeon is all the more shaken by Do Hyun.

Episodes.Title: It’s Ahn Yo Na’s world from now on! Oppa~!
Episodes.Description: Yo Na, Do Hyun's other personality, comes out and kisses Ri On on his cheek. Do Hyun finds Seo Yeon's photo.

Episodes.Title: I’ll find out about everything that had happened!
Episodes.Description: I'll find out what happened! Do Hyun spends a merry night with Ri Jin's family and regains his spirits.

Episodes.Title: Living the rest of my life to atone for the sin won’t be enough; you’re the person covered with the wounds.
Episodes.Description: Do Hyun begins recalling his lost memory and Ri On decides to look into who masterminded Ri Jin's kidnapping.

Episodes.Title: I will remember this for a long time.
Episodes.Description: I'll remember for a really long time. Do Hyun goes on a trip with Ri Jin on the winter train.

Episodes.Title: Please don’t hit Do Hyun!
Episodes.Description: Do Hyun and Ri Jin falls in shock as they remember the past. And Do Hyun learns about the fire accident.

Episodes.Title: Let’s run away..first, from the terrifying memories.
Episodes.Description: Let's run away from the terrifying memory. Ki Joon begins to collect all kinds of information about Do Hyun.

Episodes.Title: Who would despise those two people the most?
Episodes.Description: Ki Joon and Chae Yeon are surprised to learn that Do Hyun has multiple personality disorder.

Episodes.Title: Should we open the bag?
Episodes.Description: The hidden personality of Mr. X, along with Na Na, reflects Do Hyun's healing process.

Entries.Title: Oh My Venus
Entries.Description: Dumped by her boyfriend of 15 years for gaining weight, a lawyer gets help from a hotshot personal trainer to get in shape and turn her life around.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In high school, Ju-eun was "Venus of Daegu". Fifteen years later, she's achieved her dream of being a lawyer, but she's no longer every man's crush.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Young-ho thinks he can hide out in Korea away from the prying eyes of his grandmother, but he's soon proven wrong. Ju-eun loses her cellphone.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: For Ju-eun, a chance meeting with John Kim is the opportunity of a lifetime. But for John Kim, Ju-eun is a nuisance to get rid of as soon as he can.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Feeling guilty and responsible for Ju-eun's fainting spell, Young-ho decides to plan a more legitimate weight loss program for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: U-sik watches secretly as Young-ho helps Ju-eun at a time of crisis. Young-ho begins experiencing pain in his leg again, which gets him worried.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Young-ho gets dragged into "Ju-eun's Day" to celebrate her weight loss. Su-jin keeps bugging Ju-eun about the case Ju-eun doesn't want to take.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ju-eun confronts Su-jin about her attitude, both in work and in life. Young-ho ponders whether to grant his aging grandmother's one last wish.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Feeling betrayed, Ju-eun tells Young-ho that she doesn't date liars. Later, she heads down to Daegu to help her family with the new restaurant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Caught in a moment of weakness, Young-ho opens up to Ju-eun about his past. They decide to keep their relationship a secret for the time being.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Ju-eun moves out of Young-ho's place in time for him to begin his first day of work at Gahong, where a struggle for power is in full swing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Young-ho decides to lie low at Ju-eun's until the media dies down. Young-ho's grandmother finds out about his relationship and expresses disapproval.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Things seem to be finally coming together for Young-ho and Ju-eun, but there are still unresolved problems that threaten to cause trouble.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Ju-eun gets worried when she can't get a hold of Young-ho. Mr. Min looks into the details of the crash. Su-jin and Ju-eun have a long-overdue talk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: For Young-ho, the past year has been nothing but a struggle for a miracle, as even his doctor couldn't guarantee a favorable prognosis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ju-eun's mom visits her without prior notice and continues to nag her to get married. Young-ho's grandmother looks into Ju-eun's personal details.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Expecting the worst, Ju-eun meets with Young-ho's grandmother. Later, she tells Young-ho what his grandmother asked of her.

Entries.Title: Witch's Castle
Entries.Description: Oh Dan-Byul lost her parents due to her own mistake. She marries Joon-Young, but her husband passes away. Meanwhile, her mother-in-law, Ho-Duk, divorces because of her husband's infidelity and her sister-in-law, Se-Sil, returns to South Korea after divorcing her Italian husband. Now, these three women live together while overcoming their own personal problems and becoming important to each other.

Entries.Title: Yong Pal
Entries.Description: Operating under the alias Yong-pal, a surgeon gets enmeshed in a dark conspiracy involving a chaebol heiress forcibly put in a medically induced coma.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A VIP who was in a car accident lies in a coma. Yong-pal, a superstar surgeon, treats gangsters on the side to pay off his debt, and to cover treatments for his sister.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Yong-pal's scalpel was left at the last job and the police follow up the lead. Dr. Kim is assigned an ICU patient with no known family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Dr. Kim makes a stealthy move to save Young-ae from herself. Dr. Kim makes a house call for a celebrity who gets into some trouble with a woman in a hotel room.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hae-in tries to get revenge on Cha Se-yoon and threatens to kill everyone in the hospital in the process.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Tae-hyun's sister's condition gets worse. The board pushes for a court order to visit Young-ae, which forces the Chairman to make a call.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Nurse Hwang takes matters into her own hands to find out what's going on with her patient and overhears a conversation she was not meant to hear. Tae-hyun tries to figure out who is really on Young-ae's side.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: President Go and the Chairman sit down to discuss the future. Tae-hyun, having lost a lot of blood, faints in the OR.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The Chairman invites Chief Lee and Dr. Kim to his house for dinner to make sure they understand that he owns them. Chae-young tells Tae-hyun how Yeo-jin ended up in a perpetual coma.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Yeo-jin regains her strength and gets closer to Tae-hyun. Tae-hyun tells her how his sister ended up with liver damage. A local woman needs Tae-hyun's help.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tae-hyun returns to the hospital to find that a lot of things have changed. He agrees to trade his life for his sister's safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: The Chairman and President Go make arrangements for Yeo-jin's funeral. Yeo-jin puts her own plan into action and finds what her father left for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A war is brewing and everyone must choose a side. Tae-hyun asks Man-sik for help, and Doo-chul comes to Tae-hyun's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The funeral does not end the way Do-joon expected. Tae-hyun sees his new home. Chae-young and President Go try to figure out their place in the new world order.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Tae-hyun has trouble adjusting to being a bigwig at the hospital, and he finds out what happened the night his mother was brought into the hospital. Yeo-jin wants revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Chae-young reaches out to Tae-hyun for help as Yeo-jin exacts revenge on her brother. Tae-hyun tries to reason with Yeo-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yeo-jin wages war against Daejung Group. Tae-hyun makes a move that he thinks will help Yeo-jin, but it doesn't work out the way he expected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Tae-hyun has built a clinic in a small town and is trying to lead a quiet, happy life. Chae-young still wants revenge for her husband.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Tae-hyun learns who his friends and allies are when people show their true colors. Yeo-jin finally gets her ring.

Entries.Title: I Remember You
Entries.Description: This drama is a romantic thriller that centers around a criminal profiler, Lee Hyun who previously work as a consultant at the police department in New York. After he returns to south Korea, he’s in charge of a special criminal investigation team. Due to his special insight, he can analyze the crime scene and the suspect at one glance. He works together with an elite detective, Cha Ji An to solve the crimes and they develop a romantic relationship.

Episodes.Title: Every Child's Story Begins with Their Parents
Episodes.Description: Lee Hyun, a Criminologist working for the New York Police, returns to Korea to investigate a recent email that he received.  He hopes to recover all of his early memories that he lost after the tragic murder of his father.  On arrival at the airport, he deciphers some cryptographic symbology that leads him to a recent murder scene.  Team 1 Investigative Unit arrives while he is there and mistakes him for the new Team Leader.  However, Cha Ji-An, the Lead Investigator knows who he is because she has stalked him since her youth.

Episodes.Title: Hello, Monster
Episodes.Description: Plagued by insidious thoughts planted by serial killer Lee Joon-Yeong and recent events; Lee Hyun's father believes that he is becoming a monster.  He isolates him in the basement to protect both him and the world.  Joon-Yeong escapes from prison, murders his father and absconds with his brother.  Lee Hyun discovers a painting at a murder scene that he believes may be his brother Lee Min’s.

Episodes.Title: Thou Shall Not Kill, But...
Episodes.Description: Team 1 working with Lee Hyun come up with a profile of the victims.  Cha Ji-An races to the next suspected victim and is successful in capturing the murder suspect but complications arise as there is no proof and the target drops any charges.  Attorney Jung Sun-ho arrived during the interrogation process and thwarts Lee Hyun and Cha Ji-An efforts to get a confession.

Episodes.Title: The Suspect, Lee Hyun
Episodes.Description: The murder suspect, Yang Seung-Hoon, leaves on the first available plane to China.  Lee Hyun illegally uses Cha Ji-An’s computer and informs Chinese authorities of his drug trafficking.  They find evidence at his house and arrest him on arrival. Team Leader Kang Eun-Hyuk and Planning Officer Hyun Ji-Soo are reprimanded by the Deputy Chief for mishandling the case.  Cha Ji-An is transferred to another department.  Detective Yang sets up a meeting with Lee Hyun to relay some pertinent information concerning Joon-Ho.  Detective Yang is murdered, and he becomes the prime suspect.

Episodes.Title: Borne Back Ceaselessly into the Past
Episodes.Description: Cha Ji-An is going stir crazy wanting to investigate so she joins up with Lee Hyun.  They evade capture by hiding in a closet at the crime scene.  They start bonding while he hides out at her place, and she attends his wounds. He convinces her to spy for him. Together they are able to figure out who the murderer is and his next target.  The Team Leader, Kang Eun-Hyuk, makes the arrest.  He and the Planning officer convince the Deputy Chief to return Cha Ji-An to the team.

Episodes.Title: The Blood of a Murderer
Episodes.Description: Lee Hyun meets with Prosecutor Shin Jang-Ho concerning Park Young-Chul's case.  Jang-Ho informs Lee Hyun has experienced two cases of memory loss in relationship to his parents' deaths. Also, that Lee Joon-Yeong never leaves any bodies to be found for his murder cases.  In order to investigate the Park Jeung-Woo murder case, Lee Hyun is coerced to join Team 1 as an official advisor. Lee Hyun hires Jung-Sun-ho to be Lee Jung-Ha’s attorney because he believes he is innocent.

Episodes.Title: Let's Be Partners?
Episodes.Description: Lee Hyun confronts Cha Ji-An about her doubting him and thinking he may be like Lee Joon-Yeong. Lee Hyun believes Lee Jung-Ha is covering for Lee Jin-Woo.  Teams 1 solves the Park Jeung-Woo murder case.  After doing some soul searching, Cha Ji-An comes to the conclusion that she is wrong, and Lee Hyun is not like Lee Joon-Yeong.  She tells him that he is weird and annoying but not a monster.  After solidifying their partnership, she asks him out on a date and takes him to a closed amusement park to spend time together.

Episodes.Title: Remember Me
Episodes.Description: Chi Ji-An is brutally attacked in her home and Attorney Jung comes to her rescue.  Lee Hyun finds it suspicious and questions him if Yang Seung-Hoon is behind the attack.  After her hospitalization, Lee Hyun decides to let her stay with him for a few days.  Ji-An is awakened from her sleep to find Lee Hung at his desk having nightmares.  When Lee Hyun checks back with his Art Gallery friend, Na Bong Sun, finds out the symbol on the paintings is linked to an employee at the Fako Shipyard.  Going undercover, he discovers another dead body.

Episodes.Title: Stalker S
Episodes.Description: The Planning Officer still refuses to open up to Lee Hyun concerning his past in regard to Joon-Young.  Team 1 starts working on another serial killer case involving stalking and missing persons. Detective Son’s blind date, Ji Hyun-Sook, goes missing.  Lee Hyun develops a profile with possible locations the culprit may be working from.  While Cha Ji-An and Team Leader Kang go to check it out, Lee Hyun has a dinner date with two persons of interest to him, Attorney Jung and Pathologist Lee.

Episodes.Title: Find Me
Episodes.Description: The serial killers, Do Jae-Shik and Kang Seong-Eun, capture Cha Ji-An and leave Team Leader Kang dying from a knife wound.  Lee Hyun, Attorney Jung, and Pathologist Lee join Team 1 as they rush to apprehend the suspects. Planning Officer Hyun finally confesses about her deal with Joon-Yeong that inadvertently lead to the death of his father and his brother’s disappearance. Officer Cha and Ji Hyun-Sook are rescued. Budding romance blooms as Lee Hyun and Ji-An move closer in their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Birth of a Monster
Episodes.Description: Detective Jang’s missing notebook mysteriously appears at Lee Hyun’s home.  Following the clues in the notebook, Ji-An and Lee Hyun arrive at the original home of Lee Joon-Yeong.  They discover a casket with the bones of what may be Joon-Yeong’s mother.  Park Joo-Ah, one of the family caregivers, comes forward and relates Joon-Yeong’s childhood and the death of everyone else living there.  Detective Ji-An’s stalking skills are put to use resolving key issues Lee Hyun is categorizing in his head, and he realizes that every time he visited Korea, he was given a gift box which contained clues left by his brother.  Joo Yeong-Jae, a student, is murdered and the adoptive parents' actions are questioned.

Episodes.Title: If I Had to Kill Somebody...
Episodes.Description: Team 1 arrest Joo Yeong-Jae’s mother for abuse as she was a witness to the beating and did not interfere.  Na Bong-Sung provides Lee Hyun with enough evidence to support his theory that Attorney Jung is his brother Lee Min. Min catches Hyun at his home looking at his paintings. Hyun request Min not to kill anymore but if he has a need to kill him first.  Photos are delivered to the precinct that are threatening to Lee Hyun.  Convinced that it is possibly a professional killer out to take revenge for the death of his girlfriend, Hyun believes that he will be punished by the death of Ji-An or Min.

Episodes.Title: What Choice Would You Make?
Episodes.Description: Jo Yong-Woo attacks Lee Min in order to make Lee Hyun suffer.  Cha Ji-An arrives in time to prevent Yong-Woo from killing Min, but he manages to get away.  Lee Hyun confronts the Planning Officer and Deputy Chief about their collusion with Lee Joon-Yeong. Ji-An has concluded that the Medical Examiner, Lee Jun Ho is really Lee Joon-Yeong.  Tracing Jo Yong-Woo’s phone takes the team to the site where he was tortured, killed and buried.  While the team is celebrating Ji An's birthday, she receives a delivery package that contains a birthday card and map.

Episodes.Title: Lee Joon-young's Room
Episodes.Description: Reeling from the discovery of her father’s remains, Cha Ji-An wants revenge but has to settle for seeking justice.  Lee Min decides to move in with Lee Hyun and Lee Joon-Yeong’s hopes for living together with the brothers is shattered.  Planning Officer Hyun Ji-Soo is murdered, devastating the entire team.  Hyun is shocked to find out how badly Min’s logic has been tainted.  Team Leader Kang finds out who framed Ji-An’s father as an accomplice during Joon-Yeong's escape.  Ji-An seizes an opportunity to search Joon-Yeong’s home.

Episodes.Title: Is a Happy Ending Possible?
Episodes.Description: Lee Min catches Chai Ji-An ransacking Lee Jeong-Yeong’s special room but allows her to leave with some photos of children that he has taken under his wing.  Joon-Yeong poses a question to Lee Hyun, “Would you be able to take care of him by yourself?”  Kang Eun-Hyuk informs Ji-An of his father’s role in framing her dad. Min Seung-Joo finds out Choi Eun-Bok is one of Joon-Yeong’s kids.  He tries to get him to turn himself in for the murder of the Planning Officer Hyun Ji-Soo, Lee Hyun adopted mother. During the apprehension of Eun Bok, Hyun retrieves a fallen weapon which triggers memories of his past that causes him to collapse.

Episodes.Title: I Remember You
Episodes.Description: Lee Hyun remembers his past of killing the murderer of his mom and the meaning behind Lee Min’s cards. Cha Ji-An tells Lee Min to turn himself in because it is wrong to hurt other people and if he doesn’t, he and Hyun will never have a happy ending. Kang Eun-Hyuk interrupts Lee Joon-Yeong choking Ji-An. Later, he tells Ji-An that he likes her. Hyun and Min spend time together to cement the bonding of brotherhood. Joon-Yeong is stabbed by one of his kids and then Min attempts to kill him. Hyun arrives after Min is stabbed but is knockout. Min and Joon-Yeong disappear. After visiting Ji-An three times, Hyun disappears. Choi Eun-Bok confesses to killing the Planning Officer and decides to be a witness against Joon-Yeong.

Entries.Title: The Time We Were Not in Love
Entries.Description: A drama about the growing pains of turning thirty for two longtime friends.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A model disappears before a shoe launch. In the chaos, her boyfriend brings more to her plate with marriage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Oh Hana fears the gossip around Joo Hojoon's wedding. Thing get worse at work, and her heart flutters for an intern.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hana begins to feel attracted to Gi Seongjae. He keeps on approaching her, where Choi Won feels uneasy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hana's family suspects a relationship between her and Won. They suddenly announce their hot spring trip.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Cha Seohoo returns and Won is left nervous. Hana's heart may have gotten her heart shaking for him again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Seohoo learns about the chance of Lee Soeun being Won's junior at work. He now makes a request to meet Hana.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hana gets some time alone to figure out herself. Seohoo feels something sweeter for Hana.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Won has the opportunity for a two-year trip for training. Hana hears Park Jonghoon talking about the engagement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Seohoo begins to boldly express his feelings for Hana. Director Byeon Wooshik orders a review of the project.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Changsoo and Jeongmi's wedding after-party happens. Hana and Won get awkward, and friends suspect them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Seohoo goes inside the house of Hana's house and kneels just to get permission from the family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Seohoo sees Won and Hana and is anxious and angry towards Hana. She confesses a secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Hana confesses her doubts to friends after choosing Seohoo. Seohoo returns from the business trip.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Hana watches Seohoo's performance. She meets Won afterward. Seohoo sees Hana's empty seat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Won leaves for his business trip in Paris as scheduled. Upon his return, he looks for a sewing box with Hana.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Hana and Won prepare a unique wedding ceremony that symbolizes their relationship.

Entries.Title: Blood
Entries.Description: Park Ji-sang, a surgeon, leads a double life. While he tries to save his patients' lives, on the other hand, he is also a vampire who constantly craves for blood.

Entries.Title: Hwajung
Entries.Description: Fair Princess Jungmyung lives a life of the highest privilege, until her half-brother Prince Gwanghae executes the rightful crown prince and usurps the throne. Exiled from court, Jungmyung goes under disguise as a man and learns to adapt to life as a commoner — never forgetting Gwanghae's wrongdoing. But amidst rampant corruption throughout the kingdom, can Jyungmyung exact her vengeance, restore order and take back her rightful place in the palace?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Prince Gwanghae has been Crown Prince for 16 years without being confirmed. As the son of a concubine, he doesn't have the safety that his new-born brother, Grand Prince Yeongchang has. As King Seojo contemplates rescinding Prince Gwanghae's title, the nation is divided on who they support.

Entries.Title: Beating Again
Entries.Description: After his uncle's unjust takeover of the family company, Kang Min Ho grows up to be a successful, if not cynical investor who only cares about money. But when he undergoes a sudden heart transplant surgery, Min Ho literally has a change of heart when he inherits a warm and compassionate heart. In the midst of seeing the world anew, including falling for the kind Kim Soon Jung, Min Ho must mitigate his newfound personality with the demands of his cutthroat career.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Heartless investment executive Min Ho gets into a fistfight and ends up in a police station, then proposes a deal to the beautiful Soon Jung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: While Dong Wook uncovers a case of product tampering, Min Ho tries to manipulate events but ends up collapsing and going to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Despite his new heart, Min Ho's ways haven't changed: He's still determined to leave Hermia and his uncle in a state of destitution.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Having been delegated a board member for Hermia, Min Ho prepares to take his uncle down, but he has strange feelings whenever Soon Jung is near.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Chairman Kang is puzzled by the behavior of Min Ho and Soon Jung, and Min Ho is surprised to learn about the death of Soon Jung's detective fiancé.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Min Ho begins to suspect his new heart is the cause of his changes. In the meantime, he follows Soon Jung as she does a secret favor for Kang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Despite the death of his uncle, Min Ho can't seem to leave his house, spending his days at home ignoring Soon Jung's work messages.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After some therapeutic revelations about his own true nature, Min Ho shows up at a board meeting to announce his candidacy for CEO.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: After realizing who his heart donor was, Min Ho pauses his relationship with Soon Jung. Joon Hee hatches a plan to force Hermia's bankruptcy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Min Ho puts up his personal fortune as collateral to fund a new Hermia product, while Soon Jung tries to sort out her feelings for her superior.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Min Ho and Soon Jung suspect the hand of Joon Hee is in play when a major supplier on their new product pulls out, halting production.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Min Ho's new product gets a reprieve when an aunt announces her involvement in the project. A personal item of Joon Hee's seems familiar to Min Ho.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Soon Jung is forced to admit that Min Ho has become more like her former love since receiving his heart. Joon Hee hatches a new sabotage scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Min Ho decides to take the drastic step of sharing what he knows about Dong Wook's death with the media, shocking Joon Hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: After an attack on Min Ho and the theft of an incriminating memory card, detectives close in on Joon Hee, but he's quickly disposing of evidence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: As Min Ho prepares to step down and appoint a trustee, it appears that while he has found love with Soon Jung, his nemesis Joon Hee has won the day.

Entries.Title: A Dream Within a Dream
Entries.Description: When Song Xiaoyu is unexpectedly pulled into a scripted world as a tragic heroine fated to be discarded by the villainous male lead, she tries to escape, only to be trapped in an endless loop of fatal outcomes each time she strays from the plot. No matter how hard she resists, the story keeps pushing her toward Nan Heng, the cold and calculating lead. As she navigates this paper-thin world where every character is bound by fate, Song Xiaoyu must fight not just for her survival, but for control over her own story.

Episodes.Title: Becoming the Female Lead
Episodes.Description: During the script-reading for a period drama, Song Xiaoyu feels that it's unfair for Song Yimeng, the female lead. On the other hand, a click on the keyboard sends Song Xiaoyu into the script of Dream of Qingning.

Episodes.Title: Six Months before the Wedding
Episodes.Description: After crossing over into Song Yimeng's body, Song Xiaoyu is surprised to find out that she has arrived six months before her wedding. It seems she now has enough time to gradually change the course of the story.

Episodes.Title: Love Line
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng jumps into the water as soon as he hears Song Yimeng falling into the water. While Song Yimeng is struggling, she sees Nan Heng who looks exactly like Nan Feng. Her first reaction is to never go through the plot with him.

Episodes.Title: Stalling Tactic
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng doesn't know that Nan Heng is determined to kill her. She tries to bargain for her life with the Duan Blade Technique.

Episodes.Title: Law of Mutual Rescue
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng intends to be on good terms with Chu Guihong, who was just released from prison. She tells him how Nan Heng is going to put him on the spot in the imperial court.

Episodes.Title: Assassin
Episodes.Description: Fading River Moon is a guild hall opened in the capital by Nan Heng three years ago in secret. He has another secret identity, which is...

Episodes.Title: Playing Along
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He advises Nan Heng to use his identity as Li Shiliu to get closer to Song Yimeng and sabotage the marriage alliance between the Song and Chu families.

Episodes.Title: Two Li Shi Liu
Episodes.Description: The real and fake Li Shiliu duke it out in Fading River Moon until the real one knocks the mask off of Chu Guihong. Only then could the people see...

Episodes.Title: Everyone Has Their Own Agenda
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu watches as Song Yimeng lets the scroll of the Plan to Kill Heng, covered in writing, slip to the ground. A flicker of tension tightens between his brows.

Episodes.Title: A Wish
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng watches Song Yimeng make a wish sincerely. He tells Song Yimeng that if she can help him get the Duan Blade Technique, no matter what her wish is, he'll help her fulfill it.

Episodes.Title: Fire in the Southern District
Episodes.Description: Concerned about the raging fire at the oil mill, Li Shiliu leads the members of Fading River Moon into the heart of the blaze to help.

Episodes.Title: Once Friends
Episodes.Description: Under the guise of his dual identity, Nan Heng joins Song Yimeng in rebuilding the southern district. In the process, he finally uncovers the reason behind her hatred toward him.

Episodes.Title: Cracking the Secret Symbol
Episodes.Description: When Nan Heng visits his mother, Noble Consort Gao, he accidentally finds clues about the Duan Blade Technique in her old belongings.

Episodes.Title: A Public Proposal
Episodes.Description: Song Yi Meng is in love with Li Shiliu. She refuses to marry Chu Gui Hong.

Episodes.Title: Expressing One's Feelings
Episodes.Description: The emperor interrogates Song Yimeng for instigating the two princes into starting a conflict. To protect Song Yimeng, Nan Heng barges into the imperial study room and bears the blame.

Episodes.Title: Immortal under the Moonlight
Episodes.Description: Li Shiliu pays a secret visit to the Song Residence at late night. As he departs, his striking figure beneath the moonlight catches Song Yiting's eye and sparks her curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Granted Marriage
Episodes.Description: To protect Chu Guihong, the emperor makes a deal with Nan Heng to cancel the marriage between the Song and the Chu families. Nan Heng and Song Yimeng feel happy about the decision but the emperor also grants a marriage between Nan Heng and Song Yimeng.

Episodes.Title: Changing Fate
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wants to kill Nan Heng again. She has made up her mind to protect the Song family from getting wiped out by Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Concubine
Episodes.Description: Noble Consort Gao invites a group of noble ladies and their daughters to Fanghua Hall. She says that she's going to help Nan Heng choose a concubine. In reality, she's trying to stir Song Yimeng's feelings for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Offense and Defense
Episodes.Description: To keep her sister from being deceived by Nan Heng, Song Yimeng resolves to take action against him.

Episodes.Title: Last Farewell
Episodes.Description: Shangguan He tells Li Shiliu everything about the blade and Song Yiting. Li Shiliu wants Shangguan He to disguise himself as Li Shiliu for one last time tomorrow and retrieve the blade.

Episodes.Title: A Do-Or-Die Plan
Episodes.Description: Zhou Xueyi continues to force Song Yiting to get married. She has had enough and decides to have a union with Li Shiliu when he comes for the sword. Nan Heng dresses up as Li Shiliu to meet her. He then realizes that Song Yiting has lit a drugged incense that causes him to be paralyzed.

Episodes.Title: Identity Revealed
Episodes.Description: The capital is trying to arrest the Night Wandering Gods. Li Shiliu goes to their hiding spot and announces their disbandment. But they think that he's trying to protect them by saving Shangguan He himself. Due to that, they aren't willing to leave.

Episodes.Title: Atone with His Life
Episodes.Description: Learning Shangguan He is going to be executed, Song Yiting asks Song Yimeng for help.

Episodes.Title: Let Go of Yourself
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng is stopped by Nan Heng as she leaves the execution ground. She refuses to listen to his explanation and instead demands that he give an answer to the Night Wandering Gods, who were still desperately defending him even on the eve of the execution.

Episodes.Title: Assassination
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng rushes over when he finds out that Song Yimeng is in danger. He fights the men in black despite his injuries.

Episodes.Title: Destiny Can Be Changed
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng hears about Gao Changying's death. Song Yude says that the rumors circulating in the Capital have pinpointed Nan Heng as the culprit. Song Yimeng insists that Nan Heng won't do something like that.

Episodes.Title: Forced to Extremes
Episodes.Description: Long and Hu are caught and interrogated by Chu Guihong, who resorts to brutal torture just to make them testify against Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong accuses Nan Heng of ordering the assassination of Luyi. Nan Heng refutes the claim, stating that the testimony is fabricated and that the witnesses can be summoned at any time for cross-examination.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: The Gao Residence has been sealed off. His accomplices and everyone in his party are exiled to Han Bei. Nan Heng returns the Tiger Tally of the Armored Soldiers to His Majesty. His Majesty hands him the Crown Prince appointment decree. Nan Heng refuses by saying that he has sinned.

Episodes.Title: World in a Storybook
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng arranges for a proposal at Fading River Moon. However, Song Yimeng rejects him unwillingly after his confession.

Episodes.Title: The Vow
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng brings Song Yimeng to the God of Matchmaker's Temple and vows to protect her and her family. Touched by his confession, Song Yimeng agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: New Life
Episodes.Description: Nan Heng wakes up from his injury. The emperor orders the Eastern Palace to be built on the side of the inner palace for Nan Heng.

Episodes.Title: The Scripted World
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong returns to the capital city with King Qian Yu. While Song Yimeng is waiting for Nan Heng at Fanghua Hall, she accidentally runs into King Qian Yu who calls himself the Screenwriter.

Episodes.Title: In a Different Light
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng takes King Qian Yu to Fading River Moon to let him experience the interesting place. At the same time, she tries to convince him to respect the characters and allow them to live as they please.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: King Qian Yu tells Nan Heng that according to the rule of scripted world, anyone who changes their fate will suffer backlash.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng rushes into King Qian Yu's residence and asks him if he is involved in the poisoning of the emperor and the framing of Nan Rui...

Episodes.Title: Infinity Loop
Episodes.Description: Song Yimeng wakes up from a dream-like death scene. She realizes that she is back at the crown prince's residence. She is thrilled when she sees that Nan Heng is still alive.

Episodes.Title: Launching a Pre-emptive Strike
Episodes.Description: Chu Guihong changes his plans. He frames Nan Heng in advance for the poisoned mandarins the Emperor was having. He intrudes upon the Emperor's bedchamber to do the deed.

Episodes.Title: Turning the Tide
Episodes.Description: The group sets up an ambush in the streets to intercept the Qianyu Army. King Qian Yu shows up and persuades the Qianyu soldiers to switch sides.

Entries.Title: Squid Game
Entries.Description: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

Episodes.Title: Red Light, Green Light
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

Episodes.Title: Hell
Episodes.Description: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

Episodes.Title: The Man with the Umbrella
Episodes.Description: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

Episodes.Title: Stick to the Team
Episodes.Description: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

Episodes.Title: A Fair World
Episodes.Description: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

Episodes.Title: Gganbu
Episodes.Description: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

Episodes.Title: VIPS
Episodes.Description: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

Episodes.Title: Front Man
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

Episodes.Title: One Lucky Day
Episodes.Description: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Bread and Lottery
Episodes.Description: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

Episodes.Title: Halloween Party
Episodes.Description: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.
New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

Episodes.Title: Six Legs
Episodes.Description: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

Episodes.Title: One More Game
Episodes.Description: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

Episodes.Title: O ﻿ X
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

Episodes.Title: Friend or Foe
Episodes.Description: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

Episodes.Title: Keys and Knives
Episodes.Description: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

Episodes.Title: The Starry Night
Episodes.Description: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

Episodes.Title: It's Not Your Fault
Episodes.Description: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.
Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.
No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

Episodes.Title: Humans Are...
Episodes.Description: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.
